jobs.title: AI Red Team Engineer
jobs.description: **About Hamming** ----------------- Hamming is the security layer for voice and chat agents. Banks, health systems, and other enterprises are putting agents on phone lines where anyone can reach them, and where the agent can verify identity, read an account, and act. We attack those agents before criminals do, with the owner's permission, show what they fall for, and keep every fix tested on every release. We are one of the fastest engineering teams in the world. We prod deploy 4x / day. Devin Case Study Ranked \#1 Eng team OpenAI Dev Day 100billion token list **The role** ------------ Our researchers find the failure by hand. You make it happen a thousand times, against authorized targets, with evidence a customer can inspect, and again on every release. You own the harness: the runner that places calls and chat sessions, the evaluators that decide what a result means, and the replay that shows what changed. Thousands of concurrent calls, bounded, cancellable, observable. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build the attack harness.** A new technique is a new definition, not a new system. * **Generate useful variations.** Branch multi\-turn scenarios and voice conditions with the objective and conditions explicit. * **Make results trustworthy.** A successful attack, a refusal, an infrastructure failure, and an inconclusive result are distinguishable and inspectable. * **Make findings reproducible.** Scenario, configuration, model versions, tool events, outcomes, replay, and comparison. * **Keep fixes fixed.** Validated findings become regression tests that run on every change, with noise controlled. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years building backend services, async workers, or test infrastructure in Python or TypeScript, with the failure cases and the tests. * An adversarial mind: offensive tooling, CTFs, fuzzing, or a security project. The title does not matter. * Judgment about evidence: when an automated evaluator is enough and when a human has to look. * Idempotency, backpressure, observability, and limits that are enforced rather than documented. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Agent frameworks, voice or telephony systems, or LLM evaluation infrastructure * A security finding of your own, responsibly disclosed **How we work** --------------- We start with the customer problem, ship daily, and let evidence decide what comes next. Use AI tools to move faster and own the result. Direct, low ego, serious work. **Benefits and perks** ---------------------- * Competitive salary and meaningful equity * Health, dental, and vision coverage * Every frontier AI tool, fully paid, from day one * Conferences and events we sponsor * Flexible PTO * Offices in San Francisco and Austin; remote in the United States for most roles

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are accepting applications from individuals with backgrounds in deep learning, model research, and related areas of artificial intelligence to join our AI Research Engineer expert network for future independent project consideration. Potential projects involve carefully reviewing AI\-generated explanations and examples, evaluating research reasoning, and identifying where proposed answers are inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading. **Apply at https://work.atasc.ai/join?entry\=profile** **Duties** Depending on the scope of a future project, contributions may include: * Review AI\-generated explanations and examples involving deep learning, model architectures, training methods, and model research. * Evaluate research reasoning, including experimental assumptions, methods, supporting evidence, and conclusions. * Identify potential problems such as confounded experiments, data leakage, inappropriate baselines, inconsistent evaluation protocols, and unsupported performance claims. * Assess whether ablation studies and model comparisons isolate the intended variables and support the conclusions presented. * Provide clear feedback explaining what needs correction and why, including limitations affecting reproducibility or interpretation. * Suggest appropriate checks that could strengthen an answer without claiming experiments, tests, or results that have not been completed. **Experience** * Relevant background in deep learning, model research, machine learning experimentation, or related areas through professional work, research, relevant study, or practical projects. * Ability to explain your individual contributions, research decisions, and methods for checking your conclusions. * Strong analytical reasoning and attention to detail when examining experimental designs, model evaluations, and technical explanations. * Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and identify missing information, uncontrolled variables, or misleading conclusions. Applicants at different career stages, including those with early\-career experience, are welcome. Describe your background and contributions honestly. A human reviewer evaluates your contributions and supporting evidence rather than assuming expertise from a job title. **Application Process** Applicants must be **18 or older**. Complete one profile application with your background, education, résumé, and responses to short expertise questions. Select all specialty areas that match your experience. For this specialty, the intake includes the following example: *An ablation claims a gain but changes the training data and evaluation protocol together. Explain how you would isolate variables, compare baselines, and report reproducibility limits.* Focus on your reasoning and proposed checks. Do not disclose confidential work or present unperformed experiments, tests, or outcomes as completed results. Profiles are reviewed before any later verification steps. Identity documents and a separate expertise file are not required to apply. Submitted evidence is not automatically considered verified. Regulated work requires a separate review of relevant credentials and the actual project scope. Approval means eligibility for future project matching, not professional licensure or guaranteed work. Any assignment depends on availability and agreed project terms. Compensation is agreed separately for each actual project. **This is an application for future project consideration, not a currently open paid assignment or funded vacancy.** Enrollment is free. Acceptance into the network does not guarantee assignments or earnings. Pay: $50\.00 \- $100\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Migration Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Lead Cloud Migration Engineer to support a large scale data center migration to Microsoft Azure for a healthcare payer organization. This role is a key contributor within the migration factory, responsible for executing repeatable migration activities across multiple waves, including building target environments, coordinating testing, executing cutovers, and managing post go live stabilization. The Lead Cloud Migration Engineer is the single technical authority for the Azure migration program. This is not a pure advisory or design role — you will design, build, validate, and execute. You will set technical standards, own the infrastructure\-as\-code delivery, lead cutover nights, and be accountable for the technical integrity of every migration from Wave 1 through Wave 4\. The right person brings both architectural depth (landing zone design, governance, security baselines) and hands\-on migration execution experience (Azure Migrate, ASR, Bicep, DNS cutover, rollback procedures). If you have only designed on whiteboards, this is not the right role. If you have only executed migrations without owning the architecture, this is not the right role. We need both. The ideal candidate is hands on, highly organized, and comfortable operating in structured, wave based migration programs within regulated healthcare environments (HIPAA/HITECH), where precision, communication, and operational rigor are critical. **Key Responsibilities** Design and own the Azure Landing Zone: hub\-and\-spoke network topology, ExpressRoute/VPN connectivity, NSG policy, DNS zones, subscription and management group hierarchy. Build and maintain the Bicep/ARM module library — the authoritative IaC for all migrated workloads. Every infrastructure component is code; no manual provisioning in production. Define and enforce naming conventions, tagging taxonomy, RBAC model, Azure Policy assignments, and resource lock strategy across all waves. Lead the technical discovery for each application — validate scope, document dependencies (shared SQL instances, integration endpoints, certificate chains, service accounts), and produce the migration design document. Own the Azure Migrate project: configure replication, monitor replication health, manage test failover cycles, and sign off on replication readiness before each approval block opens. Author and maintain the technical runbook (playbook) for every application cutover — step\-by\-step execution sequence, rollback triggers, decision points, and owner assignments. Lead cutover execution on production nights: execute the runbook, manage the technical team, make rollback decisions within the agreed time box, and confirm application health before declaring success. Validate DNS cutover, SSL/TLS certificate continuity, IP allowlist updates, firewall rule migration, and F5/load balancer reconfiguration as part of every cutover sequence. Manage shared SQL instance migrations — coordinate multi\-application joint cutovers, validate data integrity post\-migration (row counts, checksums, referential integrity). Support the Enterprise Architecture review gate in each approval block — produce the technical evidence package (network diagram, Bicep validated, security controls mapped, DR tested). Ensure every migrated workload meets BCDR requirements: Azure Backup policy, Azure Site Recovery replication (where applicable), RPO/RTO validation, and DR test evidence. Serve as the primary technical escalation point for the delivery team and the QA Engineer during non\-production testing, the approval block, and hypercare. Provide technical input to the CAB submission package — confirm the runbook is approved, Bicep is validated, all pre\-cutover checks are complete, and the rollback procedure is tested. Lead technical retrospectives after each wave — capture lessons learned, update the IaC library, refine the approval block evidence template, and communicate changes to the program team. Mentor junior cloud engineers on Bicep authoring, Azure Migrate configuration, and migration runbook structure. Manage the relationship with managed service provider, and application vendors where vendor involvement is required for migration. **Migration Factory Execution** Execute standardized migration factory processes across multiple application waves Build and configure target environments in Azure following approved landing zone and platform standards Support re hosted, re platformed, and lightly modernized applications Ensure readiness of infrastructure, middleware, and application dependencies prior to migration **Environment Build \& Readiness** Coordinate provisioning of compute, storage, networking, security, and access for target environments Validate environment readiness against migration and security checklists Partner with platform, network, security, and IAM teams to resolve blockers Ensure target environments meet performance, availability, and compliance requirements **Testing Coordination \& Validation** Coordinate and support application, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) Validate connectivity to upstream and downstream dependencies (databases, APIs, batch jobs, vendors) Track test defects and coordinate remediation with application and infrastructure teams Ensure formal sign off prior to scheduled cutovers **Cutover \& Go Live Execution** * Execute application cutovers according to approved runbooks and schedules * Coordinate activities across application, infrastructure, network, security, and business teams * Support data validation, smoke testing, and functional verification post cutover * Ensure minimal disruption to business operations during go live events **Post Go Live Stabilization** * Own post go live (hypercare) support windows for migrated applications * Monitor application behavior and coordinate rapid issue resolution * Track and document post migration defects and lessons learned * Support formal transition to steady state operations upon stabilization **Documentation \& Reporting** * Contribute to migration runbooks, wave plans, and readiness artifacts * Maintain accurate migration status, risks, and issues * Provide input to continuous improvement of migration factory processes * Support audit and compliance documentation as required **Required Qualifications** * 15\+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications or infrastructure migrations * 10\+ years in cloud/infrastructure engineering, with a minimum of 5 years in Azure specifically (AWS/GCP experience does not substitute). * Led at least two end\-to\-end Azure data center migration programs — from landing zone design through production cutover and hypercare exit. * Personally executed production cutovers using Azure Migrate, including DNS cutover, replication failover, and post\-migration application validation. * Authored Bicep or ARM IaC for multi\-application Azure environments — not just used existing modules, but written them. * Migrated or managed SQL Server in Azure — shared instances, Always On configuration, or database migration using Azure Database Migration Service. * Worked in a regulated environment (HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, FedRAMP, or equivalent) — understands the difference between //'deployed in Azure//' and //'compliant in Azure//'.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** OcyonBio is a partnership development and manufacturing organization focused on advancing gene and cell therapies. OcyonBio provides dedicated autonomous manufacturing capacity with interconnected infrastructure and systems to support phased appropriate development for early development, pre\-clinical, clinical, and commercial start. We behave more like a cGMP incubator space with all regulatory, systems capabilities, and resources to enable CMC data to support regulatory applications. We strive to create a space free of both explicit and implicit discrimination and harassment where everyone feels safe, heard, and valued. The Controls Engineer establishes and manages the site’s automation and process control systems, standards, and procedures for manufacturing equipment, facilities, and utilities. The role provides hands\-on technical expertise throughout system design, commissioning, qualification, operation, and lifecycle support to ensure reliable controls and accurate, accessible process information. Scope includes programmable logic controllers (PLCs), human\-machine interfaces (HMIs), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA), building management systems (BMS), control logic, automation software, and associated process data systems. The role owns the automation application and control functionality. Information Technology (IT) retains responsibility for site network infrastructure, enterprise software, and IT services; shared interfaces, infrastructure support, and cybersecurity activities are coordinated with IT. Place of Performance CII George Sanders, Aguadilla Pueblo, Aguadilla P.R. 00603\. **Key Responsibilities** Automation Program Development and Site Start Up * Establish the site automation program, system inventory, criticality assessments, technical standards, and lifecycle support plans for manufacturing and engineering systems. * Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for automation changes, configuration and version control, access administration, backups, recovery, alarm management, and troubleshooting. * Create and maintain controlled repositories for PLC programs, HMI applications, BMS configurations, recipes, software versions, licenses, and vendor documentation. * Define automation requirements and review control designs, sequences of operation, input/output lists, interlocks, alarm settings, control narratives, and system interfaces. Control Systems Engineering and Operational Support * Configure, program, troubleshoot, and optimize PLCs, HMIs, BMS, and related control applications within approved change control and qualification requirements. * Support automated manufacturing equipment, heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), critical utilities, and other process control systems; diagnose faults across instruments, controllers, actuators, and application interfaces. * Manage control sequences, operating parameters, recipes, alarms, permissives, and interlocks in coordination with system owners; verify safe failure and restart behavior. * Lead automation root\-cause investigations and implement corrective actions to improve reliability, availability, and process performance. * Provide technical support and training to Manufacturing, Engineering, and Maintenance personnel; coordinate vendor escalation and planned or urgent automation interventions. Process Data and Automation System Administration * Establish controls for process data collection, trends, alarm and event histories, reports, and interfaces so records remain complete, accurate, retrievable, and traceable. * Define application user roles, permissions, audit trail settings, time synchronization needs, and data retention requirements with Quality and system owners; coordinate implementation with IT as applicable. * Establish and verify backup and restoration of control programs, configurations, and applicable process records; develop and test recovery plans with IT and vendors. * Coordinate industrial communications, remote vendor access, patches, and cybersecurity controls with IT; assess effects on process operation and the validated state before implementation. Commissioning Qualification and Quality Support * Support factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, and qualification of automated systems, including control logic, alarms, interlocks, data handling, and recovery functions. * Prepare or review user requirements, functional specifications, risk assessments, test protocols, and traceability documents in collaboration with Engineering, Quality, and Validation. * Support computerized system validation and applicable current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP), electronic records, electronic signatures, and data integrity requirements. * Assess automation changes, deviations, and corrective and preventive actions; document testing and maintain approved configurations and the validated state. * Serve as the automation subject matter expert during audits and inspections; support periodic system reviews and closure of identified gaps. Lifecycle Planning and Vendor Coordination * Develop automation obsolescence, upgrade, spare parts, and service support plans; identify risks from unsupported hardware, software, or unavailable source code. * Coordinate automation vendors and integrators, define scopes of work, review deliverables, and support budgets and procurement for controls projects. * Track recurring failures, automation downtime, backup and recovery readiness, and improvement actions; execute work under site safety and cleanroom requirements. Qualifications * Hands\-on proficiency in PLC programming and troubleshooting, HMI configuration, control logic, instrumentation, and industrial automation software. * Ability to interpret electrical schematics, piping and instrumentation diagrams, control narratives, and industrial communications architectures. * Working knowledge of BMS, SCADA, process data collection, alarm management, configuration control, and backup and recovery practices. * Understanding of regulated automation lifecycle practices, computerized system validation, change control, and data integrity; familiarity with 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, and GAMP 5 principles preferred. * Strong analytical, organizational, technical writing, and communication skills; ability to work independently and collaborate with IT, Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering. * Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and technical documentation tools. Education and Experience * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Controls, Automation, Computer, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Minimum three (3\) years of relevant industrial automation or process controls experience, including hands\-on PLC and HMI work. * Experience in pharmaceutical, biologics, or other regulated manufacturing preferred; aseptic manufacturing and facility start\-up experience are desirable. * Experience with platforms such as Rockwell Automation or Siemens, BMS applications, and automation vendors or system integrators preferred. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary (DOE) * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Training and professional development * Stock option program participation Physical Requirements * Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods. * Able to lift 25 pounds occasionally. * Ability to work in laboratories, cleanrooms, and manufacturing areas using required PPE. **We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer** OcyonBio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you want to challenge yourself and accelerate your career, there is no better place than here with our team. Join us today.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ NYC, NY **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Go To Market **Deployment Strategist** ========================= **About Us** ------------ STLabs is an AI service management platform that resolves employee requests end\-to\-end, grounded in a living model of the enterprise. This matters because we’re able to resolve requests with full context \- the people, systems, services, and policies that define how an organization actually runs. Requests that used to take days of back\-and\-forth resolve in minutes, right where employees already work. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist to own the customer experience from first touch through go\-live. You’ll work directly with enterprise customers to understand their biggest challenges, identify where STLabs can make an impact, and partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to turn those opportunities into value. As one of our earliest GTM hires, you’ll also help define how we bring STLabs to customers and scale deployments as the company grows You don’t need a technical background or prior deployment experience to succeed in this role. We’re looking for someone who’s eager to learn, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and excited to take ownership in a fast\-moving startup environment. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy being the person who makes things happen. You’re comfortable walking into a room full of people you don’t know, asking the right questions, and earning their trust. You can take an ambiguous problem, figure out what matters, and rally people around a solution. You don’t need to have all the answers, but you should be excited to find them. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own customer engagements:** Build trusted relationships with customers and serve as their primary point of contact during pilots and deployments. Understand their pain points and translate business needs into actionable use cases and deployment plans. * **Define and prove success.** Set clear success criteria with each customer at the start of a pilot, track progress against them, and own the outcome. * **Make deployments happen.** Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our Forward Deployed Engineers to take pilots from concept to execution. Own timelines, anticipate roadblocks, and do whatever it takes to deliver a successful outcome. * **Drive adoption post\-go\-live**. Train the customer’s team, get employees using STLabs in their day\-to\-day, and watch for drop\-off after launch. * **Bridge customers and product:** Translate customer feedback and operational challenges into actionable insights for our Product and Engineering teams. * **Help build the playbook.** We’re an early\-stage company, and much of how we operate is still being defined. You’ll help shape how we scope, execute, and scale customer deployments as we grow. **Qualifications** ------------------ * **0–3 years of professional experience**. Previous experience or internships in consulting, strategy and operations, business development, or customer\-facing roles are a plus, but not required. * **You’re exceptional with people.** You communicate clearly, build relationships naturally, and know how to earn trust. You’re comfortable engaging with everyone from individual contributors to senior executives. * **You’re a structured thinker.** You can take an ambiguous problem, break it down into manageable pieces, and figure out a path forward. * **You have a bias toward action.** You don’t wait for perfect instructions or someone else to solve a problem. You take initiative, find creative solutions, and follow through. * **You’re relentlessly curious.** You love learning how things work, asking questions, and getting up to speed on unfamiliar topics. You’re excited about technology and its potential to transform how businesses operate. * **You sweat the details.** You can juggle multiple priorities without losing sight of the little things that make a difference, especially when working with customers. * **You’re comfortable with ambiguity.** You thrive in environments where priorities change quickly, processes aren’t always defined, and figuring things out is part of the job. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Meaningful responsibility from day one.** We’re a small team tackling big problems. You’ll work directly with enterprise customers, own critical projects, and see the impact of your work firsthand. * **A front\-row seat to building a company.** Work closely with our founders, engineers, and customers, gaining firsthand exposure to everything from product development and customer strategy to GTM and company operations. * **Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package.** * **Collaborative, in\-person environment.** Work alongside the founding team in our Midtown Manhattan office, with opportunities to travel to customer sites. As an equal opportunity employer, we don’t tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind. Whether that’s based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **New York, NY · Full\-time · Hybrid (in office 3 days a week) · $150,000 \- $275,000 \+ equity** ***We’re deploying advanced agents into the real world to solve some of the biggest pain points in healthcare, and bringing the JOY back to healthcare by fixing the financial chaos behind it.*** Every year, healthcare practices fail to collect an estimated $125 billion in earned revenue. The money disappears into fragmented financial data, manual workflows, and opaque payer systems that don’t talk to one another. Often, these costs are passed on to patients through higher bills or rising health costs, and for many practices the losses are fatal. Joyful Health builds AI agents that take on insurers so providers get paid for the care they deliver. We didn’t start with a product. We spent ten months working as fractional CFOs for a dozen practices, doing the work alongside providers before we wrote the technology that automates it. We just announced our $22M Series A, led by CRV, with world\-class investors including the founders of MongoDB and KAYAK. Now we’re doubling our engineering team. **About the role** ------------------ We’re hiring one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers to build out the function. You’ll sit between our largest customers and our product, and your core job is to craft our agent harness to meet the real\-world needs of practices. You’ll design how our agents are orchestrated and train them on how each practice actually operates. To do that, you’ll embed with practices and their revenue cycle teams, learn how money moves through their systems, and build what gets them paid: agent workflows, data integrations, and custom tooling deployed on Joyful’s platform. This is an engineering role with a commercial edge, well suited to founders and future founders. You’ll ship production code, lead working sessions with customers, and help grow accounts. You’ll also turn what you learn in the field into what we build next. As a founding FDE, you’ll write the playbook: how we onboard customers, what gets reused, what goes back to the product, and eventually how we build the team. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Own customer deployments end to end, from signed contract to a live, measurable result. Get each practice’s data flowing into Joyful, encode their payer rules and workflows into how our agent works, and keep tuning it as results come back. * Direct our agent and build account\-specific solutions quickly (agent logic, analyses, automations, dashboards), then work with engineering to fold the winners into the core platform. * Run working sessions with customers’ revenue cycle teams. Map their workflows, find where revenue slips through, and turn that into a scoped plan with clear outcomes. * Create SOPs and work closely with our revenue cycle specialists, turning what they learn from accounts into better agent behavior. * Partner with the account team on renewals and expansion, bringing the results and insights that show customers the value we deliver. Be the engineer customers trust. * Be the voice of the customer inside Joyful. Turn field insight into clear problem statements, specs and roadmap input. * Build the FDE function: deployment playbooks, reusable patterns, internal tooling, success metrics and, over time, helping grow the team. **We’d love to hear from you if…** ---------------------------------- * **You’re passionate about Joyful Health’s mission.** You want to solve real, pressing problems for providers and put them in control of their businesses. You naturally empathize with users and enjoy building with their needs in mind. * **You’re an engineer who loves being in front of customers.** You have 3\+ years of full\-time engineering experience in software, AI or data engineering, and you’ve moved toward customer\-facing work, whether as an FDE, a solutions or deployment engineer, or the engineer who always ended up on customer calls. * **You have strong technical execution.** You’re AI\-native and fluent in Python and SQL, comfortable across backend systems, data pipelines and APIs, and experienced integrating with messy third\-party systems. You’ve built hands\-on with LLMs and agents, from turning business rules into agent logic to debugging it when it gets things wrong. Side projects count. * **You think commercially.** You can find the business problem behind a feature request, scope work to the outcome that matters, and explain technical trade\-offs to a practice owner as easily as to an engineer. * **You have a radical sense of ownership.** You’ve shown clear growth in scope and responsibility, you thrive in ambiguity, and you can turn a single customer conversation into a plan and a working prototype. * **You have a low ego and a growth mindset**, and you’re excited to shape our engineering team and culture as an early team member. * **Education:** a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Bonus points** * You’ve been a founder or an early engineer at a startup. * You have experience with healthcare data, revenue cycle management or payer workflows. It’s not required, but you’ll need to get deep fast: within weeks you’ll be reading remits and researching payer policy. * You’ve done the unglamorous data work that makes messy real\-world inputs usable. **Working at Joyful** --------------------- **Meaningful impact.** You’ll work on one of the most hair\-on\-fire problems providers face, so they can focus on caring for patients. **Autonomy and ownership.** As our founding FDE, you’ll shape the function and the company from the ground up. **Growth and learning.** You’ll get direct access to experienced founders and advisors, plus stipends for professional development courses and books. **Competitive compensation and equity.** $150K \- $275K base, plus strong equity in Joyful Health. **Be your best self.** Comprehensive healthcare benefits, unlimited PTO (with a minimum of 10 days off a year), flexibility, and regular team off\-sites and events. Please apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. Nobody checks every box every time, and we’d love to talk with you about how you see yourself growing into this role. We’re also very open to candidates with non\-traditional experience. *Joyful Health is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Who are we?** Newcode helps legal organizations build, govern, and deploy AI workflows connected to their knowledge and existing systems. Our Aurora workflow platform enables teams to turn firm expertise into repeatable workflows that operate within the firm’s technology environment. ### **The role** You'll own the backend behind our AI features. That's the APIs, the data pipelines, and the orchestration sitting between our product and the language models doing the work. In practice it means running retrieval over large sets of documents, getting dependable results out of LLMs and their tool calls, streaming responses to the UI, and processing long jobs in the background without things falling over. It isn't CRUD work. The hard parts here are keeping AI systems accurate and fast with confidential data, at production scale. You'll make architecture calls early and live with them. **Requirements** **Turn how legal work gets done into AI workflows lawyers trust** Newcode helps legal organizations build, govern, and deploy AI workflows connected to their knowledge and existing systems. Our Aurora workflow platform enables teams to turn firm expertise into repeatable workflows that operate within the firm's technology environment. Our clients are law firms and professional\-services teams. They know exactly where their work is slow, repetitive, or risky. What they don't know is how to turn that into an AI workflow they can trust with real client work. We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to do exactly that. This role reports to the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering. ### **The Opportunity** You'll work directly with clients to understand how their work actually gets done, and then build it in Aurora, our visual AI workflow builder. Aurora is low\-code. You design flows by connecting components on a canvas, configure the models, prompts, document search, and integrations, and write a short script where the canvas stops. The hard part isn't the code. It's understanding a messy process well enough to break it into steps a model can do reliably, seeing where it will fail before it does, and showing a skeptical partner at a law firm that it works. This role rewards judgment and engineering discipline more than seniority. We care more about how you think than how many years you've written code. You need to be comfortable with hands\-on technical work. For example, you can read API documentation to connect two systems, edit JSON files, write a short Python function when the canvas is not enough, and find out why a flow stopped working. ### **How the team works** You'll report to the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, who manages the FDEs across our client pods and owns engineering quality, staffing, coaching, and technical delivery practices. What you will own * Sit with clients alongside the senior legal engineer and map how a piece of work gets done today: the inputs, the decisions, the exceptions, and who signs off. * Turn the workflow requirements into working flows in Aurora, such as document intake, clause extraction, contract review, drafting, and multi\-step agents. * Configure the building blocks: prompts, model choice, search over client documents, and connections to the systems clients already use, within each firm's access controls and confidentiality boundaries. * Write python scripts where configuration isn't enough, such as a custom component, a data transformation, or an API call, and flag the ones worth reusing across clients. * Test every flow against real examples and the evals agreed with the firm, find where it fails, and fix it before a client finds it. Show with evidence against the legal acceptance criteria, not a demo, that it works. * Run workshops and pilots, help deliver the AI Academy for each firm's Aurora users, and stay responsible for the flow after it goes live, with a named owner and support plan agreed before release. * Follow the FDE team's delivery playbook and technical standards, including design and code reviews, testing, traceability, monitoring, and human review suited to each flow's intended use. * Give realistic estimates, and raise scope changes, risks, and dependencies early with the senior legal engineer and the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering. * Bring what you learn back, through the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, to Product and Engineering as patterns rather than anecdotes: missing features in Aurora, recurring requests and how often they come up, and bugs. * Help the team track delivery time, effort, workflow adoption, and component reuse, so that estimates and client outcomes improve over time. ### **What you bring** * You think in structure. Give you a vague process and you break it into clear steps, inputs, and decisions, and you see where it will go wrong. * You learn a new domain fast. You don't need a law degree, but you'll want to understand how a lawyer reviews a contract or runs a due diligence. * You explain things clearly to a law their needs, and help them realize the immense value AI can create. As part of our collaborative, high\-growth team, you'll work side by side with visionary founders at the forefront of AI and legal innovation, shaping both our product and the definition of AI native legal work. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work directly with clients on AI that ends up in real legal work, not in a demo. You'll help shape how we deploy Aurora, contributing to the Aurora playbook and the field patterns that make it into the product, and you'll grow with regular coaching from the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, clear technical standards, and a team that delivers repeatably rather than through individual heroics. We believe in being transparent about what it's like to work at Newcode.ai. As a fast\-growing startup, we're building and evolving every day. That means not every process, playbook, or framework is already in place, and priorities can shift quickly. The people who thrive here are comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership, and don't wait for perfect direction. They are resourceful, proactive, and able to "figure it out", solving problems, creating structure where needed, and helping build the company as they go. If you are good with this, great! Keep reading to learn more. **Company stage.** Newcode is a growth\-stage legal AI company founded in 2021\. It has moved beyond early product validation into scaling deployments and expanding in the U.S. The company describes its product as a configurable AI platform that connects a firm's data, systems, and workflows, with controls for permissions, models, and deployment. **Funding.** Newcode has a total funding of $20 million. The Series A was led by OnDean Forward, with participation from The LegalTech Fund, Antiportfolio Ventures, Relativity's investment arm Rel Labs, and existing investors. **Traction and deployments.** Today Newcode serves more than 100 law firms and government agencies in Europe and the United States, with annual recurring revenue more than tripling over the prior 12 months. Check out our webpage for our most recent customers. **Why now is a compelling time to join.** Newcode is at an exciting stage of growth. With fresh Series A funding and strong customer and revenue growth, we are investing in the next chapter of our growth in Europe and the U.S. Our platform is moving beyond standalone AI tools and into the everyday workflows of leading legal teams. From firmwide deployments to integrated legal research, we are helping customers put AI to work on meaningful, real\-world challenges. As we expand our product, customer support, go\-to\-market, and partnerships, you will have the opportunity to take on important work and help shape how we grow. You will join a global team of more than 60 people, with the scale to serve major organizations and the agility to make a visible impact. If you are excited to build practical AI for the legal industry and help shape a company's next stage of growth, this is a great time to join Newcode. **Benefits** We offer competitive salary, **equity**, and bonus across all locations. Benefits are tailored to each country to meet local requirements and market practice: * **US (Chicago):** Medical, dental, and vision; 401(k); paid time off; * **Norway (Oslo) and Poland (Wrocław):** Statutory benefits plus local offerings, including pension, paid leave, and parental leave ### **The hiring process** * Stage 1: Screening call (15 minutes) * Stage 2: Case assessment: design and build a flow for a realistic client problem (1 hours) * Stage 3: Presentation of your case to the team, including the Head of Forward Deployed Engineering (3 hours) * Stage 4: CEO interview (15 minutes) Newcode is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. **Visa Sponsorship:** At this time, Newcode is unable to provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the applicable country without employer sponsorship.

jobs.title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Full\-Stack AI Engineer — Liza** ================================== **About Liza** -------------- Liza Health is a Cambridge\-based startup building an AI\-enabled platform for modern primary care. Our bet is simple: primary care is the foundation of a healthy US health system, and AI finally makes it possible to rebuild and scale primary care from first principles instead of patching what's broken. Liza was co\-founded by Dr. Rushika Fernandopulle, a practicing physician who previously co\-founded Iora Health, the relationship\-based primary care company later acquired by One Medical and then Amazon, serial tech entrepreneur and investor Andy Palmer and healthcare serial entrepreneur Duncan Reece. We bring decades of experience redesigning care delivery together with a team that builds with frontier AI every day. We work alongside primary care practices to change how care is delivered: more time for relationships, less time on administrative burden, and patients who get the right care at the right time. If you want your engineering work to make care better for real patients and clinicians, this is the place. **The role** ------------ We're hiring AI Engineers who will design, build and ship the AI systems at the core of Liza's care model. You'll own problems end to end: sitting with clinicians and care teams to build real\-world healthcare applications for patients, clinicians and clinical operators. This is a generalist role by design. On any given week you might write a prompt and its eval suite, wire an agent into an EHR via FHIR, build a frontend feature for care coordinators, and develop healthcare data pipelines. We value curiosity, learning fast and shipping well. We don't care much about titles or hierarchy. The AI engineering bar here is the one set at the top AI labs: we A/B\-test agent changes in a harness, LLM judges score replies in production, and we review production traces every week. The difference is where the work lands: in the hands of patients and primary care teams across the US, helping real people live healthier lives while reducing overall healthcare costs. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build production AI applications and agentic systems that support patients, clinicians and care teams across scheduling, intake, documentation, care coordination, outreach and clinical decision support. * Partner directly with patients, physicians, health coaches and operations staff to turn messy, real\-world workflows into clear technical requirements and measurable outcomes. * Work closely with our AI\-native design team to create experiences that are simple, efficient and effective for all of our users. * Design, test and iterate on prompts, context and tool definitions that shape how our models behave, and keep them versioned, reviewed and safe to change. * Define and run evaluations: build gold\-standard datasets with clinicians, write rubrics and automated graders, read transcripts for what the metrics miss, and set launch criteria before anything reaches a patient. * Integrate AI with our healthcare stack: our FHIR backend (Medplum), practice EHRs, HIE aggregators such as Metriport, HL7 interfaces, claims and scheduling systems, and our data platform. * Build with PHI, HIPAA, privacy, security and auditability in mind, including human\-review workflows and clear escalation paths for clinical risk. * Monitor systems in production and use error analysis, observability and user feedback to rapidly improve reliability, cost, latency and model selection. * Turn what we learn into reusable building blocks: shared eval harnesses, agent patterns, integration libraries and internal tools that make the whole team faster. **Who we're looking for** ------------------------- We want exceptional builders who believe in our mission and want to have a great time pursuing it. You'll fit right in if you are: * **A mission\-driven believer.** You think US healthcare can be dramatically better, that primary care is where that change starts, and that AI is the lever that makes it possible now. You want your work measured in better care, not just shipped features. * **A generalist.** You're comfortable across the stack and across problem types, from backend services and data pipelines to frontends, prompts and evals. You pick up new tools, domains and languages quickly, and you go wherever the problem is. * **An exceptional builder.** You take pride in shipping things people actually use at large scale and you have a track record of doing it. You move from idea to working prototype fast, then have the discipline to make it reliable. Startup experience is deeply appreciated at Liza. * **A strong teammate.** You do your best work on small, cross\-functional teams with clinicians, designers, operators and other engineers. You communicate clearly, share context generously, give and take direct feedback, and care more about the team winning than about who gets credit. * **Someone who has fun.** You bring c inevitable chaos of a startup, and building something meaningful with people you enjoy. * **Someone comfortable with ambiguity.** You can frame an unclear problem, make good calls with incomplete information, and own the outcome. No prior healthcare experience or clinical credentials are required. We'll teach you the domain; we're hiring for curiosity, judgment, craft and heart. **Essential AI skills** ----------------------- Strong candidates will be deep in several and conversant in all. * **Production LLM application engineering.** 5\+ years of software engineering (our stack is TypeScript end to end), with hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-powered products to real users at scale. * **Prompt and context engineering.** Designing, testing and optimizing system prompts, tool descriptions and retrieved context, and knowing each frontier model's strengths and failure modes; treating prompts as versioned, reviewed production code. * **Agents and tool use.** Building agentic workflows with function calling, multi\-step planning, memory and state management, and protocols like MCP, including multi\-agent systems with human oversight built in. * **Evaluation and error analysis.** Building datasets and rubrics with domain experts, LLM\-as\-a\-judge and automated graders, human rating workflows and regression detection, then reading transcripts, finding failure patterns and iterating until quality measurably improves. Evals are how we know a system is safe enough for patients. * **Retrieval and knowledge systems.** RAG pipelines, embeddings, structured knowledge and memory that let models reason reliably over large, messy, heterogeneous data such as longitudinal patient records. * **Full\-stack and systems breadth.** APIs, data infrastructure, web and mobile frontends, cloud deployment, CI/CD, containers and production observability. You can take a system from prototype to reliable production on your own. * **AI\-native development.** Fluency with coding agents and AI\-assisted workflows to multiply your own output. **Like to have** ---------------- * Experience with EHR and interoperability technologies such as Epic, Oracle Health (Cerner), athenahealth, HL7, FHIR, SMART, health information exchanges and data aggregators such as Metriport, Zus, Gorilla Health, Redox. * Exposure to primary care, value\-based care, care coordination or patient access workflows. * Experience fine\-tuning or post\-training models, or building data programs for supervised fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning. * Voice or multimodal AI experience, such as patient\-facing phone agents or ambient documentation. * Prior work as a forward\-deployed engineer, technical founder or early engineer at a startup. * Open\-source contributions, publications or side projects that show your craft. **How we work and what we offer** --------------------------------- * **Small, cross\-functional teams.** Engineers, clinicians, designers and operators work side by side. Every person has real ownership and direct impact on patients. * **One codebase, shared by everyone**. Our APIs, web and mobile apps, infrastructure and agents live in one TypeScript monorepo, and every engineer ships across all of it, with coding agents as everyday tools. * **Speed with rigor.** We prototype fast, test with real users early, and hold a high bar for safety and quality before anything reaches care. * **Fun is part of the job.** We take the mission seriously, not ourselves. Expect team lunches, hack days, celebrating wins together, and colleagues you'll genuinely enjoy. * **Location:** Cambridge, MA, with in\-person collaboration. Hybrid encouraged \- most people are in the office 2\-3 days/week but we are flexible especially after ramp up. * **Compensation:** Competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits. Liza is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, which make us better at building care for everyone.

conversion bottlenecks and use data to prioritize engineering improvements. * Establish monitoring and QA processes so tracking, integrations and lead capture run reliably. **Technical Ownership \& Collaboration** * Serve as a senior technical resource within Marketing, setting development standards and scalable engineering practices. * Own projects end to end, from technical discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment and optimization. * Collaborate with designers, marketers, analysts and operational leaders to turn business objectives into technical solutions. * Balance engineering quality with the speed and experimentation a performance\-driven marketing environment demands. * Create clear documentation and reusable solutions that reduce technical debt and support future growth. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other developers and technical marketers as the team grows. **Required Qualifications** * 6\+ years in software engineering, growth engineering, marketing technology or a closely related technical discipline. * Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS and modern front\-end frameworks such as React or Next.js. * Proven experience building and optimizing production websites and landing pages with measurable conversion outcomes. * Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, third\-party integrations and backend services. * Experience designing automated workflows that connect multiple business systems. * Hands\-on experience with marketing analytics, event tracking, conversion APIs and attribution technologies. * Familiarity with Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 and major digital advertising platforms. * Experience with A/B testing, conversion rate optimization and performance\-driven web development. * Working knowledge of SQL, data structures and data flows between systems. * Experience with Git, modern deployment pipelines, testing and production debugging. * Ability to independently scope technical problems, recommend solutions and execute with limited oversight. * Strong understanding of web performance, responsive design, accessibility and technical SEO. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing AI\-powered workflows using LLM APIs, agentic frameworks or automation tools. * Proficiency in Python or Node.js for scripting, backend services and integrations. * Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make or Zapier. * Experience integrating CRM, marketing automation, lead management and call\-tracking platforms. * Familiarity with server\-side tracking, Google Ads Enhanced Conversions and Meta Conversions API. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, serverless functions and scalable web architectures. * Background in high\-volume lead generation, performance marketing or direct\-response marketing. * Experience supporting multiple brands, business units or websites within a shared technology ecosystem. * Exposure jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - AI Infra Algorithm
jobs.description: **About NeuroSpark** NeuroSpark builds and operates a high\-performance AI inference platform that helps enterprises run large language models faster, cheaper, and at scale. Inference infrastructure is the foundation the entire AI application layer runs on — every AI product ultimately depends on how fast, how reliably, and how affordably models can serve their users. Our vision is to make that layer so efficient that compute is never the reason a good AI product fails.**About the Role** ------------------ Serving inference at scale is a scheduling problem. Requests arrive with wildly different shapes and latency expectations, GPUs are heterogeneous and expensive, and the difference between a platform that's fast and one that's economical usually comes down to how well work gets placed. That system is what you'll own. You'll design and build the scheduling and routing layer of our platform: how requests get admitted, prioritized, batched, and placed across a heterogeneous multi\-cloud GPU fleet, under real multi\-tenant load and real latency commitments. This is core\-systems work with a clean slate — you'll be making the foundational architectural decisions, not maintaining someone else's, and the quality of those decisions will show up directly in our margins and our customers' latency numbers. You'll work close to the metal and close to the math. Some days that means reasoning about queueing behavior and control loops on a whiteboard; other days it means profiling Go or Rust until the tail latency comes down. We're a small team, so you'll own systems end\-to\-end — design, implementation, rollout, and the production reality afterward.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own the scheduling and routing layer** — design and build request admission, prioritization, batching, and placement across a heterogeneous GPU fleet spanning multiple clouds and accelerator types * **Engineer for latency and utilization at once** — drive down tail latency while driving up fleet utilization; these fight each other, and resolving that tension well is the job * **Model the system, not just code it** — apply queueing theory, control theory, and load\-shedding principles to make the platform behave predictably under bursty, multi\-tenant traffic * **Build multi\-tenant fairness and isolation** — ensure priority guarantees and SLO commitments hold when the fleet is saturated and customers are competing for the same capacity * **Own it in production** — instrument, observe, and debug distributed behavior in a live system; carry your designs through rollout and real\-world load * **Set the technical bar** — make foundational architecture decisions, write the design docs that anchor them, and raise the engineering standard of everyone around you **Qualifications** ------------------ This is an individual\-contributor role. We're looking for someone who has built systems like this before and can operate independently from the first week.* Substantial experience building and operating large\-scale distributed systems in production — you've owned something load\-bearing, not just contributed to it * Track record of designing core systems from zero to one, and living with the consequences of your architectural decisions * Hands\-on experience with scheduling, load balancing, request routing, or resource allocation systems * Strong systems fundamentals — operating systems, networking, concurrency — and the ability to reason quantitatively about system behavior using queueing theory, control theory, or similar * Fluency in a performance\-sensitive language (Go, Rust, or C\+\+), with the profiling and optimization instincts that come from actually chasing latency in production * Comfort with GPU infrastructure and LLM inference fundamentals — batching, KV cache behavior, throughput/latency tradeoffs; deep expertise here is a plus, but strong distributed\-systems judgment matters more * Clear technical writing — you can make a hard design decision legible to people who weren't in your head * An AI\-native way of working — you use AI tools daily and have your own view of how they change how infrastructure gets built * Mandarin proficiency is preferred for this role **Nice to have:** Kubernetes and multi\-cloud operations experience; open\-source contributions to inference, serving, or scheduling projects; experience operating GPU clusters at scale.**Why This Role** ----------------- * Ownership of a core system at the foundation of the platform, with the architectural latitude that comes with building it first * Meaningful equity — we expect the people who build the foundational systems to own a real piece of what they build * A small, high\-caliber team where the distance between a good idea and it running in production is measured in days **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- The base salary range for this position is **$170,000 – $350,000 per year**. The range reflects the position across experience levels; actual base salary will be determined by job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location, and may fall anywhere within the stated range. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for equity in the company, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage, and other benefits.**Additional Information** -------------------------- We are able to sponsor H\-1B and other work visas for qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Principal AI Ops Engineer
jobs.description: **Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure** Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system. Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** You will build the systems that let AI agents, not people, do most of the work of running Crux's TPU fleet. Reporting to our Director, AI Ops, you will be one of the first engineers on the team, writing the telemetry pipelines, correlation logic, and agents that detect, triage, and remediate failures across facilities, TPU hosts, the network, and the control plane before a customer notices. You will turn every runbook into code and every repeat incident into automation. This is a hands\-on engineering seat: you write and ship the software, then operate it in production. **In this role, you will:** * Build and own the telemetry and event pipeline that ties together power, cooling, TPU hosts, interconnect, and the control plane, with the correlation to tell a failing pump from a failing chip from a failing job. * Write AI agents that triage alerts, execute runbooks, drain and requeue workloads, and open hardware repair and RMA requests with Google, with every action logged, reversible, and measured. * Turn runbooks into code, so that every critical failure mode for the first build maps to a signal, an alert, an automated response, and an owner. * Build the guardrails that keep autonomous actions safe: blast\-radius limits, approval gates for high\-risk changes, and tested rollback paths. * Define and instrument SLOs and error budgets with Compute, Network Engineering, and Facility Operations, and build the views the team reviews every week. * Take part in on\-call and incident response, and drive postmortems that end in a fix that ships, not an action item that ages. * Measure the share of operational work that closes with zero human touch, and drive that number up release over release. **SIGNALS OF SUCCESS** **After 60 days in this role:** * Gained a complete understanding of the first\-build architecture, the failure modes that matter most, and the tooling in place today, and shipped a first working agent against a real, repeat failure. * Stood up the first version of the unified telemetry pipeline for the first build. * Adapted to a fast\-paced environment, triaging appropriately and continuously improving our function. **After 6 months:** * Taken the first Stage 1 cluster into production with automated detection and remediation in place for its top failure modes. * Shipped agents the team relies on every day, with a measured share of incidents resolved without human intervention. * Built the guardrails and audit trail that let the team trust autonomous actions in production. **After 1 year:** * Running automation across a multi\-site fleet where most repeat operational work executes autonomously, with measurable gains in availability, recovery time, and cost per chip. * Built a library of agents and runbooks\-as\-code that every new site inherits on day one. * Become a reason strong SRE and operations engineers choose Crux. **EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH** **Experiences** * 10\+ years in software engineering, SRE, or production engineering for large\-scale infrastructure, including operating a fleet across many sites against hard SLAs. * Built and shipped AI\-driven operations systems in production, such as event correlation, anomaly detection, auto\-remediation, or agentic triage, with measurable results. * Strong software skills in Python or Go, and hands\-on experience with observability stacks (for example Prometheus or OpenTelemetry), Kubernetes, and large\-scale data pipelines. **Attributes** * You are outcome driven and hands\-on. You read the telemetry and write the agent yourself. This is a builder's seat, not a supervisory one. * You are close enough to the hardware to be useful. You understand how power, cooling, accelerators, and networks fail, not just how software does. * You have a high tolerance for ambiguity. You absorb ambiguity and navigate complexity rather than passing it along. **Mindset** * You are skeptical by default. "90% automated" is a hypothesis until it survives a bad night at a new site. You build the system that makes the next incident boring. * You deliver reliability through discipline, not heroics. You would rather fix the cause once than page someone twice. * You are AI\-agentic first. Fluent with AI agents, or committed to becoming so quickly, you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process. **Nice to have (Preferred, not required):** * SRE or production engineering at a hyperscaler (Google, Meta, Microsoft, AWS) or a neocloud (CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe). * Experience operating TPU or GPU clusters for large training and inference workloads, including hardware health, repair workflows, and fleet telemetry. * Experience with data center infrastructure telemetry such as BMS, DCIM, or power and cooling systems. * Experience building LLM\-based agents with tool use, evaluations, and safety controls in production. * Experience with predictive maintenance, ML\-based anomaly detection, or failure prediction at fleet scale. **Salary Range Information** The annual salary range for this position has been estimated based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. **About Crux** * We offer generous base, bonus and additional incentive based compensation * Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life insurance and disability * Full suite of other optional benefits * 401(k) Plan with 4% company match * Hybrid schedule offering four days in\-office collaboration paired with one remote workday for focused, individual work

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Job Summary Reporting to the Engineering Manager, or any other individual designated by the Company, the Project Engineer is accountable for the planning, coordination, and execution of engineering projects and the implementation of capital and sustaining projects from concept through commissioning. The Project Engineer is responsible for managing multiple projects through various stages of development and execution, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, and compliance requirements are met. Most design and estimating activities are performed by external engineering firms, requiring the Project Engineer to maintain strong working relationships, direct and evaluate their deliverables, and ensure proper technical and commercial controls are in place. The role works under general direction, exercises independent technical judgment, and recommends solutions and project decisions to the Engineering Manager. All roles at NewRange serve as a courageous safety leader, leading by example and fostering a proactive safety and sustainability culture based on the common values of health, safety, environment, and communities. Responsibilities Project Engineering * Planning and coordinating engineering projects from concept through implementation and close\-out, working independently under general direction. * Development of project scopes, schedules, budgets, and technical documentation, and manage projects to the approved scope, schedule, and budget. * Track project progress, deliverables, and milestones, identify risks and deviations from the plan, and take corrective action or escalate with recommendations. * Coordinate project activities with internal departments including operations, maintenance, procurement, and environmental teams. Engineering Design \& Technical Review * Direct external engineering firms responsible for project design and cost estimation, and evaluate their deliverables for technical quality, cost, and schedule. * Review engineering drawings, technical specifications, and project documentation, and accept or return deliverables with required corrections. * Review construction drawings, layouts, and equipment specifications for technical adequacy and recommend approval. * Provide technical direction during equipment installation, construction activities, and system upgrades. * Troubleshoot technical issues and develop practical engineering solutions. Construction \& Commissioning * Provide field leadership during construction, installation, and commissioning of engineering projects. * Inspect installations to verify compliance with engineering designs and project specifications and resolve deviations. * Manage contractors and vendors during project execution, including scope, schedule, and change control. * Support start\-up activities and operational handover to site teams. Documentation \& Continuous Improvement * Maintain accurate project documentation, reports, and engineering records. * Prepare technical reports, project updates, and presentations for project stakeholders and management. * Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to lessons learned reviews following project completion. Other Duties * Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned to meet operational needs. This job description is intended to provide a summary of the typical functions of the job and is not a comprehensive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks, and duties. NewRange reserves the right to modify or assign other duties as necessary to meet operational needs. Requirements: Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Environmental, Mining, or related discipline). * Minimum of five (5\) years of engineering experience in mining, heavy industrial, manufacturing, construction, or infrastructure projects. * Knowledge of local building codes and regulatory requirements is an asset. * Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is considered an asset. * Professional Engineer (PE) license, or the ability to obtain licensure within 3 years of hire. Skills and Abilities * Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical documents. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including independent judgment in resolving unusual technical problems. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook. * Familiarity with engineering design or project management software (e.g., AutoCAD, project scheduling tools) is considered an asset. * Ability to work independently under general direction and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams. Physical Job Requirements \& Working Conditions This role requires the ability to work in both office and active project site environments, including occasional travel to operating or construction sites. Physical requirements may include extended periods of sitting and computer use, walking on uneven terrain, climbing stairs or accessing elevated platforms, and wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE) such as hard hats, safety glasses, steel\-toe boots, respiratory protection and high\-visibility clothing. The position may involve exposure to varying weather conditions, noise, dust, and other typical construction or industrial site environments, while maintaining a strong commitment to safety and compliance with all health, safety, and environmental standards. Refer to the position\-specific Physical Inventory for details. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement NewRange is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer (Perception)
jobs.description: Sabanto is a venture\-backed, Illinois\-based technology company on a mission to drive autonomy into agriculture. We believe the agriculture industry's lack of labor will drive the adoption of Farming\-as\-a\-Service companies using autonomous equipment. It's this very spirit that drives us to build a robotic machinery platform, delivering a service that brings unprecedented efficiency, productivity, and cost to farmers. Join our fast\-growing, industrious, and passionate team of innovators as we continue to disrupt the multi\-billion\-dollar agriculture industry. As a Perception\-focused Robotics Engineer at Sabanto, you will be building the sensing and perception systems that let autonomous tractors and other agricultural equipment see and understand the world around them. You will take real sensors from the bench to production field environments — dust, glare, rain, crop canopy and all — and turn their data into a reliable picture of the world that our navigation, safety and control systems can trust. **RESPONSIBILITIES \& OUTCOMES** * Design, build and harden perception pipelines — obstacle detection, classification and tracking — that keep autonomous agricultural equipment operating safely in the field * Integrate real sensors (cameras, LiDAR, radar, GNSS/IMU) onto tractors and implements, including drivers, intrinsic/extrinsic calibration and time synchronization * Fuse multi\-sensor data into a dependable world model that feeds navigation, safety, control and sequencing systems * Evaluate, select and integrate third\-party sensors and perception vendors, from bench prototype through production deployment * Deploy and optimize computer vision models on edge compute within real\-time latency, thermal and power constraints * Build data collection, labeling and evaluation pipelines from field logs to measure and improve perception performance across crops, seasons, lighting and weather * Triage, reproduce and resolve perception issues seen in the field using recorded sensor data * Occasional travel to observe and refine perception systems at customer sites * Write tested, hardened and safe code — unit tests, replay tests against real field data, and on\-vehicle validation before every change ships **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering or a related field * Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem\-solving skills, with comfort in geometry, linear algebra and probabilistic estimation * An entrepreneurial attitude with a keen eye for detail * Can code with and without AI help. * Organized, disciplined, and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously * Industrious – ideally can drive, or willing to learn to drive, tractors, and anything with four wheels * Ag\-gnostic – Excited about learning the ag industry, understanding what's important to farmers and helping them be successful with our offerings **DESIRED EXPERIENCE** * 5\+ years building perception, computer vision or other real\-time sensing applications, with a track record of shipping to production hardware outside the lab * Mastery of C\+\+ and/or Python * Mastery of ROS/ROS2, including sensor drivers and high\-bandwidth message pipelines * Hands\-on experience integrating and calibrating real cameras, LiDAR and/or radar in production environments * Experience with computer vision and point cloud libraries (OpenCV, PCL, Open3D or similar) * Experience training and deploying deep learning models for detection or segmentation on edge hardware (PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson or similar) * Experience with sensor fusion, state estimation and multi\-object tracking (e.g. Kalman filters) * Experience working with Geospatial data a plus * Familiarity with functional safety standards for autonomous machinery (e.g. ISO 25119, ISO 18497, ISO 13849\) a plus * Experience working with Docker\-based software and build pipelines a plus **BENEFITS** At Sabanto, every member of our team moves the needle. With a firm footing in our core company values, we've built a fast\-paced, demanding work culture that allows for the flexibility, autonomy, and career opportunities you'd expect from a growing company. We offer competitive benefits including: * Working on a concept that will forever disrupt the agriculture industry * The chance to make an immediate impact and do the best work of your life * Unlimited Vacation and flexible time * 401k, medical, dental **OUR CORE VALUES** * Own It \- Be self\-driven, entrepreneurial, and efficient * Raise the Bar \- Challenge complacency and mediocrity; be adaptable and agile; details matter * Be As One \- Trust, collaborate, and support; invest in co\-workers and customers * Embrace Curiosity \- Always be learning, be curious and share; be humbled but not embarrassed by mistakes * Do the Right Thing \- Act with integrity, even when no one is looking; be transparent * Empower Farmers \- Create solutions where customers, i.e. farmers, win At Sabanto, we value diversity of culture and background for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.
