jobs.description: As a Robotics Research Engineer on our Robotics team, you'll design, train, and evaluate robotics policies from imitation learning to reinforcement learning to foundation/VLA models using Zeromatter's simulation platform, then validate, and iterate against real hardware. This work is grounded in real customer use cases as much as internal research goals. The manipulation and automation tasks you train and validate often trace directly back to a problem a customer is trying to solve. You'll work closely with our Dynamics team, who own Physics Engine development, to make sure the simulator keeps pace with what policy training needs. You'll be running the experiments, in sim and in the lab, that push our simulator's fidelity and our policies' transfer performance forward together. Responsibilities may vary from month to month, but here are some examples of things you might find yourself working on. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design and run experiments training robotics policies (imitation learning, reinforcement learning, VLA models, etc.) entirely or primarily in simulation. * Work hands\-on with physical robots (e.g. bimanual manipulator arms) to collect real\-world data, validate sim\-trained policies, and characterize the sim\-to\-real gap. * Collaborate with our Dynamics team to identify simulation fidelity gaps that limit transfer performance, and help prioritize and validate fixes. * Build and maintain data pipelines and evaluation frameworks/benchmarks for policy training and transfer performance. * Prototype new tasks and domains (e.g. dexterous manipulation, cross\-embodiment transfer), often grounded in real customer use cases, to expand what Zeromatter's platform can demonstrate. * Read, evaluate, and adapt techniques from state\-of\-the\-art robot learning research for use on Zeromatter's platform. * Contribute findings and results to customer\-facing technical materials and demonstrations. * Build reusable libraries and tooling (in Python, Rust, and/or C\+\+) to support this work at scale. **Qualifications** ------------------ * You have an engineering or related technical degree (e.g. robotics, computer science, mechanical/electrical engineering, physics) or equivalent hands\-on experience. * Experience training and evaluating robot learning policies (imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and/or foundation/VLA models) gained in industry, in a research lab, or through graduate/postdoctoral work. * Hands\-on experience working with physical robots including collecting data, running experiments, and debugging real\-world hardware/software issues. * Proficient in Python, Rust, and/or C\+\+, with experience in ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. * Comfortable working with incomplete information, iterating quickly between simulation and real\-world validation. * Familiarity with the practical challenges of sim\-to\-real transfer (e.g. domain randomization, system identification, observation/action space design, adaptation). * Bonus: Experience with dexterous manipulation or other contact\-rich manipulation tasks. * Bonus: Experience with cross\-embodiment policy learning or transfer across robot platforms. * Bonus: Experience with teleoperation systems and data collection pipelines. * Bonus: Experience working end\-to\-end across the robotics stack, including perception, classical and learned control systems, task planning, etc. * Bonus: Familiarity with physics/dynamics simulation engines (e.g. MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or custom/proprietary engines). * Bonus: Publication record or open\-source contributions in robot learning, embodied AI, or manipulation.

This role owns compute and networking reference architectures, evaluates NVIDIA and other GPU platform requirements, and establishes repeatable cluster, network, and rack configurations that connect directly to physical facility requirements. This is a systems engineering and infrastructure product role, not routine network administration. External Engineering, OEM \& Vendor Leadership * Direct equipment manufacturers, systems integrators, and external technical partners responsible for detailed design and implementation. * Establish reference specifications, work scopes, technical integration criteria, and review requirements. * Challenge OEM proposals, cluster configurations, network designs, and vendor assumptions. * Identify and maintain approved equipment configurations and qualified alternative suppliers. * Coordinate with facility engineering firms so compute requirements appear correctly in detailed electrical, mechanical, and civil designs. * Standardize equipment installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and deployment requirements. Cross\-Disciplinary Collaboration * Work with electrical, mechanical, and civil disciplines to define integrated infrastructure products. * Support customer technical discovery and evaluate implications of new GPU and networking generations. * Incorporate deployment, commissioning, and operational feedback into revised reference systems. Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Significant AI compute, high\-performance computing, hyperscale data\-center, or large\-scale network experience. * Demonstrated design or architecture experience with GPU clusters, high\-performance networks, or large compute environments. * Strong understanding of InfiniBand, high\-speed Ethernet, network topology, and AI cluster connectivity. * Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU platforms and associated infrastructure requirements. * Experience evaluating technical architectures, OEM equipment, integration constraints, and system\-level tradeoffs. * Ability to lead external technical partners and understand rack\-level power, thermal, and facility interfaces. jobs.description: **Job Title:** Sr. Applied Machine Learning Engineer **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Head of Engineering **ABOUT PLUG** -------------- Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers and commercial partners trade in, sell and auction used EVs on a platform built only for electric vehicles. Nothing in it is adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing and battery state\-of\-health analysis. Pickup, payment and title transfer are handled end to end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers and commercial partners. Sellers get a fast, fair exit, and dealers get a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Plug was founded in 2023 and is led by former Tesla executives. It is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles: operators, engineers and ML researchers building the transaction rails for the fast\-growing used EV market. **WHY PLUG** ------------ * You'll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built only for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company that is rethinking how work gets done. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion\-dollar businesses in automotive, EV and marketplaces. * You'll work alongside a small, senior team, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes. **THE OPPORTUNITY** ------------------- Every car on Plug starts with a number: what is this EV worth today, and what will a dealer pay for it tomorrow? Those numbers come from our models. They draw on auction results, market data, vehicle telematics and battery health. As volume grows, our models have to get more accurate, update faster, and be easier to trust and explain. You'll join our Intelligence team and work alongside our ML engineer and data team, who built the models behind pricing and battery health. Together you'll take those models further: sharper price and volume forecasts, battery state\-of\-health models built from telematics, and LLM pipelines that pull structured data out of vehicle, title and inspection documents. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * Work with the team to build, improve and run in production the models behind instant offers, auction pricing and sell\-through: valuation, price and volume forecasting, and demand signals. * Develop battery state\-of\-health and vehicle\-condition models from telematics and other time\-series data, which is often noisy, sparse or only partly labeled. * Take models through the full lifecycle together with the team: feature pipelines on our Snowflake/dbt stack, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, drift detection and retraining. * Evaluate models by statistical accuracy and by business outcomes such as offer acceptance, margin and arbitration rate, and help build the feedback loops that connect the two. * Bring in LLMs where they work better than traditional models, for example pulling structured data out of vehicle, title and inspection documents. Build the evaluations that show whether they hold up. * Strengthen how the team works as it grows: experiment tracking, model registry, reproducible training and code review for ML work. Share what you know, pair on hard problems, and learn from the people who know our data best. **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** --------------------- * 5\+ years building and shipping machine learning systems, with several models running in production that you supported well after launch, not just trained. * Strong Python, plus deep experience with at least one modern ML framework (PyTorch, scikit\-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM or similar). * Practical experience with forecasting, regression or pricing problems on tabular and time\-series data. * Solid grounding in statistics and experiment design: validation strategy, leakage, calibration, and knowing when a metric is lying to you. * Comfort with real\-world, messy data and strong SQL. Experience with a modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt or similar) is a plus. * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs: tool use, retrieval, structured output, and above all evaluation. * You work agent\-first. You've built your own tooling around coding agents, such as skills, MCP servers, custom workflows or evals. * A habit of writing things down: design docs, model cards and runbooks that others can pick up. * You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other's work and sharing credit. * Comfort building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case and then ship the agreed plan. * High agency in an ambiguous, fast\-moving startup. You find the most valuable problem and ship against it without waiting for a perfect spec. * BS or MS in a quantitative field (computer science, statistics, engineering, physics, applied math) or equivalent experience. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with vehicle, marketplace, auction, lending or insurance pricing data. * Experience with sensor or telematics data, battery modeling or other physical\-systems data. * Experience with transfer learning, multi\-task learning or model distillation. * Experience with ML or LLM serving on a budget for latency and cost. **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS** ----------------------------- **Annual salary:** $164,000 – $200,000 Salary ranges come from independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs and market conditions. We review ranges periodically and may adjust them as the market changes. ### **Benefits and perks** * Health, vision and dental insurance * 401(k) plan * 30 days of work from anywhere per calendar year * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This is a full\-time, in\-person role based in our Los Angeles office in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). We provide relocation assistance for candidates who need to move. Sponsorship is not available at this time. **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description: Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life\-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3\.6 million patients!** We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round. **About The Role** ------------------ We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** who wants to set the direction for AI products that do real work in healthcare, and still write a lot of the code. You'll lead projects that span systems, from the experience prescribers see to the services and AI behind it, get people aligned on the approach, and see it through to adoption. Success here looks like the whole team shipping faster and more reliably, not just you. Some of what you'd lead, from setting the direction to seeing it adopted: * **One routing model for every insurer.** Today, where a request goes depends on rules scattered across the system. You’ll design a single model that works across every channel and move every flow onto it, so prescribers can hit send and trust it lands in the right place. * **AI that does the work inside the prescriber’s tools.** You’ll set the technical direction for the AI that reads clinical notes and works through insurance rules, and shape how prescribers experience it, so requests move forward without pulling them away from patients. * **The workflow engine behind every request.** Requests move between our AI, our operations team, prescribers, and insurers over days or weeks. You’ll decide whether to evolve or replace the engine that coordinates it, so nothing stalls and everyone can see where a request stands. * **Coverage answers at the moment of prescription.** You’ll set the direction for the models and data that predict cost and requirements, and bring those answers into the prescriber’s workflow before they hit send. * **How we build with AI.** We move fast with coding agents. You'll raise the bar, set standard and drive adoption of cutting edge agentic coding across the engineering team. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * At least 8 years building and shipping production software, including setting the technical direction for a system multiple teams depend on and seeing it through to adoption. * You decide which problems are worth solving. You work with users and stakeholders to frame broad goals, negotiate scope, and push back when a requirement works against the outcome. * You design for where the product is going, not just the next feature. You weigh alternatives and failure modes across systems, know when an existing design needs to be replaced, and still reach for the simplest path there. * You raise the bar for the whole team. You spot the failures that keep coming back, fix the patterns behind them, and mentor engineers into owning bigger work. * You push coding agents to their limits, hold their code to the same bar as your own, and turn what you learn into practices the whole team uses. **You Don't Need** ------------------ Healthcare experience. We'll teach you the domain. You also don't need a PM background, experience building for planet\-scale traffic, or management experience. **How We Work** --------------- We start simple and add complexity when we have a reason to. We care a lot about getting things right, because a dropped request here means a patient waits longer for their medication, and we handle protected health information every day. Engineers own their work from the first customer conversation through launch and after. The people who do well here push hard, take feedback well, and ask a lot of questions. **What We Offer** ----------------- * 250K–300K base plus meaningful early\-stage equity * Medical, dental, and vision. We pay 100% of your premiums and 50% for dependents * 401(k) with a 4% match * Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, starting from your first day * Flexible PTO and all major holidays * A high\-end workstation and budget for the AI tools you want to use * A $5K relocation bonus Visa sponsorship will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. As an early\-stage company, our ability to provide immigration support depends on the role, applicable immigration requirements, anticipated costs, and timing. Support is subject to review by immigration counsel and company approval. At this time we do not support new H1\-B visas for candidates outside the United States. **Interviewing With Us** ------------------------ There are three steps: a recruiter call, an engineering skills screen built around a realistic problem instead of trivia, and an onsite at one of our Bay Area offices. jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description: **UX Designer** --------------- ### **About Andromeda** Andromeda is building autonomous surgical robots designed to help surgeons perform procedures more safely, consistently, and efficiently. Our engineers and designers work across robotics, software, hardware, machine learning, and clinical operations to bring robotic systems from concept to real\-world deployment. We are a small, highly collaborative team of 11 that values ownership, curiosity, craft, and the ability to move quickly from idea to execution. ### **The Role** We are looking for a creative UX Designer who thinks like an artist and is comfortable at the intersection of hardware and software. This is not a traditional product design role. You will design the experience through which surgeons control a surgical robot via an iPad, making complex real\-time interactions feel intuitive, responsive, and human. Think of it like designing a game where every interaction has real consequences. If the surgeon pushes on tissue, the interface needs to respond visually, the way a game gives you feedback when you hit something. That level of craft and psychological thinking about interaction is what we are looking for. As the first and only designer on the team, you'll be hands\-on with everything from research to pixel\-level execution, without a dedicated research team, design system, or large budget to lean on. We're looking for someone who sees that as an opportunity to build something foundational, not a constraint. ### **What You'll Do** * Design the touchscreen interface that lets surgeons control the robot intuitively in real time. * Create visual feedback systems that communicate robot state, tissue interaction, and surgical progress clearly and immediately. * Conduct user research with surgeons to understand their mental models, workflows, and pain points. * Rapidly prototype and iterate on interaction concepts, from rough sketches to high\-fidelity mockups. * Work across both 2D and 3D, designing dynamic interfaces with animation and motion, not static screens. * Collaborate closely with hardware and software engineers to translate design intent into a working product. * Prepare and maintain design documentation to support regulatory and compliance processes (e.g. FDA filings). * Define and maintain design guidelines for the surgical interface. ### **What We're Looking For** * 3 to 4 years of experience in UX, interaction design, or a related creative field. * A strong portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, high\-craft work. This is the main thing we evaluate, more than years of experience. * Experience designing something genuinely impressive, ideally involving hardware\-software interaction. * Real ability across both 2D and 3D design, including dynamic interfaces, animation, and how interactions feel to the user. * Experience conducting user research. You should have done user research before and know how to translate insights into design decisions. * Comfort working in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment with limited resources, where the scope evolves and you're expected to move fast with what you have. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Background in game design or mobile game development. * Background at animation studios such as Pixar or Disney. * Experience with Unity, Unreal Engine, or similar interactive tools. * iOS or mobile app design experience. * Background in industrial design, having designed physical hardware products (form, materials, ergonomics). * Experience working in a regulated or compliance\-heavy environment (medical device, aerospace, automotive), including preparing design documentation for regulatory purposes. ### **What This Role Is Not** * This is not a front\-end coding role. We have a UI Engineer for that. * This is not a traditional enterprise UX role focused on wireframes and user flows. * This is not for someone who has only designed digital\-only products. ### **What Success Looks Like** Successful designers at Andromeda combine strong craft and taste with a deep curiosity about how people interact with complex systems. They prototype quickly, conduct real user research, and design interfaces that feel intuitive even when the underlying system is complex. They collaborate closely with engineers, iterate fast, and care about building something that works in the real world, even with limited resources. ### **Why Join Andromeda?** At Andromeda, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a small, highly technical team tackling some of the hardest problems in robotics, software, and healthcare. Your work will directly shape how surgeons interact with our robot, and will have a direct impact on products deployed in real clinical environments. ### **We Offer** * Competitive salary and equity package * Flexible healthcare benefits through an individual coverage reimbursement program * Monthly health and wellness stipend * 401(k) retirement plan * Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates * The opportunity to help build a category\-defining company from an early stage

and project stakeholders to develop your consulting presence and client management skills. **Who You Are** --------------- * Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering or equivalent with EIT certification and actively working toward PE licensure. * 1 to 5 years of civil design experience, ideally with growing project management responsibilities. * You have a "Do what needs to be done" with Microsoft Office Suite. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams, clients, and agencies. * Highly organized with the ability to juggle multiple projects and teams running smoothly. * A strong team player who thrives in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. * Excited about growing into a well\-rounded consultant — not just a technical specialist — and wants exposure to different project types, clients, and challenges. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Familiar with HydroCAD or other hydro\-modelling software for stormwater modeling and analysis. * Proficient with Bluebeam for reviewing and marking up plans and documents. * Skilled at building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, agencies, and team members. * Enjoys mentoring and supporting the growth of junior staff. **Why AKS?** ------------ At AKS, we believe your work should support your life, not the other way around. jobs.title: Controls Design Engineer
jobs.description: ATC Automation is seeking a Mid\-Senior Level Controls Engineer to join our team at our Simi Valley, California location. This role also involves programming and commissioning automated machinery with a high level of technical proficiency. The ideal candidate will possess experience with PLCs (Allen\-Bradley and Siemens), HMIs, robotics, servo systems, vision systems, and a variety of industrial sensors and actuators. The position offers opportunities for professional growth and advancement throughout our organization. You can enjoy great benefits such as Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, and Paid Time Off. If you are passionate about driving automation solutions and eager to make a tangible impact, this is the perfect opportunity for you to showcase your talents. electrical and pneumatic schematics using AutoCAD Electrical. * Design, develop, and debug complex control programs for industrial machinery and manufacturing processes. * Utilize advanced software tools to develop ladder logic, machine controls, and operator interfaces. * Communicate directly with customers to define machine requirements and performance criteria. * Apply electrical and controls engineering principles to solve technical challenges and optimize machine performance. * Support installation, startup, commissioning, and validation of completed automation systems. * Travel as jobs.title: Senior Frontend/Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: AgentSync started in 2018 with one conviction: compliance shouldn't be this hard. It should enable it. We're a venture backed category\-defining SaaS company headquartered in Denver. We've raised $161 million from investors including Craft Ventures, Valor Equity Partners, and Marc Benioff. Our culture runs on four values: customer love, inspire excellence, always be curious, and act like an owner. That means no ego, no politics, and real ownership over your work. If you want to build something that matters for an industry that's ready for change, we'd love to talk. #### **Overview** Insurance powers almost everything, and yet the systems behind it are still held together with spreadsheets and manual processes. AgentSync is fixing that. We build modern infrastructure for carriers, agencies, and MGAs that makes compliance automatic and growth possible. In this role you'll own the experience layer of the AgentSync app and carry features end to end, from the React experience our customers touch through to the Go and Java services that power it. We hire product\-minded engineers who think like owners — people who care as much about the customer and the craft of the experience as the code behind it. Our teams run lean, with a high engineer\-to\-PM ratio and no dedicated designer, which means the engineers closest to the work are the ones defining what great looks like. We move fast, we build with intention, and we expect everyone to bring their full capability to the work — including knowing when and how to use AI to do it better. We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who is primarily frontend but genuinely full stack. You'll spend most of your time in the new AgentSync App, which we're building from the ground up in our TypeScript and React monorepo. You'll own the quality and architecture of that experience, and carry your work into our Go backend\-for\-frontend and services when a feature needs it rather than handing it off. You'll help shape the path forward for our frontend architecture and design system.#### **What You’ll Do** * Build high\-quality, accessible, performant features in React and TypeScript across multiple product areas of the new AgentSync App * Own features end to end: the React experience, the API it depends on, and the service changes behind it, including UX, without waiting for a designer to hand you a spec * Evolve our frontend monorepo, shared packages, build tooling, and the boundaries between apps and help shape the path forward for our frontend architecture * Build and extend a shared component library and design system for consistent UX across product areas * Work in our Go backend\-for\-frontend and services when a feature calls for it, shaping the API responses and generated types the UI depends on * Work in an AI\-native development process: use Claude to turn product requirements into well\-scoped stories, write and review code, and generate tests also help refine the workflows, prompts, and standards that make it work for the whole team * Use AI design tools — Claude Design where it makes sense — to move from idea to working UI faster * Identify opportunities to embed intelligent, AI\-assisted experiences into the product * Take vague problems from Product and turn them into a scoped, sequenced plan, written clearly enough that teammates or AI agents can carry it out, and surface risks and tradeoffs early * Raise the quality bar through clean, well\-tested code, focused pull requests, high\-leverage code reviews, and mentorship that works by example rather than gatekeeping #### **What You’ll Bring** * 5\+ years building and shipping production, mobile\-responsive web applications * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development, using tools like Claude to generate stories, write and review code, and produce tests with a point of view on where they help and where they don't. Experience on a team where AI agents build from well\-written specs is a big plus * Deep expertise in React and TypeScript, plus modern frontend tooling, state management, and testing (experience with React Query, MUI, Vite, Vitest, or Playwright is a plus) * Strong web fundamentals — HTML, CSS, accessibility, responsive design, and performance * A strong design and UX sensibility and be comfortable owning the experience without a dedicated designer * Experience building or contributing to shared component libraries and design systems * Experience working in and evolving a frontend monorepo (e.g. Turborepo, Nx, or Yarn workspaces), with a point of view on keeping shared packages and app boundaries healthy * Working backend experience in Go or Java (Go preferred), with a solid understanding of APIs, OpenAPI\-generated clients, relational data, and how the full system fits together * Familiarity with OAuth/OIDC sign\-in flows, feature flags, and frontend observability is a plus * A reputation as a strong reviewer and mentor who raises the technical bar across a team without managing them * Clear communicator with a strong ownership mentality. You take a half\-formed problem and come back with a plan, align engineering and product around it, and surface risks and tradeoffs early * Familiarity with AWS is beneficial * A scrappy, gritty, roll\-up\-your\-sleeves mentality — you thrive with ambiguity and ownership **Location** Our ideal candidate will live within 25 miles of our office in Denver. Other states we're able to consider candidates in CA, CO, GA, IL, KS, MA, MI, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, and WA. **Total Compensation** The following represents AgentSync’s reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role. $160K\-$185K base salary Annual company bonus program * ️ Equity in the form of stock options **Health Benefits** Medical \- Multiple Cigna plans to choose from, with up to 80% employer paid premiums for you and your dependents Dental \- Multiple Cigna plans with up to 80% employer paid premiums for you and your dependents ️ Vision \- 80% paid premium plan for you and your dependents Employee Assistance Plan, Life \& AD\&D Insurance **Financial Benefits** 401(k) retirement savings plan HSA employer contributions **Other Benefits** Flexible PTO 12 paid holidays per year 12 weeks parental leave w/generous return to work stipend Candidates: AgentSync Recruiting \& Talent teams will only communicate with you using @agentsync.io email addresses. When you receive communication from AgentSync, check the email address domain to ensure you're connected with our team (and not a scammer!). **We are not able to consider candidates who require a work visa now or in the future.** **E\-Verify:** *AgentSync participates in the federal E\-Verify program. As required, we will verify the identity and employment eligibility of all newly hired employees through E\-Verify.*

jobs.title: Network Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **About Alaska Communications** Alaska Communications provides telecommunications, broadband internet, fiber\-optic networking, and managed IT services to residential customers, businesses, government organizations, and enterprise clients throughout Alaska. The company operates an extensive statewide fiber network and undersea fiber\-optic infrastructure connecting Alaska to the contiguous United States. Its network infrastructure supports essential voice, data, broadband, and enterprise connectivity services for communities and organizations across the state. Reliable network performance, continuous infrastructure monitoring, and effective telecommunications operations are essential to maintaining service availability and meeting customer connectivity requirements. We are seeking a technically skilled Network Operations Engineer to help maintain, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize telecommunications network infrastructure. This position is ideal for an engineering professional with experience in IP networking, fiber\-optic transport systems, broadband infrastructure, network monitoring, and telecommunications operations who wants to contribute to the reliability and continued development of a statewide communications network. **Job Summary** Alaska Communications is seeking a Network Operations Engineer to support the monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of its telecommunications network infrastructure. This position will focus on maintaining reliable network connectivity across fiber\-optic transport systems, broadband access networks, IP routing and switching infrastructure, Ethernet services, and enterprise telecommunications platforms. Working closely with Network Operations Center (NOC) personnel, network engineering, field operations, technical support, and infrastructure teams, the engineer will help identify network performance issues, investigate service interruptions, coordinate network restoration activities, and implement solutions that improve network reliability. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional\-grade APIs. We're deeply committed to open\-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award\-winning, developer\-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. **Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top\-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.** **Our Team Members:** We're a dynamic team of 400\+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. **Your Role:** We are seeking an AI Security Engineer to own the technical security controls for how Alpaca uses AI. The scope includes identity for AI agents and automations, security requirements for AI tools and integrations, guardrails, and security logging. You will also assist in developing AI\-powered security tooling. You will keep those controls consistent as AI adoption grows, and you will work with the teams building with AI so security is part of the design. This role reports to the Enterprise Security Architect and works closely with AI Enablement, Engineering, DevOps, GRC, and the wider Security team. The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote. **Things You Get To Do:** The core responsibilities of the AI Security Engineer are focused on AI access controls, secure AI platforms, guardrails, visibility into AI usage, and AI\-powered security tooling. ### **AI Identity and Access Controls:** * **Agent Identity: Define how AI agents, bots, and automations authenticate, what they can access, and how their actions are attributed and audited.** * **Tool Access: Own security requirements for AI tool integrations, including least\-privilege access and credential handling.** * **AI Assistant Controls: Define and enforce security settings for approved AI tools, including data handling and access policy.** * **Least Privilege: Limit each agent and integration to the access it needs, and review that access when the integration changes.** ### **Secure AI Platform, Tooling, and Response:** * **Security Requirements: Define security requirements for internal AI applications, including identity, data handling, secrets, and review of new integrations.** * **Guardrails: Design and implement guardrails for AI applications and agents.** * **Design Reviews: Review new AI applications and integrations for security risks, and give builders clear, practical requirements.** * **Security Tooling: Assist Security Operations in developing AI\-powered tooling that supports detection, investigation, and response work.** * **Safe Use in Security: Apply the same identity, data handling, and logging requirements to security team AI tools as to the rest of the company.** * **Telemetry Requirements: Define the security logging AI systems must produce, and work with Security Operations on detection.** * **Approved Use: Maintain visibility into AI tool usage and confirm it follows approved configurations.** * **Incident Support: Lead the AI\-specific aspects of security incidents, such as agent misuse or data exposure through AI tools.** * **On\-Call: Participate in the Security Operations on\-call rotation after onboarding and cross\-training.** ### **Governance:** * **Standards: Turn AI security standards into technical controls.** * **GRC Partnership: Partner with GRC on AI governance and provide technical evidence for control design.** **Who You Are (Must\-Haves):** * Excited about Alpaca's mission and what we're building * 2\+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or cloud security roles * Hands\-on experience securing LLM applications, AI agents, or AI developer tools * Understanding of AI\-specific risks, such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool use (for example, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) * Experience with identity and access controls for services and non\-human identities, including OAuth, service accounts, and secrets management * Programming experience in Python or another general\-purpose language * Experience with CI/CD security checks and cloud\-native deployments * Experience with security operations or incident response * Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining risk to non\-security builders * Comfortable working cross\-functionally and making pragmatic security decisions * Willing to participate in an on\-call rotation * Experience building AI\-assisted workflows for security operations * Experience building security telemetry for AI systems **Who You Might Be** (**Nice\-to\-Haves):** * Experience securing financial, trading, or other highly regulated platforms * Experience securing enterprise AI coding tools and AI integrations * Experience with policy\-as\-code and Kubernetes * Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO 42001 * Ability to balance security rigor with operational efficiency and business needs ### **How We Take Care of You:** * Competitive Salary \& Stock Options * Health Benefits * New Hire Home\-Office Setup: One\-time USD $500 * Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card *Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.* *Recruitment Privacy Policy*

jobs.title: Chief Engineer, USMC Air Defense Programs
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **ABOUT THE TEAM** ------------------ Anduril's Air Defense team develops, integrates, and fields autonomous systems that find, track, and defeat threats in the sky while keeping operators in control of engagement decisions. The team brings together Roadrunner, Sentry, Anvil, Pulsar, and Wisp with existing and third\-party sensors and effectors through Lattice, creating a software\-enabled family of systems for the modern battlespace. As control of the air becomes more contested, these networked capabilities give warfighters the awareness and response options needed to protect forces against rapidly evolving UAS threats. **ABOUT THE JOB** ----------------- Anduril runs two kinds of air defense programs for the U.S. Marine Corps. The first is a counter\-UAS program of record that defends Marine Corps installations in the U.S. and overseas. The second is organic counter\-UAS for the Marine maneuver force across dismounted, mounted, and expeditionary formations, where the Marine Corps is selecting systems now through competitive white papers, government demonstrations, and fly\-offs. As Chief Engineer, you're the single technical authority across both. You own the architecture and technical performance of everything Anduril delivers or proposes to the Marine Corps: our own sensors and effectors, the third\-party and government\-furnished systems we integrate, and the networks and command and control that connect them. The Marine Corps acquires these two kinds of capability in different ways. An installation is a sustained service, where uptime, configuration control, safety, and accreditation carry as much weight as the sensors. A Marine maneuver unit buys a system, takes it out of the box, and expects it to work without a software update in the field. That changes what counts as ready, how Anduril prices and sustains the system, and what we can responsibly promise. You keep the two models separate where they have to differ, and you build commonality across them where it holds up. You also decide what Anduril presents to the customer as ready. Each product team owns its own product, and you own the integrated answer: what we have, which fielded systems we could integrate, what a winning solution looks like for how Marines will use it, and what isn't mature enough to show a customer yet. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ **Portfolio technical authority.** Serve as Chief Engineer for Air Defense's U.S. Marine Corps programs. Own system architecture, integration strategy, fielding readiness, and sustainment outcomes across the fielded installation program and the maneuver programs and pursuits. Set the technical baseline, chair design reviews, and make the technical decisions that keep schedule and engineering aligned. Exercise this authority across program engineers, product teams, and field teams who don't report to you. **Fielded baseline.** Maintain the engineering baseline for a fleet deployed across many sites as it transitions to a next\-generation sensor and compute configuration. Run engineering change and configuration management so hardware, software, and documentation agree at every site. Change the baseline when field evidence shows it's incomplete or wrong, and make the case for the investments the next delivery needs. **Maneuver architecture.** Turn Marine Corps operational concepts for dismounted, mounted, and expeditionary counter\-UAS into systems a Marine can carry, mount, or set up and trust. Design within size, weight, power, and transportability limits, and own integration onto vehicles and other platforms. Define interfaces to the command and control and effectors the Marine Corps already fields. Own the technical case through government demonstrations and fly\-offs. **Technical maturity.** Review what product teams and business development plan to show the customer before they show it. Give Anduril a clear account of what works today, what needs an engineering sprint, and what isn't ready, and hold customer commitments to what the engineering supports. **Field performance and recovery.** Define the verification and qualification approach, and make the call on whether a configuration is ready to ship or demonstrate. When a fielded site degrades, lead the recovery under time  g change experience on a program of record, including system safety and item identification requirements * Experience owning a system's technical case through a competitive government demonstration or fly\-off * Depth in one or more of: radar, passive RF detection and electronic warfare, electro\-optical and infrared sensors, effector integration, tactical networking, or air defense command and control * Experience fielding at overseas installations, including host\-nation spectrum and site approvals The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployments (Global & Public Health)
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About Beneficial Deployments** Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission\-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most. **About the Role** We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping public health, global health and humanitarian organizations get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for partners such as public health agencies and ministries of health, the institutes and NGOs that support them, and humanitarian organizations working in crisis settings. You'll help them find where Claude makes a real difference, from disease surveillance and outbreak response to health data, communications and program delivery, design solutions that fit their data, privacy and procurement rules, and turn early pilots into lasting deployments. What works for one partner becomes something the whole field can use. **Responsibilities** * Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of health partners from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success. * Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API, Claude Science and Claude Code across surveillance, outbreak response, data analysis and public communications. * Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement, from national agencies to field operations. * Run workshops, trainings and tabletop exercises that build AI fluency across partner teams. * Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next. * Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed. * Travel to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building. **You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have** * 3\+ years in customer\-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering or technical consulting. * Experience working with public health agencies, ministries of health, global health or humanitarian organizations, or similarly complex public institutions, including how they buy, adopt, and govern technology. * A track record of making technology stick inside slow\-moving organizations with many stakeholders. * Hands\-on experience building with LLM APIs: you can prototype a working demo. You don't need to write production code. * Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to epidemiologists, program leads, field teams and executives. * Patience with long buying cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit. * Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission. * Bonus if you've worked on disease surveillance, outbreak response, health information systems or emergency operations. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $240,000 \- $315,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Agent Harness
jobs.description: Summary Join the team redefining what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be. As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world’s most widely used AI assistants. It runs on our next generation of Apple Intelligence, with capabilities like personal context understanding and on\-screen awareness, and it is built with privacy from the ground up. We build the harness, the foundation that turns a model into an assistant that can act. This is a systems engineering role for people who understand how large language models behave. Description A model can't act on its own. The harness runs the agent loop, carries context and tools to the model, executes the tool calls it makes, and streams results back reliably. It spans models running on device and larger models in Private Cloud Compute. It handles everything from single\-turn requests to long multi\-step tasks that span apps, survive interruptions, and resume cleanly. We're looking for a strong systems engineer who is fluent in how LLMs behave. The work is real\-time and resource\-constrained: responses must start fast enough for a voice assistant to feel instant, under tight latency, memory, and power limits on everything from Mac and iPhone to Apple Watch. Failures rarely have a single cause. In a typical week you might track down why a streamed response stalls, make tool calls cancel cleanly when the user interrupts, or replay a failed request to tell whether the model, the context, or the runtime was at fault. Every change to the harness changes how the model behaves, so we measure our work with evals, not just tests. You'll join the team that owns the core runtime and work alongside senior engineers and researchers. You'll also partner closely with the modeling, tools, and context teams and with app and framework teams across Apple. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Apple Cloud Object Storage (ACOS), Storage Infrastructure
jobs.description: Summary ACOS is Apple's geo\-distributed, exabyte\-scale object storage service. It serves billions of requests per day for iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV, Apple Maps, and Apple's internal data and analytics platforms. It provides 11\-nines of durability and 4\-nines of availability. The ACOS Storage Infrastructure team owns how data is encoded, placed, verified, repaired, and reclaimed inside a storage cluster. This includes erasure and replicated encoding schemes, data placement and rebalancing optimization, compaction, scrubbing and repair, durability modeling, performance tiering, and the supply chain that keeps available capacity in front of customer demand. In practice, this team determines what storage costs, how it survives in the face of software and hardware failures, and how fast it is served. Description This is a role for an engineer who has designed, shipped, and operated the data path of a storage system at exabyte scale. The next big challenge here is to support the industry's transition to much denser drives. This means capacity per drive is growing far faster than IOPS per drive, and maintenance operations — sealing, compaction, scrubbing, repair, rebalancing, cross\-region replication — consumes that increasingly scarce IOPS budget. This is made harder by the growing demand for high\-performance storage tiers by Data and AI workloads You will own the technical agenda for solving that, across four areas: \* Storage Efficiency. Drive cost per usable byte down further: reduce replication factor without conceding the durability bar, reclaim storage overheads for compaction and other processes, and make placement maximize both space and IOPS utilization. Land support for denser and heterogeneous drive generations (CMR, HAMR, SMR) without letting IOPS\-per\-TB become the binding constraint on the fleet. \* Storage Integrity. Guarantee 11\-nines of durability in production in the face of software and hardware failures. Own detection and repair end to end: balance detection latency against the IOPS cost of scrubbers and ensure correctness of the encode/decode/repair/rebalance paths. \* Storage Performance. Deliver differentiated performance tiers. That means improving tail latency and IOPS for the standard performance tier, while also introducing high\-performance SSD\-backed tiers for data and AI workloads. \* Capacity Planning and Management. Make supply closely track customer demand. Own demand forecasting, drive\-generation transitions, capacity on\-boarding and decommissioning, quota and rate\-limit commitments, and the release value when the system is oversubscribed. Your influence will extend well beyond ACOS. You will be the person Apple's storage organization, its hardware engineering partners, and its executives rely on for judgment on encoding, durability, and fleet efficiency. Minimum Qualifications * 15\+ years in software development, with at least 10\+ years designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed storage systems. * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or a related field. A PhD in distributed systems or storage is a strong plus. * Proven track record of delivering storage systems at \~exabyte scale. Your past work should demonstrate depth in erasure coding, replication, data placement, repair and reconstruction, consistency models, and consensus protocols (e.g., Paxos, Raft). * Deep, hands\-on expertise in the encoding layer specifically: Reed\-Solomon and Local Reconstruction Codes, wide\-stripe and geo\-distributed coding schemes, and the ability to reason quantitatively about the resulting durability, availability, repair\-bandwidth, and IOPS trade\-offs. * Familiarity with the architecture of industry\-leading storage systems (e.g., Google Colossus, Ceph/RADOS, Azure Blob Storage, Amazon S3, Meta f4/Tectonic, HDFS). * Experience with the modern drive landscape and its implications: QLC and dense flash, SMR, HAMR, heterogeneous fleets, declining IOPS per TB, and disaggregated storage and compute. * Experience designing storage for high\-performance workloads, particularly AI/ML or large\-scale analytics. Familiarity with the I/O patterns of training pipelines, data processing engines, and high\-transaction databases. * Operational credibility: you have carried a pager for a storage system at scale, and your architectural judgment is shaped by having debugged data loss and availability incidents. * Exceptional ability to influence without authority, with a history of driving major technical decisions and aligning senior engineering leaders across a large organization. * Outstanding communication skills — able to distill trade\-offs for an executive audience and to hold a deep technical debate with principal\-level engineers. Preferred Qualifications * Experience building out a credible, funded, multi\-year path to a materially lower cost per usable byte. * In\-depth understanding of maintenance overhead per usable byte trending down as drive density goes up — support denser drives. * Experience with durability guarantees measured and guaranteed in production. * Knowledge of performance tiers in production that support AI/ML and data teams. * Understanding of capacity that tracks demand within a tight band. We're seeking skilled Machine Learning Engineers to transform cutting\-edge research into scalable, production\-ready AI solutions. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building systems that push the frontier of deep learning in terms of scaling, efficiency, and flexibility and delight millions of users in Apple products. We build the foundation models behind intelligent experiences across Apple products, from high\-performance server models to highly efficient on\-device models, all designed for Apple silicon and for private, personal use. How good these models get depends on the data they learn from and on how well we measure them. We are looking for a technical leader to drive training data and model evaluation across the foundation model training lifecycle, from pre\-training and mid\-training through post\-training. You will influence our strategy for data development: data at scale, at high quality, compliant with privacy and policy requirements, and targeted through curation and synthesis based on product feedback. You will also drive evaluation that steers model training and predicts real user experience. Description This position combines machine learning research, model evaluation, and distributed data systems. Success is measured by the model improvements our data produces, and by evaluations that are reliable, predict real user experience, and guide training decisions. You will work through trade\-offs when data, evaluation, and training priorities compete, and bring data and evaluation insights into model decisions: which capabilities to prioritize, which data and mixture changes to adopt, and whether a model is ready for release. You will partner with model training leads, product teams, and security, legal, and compliance teams. You are a recognized technical expert who leads across teams through technical depth and influence. Depending on your background, the role may include managing a team. The responsibilities below cover the full scope of the area. Your focus will be the subset that best matches your background, and it can grow over time. \- Production model strategy \- Closing the loop between evaluation, data, and training \- Evaluation \- Data systems and curation \- Technical and team leadership Minimum Qualifications * PhD and 5\+ years or MS and 8\+ years of experience in machine learning or data infrastructure, including leading technical work at scale. * Deep machine learning expertise in LLMs or multimodal foundation models, with depth in either evaluation methodology or large\-scale training data systems and curation, and working fluency in the other. * Strong fundamentals in statistics and experimental design, and the credibility to review designs and experiments in detail. * A track record of training data or evaluation work on large models that measurably improved model quality or changed how models are built. * Technical leadership across teams: setting direction, mentoring senior engineers or researchers, and driving adoption of systems, benchmarks, or standards beyond your own team. * Ability to influence senior leaders and cross\-functional partners, and to turn complex results into clear decisions. * Hands\-on proficiency in Python and an ML framework such as PyTorch or JAX. Preferred Qualifications * PhD in a related field. * Training data: experience across pre\-training, mid\-training, and post\-training data, including data ablations and scaling\-law studies, and with non\-text modalities (images, audio, video) and source code at scale. * Evaluation: experience designing standardized LLM benchmarks, LLM\-as\-a\-judge frameworks, contamination detection and decontamination, or human evaluation programs with annotation teams and vendors. * Systems: experience architecting distributed data pipelines (for example Apache Beam, Spark) on major cloud platforms, strong systems programming skills, and building evaluation or data platforms adopted across multiple teams. * Governance: experience with data provenance, licensing, and privacy\-preserving practices for training data. * Experience managing a team of engineers or researchers. Working in our Software Group (SWE) you’ll see why every Apple product and service feels intuitive and simple, and why every aspect of this group’s work is built around a respect for the customer’s needs. Apple's Security Engineering \& Architecture team (SEAR) focuses on security needs. Passionate about safeguarding, we believe the best defense is a good offense. When it comes to securing more than a billion devices running the world's most sophisticated operating systems, that means finding vulnerabilities first. We are now making our security evaluation pipeline fully AI\-native, from vulnerability discovery to validation, using the most advanced AI capabilities available. Can you make a difference on this scale? Join our extraordinary team of security researchers, engineers and AI specialists, and help discover and patch Apple products' vulnerabilities before they ship. You will bring a product\-oriented mindset to complex systems, shaping our end\-to\-end security evaluation pipeline and driving its evolution toward an AI\-native approach. Your organization will include software and security engineers and AI engineers who bring advanced AI capabilities into every stage of the work. Your teams will partner very closely with Apple's security researchers, who are your primary customers and collaborators. You will make sure they have the tools that make the difference: you will understand their workflows, anticipate their needs, and turn their feedback and ideas into reliable products that multiply their impact. You will set technical direction, grow and mentor your teams, and ensure that what they build is adopted and used across Apple. We are looking for a senior data engineer to own our data lakehouse: turning a stream of device and compute events into data that is accurate, timely, and easy to explore. You will build the pipelines and table designs that power forecasting, capacity planning, and fair cross\-charging across the organization, and help us spot issues before an internal customer ever notices them. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Apple Data Platform
jobs.description: Summary We are seeking exceptional software engineers to work on Apache DataFusion Comet, Apache Spark, and related open\-source technologies. Comet, the native accelerator for Apache Spark, was created at Apple and donated to the Apache Software Foundation. If you love pushing distributed query engines to their performance limits without compromising correctness or stability, this role is for you. We are looking for engineers with deep expertise in Spark internals and in related data formats and query engines, such as Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Arrow, and DataFusion. In this role, you'll collaborate with teams across Apple operating Spark at massive scale and actively contribute upstream to these open\-source communities. Description As an engineer on our team, you will advance Apache Spark to meet Apple's scale while driving significant efficiency gains through Apache DataFusion Comet. You will design and implement native operators and expressions using Apache DataFusion and Apache Arrow, extend Comet's integration across Spark versions, and accelerate Apache Iceberg and Parquet reads and writes, all while guaranteeing strict behavioral and numerical compatibility with vanilla Spark. Working alongside a team of open\-source experts, including Apache Spark, DataFusion, and Iceberg committers, you will actively contribute that work back upstream. jobs.title: In-House Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Ascential Technologies is a global leader in high performance automated test systems, precision manufacturing solutions, and advanced industrial automation. With more than 70 years of experience, 2,300\+ experts, and a network of over 45 locations across 22 countries, we deliver mission critical equipment and lifecycle support for customers in aerospace, defense, transportation, heavy industry, energy, and advanced manufacturing. Our team brings together expertise across all engineering disciplines—mechanical, electrical, controls, systems, and software—allowing us to design, build, validate, and support highly complex automation and test platforms under one roof. This role is part of Ascential Care, the global service organization of Ascential Technologies. Ascential Care provides technical assistance and lifecycle support for all Ascential Technologies group products. Customers rely on Ascential Care for safety first design principles, disciplined engineering processes, and end to end quality—supported by deep domain expertise and a commitment to on time, to spec execution. Ascential Care operates with international coverage, harmonized service processes, ongoing technical training, performance management, and remote support. Service teams within Ascential Care are trained across multiple product lines/industries and supported in their professional development within a truly international environment. **Job Description** The In\-House Engineer for Ascential Care is responsible for end\-to\-end ownership of customer service cases, providing remote technical support, and ensuring effective resolution of equipment issues across all Ascential Technologies brands and systems in the aerospace, automotive, agricultural and general industry sectors. This role serves as a critical interface between customers, field service, and engineering teams, leveraging Service Cloud and technical expertise to diagnose problems remotely, coordinate service execution, and drive customer satisfaction. This position emphasizes strong case management, technical troubleshooting, cross\-functional coordination, and continuous communication throughout the service support lifecycle. This role requires a willingness to learn and adapt across our full range of brands, and supported industries, along with a strong desire to engage directly with customers working with cutting\-edge technologies. **Core Duties and Responsibilities** * Own customer service cases from initiation through closure, ensuring timely and effective resolution. * Provide remote technical support to customers and field service teams via phone, email, and telepresence tools. * Diagnose complex mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic and control\-system issues; jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, People
jobs.description: Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI\-native, all\-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler (MC) is aimed at micro\-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex\-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date. Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara. ### **About The Role:** This role reports to the Head of Strategic Growth and can be full\-time or contract. You'll be the first engineer embedded in our People team, working directly with leadership and building agents that reach every corner of the company. As we scale, there's real opportunity to work across functions and embed with other teams. Our goal is to build one of the first AI\-native People Operations systems inside a scaling technology company. Instead of a large administrative HR organization, we're building a small, high\-leverage People team powered by smart systems, operational excellence, and AI\-enabled processes we invent as we go. Our People team knows our Atomizers (that's what we call our people) but lacks the technical skills to build systems that scale our people practices. You'll be the person who turns our ideas into working tools, uncovers redundancy, gets more out of the platforms we already use, and builds AI proficiency across the team. This role is about efficiency, clear metrics, and leaving the team more capable than you found it. ### **What You'll Do:** * **Build agents and automations.** Ship agents and workflows across the employee lifecycle, from recruiting and onboarding to benefits and People Operations. * **Shape our People tech stack.** Connect Greenhouse, Metaview, Justworks, Slack, and Google Workspace, define how People data flows between them, and get the most from what we already use. * **Own People metrics and dashboards.** Build clear, trusted views of hiring pipeline, time to fill, recruiter capacity, headcount, and organizational health so leaders can make decisions quickly. * **Find redundancy.** Map how our team actually works, spot repeated manual steps and tool overlap, and fix them. * **Support a fast\-scaling recruiting function.** Help us keep up with a high volume of open roles without losing quality or candidate experience. * **Teach AI fluency.** Run hands\-on sessions, write simple playbooks and build templates so non\-technical teammates can use Claude, ChatGPT and agents confidently. * **Keep exploring.** Stay on top of new AI tools and practices, test them, and bring forward what's actually useful. * **Handle data responsibly.** Treat employee and candidate data with the care and confidentiality it needs. ### **What You Bring:** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 1–2 years of experience, including internships or substantial projects, building AI agents or LLM\-powered workflows that can scale across an organization. * Strong proficiency with Claude Code, plus comfort with Python, SQL and APIs. * Experience building dashboards or reporting from messy data. * A track record of building efficient, repeatable practices that scale, not one\-off scripts. * The ability to explain technical ideas in plain language to non\-engineers, and patience teaching them. * Curiosity about how teams work, and a habit of asking "why do we do it this way?" * Good judgment about privacy and handling sensitive information. ### **Nice to Have:** * Familiarity with both Claude and ChatGPT ecosystems, including MCP connectors, custom GPTs or Projects. * Experience with workflow tools or BI platforms. * Interest in people operations, talent, or organizational design. ### **Why Join:** * You'll build agents that reach every team in the company, with real ownership from day one. * Your work will shape how a fast\-growing deep\-tech company hires and supports its people. * You'll have the space to experiment with the newest AI tools and see your impact right away. Atomic Machines is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and does not discriminate based on characteristics protected by applicable law. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com. To help our recruiting team manage application volume and respond to candidates more efficiently, Atomic Machines may use AI\-assisted tools.
