jobs.description: CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events. Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale. Why Join Us * Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change. * Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest\-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth\-stage organization. * Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote\-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX. * Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long\-term stability. **About the Role** CharterUP is seeking a **Software Engineer II \- Full Stack** to design, build, and support a wide range of customer\-facing and internal systems that power our two\-sided marketplace. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with engineering leadership, product managers, and cross\-functional teammates to deliver scalable solutions that support our rapidly growing business. You’ll contribute to initiatives across multiple technical areas, including RESTful API services, web applications, mobile applications, data pipelines, and DevOps, taking ownership of well\-defined projects from implementation through deployment and ongoing improvement. **Title:** Software Engineer II **Reports to:** Engineering Manager **Location:** Austin, TX (Hybrid: Monday, Wednesday, Friday in\-office). **What You’ll Do** * **Build Quality Software:** Build, test, and maintain features using JavaScript (Vue or React) on the frontend and Java on the backend, using AI\-assisted tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and code quality. * **Support Reliable Operations:** Help deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot applications in AWS, contributing to reliable and observable services. * **Own Feature Delivery:** Take well\-defined features from implementation through release, following established patterns and seeking guidance on unfamiliar or complex problems. * **Contribute to Team Practices:** Participate in code reviews and technical discussions, incorporate feedback, and share knowledge to improve how the team works. * **Collaborate Across Functions:** Partner with product and design to clarify requirements and deliver features that solve customer problems. **What You’ll Bring** * **Technical Foundation:** 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with frontend skills in Vue, React, or Angular and backend experience in Java, Kotlin, C\#, or a similar language. * **Production Experience:** Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, automated testing, and troubleshooting applications in production. * **Applied AI Experience:** Experience using AI\-assisted development tools to write, test, or debug code, with the judgment to validate their output. * **Independent Execution:** You own well\-defined features through release, work through routine challenges independently, and seek guidance when requirements or technical decisions are unclear. * **Communication and Collaboration:** You ask thoughtful questions, incorporate feedback, and communicate progress and blockers clearly to engineering, product, and design partners. If this role interests you and your experience aligns with many of these qualifications, we encourage you to apply. We value relevant skills and experience gained through different career paths. **Recruiting Process** * **Step 1:** Video interview with Talent Acquisition * **Step 2:** Video interview with live coding assessment * **Step 3:** Video interviews with team members * **Step 4:** Offer and reference check * Welcome aboard! Salary $120,000 \- $135,000 USD #### **Global Benefits \& Perks at CharterUP** We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, and Miami as we grow our global team. * Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote\-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in\-office presence based on team and business needs. Role\-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.\-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states. * Comprehensive Health \& Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family\-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards. * Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) \+ 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country. * Financial Peace of Mind: Company\-paid life, short\-term, and long\-term disability insurance where available. * Performance\-Driven Culture: Join a fast\-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together. * Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team. * Planning for the Future: Long\-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region\-specific savings programs where applicable. * Top\-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running. ***CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.* ***Hiring Locations:*** *CharterUP U.S.\-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.* We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: Job Description: **Our Opportunity** We are hiring a **Software Engineer II** to join the **Fulfillment Execution Application** team in Minneapolis, MN. At Chewy, it is our mission to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents (and partners) everywhere. You will help develop services and applications to enable, support, and optimize software development processes and practices for the fulfillment execution teams. In this role, you will develop new features that enhance existing systems for our fulfillment team members. Further, you will have the opportunity to collaborate across engineering and operations teams to deliver solutions that empower team members to fulfill Chewy customer orders. **What You'll Do:** * Apply algorithms, data structures, and design patterns to build scalable and performant code * Design resilient systems for team member\-facing web application from scratch * Partner with stakeholders and cross functional technology teams on how to best implement desired customer features and enhancements * Collaborate with Team Members to drive automated solutions to standardize methodologies, workflows, reusable modules, and tooling * Contribute to team’s standard processes for logging, testing, instrumentation, metrics, monitors, alerts, practices, and processes * Conduct design and code reviews and raise the bar on engineering rigor and standard * Participate in setting guidelines for evolving development practices, as well as mentoring junior engineers * Participate in on\-call rotations, troubleshooting production issues and improving operational excellence **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or similar; or equivalent experience * 3\+ years of professional software development experience * Experience with cloud native technology stacks such as **AWS Lambdas, S3, SQS/SNS** * Experience as a fullstack developer working in **Java**, **React**, **Typescript** or other related languages * Ability to think independently and break down product requirements into well\-defined tasks * Ability to collaborate with stakeholders to ensure development efforts align with stakeholder needs * Experience in monitoring production environment, troubleshooting, triaging and addressing production issues * Experience with CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins or similar tool * Experience with designing, building and deploying scalable, highly available systems **Bonus:** * Hands\-on experience with AI tools and proven ability to apply AI to drive productivity. * Experience with scalable deployment technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes The base salary range for this role is $115,000 \- $184,500\.00\.* The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08\+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus. We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com. Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations. Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally\-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer – Guest Experience Site Reliability
jobs.description: **\*\* This role is not eligible for sponsorship AND is four days onsite hybrid at our N. Scottsdale office \*\*** **Who are we looking for?** --------------------------- Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, has an exciting new opportunity as a Principal Software Engineer on our Digital Site Reliability team in Digital Experience. The Digital Site Reliability team keeps the guest\-facing platforms that millions of travelers rely on available, fast, and trustworthy: choicehotels.com, the Choice Hotels Android and iOS apps, and the call center technologies our reservation agents use every day. These platforms are highly visible, revenue\-generating, and central to how guests book stays, manage reservations, and engage with our loyalty program. As a key member of this team, you will be the engineer people turn to when something complex breaks and the clock is ticking. You will dig into logs and telemetry, build the dashboards that make problems visible before guests feel them, and design lasting solutions to highly complex, multi\-variable problems that span front end, API, cloud, and mobile layers. You will write production code, but your real signature is problem solving: finding the root cause, framing the options, and bringing the right people together to decide quickly. You will also use AI\-assisted tools pragmatically to speed up diagnostics, reduce toil, and improve outcomes. If you are a self\-driven engineer who can code with the best of them, takes pride in untangling the hardest problems, and loves leading a room through a high\-pressure incident, we invite you to apply today and \#MakeItYourChoice. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues across choicehotels.com, Choice’s mobile apps, and call center technologies by analyzing logs, metrics, traces, and runtime signals, with Grafana as a primary tool. * Lead and facilitate cross\-functional conversations during incidents and time\-sensitive technical discussions, aligning engineering, product, and business partners on root cause, options, and next steps. * Participate in the on\-call rotation for Guest platforms, serving as a senior escalation point and driving critical incidents to resolution. * Write secure, stable, maintainable code to fix reliability defects, build tooling and automation, and strengthen the resiliency of our applications. * Apply expertise in CDN, DNS, WAF, security, and vulnerability management to protect the environment, with experience using solutions such as Akamai. * Drive improvements to CI/CD pipelines and release safety in Harness, including automated deployment verification, rollback strategies, and pipeline guardrails. * Identify systemic risks and failure modes in AWS\-hosted services, such as capacity limits, brittle error handling, poor failure propagation, and unsafe defaults, and translate them into well\-scoped improvements. * Apply AI\-assisted development, log analysis, and incident tools where they measurably improve root cause analysis, engineering productivity, and reliability outcomes. * Conduct trade\-off analysis across alternative technical approaches and present clear pros, cons, and recommendations to peers and leadership. * Mentor and coach engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing, and influence engineering practices across teams without formal authority. * Partner with Solution Architects, Engineering Managers, and Mobile, Web, and Contact Center teams to define non\-functional requirements for scalability, availability, and security. * Evaluate and introduce tools and technologies that improve observability, platform safety, and developer productivity, prioritizing simplicity, adoption, and long\-term impact. **Your Experience, Skills \& Competencies** ------------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience building and operating production systems. Master’s degree or equivalent experience preferred. * 10\+ years of relevant experience in software development, including experience with distributed systems, cloud platforms, and API\-based architecture, and experience serving as a technical lead or in an architecture role. * Strong hands\-on experience with AWS public cloud services and an understanding of how managed services influence reliability, scalability, and operational behavior. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Harness (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar a plus), with Git\-based source control and sound branching and collaboration practices. * Strong Java experience, including building and operating Java\-based services (Spring Boot preferred) in cloud and containerized environments. * Proficiency building front\-end applications with React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript. * Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting GraphQL APIs, plus famili ments (such as PCI, OAuth, and OWASP). * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical issues to audiences ranging from engineers to senior leaders and to facilitate productive discussion under time pressure. * Ability to deal with ambiguity, take ownership of highly complex problems from inception to completion, and lead others in the absence of formal positional power. * Preferred: Kotlin experience and experience supporting mobile applications (Android and/or iOS), including mobile release, crash, and performance monitoring. * Preferred: AWS certifications or equivalent technology certifications. * Competencies demonstrated: Technical Leadership, Problem Solving \& Decision Quality, Manages Complexity, Collaboration \& Communication. **Your Team** ------------- This is an individual contributor role that will report to the Head of Digital \& Loyalty Engineering. You will collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Solution Architects, Engineering Managers, and the web, mobile, and call center teams across Digital Experience to keep Choice’s Guest platforms reliable and performing at their best. **\*\* This role is not eligible for sponsorship \*\*** Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals \- here are just a few: * Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage * Leave and paid time\-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance * Financial benefits for retirement and health savings * Employee recognition programs * Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide **About Choice** Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45\+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high\-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too. At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be *even* better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business. *Our corporate office locations:* **North Bethesda, MD** — Located at Pike \& Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I\-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail. **Scottsdale, AZ** — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail. **Minneapolis, MN** — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown. **Field/Remote** — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role. **Choice’s Cultural Values** Welcome and Respect Everyone \| Be Bold \| Be Quick \| Listen \| Be Curious \| Show Integrity **Choice’s Leadership Principles** Act with Intention \| Lead with Authenticity \| Grow \& Deliver

jobs.title: Network & Wireless Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Global Network \& Wireless Infrastructure Engineer to design, implement, administer, maintain, and support our organization's wired and wireless network infrastructure across all domestic and international locations. This position serves as a primary technical resource for global network infrastructure, with responsibility for maintaining reliable, secure, and high\-performing network connectivity throughout the organization. The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands\-on experience in enterprise Wi\-Fi design, implementation, optimization, and troubleshooting, along with strong technical proficiency in Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco Meraki MX firewalls, and Ubiquiti UniFi wireless networking. The successful candidate must be capable of independently designing and implementing moderately complex LAN environments, deploying reliable wireless networks in challenging physical environments, and resolving complex networking issues across geographically distributed facilities. The role combines network engineering, infrastructure administration, project implementation, and operational support. Domestic and international travel is required for network installations, upgrades, troubleshooting, site assessments, and other infrastructure projects. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Global Network Infrastructure Management** * Serve as a primary technical resource responsible for wired and wireless networking infrastructure across all company locations worldwide. * Design, implement, administer, monitor, and maintain LAN, WLAN, WAN, firewall, and VPN infrastructure. * Establish and maintain consistent network architecture, configuration standards, and security practices across global facilities. * Support the deployment of network infrastructure at new locations, facility expansions, relocations, and renovations. * Independently plan and execute network upgrades, hardware replacements, and infrastructure improvements. * Remotely diagnose and resolve network issues affecting domestic and international locations. * Coordinate with local personnel, telecommunications providers, contractors, and equipment vendors. * Maintain accurate network topology diagrams, IP addressing documentation, equipment inventories, and configuration records. * Identify opportunities to improve network reliability, performance, security, and standardization. * Participate in network infrastructure planning, lifecycle management, and technology refresh initiatives. **2\. Enterprise Wireless Network Engineering** * Design, deploy, configure, optimize, and maintain enterprise Wi\-Fi networks, primarily using Ubiquiti UniFi equipment. * Conduct predictive and physical wireless site surveys, RF assessments, and post\-installation validation. * Develop wireless coverage and capacity plans based on facility layouts, building materials, device density, and operational requirements. * Determine appropriate wireless access point placement, antenna selection, channel assignments, and transmit power settings. * Configure and optimize wireless networks using 2\.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz technologies where applicable. * Support Wi\-Fi 5, Wi\-Fi 6/6E, and Wi\-Fi 7 technologies. * Configure SSIDs, VLAN assignments, wireless security, guest access, and enterprise authentication. * Troubleshoot wireless roaming, interference, authentication failures, intermittent connectivity, and performance degradation. * Optimize wireless connectivity for handheld scanners, Android devices, laptops, and other business\-critical mobile equipment. * Design wireless solutions for challenging environments, including warehouses, industrial facilities, high ceilings, metal shelving, and areas with significant RF interference. * Administer Ubiquiti UniFi Network management platforms and maintain consistent wireless configuration standards. * Utilize wireless survey, spectrum analysis, packet capture, and diagnostic tools to identify and resolve complex RF issues. Extensive hands\-on wireless design and troubleshooting experience is essential. **3\. Cisco LAN Switching \& Network Design** * Design and implement moderately complex enterprise LAN environments. * Configure, administer, and troubleshoot Cisco Catalyst switches running Cisco IOS and IOS XE. * Perform switch configuration and troubleshooting using the Cisco command\-line interface. * Configure and maintain Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching, VLANs, trunking, and inter\-VLAN routing. * Configure and troubleshoot STP/RSTP, EtherChannel/LACP, ACLs, and PoE. * Implement IP addressing schemes, subnetting, static routing, and dynamic routing where appropriate. * Troubleshoot switching loops, broadcast storms, network congestion, and connectivity failures. * Design reliable network uplinks, switching architectures, and redundant network connections where required. * Plan and execute switch replacements, firmware upgrades, and configuration changes. * Maintain consistent switching standards and configura AT, VPNs, and WAN connectivity. * Familiarity with Meraki Dashboard monitoring and troubleshooting capabilities. **Core Networking** * Strong understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4 subnetting, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, and network security. * Proficiency using network diagnostic tools, including Wireshark and packet capture utilities. * Ability to independently troubleshoot complex network performance and connectivity problems. * Knowledge of network documentation and infrastructure management best practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Cisco CCNA or CCNP certification. * Ubiquiti wireless or enterprise networking certifications. * Wireless networking certifications such as CWNA or CWSP. * Experience with Ekahau, Hamina, NetAlly, or similar wireless design and analysis tools. * Experience designing and supporting wireless networks in warehouses, distribution centers, or industrial facilities. * Experience supporting Android handheld scanners, barcode readers, and other mobile operational devices. * Experience administering network infrastructure across international locations. * Familiarity with Microsoft NPS, RADIUS, and Microsoft Entra ID\-related network authentication. * Experience with SD\-WAN, redundant internet connectivity, and multi\-site VPN architectures. * Knowledge of fiber\-optic networking, structured cabling, and network equipment installation standards. * Familiarity with network automation, scripting, or centralized configuration management. **Professional Skills \& Competencies** * Ability to work independently and take ownership of network infrastructure projects. * Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent organizational, documentation, and time\-management skills. * Ability to coordinate technical activities across geographically distributed facilities. * Strong communication skills when working with technical personnel, local management, vendors, and service providers. * Ability to prioritize network incidents, maintenance, and infrastructure projects. * Comfortable performing both network engineering and routine administration responsibilities. * Ability to work effectively with limited supervision during domestic and international assignments. * Willingness to support critical infrastructure outside normal business hours when necessary. **Education \& Certifications** * Associate's or bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Networking, or a related field preferred. * Equivalent professional experience will be considered. * Cisco CCNA certification preferred. * Relevant wireless networking certifications are beneficial but not required. Demonstrated hands\-on technical proficiency and relevant experience are more important than formal education or certifications. **Travel \& Work Requirements** * Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require. * Ability to obtain and maintain a valid passport and meet applicable international travel requirements. * Ability to work occasional evenings or weekends for planned maintenance, infrastructure implementations, or critical incidents. * Ability to perform on\-site network equipment installation and troubleshooting, including work in network closets, equipment rooms, and warehouse environments. * Ability to coordinate projects and technical support across multiple time zones. **Position Expectations** This is a hands\-on global network engineering and administration role, not an architecture\-only or network monitoring position. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable designing network solutions, implementing infrastructure, troubleshooting complex problems, and performing ongoing network administration. **Enterprise Wi\-Fi design and troubleshooting expertise is a primary requirement.** Candidates whose experience is limited to routine wireless administration or basic access point configuration will not meet the technical expectations of this position.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Delivery Engineering
jobs.description: **About CircleCI Engineering** ------------------------------ CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. **About Delivery Engineering** ------------------------------ Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil. Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on. We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build AI\-natively.** AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. * **Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents.** Help define the end\-to\-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on. * **Start from how our teams actually work.** Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate. * **Build platforms, not one\-offs.** Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done. * **Measure what matters.** Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns. * **Make build\-vs\-buy calls.** Evaluate models, vendors, and open\-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage. * **Lead through influence.** Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * **Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts.** You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work. * **Hands\-on depth with agentic tooling.** You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics. * **A platform mindset.** You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption. * **Backend depth in Go.** You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration. * **A track record at staff scope.** 8\+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed. * **Decision\-making grounded in your users.** You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along. This role is open to candidates based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone. **Sound like you?** ------------------- You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the engineers using your tools as much as the code behind them. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it with the people who'll use it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. **About CircleCI** CircleCI is the world's largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most\-used DevOps tools \- processing more than 3 million jobs a day \- CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture\-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. **How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring** At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you. **Where we may use AI** * *Job descriptions and messaging*: AI may help draft job descriptions and role\-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate. * *Application review*: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. * *Interview notes*: With advance notice, an AI note\-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected. * *Outreach*: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending. **Our commitment** AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Research Scientist (PhD)
jobs.description: **Job Type:** Flexible Contract (Remote) **Job Summary:** We are hiring PhD\-level Cybersecurity Research Scientists for a contract project that tests whether frontier AI models can handle real security research work. You will create hard tasks from your field that a leading AI model cannot solve, then review where and why it fails. **What you will do** * Create command line tasks based on real security research problems. * Build each task’s environment, including the code, data and dependencies, and write a reference solution. * Write automated tests that check whether a solution is correct, with consistent results on every run. * Run your task against a leading AI model, review its attempt, and adjust the task until the model fails because the problem is truly hard, not because the instructions are unclear. **Who we are looking for** * A PhD in computer science, security, engineering or a closely related STEM field. PhD candidates and students are welcome to apply. * Hands\-on research or industry experience in security, such as vulnerability research, reverse engineering, malware analysis, applied cryptography, systems security or network security. Ten or more years of experience is ideal. * At least one publication, academic or professional, such as a paper at a security venue, a CVE write\-up, a conference talk or a technical advisory. * Comfort with Python, the Linux command line, Docker and Git. * Familiarity with tools such as Ghidra, gdb, Wireshark, fuzzers or similar analysis tooling is a plus. * Experience with experimental design, benchmarking or testing AI systems is a plus. * Experience with machine learning security or LLM security is a plus. * Peer review experience, or experience building technical tests, CTFs or assessments, is an advantage. * Able to work independently in a remote setting and explain technical findings clearly. **Why Cobalt AI** * **Advance frontier AI where it counts.** Apply your expertise to the data frontier labs cannot get any other way, where your reasoning directly shapes how the next generation of models solves technical problems. * **Grow professionally.** Expand your influence through evaluation projects, advisory roles and research collaborations, while deepening your understanding of how frontier models are trained and assessed. * **Work with a top\-tier network.** Collaborate with researchers and engineers from leading institutions and labs on high\-impact, flexible work. * **Set your own schedule.** Flexible 10 to 40 hour weeks that fit around your current role and your life. * **Competitive pay.** Paid per accepted task, with higher rates for consistently strong work. Job Type: Part\-time Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Security Engineer, AI Evaluation (PhD)
jobs.description: **Job Type:** Flexible Contract (Remote) **Job Summary:** Cobalt is hiring PhD\-level security engineers to review reinforcement learning tasks and environments used to test whether frontier AI models can carry out real security work. Your job is to make sure each task is correct, fair, realistic and actually measures what it claims to measure before it is accepted. If you have built your research or career around finding the flaw that scanners miss, the patch that only looks like a fix, or the exploit path nobody planned for, this role puts that experience to work at the frontier of AI evaluation. **What you will do** * Review security tasks end to end, including the task description, environment code, containers, vulnerable code, dependencies, reference solution and automated tests or graders, and confirm that each part is correct and consistent with the others. * Run reference solutions and graders yourself to confirm that correct fixes pass, incorrect or incomplete fixes fail, and results are reproducible across runs. * Look for ways an agent could pass without doing the intended work, such as reading the expected output directly, special\-casing the grader’s test inputs, disabling a feature instead of fixing the flaw, or applying a patch that blocks the test exploit but leaves the underlying vulnerability open. Document each issue so the task author can fix it. * Confirm that graders verify real security outcomes thoroughly and deterministically, including variant inputs and regression checks that keep legitimate behavior working. * Review how a frontier AI model attempted each task and judge whether its failure reflects a real capability gap, or instead reflects ambiguous wording, a hidden assumption, a broken environment or an unfair grader. * Judge whether each task reflects how security work is actually done in industry, including realistic codebases, messy dependencies and real\-world constraints, and push back on tasks that are unrealistic, trivial or testing the wrong skill. * Write clear, specific feedback to task authors and work with them through revisions until the task meets the acceptance standard. **Who we are looking for** * A PhD in computer science, security, engineering or a closely related STEM field. PhD candidates and students are welcome to apply. * Hands\-on research or industry experience in security, such as vulnerability research, secure code review, reverse engineering, malware analysis, applied cryptography or systems security. Ten or more years of experience is ideal. * At least one publication, academic or professional, such as a paper, CVE write\-up, conference talk or technical advisory. * Expert command of Python and at least one systems or web language, and the ability to read code and explain exactly why it is or is not vulnerable. * Hands\-on experience with security tooling, such as debuggers, fuzzers, static and dynamic analysis tools or reverse engineering tools. * Deep familiarity with Linux, Docker and Git, enough to set up an environment, run a task and trace a failure. * Careful, direct written communication. Much of the job is explaining precisely what is wrong and why. **Strong advantages** * Experience designing technical assessments, CTF challenges or interview problems, writing autograders, or serving as a peer reviewer for a security conference or journal. * Significant open source security contributions, bug bounty track record or published vulnerability disclosures. * Experience with machine learning security, or with reinforcement learning, including how reward signals can be gamed. **Why Cobalt AI** * **Work on frontier AI evaluation.** Your judgment directly determines which tasks are used to measure what leading models can and cannot do in security. * **See how frontier models are trained and assessed.** Reviewing many tasks and model attempts gives you a close view of where current models succeed in security work and where they break. * **Fit the work around your other commitments.** Set your own schedule, with flexible weeks of 10 to 40 hours. * **Shape the work.** Strong reviewers can lead task design, run projects and collaborate on research. Job Type: Part\-time Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, IT Digital Employee Experience** ------------------------------------------------------------ ### **San Francisco, California** **GAQ427R232** At Databricks, we are on a mission to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems. The IT Digital Employee Experience team builds the internal tools, platforms, and data systems that power how every Brickser works. From procurement applications and SaaS inventory systems to mobile apps, AI\-powered tools, and data pipelines that serve IT. You will own architecture, design, implementation, deployment, and stakeholder management. You'll build production web and mobile applications on the Databricks Platform, design data pipelines that ingest from dozens of SaaS systems, and ship AI\-powered integrations (MCP servers, LLM features) that reduce friction across the entire company. This is a high\-autonomy, high\-impact role where you operate with a startup mentality inside a scaled organization. ### **The impact you will have** * Design, build, and maintain production full\-stack applications (web and mobile) used company\-wide. Such as, but not limited to, procurement platforms, employee experience apps, SaaS management tools, and mobile apps for leadership. * Build and own data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve data from SaaS systems into Databricks, ensuring data quality and pipeline reliability. * Architect and implement authentication and authorization flows using Okta, OAuth, and service principals. * Build and deploy MCPs that connect internal tools to AI assistants, and contribute to AI\-powered features, including LLM\-based classification, data enrichment, and prompt\-based guardrails. * Design and manage CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and deployment automation using GitHub, HashiCorp Vault, and Databricks tooling. * Improve and enforce SWE standards for the team: PR review processes, testing frameworks, and environment management (dev/staging/prod). * Work directly with stakeholders across Security, Legal, HR, Finance, and Engineering to gather requirements, navigate trade\-offs, and deliver solutions. * Author design documents, PRDs, and architecture proposals for new systems and features. * Mentor contractors and junior engineers. Delegate work, break down roadmap items, and drive project planning with minimal management oversight. * Drive roadmap planning for your domain by identifying high\-impact work and autonomously sequencing it. ### **What we look for** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of production software development experience, with demonstrated full\-stack proficiency (backend, frontend, and data). * Strong experience with Python as a primary language, with production experience building full\-stack applications. * Experience designing and deploying applications on cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure). * Hands\-on experience with data engineering — building ETL/ELT pipelines, working with structured and semi\-structured data. * Familiarity with CI/CD, IaC, and modern DevOps practices (GitHub Actions, Terraform, Docker). * Experience with SaaS platforms or service\-oriented architectures. * Experience with security and systems that handle sensitive data: identity management, access control, RBAC/RLS patterns. * Strong communication skills. You can write a clear design doc, present to cross\-functional stakeholders, and navigate technical trade\-offs with non\-technical audiences. * Experience with AI/ML tooling, LLM integrations, prompt engineering, evals, and MCP servers. * Experience mentoring other engineers. ### **Bonus points** * Experience with the Databricks platform (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks Apps, Workflows). * Strong SQL proficiency. * Familiarity with identity and access management systems (Okta, Opal, Google Workspace). * Experience building mobile applications (iOS/Android). * Experience with SaaS management, procurement systems, or IT operations tooling. * Background in data governance, schema design, access control, and data quality monitoring. * Experience working with distributed teams across time zones. **About Databricks** Databricks is the Data and AI company. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. **Benefits** At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. jobs.description: **Senior Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications** -------------------------------------------------------- **Enterprise Platform Group · Commercialization (Quote\-to\-Cash) · Mountain View, CA** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the Agentic Applications team, you will be the hands\-on technical lead for how Databricks quotes, orders, bills and recognizes revenue. Your core function is to build bespoke first\-party, agents\-first applications built on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will own the technical architecture end to end, from quote to cash. You will design agents that work reliably inside revenue\-critical workflows, set the engineering standards the team builds on, and make sure every agent\-assisted decision can be observed, audited and trusted by Finance, Deal Desk and Sales. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role, not a people\-management role. You will write code, review designs, and be the most senior technical voice in a domain that touches every dollar Databricks books. ### **The impact you'll have** * **Own the agentic architecture for Quote\-to\-Cash.** Define and lead the target technical architecture across Configure\-Price\-Quote, deal management, ordering, subscriptions, investments, billing and revenue recognition. Drive the move from vendor\-configured workflows to first\-party, AI\-native applications built on Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Unity Catalog and Mosaic AI. * **Build production agents that sellers and Deal Desk trust.** Design and ship LLM\-powered agents for deal guidance, quote generation and summarization, multi\-option proposals, approval insights, and pricing and discount recommendations. Work directly with sales, Deal Desk and Finance to define what "good" looks like for each workflow. * **Make agent reliability a core system property.** Own the eval and quality system for this domain: per\-workflow quality criteria, offline eval suites, LLM\-as\-judge and human\-labeled benchmarks, behavioral regression testing in CI/CD, online tracing, and feedback loops that improve agents based on what users approve, edit and reject. * **Design human\-in\-the\-loop controls for revenue\-critical decisions.** Build the separation between what an agent proposes and what gets committed, plus diff\-based review, approval routing, audit logging, and policy guardrails. Together these decide when an agent can act on its own and when a person has to approve, especially for pricing, discounting, contract terms and order creation. * **Treat systems of record as agent tools.** Architect tool\-calling and MCP\-style interfaces that give agents governed, run\-time access to pricing, product catalog, order, contract, subscription and billing data. Follow single\-source\-of\-truth principles across CRM, ERP and billing systems. * **Protect financial integrity at scale.** Make sure agent\-assisted quoting and ordering produce accurate, compliance\-grade outputs downstream: order validation, billing, invoicing and revenue recognition, where errors directly affect financial reporting. * **Lead the migration path.** Act as the bridge between today's production quoting platform and the target agentic architecture. Sequence the migration so the business keeps scaling without disruption, and decide what to retire, rebuild or wrap. * **Raise the engineering bar.** Lead architecture reviews, establish design patterns for agents (orchestration, memory, retrieval, tool use, multi\-agent coordination), and mentor senior and mid\-level engineers on production\-grade agentic engineering. * **Earn cross\-functional credibility.** Partner with Finance, Deal Desk, Sales Ops, Legal and the broader Platform engineering org. Platform\-specific configuration expertise is a plus but not a requirement. * Experience with the Databricks platform (Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI Agent Framework, MLflow tracing and evaluation). * Familiarity with SOX controls, audit requirements, and financial\-systems compliance. **About Databricks** Databricks is the Data and AI company. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 15 years of experience in engineering or related function. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with the modern LLM stack (e.g., agent architectures and harnesses, multi\-agent swarms, post\-training/fine\-tuning/RL, or large\-scale LLM evaluation). * Experience in software engineering, systems infrastructure, or AI/ML modeling using Python and C\+\+. * Experience with technical leadership and driving multi\-team, cross\-functional projects from inception to delivery. * Experience in information retrieval, search and ranking systems, clustering, or large\-scale data processing infrastructure. **About the job** ----------------- Going beyond standard long\-context retrieval, we are developing the Agera Kernel—a scalable engine designed for "pre\-computation of expertise." The system leverages map\-reduce style processing, agentic exploration, and persistent memory states to allow models to ingest, structure, and deeply understand complex domains prior to user interactions. By combining automated domain pre\-computation with expert human calibration in Agera Studio, we aim to produce specialized Expert Models that significantly outperform foundational models on intricate, multi\-turn tasks. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $307000 \- $427000 (USD) \+ 30% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Partner with product and research teams across Google Deepmind (GDM) and Google to invent 0\-to\-1 features and products powered by Agera, identifying where Agera creates real leverage and aligning teams around a shared goal. * Develop across the full AI systems stack (e.g., agent harnesses and isolated subagent swarms, inspectable semi\-structured state, vectorized tool execution, custom retrieval indices and universal reranking, large\-scale evals, human\-in\-the\-loop Studio UIs, and fine\-tuning/expertise distillation into weights and skills). * Balance rapid, exploratory prototyping with the discipline to write clean, scalable code. * Lead complex engagements end\-to\-end, bridging different team roadmaps and constraints, setting technical direction, and driving convergence through working prototypes. The freedom to pursue new ideas, offer different perspectives, and grow in your career is fundamental to working at Dorman. **Job Summary** --------------- The Cloud \& Data Center Engineer is a hands\-on infrastructure role that supports the day\-to\-day operation, reliability, and improvement of Dorman's on\-premises data center and cloud environments. Reporting to the Lead System Analyst, this position provides operational support across compute, storage, virtualization, backup, monitoring, and cloud infrastructure, with a primary focus on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and supporting responsibilities in Microsoft Azure. AWS experience is preferred and Azure experience is a plus. * Experience administering VMware environments, NetApp storage systems, Veeam backup and recovery platforms, and Datadog monitoring solutions is strongly preferred. Experience supporting Windows and Linux infrastructure in enterprise environments is required. * Associate or administrator\-level certifications are preferred, such as AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate, AWS SysOps Administrator \- Associate, Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate, VMware VCP, or comparable credentials. * Experience supporting data, analytics, or AI platform infrastructure is a plus, but is not required. \#LI\-EK1 The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $92,700\.00 to $138,000\.00\. jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== DoubleVerify is the leading independent provider of marketing measurement software, data and analytics that authenticates the quality and effectiveness of digital media for the world's largest brands and media platforms. DV provides media transparency and accountability to deliver the highest level of impression quality for maximum advertising performance. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best\-in\-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com. **Role Overview** ================= We are looking for a talented and driven **Senior AI Engineer** to join the Pinnacle AI (PinAI) team at DoubleVerify. In this role, you will be a core builder of **AgentOS** — our agentic AI platform that powers conversational, intelligent experiences across the Pinnacle advertising analytics suite. You will design and implement AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and LLM\-backed tools that allow Fortune 500 clients to interact with their advertising data through natural language. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who is passionate about applied AI, thrives in a fast\-moving environment, and wants to see their work directly impact how the world's largest advertisers make decisions. **What You'll Do** ================== ### **Agentic AI Development** * Design, build, and maintain AI agents within the AgentOS framework using architectures based on MCP (Model Context Protocol), LangChain, LangGraph, and related tooling * Develop new MCP servers and tools that expose Pinnacle analytics capabilities — including metrics, dimensions, settings, and user data — to AI agents * Implement multi\-turn conversational flows, tool\-use reasoning chains, and agent orchestration logic that handle complex, real\-world advertising analytics queries * Build and maintain the chat UI integration layer, connecting AgentOS to the Pinnacle front\-end experience ### **LLM Engineering \& Optimization** * Work with major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others) to select, prompt, and integrate models appropriate for specific agent tasks * Develop and own prompt engineering strategies, including system prompts, few\-shot examples, and chain\-of\-thought techniques * Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground AI responses in Pinnacle's proprietary data and documentation * Continuously optimize model performance through evals, latency tuning, and cost management ### **Evaluation \& Quality** * Build and maintain evaluation (evals) frameworks that measure agent accuracy, instruction\-following, hallucination rates, and user satisfaction * Define quality benchmarks and run regression evals on every agent change before production deployment * Instrument agents with observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Weights \& Biases, or custom tracing) to support debugging and continuous improvement ### **Integration \& Platform Engineering** * Integrate AgentOS with Pinnacle's existing platform services — including PIAM/Keycloak authentication, Settings APIs, and analytics data layers * Collaborate with backend teams to build and consume APIs that surface data cleanly and securely to AI agents * Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to technical design documents for new AI\-powered features ### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner closely with Product, UX, and Data Science to translate business requirements into agent capabilities and conversational flows * Work with QE teams to define testing strategies for AI features, including behavioral testing and adversarial prompting * Contribute to the team's shared AI engineering standards, best practices, and documentation **Who You Are** =============== **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- ### **Experience:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building production\-grade systems * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience developing LLM\-based applications or AI agent systems * Demonstrated experience shipping AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, from prototype to production ### **Technical Expertise:** * **Agentic AI Frameworks:** Solid hands\-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks * **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Familiarity with MCP or similar modular tool\-integration protocols for AI agents (or strong appetite to ramp quickly) * **LLM Integration:** Experience calling and integrating with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or similar), including streaming, tool\-calling, and structured output patterns * **Python:** Strong Python proficiency; ability to build clean, testable, production\-quality backend services (FastAPI experience a plus) * **RAG \& Embeddings:** Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation patterns, vector stores, and semantic search * **Evaluation Mindset:** Experience building or using eval frameworks to measure LLM/agent quality and regression\-test AI behavior * **Cloud \& Infrastructure:** Familiarity with cloud environments (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization basics (Docker/Kubernetes) ### **Soft Skills:** * Strong problem\-solving skills with a bias toward shipping and iterating * Clear communicator — able to explain AI behavior and limitations to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders * Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-paced, evolving AI landscape * Collaborative team player who contributes actively to shared standards and code quality ### **Education:** * BS/MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related technical field **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with MCP server development and tool\-use patterns in production agentic systems * Familiarity with IAM, Keycloak, or OAuth 2\.0\-based authentication patterns * Knowledge of advertising analytics, AdTech platforms, or BI tools (Looker, Snowflake, etc.) * Experience with modern front\-end frameworks (React/Angular) for conversational UI features * Contributions to open\-source AI projects or published work in AI/ML * Experience with agent evaluation tools such as DeepEval, LangSmith, or Braintrust * Knowledge of responsible AI practices, including bias mitigation and hallucination reduction strategies This position is full\-time and located in our New York City headquarters offices offering a hybrid work model from office and remote. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined by a number of non\-discriminatory factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role, based on the qualifications set forth in the job description, is between $131,000 $241,000\. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted. **Not\-so\-fun fact:** Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

jobs.title: Sr Product Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Sr Product Security Engineer** ================================ * **Business Unit:** Draeger Medical Systems, Inc., **Job\-ID:** 1398 * **Location:** Andover * **Function:** R\&D * **Work Location:** Hybrid * **Employment Type:** Permanent **The Job Responsibilities** ---------------------------- We are hiring a Senior Product Security Engineer to work hybrid, 3 days a week, in our Andover, MA office. The Senior Product Security engineer helps secure patient monitoring medical device solutions and connected health software throughout the product lifecycle. This role partners directly with systems, software, and test engineering teams to build security into product architectures, generate objective evidence for regulatory submissions, and maintain product cyber resilience after release. The selected candidate will support the integration of advanced cybersecurity controls, identify and mitigate vulnerabilities, and contribute to initiatives that improve cyber resilience across the product lifecycle. This person will serve as a technical subject matter expert, collaborate across functions, and help drive long\-term improvements in product security posture. This is a product security engineering role; it is not focused on enterprise IT security. Main Responsibilities: * Product Security \- Implement security requirements across the medical device development lifecycle by partnering with cross\-functional teams and applying best practices from design through deployment. * Perform threat modeling, attack\-surface analysis, and product cybersecurity risk assessments. Define security requirements and risk controls, and integrate cybersecurity risks with product safety risk management. * Support the design and delivery of secure medical devices through implementation of capabilities such as secure boot, secure communications, data protection, software update mechanisms, system integration protections, and access controls. * Plan and review cybersecurity testing, including vulnerability scanning, software composition analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing. Drive remediation and confirm closure through retesting. * Maintain product SBOMs and assess reported vulnerabilities. Determine product impact, prioritize remediation, and support coordinated vulnerability disclosure and postmarket monitoring. * Prepare and review cybersecurity documentation for FDA and other regulatory submissions. Respond to regulator and customer cybersecurity questions. * Support DoD and federal customer Risk Management Framework (RMF) authorizations. Map product controls to NIST SP 800\-53, apply and evidence DISA STIG compliance, and prepare authorization artifacts (SSP, SAR, POA\&M) supporting customer Authority to Operate (ATO) decisions. * Serve as a technical subject matter expert. Work with engineering, test, quality, regulatory, service, legal, and program management teams to resolve product security risks. * Improve product security processes, tools, and reusable engineering practices based on emerging threats, standards, and regulatory expectations. **Your Qualifications** ----------------------- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Required Qualifications * 3 to 6 years of experience in product security, application security, embedded security, or security engineering in a product development environment * Experience with threat modeling, cybersecurity risk assessment, secure design, vulnerability analysis, and security testing. * Working knowledge of embedded, Linux, Windows, real\-time, or network\-connected systems, including common network security principles and protocols. * Understanding of secure development lifecycle and security\-by\-design practices. * Ability to communicate technical risks clearly, develop traceable documentation, and support multiple assignments in a cross\-functional environment. Preferred Qualifications * Experience developing or securing medical devices, safety\-critical products, or products in another regulated industry. * Experience supporting FDA and other global medical device cybersecurity submissions and responding to regulatory questions or deficiencies. * Familiarity with IEC 81001\-5\-1, AAMI TIR57, applicable FDA cybersecurity requirements and guidance, NIST publications. * Experience with the DoD Risk Management Framework (DoDI 8510\.01, NIST SP 800\-37, NIST SP 800\-53\), including control implementation, STIG hardening, and preparation of authorization artifacts (SSP, SAR, POA\&M) supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) decisions for products deployed on DoD or other federal networks. * Hands\-on experience with secure product implementation, security testing, SBOM or software composition analysis tools, and vulnerability remediation. * Programming or scripting experience and relevant cybersecurity certifications such as CSSLP, GPEN, or Security\+. The targeted pay range for this position is typically between $115,000 \- $127,000\. We note that the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. This position is eligible for the following additional compensation: annual bonus. **While Draeger values diverse global talent, this role requires current and ongoing work authorization in the United States. Unfortunately, Draeger is unable to provide visa sponsorship now or in the future.** Draeger is a federal government contractor. If this position requires access to federally restricted information, the individual’s eligibility for and attainment of federally required licensing is a condition of employment. **Dräger Benefits** ------------------- At Draeger, Technology for Life means supporting our people in every aspect of their lives. We offer a competitive benefits package that may include:* Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Life, short\- and long\-term disability coverage * 401(k) with company match * Over 4 weeks of paid time off, plus holidays and parental leave * Flexible spending accounts and employee assistance program Select locations also offer free parking, an on\-site gym, cafeteria, and game room. Talk to your Draeger recruiter to learn more!**Who we are** -------------- We’re hiring! If you want your contributions to make a real difference, check out this new career opportunity with us at Draeger where we are led by the guiding principle “Technology for Life”. Draeger has several sites located across North America as well as field\-based sales and service positions. Our North America headquarters is located in Telford, PA just north of Philadelphia. We also have US sites in Andover, MA, and Houston, TX. Our Canada site is located in Mississauga, Ontario. Draeger is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**Interested?** --------------- Please, apply directly through our career portal. We look forward to receiving your application.
