jobs.title: Structural Engineering Manager - Cary, NC
jobs.description: **Build and lead a capable, accountable structural engineering team that delivers technically sound, practical work on scope, schedule, budget, and quality by owning people, capacity, assignments, technical standards, proposal input, technical risk, and continuous improvement.** EAD supports engineering, automation, and project delivery in industrial and manufacturing facilities. Work is often multi\-discipline, fast\-moving, and performed in active or existing facilities where sound judgment, safety, quality, clear communication, and dependable execution matter. **Role Summary** ================ The Manager, Structural Engineering owns structural engineering people, capacity, assignments, technical standards, review coverage, proposal and estimate input, capability development, and discipline quality across the Project Delivery Group. The role is a working manager with expected billable contribution generally 50\-75%. Project Managers own overall project delivery; this role owns who performs the discipline work, whether the assigned team is capable and available, and whether the discipline work is technically sound and properly reviewed. Reports to: VP, Project Delivery **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Lead employees and working leads through assignments, priorities, coaching, performance feedback, hiring, onboarding, development, licensure, and succession. * Own the 13\-week discipline capacity view and all assignment decisions affecting discipline employees. Use prioritized, time\-phased demand from Project Managers and the Director, Project Management to assign qualified people based on capability, availability, workload, development needs, and project commitments. * Establish the minimum discipline execution\-planning standard and ensure qualified Project Discipline Leads develop and maintain right\-sized engineering execution plans for applicable projects. Verify that discipline scope, deliverables, hours, staffing, schedule, quality reviews, codes and standards, technical risks, mitigation actions, and coordination requirements remain current. * Lead or approve discipline proposal and estimate inputs, including technical scope, deliverables, hours, staffing, schedule, assumptions, exclusions, interfaces, review requirements, and execution risks. Develop practical mitigation strategies and escalate material residual risk before EAD makes the commitment. * Own discipline technical standards, checklists, responsible\-charge coverage, technical\-review practices, competency expectations, and lessons learned. Ensure required technical reviews and issue closures occur before release. * Partner with Project Managers, who own overall project scope, schedule, budget, changes, client commitments, Project Execution Plans, Project Execution Checklists, and coordination across disciplines and workstreams. * Maintain practical visibility into discipline DLU/RevGen, planned\-versus\-actual effort, upcoming commitments, quality results, available capacity, overload, and capability gaps; act early or escalate when the discipline cannot support the commitment. * Provide discipline\-specific technical leadership for structural analysis and calculations; foundations, supports, platforms, mezzanines, wall/floor/roof systems, equipment supports, brownfield modifications, field investigation, undocumented conditions, constructability, and code compliance. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Active Professional Engineer license required; able to personally produce, review, serve in responsible charge, and seal structural work. * Strong industrial structural engineering experience and progressive multi\-project leadership. * Demonstrated resource planning, assignment, proposal, technical review, coaching, and client\-facing capability. * Strong written and verbal communication, sound judgment, organization, and dependable follow\-through. * Ability to work effectively across offices, disciplines, project teams, and client organizations. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with industrial or manufacturing facilities and brownfield project environments. * Experience with Unanet AE, Microsoft 365, and project\-based reporting or collaboration tools. **Behavioral Expectations** =========================== * High Character \- Acts with integrity, accuracy, discretion, and sound judgment; raises safety, quality, financial, contractual, and people concerns early. * Own the Outcome \- Takes responsibility, follows through, closes loops, and creates clarity when priorities or conditions change. * Positive Mindset \- Stays practical, respectful, steady, and solution\-oriented through pressure, ambiguity, and change. * Empower Successful Teams \- Gives people clear expectations, useful context, timely feedback, and the support and authority needed to succeed. **Working Conditions** ====================== Office and computer work are regular. Project, client\-site, plant, and field conditions may include stairs, ladders, tight spaces, moving equipment, noise, dust, chemicals, and required PPE. Occasional evening, weekend, holiday, startup, or shutdown work may be required based on the role and project. Travel is required as project and leadership needs require. EAD \| Enterprise\-wide role

jobs.title: System Studies & Modeling Engineer
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Competitive salary * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Opportunity for advancement * Paid time off * Training \& development * Vision insurance * Wellness resources **Job Title**: System Studies \& Modeling Engineer **Employment Type**: Full\-Time, Salary, Exempt **Location**: Hybrid, only accepting candidates in East or Central time zone **Travel**: up to 25% annually **Department**: Engineering **Reports To**: VP of Engineering **Compensation**: $105,000\-$145,000 annual salary \+ exempt supplemental pay **About Us** ECNS Global Consultants, PLLC is a specialized engineering and consulting firm serving the energy and utilities industry. The company provides electrical engineering, controls, cybersecurity, commissioning, testing, quality inspections, and construction management services, supporting projects from concept through completion. With a focus on safety, quality, compliance, and innovation, ECNS delivers reliable solutions for complex infrastructure projects. **Position Summary** The System Studies \& Modeling Engineer is responsible for performing electrical power system studies, developing and maintaining system models, analyzing system performance, and preparing technical recommendations that support the planning, design, operation, and reliability of electrical power systems. This role performs engineering studies such as load flow, short\-circuit, protective device coordination, arc\-flash, and other system analyses based on project requirements. The engineer works closely with ECNS engineering teams, Project Managers, clients, utilities, and other project stakeholders to collect system data, develop accurate models, evaluate study results, and prepare clear technical reports and recommendations. **Key Responsibilities** *Power System Studies \& Analysis* * Perform power system analyses based on project scope and client requirements. * Conduct load flow, short\-circuit, protective device coordination, and arc\-flash studies. * Evaluate electrical system performance under normal and contingency operating conditions as required. * Analyze study results and identify system limitations, equipment concerns, coordination issues, and potential improvements. * Develop technically sound recommendations based on study findings. * Support additional electrical system studies and engineering analyses based on project requirements. *System Modeling* * Develop, maintain, and update electrical power system models using project drawings, equipment information, utility data, and field information. * Verify model inputs for completeness, consistency, and technical accuracy. * Model electrical equipment including transformers, generators, motors, cables, buses, protective devices, and other system components as applicable. * Update models to reflect system modifications, design changes, and revised operating conditions. * Maintain organized model files, assumptions, inputs, calculations, and supporting documentation. * Perform model validation and quality reviews before completing engineering studies. *Protection \& Coordination* * Perform protective device coordination studies for electrical distribution and power systems. * Review protective device settings and time\-current characteristics. * Evaluate coordination between relays, circuit breakers, fuses, and other protective devices. * Identify potential coordination concerns and develop recommendations for improvement. * Coordinate study recommendations with Protection \& Control engineers and other technical disciplines. * Support development or review of protection\-related engineering documentation as assigned. *Arc\-Flash \& Electrical Safety Studies* * Perform arc\-flash hazard analyses based on applicable project requirements and standards. * Calculate incident energy and arc\-flash boundaries using approved engineering methodologies and study software. * Review system configurations, protective device clearing times, and other factors affecting arcflash results. * Identify opportunities to reduce incident energy when appropriate. * Prepare technical information supporting arc\-flash labeling and documentation requirements. * Coordinate findings with project teams and clients. *Engineering Documentation \& Reporting* * Prepare clear, accurate, and organized engineering study reports. * Document study methodology, assumptions, system conditions, findings, and recommendations. * Develop supporting calculations, tables, plots, diagrams, and technical exhibits. * Review study deliverables for technical accuracy and consistency before issuance. * Respond to technical review comments and revise studies as necessary. * Maintain appropriate project records and supporting engineering documentation. *Project Support \& Collaboration* * Work with Project Managers to understand project scope, schedule, deliverables, and technical requirements. * Coordinate with Engineering, Field Services, Commissioning, Protection \ neering, power systems engineering, system studies, system modeling, or a related field. * Hands\-on experience performing power system studies and developing electrical system models. * Experience with load flow, short\-circuit, protective device coordination, and arc\-flash analysis. * Experience interpreting one\-line diagrams, equipment data, protective device information, and other electrical engineering documentation. * Experience working with utility, industrial, renewable energy, data center, substation, generation, or other complex electrical power systems preferred. * Consulting engineering or project\-based engineering experience preferred. * Experience preparing technical engineering reports and presenting study results to technical stakeholders. *Additional Requirements* * Strong understanding of electrical power systems and power system analysis principles. * Knowledge of load flow, short\-circuit, protection coordination, and arc\-flash study methodologies. * Ability to read and interpret electrical one\-line diagrams, schematics, equipment specifications, and technical documentation. * Experience with ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, ASPEN OneLiner, PowerWorld, PSS®E, PSCAD, or comparable power\-system analysis software, depending on project requirements. * Experience with RSCAD and Hardware in the Loop Testing. * Familiarity with applicable IEEE, NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, and utility/client engineering requirements relevant to assigned studies. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to technical accuracy. * Ability to evaluate large amounts of system data and identify inconsistencies or missing information. * Strong technical writing and documentation skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities within project schedules. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary engineering and project teams. * Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and other standard engineering documentation tools. **Physical Requirements** * Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer. * Ability to communicate effectively by phone, video, and email. * Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment. * Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching. * Travel up to 25% annually to support team members at job site, meet with client, etc. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. **Benefits** As a full\-time employee, you are eligible to participate in ECNS’s benefits program. Subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements. * Competitive compensation * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match * Generous PTO and paid holidays * Professional development opportunities * Employee wellness programs **Core Values** *Mission and Vision*: ECNS aims to deliver engineering excellence and innovate for a sustainable future using advanced technologies and eco\-friendly practices. *Integrity and Trust*: Integrity fosters transparency and ethical standards, building trust among clients and team members in all dealings. *Collaboration Across Teams*: Effective collaboration across diverse teams ensures projects benefit from collective expertise and shared goals. *Innovation for Future Readiness*: Innovation drives the development of future\-ready solutions and keeps ECNS ahead of industry trends **Disclaimers** This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, and responsibilities associated with this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice. Equal Opportunity Employer: We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, marital/familial status, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, or other protected class. Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Sr. Site Reliability Engineer - Digital Assets
jobs.description: At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting\-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses. Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment. Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship. **Overall Purpose** The Sr. Site Reliability Engineer applies software engineering and systems engineering practices to improve the reliability, resilience, scalability, and operational health of production services. The role partners with Software Engineering and other technology teams to ensure reliability, observability, recoverability, performance, and operational readiness are engineered into systems throughout their lifecycle. The role independently identifies systemic reliability risks, owns broader reliability outcomes, and influences engineering decisions across multiple services. **Essential Functions** * Use software engineering, automation, and DevOps principles and practices to continually improve how services are built, tested, deployed, observed, operated, and recovered. * Use data, evidence, experimentation, and rigorous engineering analysis appropriate to the level to identify reliability risks, test assumptions, and guide technical decisions. * Define, implement, or improve SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and other service\-health measures appropriate to the scope of responsibility. * Improve observability through metrics, logging, tracing, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and service\-health instrumentation. * Drive continuous improvement across CI/CD, observability, deployment practices, Infrastructure as Code, automation, testing, incident response, capacity management, resilience, and operational readiness. * Identify recurring or systemic production issues and translate operational experience into improvements in code, architecture, automation, tooling, and engineering practices. * Partner with Software Engineering teams to incorporate reliability, resiliency, scalability, performance, observability, recoverability, and operational readiness throughout the development lifecycle. * Participate in or lead incident response, troubleshooting, service restoration, and blameless post\-incident learning appropriate to the level. * Reduce operational toil and unnecessary manual intervention through software, automation, reusable patterns, and better engineering practices. **Leveling Intent** Senior represents the transition from independently performing SRE work to owning broader reliability outcomes and influencing how others engineer reliable systems. Senior SREs increasingly act as force multipliers by mentoring others and spreading reusable engineering practices. **Level Expectations** * Begins to act as a broader force multiplier by mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge, and developing reusable solutions and practices that increase the effectiveness of the team. * Demonstrates software engineering, systems thinking, troubleshooting, and production reliability capabilities appropriate to the level. * Applies evidence\-driven reasoning and technical rigor to distinguish observed facts from assumptions and make defensible engineering recommendations. * Shares knowledge and contributes to sustainable engineering capability rather than creating dependency on individual expertise. * Operates independently across complex systems and ambiguous reliability problems. * Owns reliability outcomes across multiple services and guides less\-experienced engineers. **Minimum Qualifications** * Typically 5–8 years of relevant professional experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Systems Engineering, Cloud/Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Architecture where applicable, or a comparable technical discipline. * Experience with software development or scripting using one or more modern programming languages. * Experience with software engineering principles, distributed systems, production troubleshooting, automation, and observability appropriate to the level. * Experience with public cloud technologies and architectures, preferably AWS, along with infrastructure, networking, Linux/Unix, and modern application architectures appropriate to the level. * Demonstrated analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills appropriate to the scope of the role. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with AWS is preferred, or comparable experience with another major cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). * Experience developing, deploying, operating, or improving highly available production software or distributed systems. * Experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, containers or orchestration, observability, monitoring, alerting, and software\-delivery automation. * Experience with SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management, performance analysis, capacity management, resilience testing, disaster recovery, or operational readiness appropriate to the level. * Experience creating reusable automation, tooling, platforms, patterns, or practices that improve engineering effectiveness. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Employee must be able to perform essential functions and physical requirements of position with or without reasonable accommodation. **Physical Requirements** Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers. The above job description is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow instructions and perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor. The base pay scale for this position in: Phoenix, AZ/ Chicago, IL in USD per year is: $101,000 \- $135,000\. New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA in USD per year is: $122,000 \- $162,000\. Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits. guidelines * Provide escalation support and guidance to stakeholders and help desk staff, and mentor team members on technical best practices * Develop and deliver training and documentation to end users on systems, tools, and security best practices * Effectively navigate complex software licensing models and ensure the company is strategic in its SaaS purchasing, usage, and renewals * Manage jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Emerson, we help the world run safer and smarter. As a global leader in automation, our Analytical Instruments organization develops advanced technologies and solutions that safeguard industries and keep critical systems running. Join our Liquid Analysis team in Shakopee, MN, as a Senior Embedded Software Engineer — where you'll work on both new product development and sustaining engineering for process analytical equipment that protects water quality, supports life sciences, strengthens industrial safety, and serves industries worldwide. If solving complex engineering problems with software excites you, this is an opportunity to build real embedded products, work closely with software, hardware, systems, and test engineers, and see your work come together in the complete product \- become part of a team that’s growing, learning, and focused on delivering results! **IN THIS ROLE, YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL:** * Design and develop embedded software solutions for new products and major product enhancements. * Own significant software features and technical efforts, breaking down work and driving it through implementation, integration, and completion. * Solve complex embedded software and hardware/software integration problems through hands\-on development, debugging, and testing. * Collaborate with global, cross\-functional teams across software, test, systems, hardware, project management, and product management. * Follow and strengthen engineering practices aligned with our SDLA and IEC 62443\-4\-1, including requirements, design, cybersecurity, implementation, testing, reviews, documentation, and release. * Develop and maintain software requirements, architecture, interfaces, and traceability throughout the development lifecycle. * Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers and participate in meaningful technical and peer reviews. Maintain and improve existing products while exploring new technologies, tools, and approaches that improve our products and engineering capabilities. * **WHO YOU ARE** : You take on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks. You deal constructively with problems that do not have clear solutions or outcomes. You grow from hardships and negative experiences You partner with others to get work done. You admit mistakes and gain insight from experiences. **FOR THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering or science from an engineering school * 5\+ years of applicable experience * Experience developing using C/C\+\+ for real\-time, multi\-threaded embedded systems and microcontroller\-based products * **Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now and in the future** + **Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F\-1 (including those with OPT or CPT), H\-1, H\-2, L\-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.** **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS THAT SET YOU APART:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; ABET\-accredited engineering degree preferred * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+, with experience in modular embedded software architecture, object\-oriented design, design patterns, and UML * Experience with embedded Ethernet and TCP/IP networking; industrial Ethernet protocols and stacks such as EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, and PROFINET are a plus * Working knowledge of embedded communication interfaces and industrial protocols such as CAN, SPI, UART/SCI, I²C, HART, Modbus, and PROFIBUS * Demonstrated ability to solve complex embedded software and system\-level technical problems * Experience with secure software development lifecycle practices; familiarity with IEC 62443\-4\-1 or similar product cybersecurity standards preferred * Ability to communicate technical designs, decisions, and tradeoffs and work effectively with cross\-functional teams Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve software development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity * **Our Culture \& Commitment to You:**At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing and know that to do your best you must have flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide, a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, profit sharing retirement, tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture prioritizes work\-life balance and offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave. Our compensation philosophy is simple: we pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which we operate, and reward performance during our annual merit review process. The salary range for this role is $94,000\-$134,000 annually, commensurate with the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role. **\#LI\-BA1** **\#LI\-HYBRID**

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (REMOTE)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Senior AI Engineer is a hands\-on individual contributor who builds, trains, and evaluates machine learning models. The role combines knowledge engineering and data analysis with applied reinforcement learning, and owns work end to end, from data and experiment design through training, evaluation, and reporting. The ideal candidate brings practical reinforcement learning experience, strong engineering discipline, and the ability to collaborate closely with domain experts and communicate results to technical and non\-technical audiences. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Work with domain experts to capture specialized knowledge and represent it in structured, usable form. * Analyze source material and datasets for quality, consistency, and coverage, and resolve issues with the appropriate stakeholders. * Perform exploratory and statistical analysis to inform data, modeling, and evaluation decisions. * Create and curate training and evaluation datasets, using both automated and human validation. * Design reinforcement learning environments, reward functions, and verifiers. * Train and fine\-tune language models using supervised and reinforcement learning methods such as PPO, DPO, and GRPO. * Establish baselines, run ablations, and diagnose training issues such as reward hacking, instability, and data leakage. * Follow the research literature and bring promising techniques into practice. * Manage experiments rigorously, including versioned configurations, reproducible runs, experiment tracking, and compute budgeting. * Design and extend evaluation frameworks, metrics, and benchmarks. * Compare models and approaches through structured experiments and A/B testing. * Document results, failures, and next steps in clear technical write\-ups. * Present findings to engineers, domain experts, and business leaders in language each audience can act on. ### **Requirements \& Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field; MS or PhD preferred. Equivalent hands\-on experience will be considered. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience training or fine\-tuning language models. * Demonstrated reinforcement learning experience, including designing an environment and reward function end to end and training a policy in it. * Working knowledge of policy optimization methods for language models, such as PPO, DPO, or GRPO, including their failure modes. * Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with fluency in the Hugging Face ecosystem and parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning techniques. * Experience building and evaluating LLM\-based agents or multi\-turn systems. * Experience designing evaluations for language models, including held\-out sets and automated grading. * Ability to analyze complex, detailed documentation and translate it into precise, structured, testable form. * Clear technical writing, with the ability to explain an experiment and its results concisely. * Comfort working directly with domain experts who are not machine learning practitioners. * Experience working with healthcare data or in another highly regulated industry is highly preferred. * Experience training models to produce structured or schema\-constrained output is highly preferred. * Experience with a broad range of reinforcement learning algorithms and advanced reward design is highly preferred. * Experience with knowledge representation approaches such as knowledge graphs or ontologies is highly preferred. * Experience generating and validating synthetic data for model training is highly preferred. * Publications or open\-source contributions in reinforcement learning, language model fine\-tuning, or model evaluation is highly preferred. * Experience handling sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA is highly preferred. * Timely and regular attendance. * Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered * To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. ### **Special Considerations and Prerequisites** * Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission. * This is a 100% hands\-on individual contributor role. The AI Engineer owns experiments from design through code, training, and results. * Expect roughly half of the role to focus on reinforcement learning and model training, with the remainder split between knowledge engineering, data analysis, and evaluation. * Success requires sustained, close collaboration with domain experts and a genuine working understanding of the subject matter. * The underlying knowledge evolves over time. The AI Engineer must design data, training, and evaluation approaches that adapt to change without starting over. * All work must comply with HIPAA and EnableComp data policies, using de\-identified or synthetic data wherever possible. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Engramme Visionary Explorers (EVE)
jobs.description: Engramme Visionary Explorers is our flagship fellowship for exceptional emerging talent with the curiosity, energy, and perseverance to tackle foundational problems in AI. Over six months in our offices in San Francisco, you’ll work alongside Engramme’s researchers and engineers to help build Large Memory Models. You’ll turn ideas into experiments, test assumptions, and contribute to systems designed to expand what humans and AI can remember, learn, and accomplish. We are looking for people who bring fresh perspectives, learn quickly, and sustain their focus through difficult problems. **About Engramme** ------------------ Engramme is a Frontier AI lab spun out of Harvard focusing on AI x Human Memory. Persistent memory is a fundamental open problem at the heart of AI. Our vision is to build models of human memory, and to endow humans with perfect and infinite memory. Before starting Engramme, the founding team has produced and commercialized extensive research in machine learning and neuro\-science inspired memory models: * Gabriel Kreiman (CEO \& Co\-founder): Professor of Neuroscience and AI, Harvard Medical School. Led key research on brain memory consolidation at Harvard University. * Spandan Madan (CTO \& Co\-founder): PhD in Computer Science from Harvard, designed AI models which were commercially deployed at Adobe, Fujitsu, and Meta. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Develop and pursue a focused research or engineering project with the Engramme team. * Explore how AI systems can form, organize, retrieve, and use memories. * Build prototypes, run experiments, and develop evaluations. * Share findings, seek feedback, and turn promising results into the next algorithms. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- You may be an undergraduate student, Masters student or PhD student. You may be an early\-career researcher, an engineer, a recent graduate, or a self\-directed builder with compelling work to show. We are particularly interested in people who demonstrate: * Strong foundations in programming, mathematics, or a relevant scientific discipline. * Evidence of initiative through research, publications, software, independent projects, or other substantial work. * Intellectual honesty, resourcefulness, and persistence. * A deep interest in memory, intelligence, and technology that augments human capabilities. Prior AI research experience is valuable, but applicants from adjacent disciplines and unconventional backgrounds are encouraged to apply. **What to Submit** ------------------ Apply below with your CV and links to relevant work you are proud of.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, AI Accounting
jobs.description: **Overview** Exponent is the fastest\-growing financial technology platform built exclusively for franchise and multi\-location brand operators. We offer three integrated products — industry\-leading financing programs including a charge card, acquisition and build\-out loans, and an AI\-powered Accountant — giving operators a single platform to manage spend, access growth capital, and automate their financial operations. We have secured significant equity and credit capital and are backed by leading institutional investors and family offices who operate large franchise portfolios. **Role Description** The role will own core systems inside our AI\-powered Accountant — the product that ingests a franchise operator’s POS, banking, payroll, and processor data, classifies and reconciles it, and automates the monthly close. You will be hand\-on, working alongside a tightly knit, experienced engineering team that ships to production every day. This is a individual contributor role with a path to leading engineers as the team grows. **What You’ll Do** **Own systems end to end:** Design, build, ship, and operate backend systems in production \-from schema to deploy to on\-call. You own what you built after it goes live. **Make unreliable data reliable:** Integrate against difficult third\-party APIs and design ingestion that is idempotent by default — deduplication, safe replay, historical backfill — so every source can be re\-pulled and re\-processed without corrupting the ledger. **Keep every account in sync:** Own the background job infrastructure that keeps thousands of accounts in sync — scheduling, locking, retries, failure handling, and the observability to know when a sync silently stopped. A stuck job is a product bug, not an ops chore. **Put LLMs and ML into the product path:** LLMs and ML models already do the classification and reconciliation work in the product, and we are taking it from build to first pilots now — the point where the decisions about output validation, confidence thresholds, fallbacks, and failure handling actually get made. You will make them. Make a probabilistic component behave inside a system that has to be deterministic where it matters. **Help build a world class growth company:** We are a small, experienced team with broad scope. Every engineer owns what they ship and is expected to exercise judgment rather than wait for direction. Get deep on how technology enables Exponent and its customers to move faster with better experiences and results. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of full stack engineering, with end\-to\-end ownership of systems shipped to production * Ruby on Rails, or equivalent depth in another server\-side framework with a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly * PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, transactional correctness * Third\-party API integration against unreliable sources: incomplete documentation, no webhook support, undocumented format changes, duplicate or partial data * Idempotent data ingestion (deduplication, replay, historical backfill) and background job infrastructure (scheduling, locking, retry and failure handling) * Production experience with LLMs or ML in a product path, including output validation and failure handling **Preferred Requirements** * POS or restaurant data systems: Square, Toast, Qu, Revel, delivery platform payouts, processor settlement files * Accounting platform integration: QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, Restaurant365 * Financial data aggregators: Plaid, Rutter, Stripe * Ledger, double\-entry, or reconciliation system design * Classification model work with measurable evaluation * CSV and file\-based import pipelines at scale Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10016

Fehr Graham is a fast\-growing Midwest engineering and environmental firm looking for a motivated Structural Engineer to join our team. We’re not just seeking someone to fill a position. We want a proactive communicator who can take charge and help lead our growing structural engineering team. Your ideas and vision will be vital as we expand into new markets. You’ll be at the forefront of our growth. **What’s in it for you?** We offer an exciting and engaging work environment where every day brings new challenges and opportunities. As a Structural Engineer, you’ll have the chance to work on diverse projects that push the boundaries of innovation. You'll showcase your skills and expertise while having a real impact on communities, industries and infrastructure throughout the region. Your knowledge of structural systems, engineering design and project delivery will be the backbone of our success. **Where you’ll work** This is a full\-time, in\-office position based out of our East Peoria office. At Fehr Graham, we believe in work\-life balance, and that includes injecting a healthy dose of fun into everything we do. It’s even part of our Core Values! We celebrate milestones and enjoy friendly team\-building activities and office outings. A happy and engaged work team is a successful one. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer- AI & Data Platforms
jobs.description: Description: At First Electronic Bank (FEB), we are driven by the purpose to make credit accessible to everyday Americans and their businesses. Partnering with some of the most innovative fintech companies in the nation, we offer a wide range of consumer and commercial credit and deposit products on a national basis. Offering deposit accounts and debit cards, revolving lines of credit, private\-label credit cards, installment financing programs and more, FEB engages with strategic, collaborative partners, promoting services and products to provide the most beneficial consumer and commercial financing solutions. We are engineering toward self\-healing operations, reflex\-speed decisions, and intelligent automation with a clear audit trail. We want systems that do more than surface information: they help the bank respond, recover, and act with control. Independently lead high\-impact data engineering workstreams from problem definition through measurable production outcomes. Build reliable pipelines, trusted data models, and governed AI workflows, owning design, delivery, operational readiness, and results within Engineering standards. Combine deep Python and SQL engineering with coding agents, retrieval systems, and targeted small\-model experimentation. Evaluate architectures across approved cloud platforms based on security, correctness, performance, recoverability, and cost. Help establish how intelligent systems access and protect enterprise data, turning proven approaches into reusable team patterns. **Representative work:** Modernize warehouse and lakehouse pipelines; integrate partner data through APIs, files, and secure shares; design event\-driven data flows; strengthen reconciliation and automated recovery; build permission\-aware agents; and evaluate emerging defenses in isolated environments. **What You'll Do:** **End\-to\-end ownership:** Clarify problems and success measures; design solutions within established architecture; manage dependencies and risks; and drive delivery within assigned workstreams, following Change Management processes, through adoption, production support, troubleshooting, and improvement. **Data platforms and event\-driven systems:** Build secure batch, streaming, and message\-driven pipelines and reusable data services. Evaluate compute placement, data movement, throughput, latency, delivery guarantees, recoverability, and operating cost. Apply FinOps discipline: monitor cloud compute and storage spend, identify wasteful patterns, and right\-size workloads. **Correctness and resilience:** Engineer idempotent, replayable pipelines with deduplication, schema\-evolution handling, and late\-arriving data support. Build reconciliation, control\-total, checkpoint, and bounded automated recovery tooling with human escalation, supporting Finance and Operations sign\-off. **Trusted analytics:** Develop curated datasets, documented models, and semantic layers for internal and partner\-facing reporting. Partner with business users and BI on definitions, validation, lineage, and controlled access. **Agentic coding:** Delegate bounded tasks to approved coding agents, supply repository context, manage handoffs, and independently validate generated code and data. Retain human ownership of quality, security, and release decisions. **Governed AI workflows:** Build retrieval and tool\-using agents over approved data and MCP servers. Implement permission\-aware access as defined by data owners briefed by Security, along with state management, evaluations, tracing, recovery, and approvals. Treat retrieved content as untrusted. **Defensive AI engineering:** Build and test defensive AI controls in partnership with Security, including segmented agent trust zones, isolated execution, policy\-enforced access, and auditable tool use. Work within Security\-provided sandbox environments and governance to evaluate emerging AI security and adversarial testing techniques through controlled, authorized exercises, producing evidence of meaningful testing to support go\-live decisions. Measure containment, detection, and effects on legitimate workflows. **Applied modeling:** Prototype small\-model or machine\-learning applications for classification, extraction, entity matching, and data\-quality triage. Compare reproducible evaluations against simpler approaches before recommending production use. **Production accountability:** Own reliability, operational readiness, runbooks, and remediation within assigned workstreams, following Change Management processes; collaborate on?CI/CD, identity, networking, secrets, observability, capacity, incidents, and costs. Produce audit evidence, support control testing, and maintain rollback plans and appropriate human approvals. **Team leverage:** Mentor through design and code reviews; convert proven approaches into reusable components and playbooks. Help develop validated engineering and security patterns. Requirements: **What We're Looking For:** * 5\+ years of production data engineering experience, or equivalent scope, delivering reliable cloud\-based solutions. * Demonstrated success independently leading ambiguous work through sustained production use while mentoring engineers and improving team practices. * Strong Python and advanced SQL, including automated testing, query\-plan analysis, performance tuning, and transformation validation. * Production experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, AWS, or a comparable platform, including orchestration and data modeling. Depth and transferable judgment matter more than familiarity with every listed product. * Experience integrating APIs, files, databases, or data shares, including incremental processing, backfills, schema changes, reconciliation, and recovery. * Demonstrable use of coding agents to delegate meaningful work, manage context and handoffs, verify changes, and deliver tested results. * Hands\-on experience building a retrieval, agent, or LLM\-enabled workflow over real data; understanding of evaluation, prompt\-injection risks, permission boundaries, and limitations. * Practical knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, least privilege, secrets management, observability, and troubleshooting. * Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into focused solutions and explain tradeoffs to non\-technical users. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Advanced Snowflake engineering, including secure sharing, Snowpark, performance optimization, and cost governance. * Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Dataverse, Power BI semantic models, or warehouse\-to\-lakehouse modernization. * Event streaming and enterprise message queues, including Azure Service Bus and Azure Event Hubs alongside Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, and comparable platforms ; partitioning, ordering, replay, idempotent consumers, backpressure, and failure recovery. * AWS data services, secure cross\-cloud integration, infrastructure automation, or private\-network architectures. * Production agent systems, MCP integrations, persistent state, evaluation, tracing, and recovery. * Agent security, sandboxing, adversarial evaluation, or deception engineering; familiarity with emerging AI security research is a plus, not a prerequisite. * Small\-model fine\-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, quantization, self\-hosted inference, or reproducible model evaluation. * Banking, fintech, payments, or another regulated environment. * Relevant certifications, or a master's or doctoral degree in a related field.

jobs.title: AI Design Engineer
jobs.description: **AI DESIGN ENGINEER** **Custom Millwork, Casework \& Fixtures** **Location: Tacoma, WA · Full\-Time · On\-Site** **Travel: Some travel to El Paso, TX and Phoenix, AZ** **Reports to: Director of AI \& Automation and Director of Operations** **Industry: Commercial Construction \& Manufacturing** **Compensation: $105,000 – $165,000 plus bonus** It's 11:40 on a Tuesday night, and you're doing it again. The house is quiet. You've got an AI model open on one monitor and a reception desk elevation on the other. You're trying to get the model to read an architect's PDF, find the casework, and give you a cabinet schedule your engineering software can actually use. It half\-works. You're grinning anyway. At 7:00 tomorrow morning you'll walk into a drafting room where that same architect's PDF gets redrawn by hand, line by line. The submittal goes out, comes back covered in redlines, goes out again, comes back again. Someone re\-keys dimensions that already exist in three other files. The most experienced engineer in the building carries the shop's construction standards in their head, and nobody has written them down because nobody has the time. You mentioned AI in a meeting once. Someone called it "your computer thing," and the room moved on. You're not crazy. You're early. We've been looking for you. **This Industry Still Draws Like It's 1998\.** Here it is plainly. Custom millwork, cabinetry, and commercial construction have worked the same way for a long time. Drafting is still manual. Design intent arrives as a PDF and a skilled person redraws it. A single wall\-paneling submittal has to show every joint condition, the panel core, veneer species and cut, leaf and panel matching, room\-match sequencing, grain direction, blocking heights, and the hardware schedule. Every line is drawn by a human, and when the architect changes one dimension, a human redraws all of it. Engineering is still translation. Product libraries help. But every custom reception desk, feature wall, art display, and curved transaction top still starts with a person converting someone else's drawing into parts, joinery, and machining. Manufacturing is still manual everywhere except the robots. The CNC router is the future. The tape measure, the paper traveler, and the re\-keyed cut list are not. That isn't where this industry is going. Frontier doesn't intend to wait for a software vendor to deliver the future in a version 14\.0 update. **We Don't Want Someone to Use Better Software. We Want Someone to Change the Industry.** This is not a CAD manager job. We're not looking for someone to maintain our libraries, run our upgrade cycle, or train people on new buttons. We want the person who is going to work out what engineering, drafting, and design look like when AI is part of the crew, prove it on real projects that get built on our floor and installed in real buildings, and then watch the rest of the industry try to catch up. That's the job: you, Frontier, and the tip of the spear. **Ownership Is Making a Bet. The Bet Is You.** Most manufacturers our size put their big money into equipment: a new CNC router, a panel saw, an edgebander line, a robot cell. We buy machines too. We're manufacturers, and we love machines. But Frontier's ownership believes the bigger opportunity is this one. Changing how we engineer, draft, and design is a bigger lever than the next large piece of capital equipment. That isn't a line in a slide deck. It's how ownership thinks about where money goes. Frontier is an aggressively AI\-forward company with AI\-forward ownership. Our leadership doesn't just "support" AI. They use it, they understand it, and they fund it the way manufacturers fund equipment. We've already hired a Director of AI \& Automation to drive AI across the business. This role takes that same commitment to the core of what we make: the drawings, the engineering, and the design behind every piece of millwork that leaves our shop. You will work for that Director, alongside the leadership of our cabinet engineering and drafting team. **Efficiency That Grows the Shop** The point of making drafting and engineering faster is not to shrink the team. It is to take the capacity we free up and put it into more work, more complex projects, and more people growing into this craft in a technological world. Every hour we pull out of redraw, re\-keying, and tribal\-knowledge bottlenecks is an hour we can put into taking on more volume, training the next generation of engineers and drafters, and opening roles that did not exist when every line had to be drawn by hand. Frontier intends to grow and expand the operation. AI is how we create the room to do that without burning out the people who already carry the standards in their heads. This role amplifies craftspeople. It does not replace them. The efficiency pickups fund growth, new opportunities, and a bigger shop that can compete on both craft and technology. **Signs This Is You** * You have a folder somewhere n the software vendors. Nobody has written it. That's the job. If you need clean, structured data and a defined process before you can do anything, this isn't the role. If you look at a stack of redlined PDFs and see the next ten years of your career, we should talk. What you will have is something almost nobody in this industry gets: ownership that understands what you're trying to do, funds it like equipment, and will clear obstacles out of your way. And a clear mandate: the wins you create are meant to help us grow, not just do the same work with fewer people. **About Frontier Door \& Cabinet** We are builders. True American manufacturers. Frontier Door \& Cabinet has been in business for nearly 30 years. We started as a garage operation and grew into one of the largest specialty contractors in the Pacific Northwest, focused on Division 08 (doors, frames, and hardware) and Division 12 (cabinets and countertops) for commercial construction, with operations in Tacoma, El Paso, and Phoenix. Our facilities run CNC routers, panel saws, and edgebanders, and our estimating team quotes nearly every available project in our markets. Cabinets get installed. Projects have deadlines, budgets, and general contractors who don't care about your technology roadmap. They care that the casework matched the submittal and showed up on time. That pressure is exactly why AI matters so much here. The gap between where this industry is and where it could be is enormous, and we intend to be the company that closes it first, and to use that advantage to expand what we can take on. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary ($105,000 – $165,000 depending on experience) plus bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) * A real budget for AI tools, hardware, training, and industry events (IWF, AWFS, AWI), funded the way we fund production equipment * Direct access to ownership and the leadership team, without layers in between * The chance to build something the whole industry ends up copying, and to help grow a real manufacturing operation while you do it **How to Apply** Send your resume and answers to two questions. No cover letter. 1\. Show us the most interesting thing you've built with AI on your own time. A repo, a screen recording, a screenshot, or a photo of the whiteboard all work. We want proof that you build things. 2\. Name the first drafting or engineering task you'd eliminate, and tell us how you'd do it. If you've spent years thinking "this could all be so much better" while the rest of the shop kept doing it the old way, this is your chance to stop thinking it and start building it. **The Fine Print: The Software** Software isn't the point of this job. But you should know we speak the language, and that you'll be walking into a familiar world. The people we want have lived inside some combination of these: * Microvellum on AutoCAD / BricsCAD: parametric casework engineering, shop drawings, CNC output * Cabinet Vision: design\-to\-manufacture for cabinets and casework * AlphaCAM: CNC router and stone programming, nesting * SolidWorks (and SWOOD): complex fixtures and mixed wood, metal, and glass assemblies * AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino \+ Grasshopper, Inventor * Bluebeam Revu: submittals, redlines, and revision tracking **Also familiar:** TopSolid'Wood, imos iX, 2020 / Design Flex, Moraware CounterGo, SlabSmith, digital templating (Prodim, LPI) **On the AI side:** whatever is best this month. Python, LLM APIs, agents, AutoLISP, .NET, the SolidWorks API. You don't need all of them. You need to know why each one still takes so many clicks and have a theory about how few it should take. *Frontier Door \& Cabinet, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Autonomy Evaluation Applications
jobs.description: **Job Description** **About the Organization** Join the team building GM's next generation of autonomous driving, starting with eyes\-off driving on the highway and growing toward point\-to\-point autonomy. The goal is autonomous capability that is safe, reliable, comfortable, and scalable across GM's vehicle portfolio. Autonomy Evaluation helps the AV program figure out where the driver still falls short. Every mile our vehicles drive, on the road or in simulation, carries that signal. We turn it into answers: what is limiting the system, how big each problem is, and what fixing it is worth. Those answers steer what GM's autonomy teams build next and inform software release decisions. Evaluation Applications is the part of Autonomy Evaluation that turns evaluation into decisions. It has four teams. Driver Performance measures overall driving quality. Subsystem Evaluation measures how subsystems such as perception, prediction, planning, and localization affect driving. Scenario Classification builds the scene classifiers that tag what happened in every drive and simulation run. Test Insights turns results into findings for engineering and release reviews. **The Role** ------------ As Senior Manager of Eval Applications, you will lead these four teams through their managers and tech leads, and own the roadmap, execution, and staffing for how we measure driving quality and turn it into decisions. The work is concrete: using scene classifiers to find simulation tests that don't exercise the behavior they were written to check, or ranking the subsystem failures behind a drop in driving quality so the right team fixes the right thing first. You'll set priorities, build the team, and make sure partner teams trust and act on what we produce. You'll work with the org's principal and staff engineers, who lead evaluation methodology, and with the Software Validation and Safety teams, who use our results in test strategy and release decisions. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the strategy, roadmap, and quarterly plans for Eval Applications, tied to the AV program's product milestones and release needs. Decide what the teams build, what they stop, and in what order. * Make evaluation results trusted and used. Partner teams in Autonomy, Simulation, Systems, Safety, and Software Validation should know what each metric and scene classifier means, how accurate it is, and when to rely on it. * Run the loop from observed driving behavior to ranked problems to fixes, so issues found in road and simulation testing get sized, routed to the owning team, and tracked to closure. * Make sure teams can tell quickly and reliably whether a software or model change improved driving, including regression detection that release reviews can depend on. * Set and track org\-level measures of evaluation quality and impact, such as classifier precision and recall, time from a new question to a trusted answer, and how often our findings change a decision. * Keep the technical bar high through design reviews, code review standards, testing, and statistically sound analysis, and work with principal and staff engineers on technical direction. * Bring in new methods where they pay off, including VLM\- and LLM\-based classification and triage with human review, and AI\-assisted development across the team. Turn results into clear recommendations for engineering and executive leadership: what changed, how confident we are, and what to do next. * **Leadership Responsibilities** ------------------------------- * Hire, develop, and retain managers, tech leads, engineers, and data scientists, and grow the next layer of leaders. * Lead through managers and tech leads with clear ownership, steady operating rhythms, and real accountability. Run performance management fairly and directly. * Shape team structure and staffing as priorities change, balancing near\-term program needs against longer\-term investments in methods and tooling. * Resolve cross\-team conflicts over priorities, ownership, and contradictory results, and align stakeholders on what to do next. jobs.title: Genesis-World: Core Simulation Engine Engineer
jobs.description: **What we’re building** ----------------------- Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis\-World is our bet on that future. Genesis\-World is an open\-source, general\-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi\-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in\-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real\-time photo\-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state\-of\-the\-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open\-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full\-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python\-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in\-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64\. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non\-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. This is at the core of Genesis AI’s strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall\-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200\+ hours), while correlating with on\-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute. **The role** ------------ Simulation is still a hard sell in robotics. Outside a few success stories, like reinforcement learning for locomotion, most teams skip it, and friction is a big part of why: painful to use, painful to debug. We live that pain ourselves: debugging a failing experiment during policy evaluation takes 30 minutes, and there is no way to automatically generate a standalone reproduction script. That blocks adoption, even internally. Your job is to kill that friction. You build the software engineering backbone of Genesis\-World: everything that makes a large, fast\-moving simulation codebase reliable, maintainable, frictionless. And it all ships in the open. Every hour of pain you remove, you remove for every roboticist who comes after you. You join as core maintainer of Genesis\-World, with shared stewardship of the whole platform from day one. Our physics team develops the algorithms, but just as importantly, you work to make everything around them excellent: infrastructure, tooling, APIs, architecture. **The problems waiting for you** -------------------------------- * **Make testing of a JIT\-compiled engine scalable.** Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10\. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis\-World and the compiler teams. * **Make any bug reproducible.** Dump and reload simulations bit\-exactly, across machines, across backends, even when a single timestep of a batched simulation can already max out VRAM. Turn any failing run into a standalone reproduction script, automatically. * **Make autodiff first\-class.** Genesis\-World is differentiable today, but partially: memory\-hungry, slower than it could be, and hard to maintain due to manual operation recording. The project spans the engine and the compiler: you drive the requirements on Quadrants and iterate in a tight loop with the compiler team until the integration is solid. * **Edit scenes at frozen time.** See the scene, move entities and robots around, iterate on layout, all without building the scene or compiling the engine. Authoring today means a full build cycle. Make it instant. * **Make the simulator extensible.** First\-class plugins for physics solvers and interactive viewer backends, including Nyx. Sensors already work this way. Generalize it, and Genesis\-World becomes a platform others build on. * **Give robots real actuation.** Motors and MIMO transmissions, cleanly abstracted at the interface between users and the physics engine. * **Make time a local variable.** Today the clock and the timestep are global to the engine, which forbids whole classes of speedups: environments cannot step independently, the timestep cannot adapt to the state, and individual solvers cannot advance at their own rate. Free the clock down to the sub\-scene level and let the simulation fly. * **Make scenes come alive.** Events triggered by physics: press the button and the microwave door pops open, squeeze the trigger and the drill spins. * **Keep the core sharp.** Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay. Beyond the code: you review issues and pull requests with the core team, answer questions from users and contributors, and can join the push on adoption. **Who you are** --------------- You care about the engineer using what you build as much as the thing itself. A slow test, a cryptic error, a manual step: you see it, you go after the root cause, and you remove it for everyone. You have opinions about API design. You are comfortable with physics and robotics: the right design choices take a working picture of what a simulator like Genesis\-World does, how it works, and how it is used, a picture you can partly build on the job. * Strong Python engineering on large codebases: architecture, refactoring, typing, packaging, performance profiling (py\-spy, Nsight, Xcode Instruments, RenderDoc). * Developer tooling, test infrastructure, or CI at scale. * Enough fluency with JIT compilation, code generation, or GPU computing stacks to reason about compilation caching, kernel dispatch, and startup cost. You will work closely with Quadrants. * At ease debugging across the full platform matrix: Windows, Linux, and macOS, on x86 and arm64, over CUDA, AMD, and Apple Metal (and possibly Intel XPU via Vulkan soon) * Open\-source reflexes: triaging issues, reviewing external pull requests, communicating with a community. Bonus points: experience with other robotics simulators (Drake, MuJoCo, Newton, Isaac, RaiSim, Jiminy, Brax). PyTorch, our user\-facing interface. Other JIT compilers such as Triton, JAX, or Numba. 3D tooling and interactive editors (Maya, Blender, Houdini). Serialization formats (USD, glTF, MJCF/URDF). C\+\+, CUDA, or Metal. Developer relations or community work.

jobs.description: Gradian is an engineering\-led, full\-line thermal solutions partner serving data center and other mission\-critical, commercial, and industrial markets. Headquartered in Maple Grove, MN, with additional facilities across North America, we design and manufacture liquid cooling systems, air handling equipment, heat rejection units, and modular, factory\-assembled thermal management solutions. Gradian was founded through the unification of four complementary, established brands: MAS HVAC, Daedex, DeepCoolAI, and EcoChillers. Together, we act as a single\-source provider, deploying cooling technologies as scalable systems optimized for efficiency, spatial constraints, and overall performance. With a vertically integrated engineering and manufacturing model, we pair rapid design turnaround with precision fabrication, so customers can move faster on complex projects where reliability, timeline, and quality all matter. Why work here At Gradian, you'll work alongside others who get genuinely fired up by complex problems, see your work go from first sketch to job site in weeks, not years, and know that while we're developing the technologies critical for AI infrastructure to scale, our culture remains people\-first by design. It is core to our identity that we operate as one team — driving to win together, energizing others, and building lasting relationships that make the work fun and rewarding. Position Summary: We are seeking a Test \& Integration Engineer to own the execution, validation, and continuous improvement of laboratory and system\-level testing across Gradian’s air handling, liquid cooling, and chiller product lines. This role owns the Design Verification Plan (DVP), translating product and system requirements into traceable verification methods, test procedures, acceptance criteria, schedules, and objective evidence. The position leads test configuration, integration, commissioning, data analysis, and onsite system setup while partnering with NPD, Quality, Operations, Controls, and Product Engineering teams to validate product performance, reliability, safety, compliance, and release readiness. Key Responsibilities: * Own, develop, and maintain the Design Verification Plan (DVP) for air handling, liquid cooling, and chiller products, including requirements traceability, verification methods, test ownership, acceptance criteria, schedules, risks, and closure evidence. * Define and execute functional, performance, reliability, compliance, integration, and commissioning tests across NPD programs; ensure results support design decisions and product release readiness. * Set up, configure, operate, and monitor air, liquid, and refrigeration test systems, including fans, blowers, dampers, coils, pumps, heat exchangers, compressors, valves, sensors, filtration, fluid\-handling equipment, ductwork, piping, and environmental controls. * Develop and review test procedures to ensure correct system configuration, instrumentation placement, airflow and fluid\-flow control, refrigeration conditions, electrical and controls interfaces, safety controls, and environmental conditions. * Monitor and evaluate system behavior, including thermal capacity, psychrometrics, airflow, pressure stability, fluid\-flow characteristics, refrigerant circuit performance, acoustics, vibration, leak detection, and overall system integrity. * Collect, analyze, validate, and report high\-quality test data using calibrated temperature, pressure, airflow, fluid\-flow, humidity, electrical, and refrigeration instrumentation, ensuring precision, repeatability, and traceability. * Perform instrumentation verification and calibration checks, validate sensor accuracy, and maintain calibration, configuration, and deviation records to protect data integrity. * Lead test issue resolution by documenting anomalies, supporting root\-cause analysis, coordinating corrective actions, and updating the DVP and verification evidence as designs evolve. * Assemble, adjust, and reconfigure test fixtures, ductwork, piping, brackets, controls, and lab hardware; support installation and commissioning of prototype and production equipment. * Create and maintain test logs, configuration records, procedures, work instructions, results summaries, and DVP status; communicate risks, gaps, equipment issues, and verification conclusions to cross\-functional stakeholders. * Provide day\-to\-day work direction to Test Technicians by clarifying procedures and acceptance criteria, coordinating resources, monitoring execution, and reviewing test records and results for completeness and accuracy. * Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Systems, Quality, Operations, Product Management, suppliers, and external laboratories to improve product validation, laboratory capability, safety, efficiency, and continuous improvement. Qualifications \& Requirements: Required: * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited institution. * 1–3 years of engineeri ia, and requirements traceability; ability to organize objective evidence through DVP closure. * Familiarity with temperature, pressure, airflow, fluid\-flow, humidity, electrical\-power, vibration, and refrigeration instrumentation and associated data\-acquisition systems. * Ability to analyze test data, assess uncertainty and repeatability, identify abnormal system behavior, and communicate technically sound conclusions. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, P\&IDs, refrigeration schematics, wiring diagrams, control sequences, specifications, and product requirements. * Ability to work safely around rotating equipment, pressurized systems, electrical controls, refrigerants, water/glycol mixtures, and operating HVAC equipment. Preferred: * Experience testing air handling units, computer\-room air handlers, liquid\-cooling distribution units, heat\-rejection equipment, or packaged chillers. * Experience with DAQ and controls platforms such as LabVIEW, PLC\-based systems, building automation systems, or similar tools. * Knowledge of applicable HVAC, chiller, pressure, electrical, and product\-performance standards and certification test methods. * Experience with glycol\-based coolants, water treatment, fluid cleanliness, filtration, evacuation, charging, refrigerant handling, and contamination control. * Experience with statistical analysis, test uncertainty, design of experiments, failure analysis, and corrective\-action methods. * Basic programming or data\-analysis capability for automating tests, processing data, and generating repeatable engineering reports. Key Competencies: * Ownership mindset with the ability to drive a DVP from planning through execution, issue resolution, evidence review, and closure. * Strong systems thinking across mechanical, electrical, controls, airflow, hydronic, and refrigeration interfaces. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, configuration control, and requirements traceability. * Clear technical communication and the ability to coordinate priorities, risks, and decisions across cross\-functional teams. * Ability to provide clear work direction, technical coaching, and constructive feedback to Test Technicians while maintaining accountability for safe, accurate, and timely test execution. * Practical problem\-solving skills, sound engineering judgment, and a disciplined approach to root\-cause analysis. * Ability to adapt to evolving product requirements, prototype maturity, test availability, and shifting program priorities. * Strong safety mindset and ownership of laboratory organization, equipment readiness, and continuous improvement. * Hands\-on approach with curiosity and a passion for developing robust products and test capability. Benefits:* Medical, vision, and dental plans * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance * Group term life insurance coverage * HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care plans available * 8 paid holidays, 4 floating holidays, and generous PTO policy * 401k matching * Company paid events * Annual safety shoe allowance * Education assistance program EEO Statement: Gradian Thermal Solutions is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity.
