jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: *Mechanical Design Engineer \- Growth to Technical Leadership* For 20 years, Gray Matter Research has designed and built specialized equipment for neurophysiology laboratories, ranging from large equipment to complex, precision miniature instruments. We are a small, profitable, founder\-owned company that grew out of a neuroscience lab at Montana State University. Our work is highly specialized, hands\-on, and technically varied, with products used by researchers around the world. **The Role** We are hiring a Mechanical Design Engineer to work closely on the design, customization, documentation, and release of our products. You will work directly with customers, suppliers, fabricators, and our machine shop partner while gradually taking on greater responsibility for engineering projects and day\-to\-day technical work. This is not a narrow design role. We are looking for someone who enjoys both engineering and the practical side of bringing a product to life: understanding a customer's need, developing a solution, creating manufacturable designs, solving problems during production, and supporting the finished product. The person in this role will have the opportunity to learn the products and business while gradually taking on more responsibility and independence. Over time, this position may grow into broader technical leadership, customer and vendor relationships, business responsibilities, and potentially an ownership opportunity. What that path could look like will be discussed openly as the role develops. **Location:** On\-site, in person 619 N. Church Ave., Unit 1 Bozeman, MT 59715 **Schedule:** Salaried position, approximately 30 hours per week. **Reports to:** Founder and Owner **What You Will Do**  Design and customize products for individual customers, from initial quote through released drawings, bills of materials, and build instructions.  Develop precision mechanical parts and assemblies using SolidWorks.  Take projects from customer need through concept, design, prototype, production, and delivery.  Work hands\-on with the products you design, including assembly, testing, prototyping, 3D printing, and occasional machining.  Turn repeat products into well\-documented platforms using parametric CAD models, configurations, template drawings, and repeatable build documentation.  Help develop and launch new product lines from prototype through production.  Work closely with our machine shop partner and other suppliers on manufacturability, tolerances, quotes, lead times, and quality.  Communicate directly with customers to understand their technical needs and support equipment after delivery.  Improve engineering documentation, procedures, and design standards so critical company knowledge is captured and transferable.  Help guide interns, technicians, or junior engineers as appropriate.  Gradually take on more responsibilities, including quoting, project prioritization, vendor relationships, customer accounts, and technical decision\-making. Because we are a small company, everyone occasionally helps outside a narrowly defined job description. We value people who are comfortable pitching in when needed, but the primary focus of this position is engineering, product development, and technical problem\-solving. **What We Are Looking For**  Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field.  Approximately 3–7 years of professional mechanical design or product\-development experience. We are open to candidates outside this range when their experience is a strong fit.  Strong SolidWorks expertise, including parametric and configuration\-driven modeling, surface modeling, and preparation of clear, machinist\-ready drawings.  Strong understanding of GD\&T, materials, fasteners, mechanisms, and precision mechanical design.  Practical design\-for\-manufacture experience, particularly with machined and assembled parts.  Experience working directly with machinists, fabricators, or manufacturing partners.  Experience taking products from concept through prototype and production.  Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.  Excellent fine motor skills and attention to detail for the assembly and testing of intricate miniature equipment.  Ability to move comfortably between custom one\-off projects and standardized products.  Strong written and verbal communication skills.  Ability to document technical work clearly for customers, suppliers, and teammates.  Ability to take ownership of projects while also collaborating closely with the founder.  Interest in taking on greater technical and business responsibility over time. **Nice to Have**  Experience with scientific instrumentation, laboratory equipment, medical devices, precision manufacturing, or other low\-volume, high\-mix products.  Experience with machining and 3D printing.  Experience with animal\-research or biomedical equipment.  Curiosity about neuroscience and research applications.  Experience mentoring technicians, interns, or junior engineers.  Experience with MRI/CT\-based modeling in tools such as 3D Slicer.  Exposure to quoting, pricing, or customer\-facing technical sales.  Understanding of sterile technique and products used in surgical procedures.  Familiarity with basic electronics, PCB design, or MATLAB.  Interest in learning more about the business side of a small engineering company. **What We Offer**  Salary: $64,000–$83,000 per year for 30 hours per week, depending on experience. This is equivalent to approximately $85,000–$110,000 annually on a full\-time basis.  Flexible schedule: An approximately 30\-hour workweek that allows room for life outside of work.  Room to grow: The opportunity to take on greater engineering, customer, and business responsibility as your experience with Gray Matter Research grows.  Long\-term opportunity: For the right person, the role may eventually develop into technical leadership and potentially an ownership opportunity.  Real responsibility: You will make meaningful design decisions, work directly with customers, and have influence over existing and future product lines.  Interesting work: You will solve unusual engineering problems and see your designs move from concept to finished product.  Stability: A profitable company with a 20\-year history.  Benefits: Two weeks of paid time off plus paid holidays, a SIMPLE IRA with a 3% employer match, and a flexible schedule.  We do not currently offer employer\-sponsored health insurance. We are especially interested in someone who wants more than a narrowly defined engineering position—someone who enjoys hands\-on product development, is interested in understanding how a small technical business operates, and would like the opportunity to grow their responsibility over time. If that sounds like the kind of engineering career you are looking for, we would like to hear from you. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $64,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off * Retirement plan Work Location: In person

vendors, line\-of\-business application providers), driving resolution on vendor\-dependent issues. * Create, maintain, and quality\-review internal and client\-facing documentation, including network diagrams, asset inventories, and standard operating procedures, setting the documentation standard for the Pod. * Identify recurring issues, inefficiencies, or improvement opportunities in client environments and bring proposed solutions, not just problems, to the Pod Manager and Account Team (CSM and CIO). * Participate in and help coordinate the emergency on\-call rotation, responding to after\-hours incidents, outages, and critical client escalations, often as the first point of technical escalation for on\-call Field Technician I staff. * Mentor and onboard Field Technician I staff, identity configurations. * Hands\-on experience administering Windows Server environments including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and server virtualization technologies (VMware and/or Hyper\-V). * Working experience supporting MacOS workstations and Apple Business Manager enrolled devices in a mixed\-OS environment. * Hands\-on configuration and troubleshooting experience with networking infrastructure: firewalls, managed switching, VLANs, and wireless (Meraki, Fortinet, and/or Palo Alto experience strongly preferred). * Practical experience with modern endpoint and mail security tooling: EDR/antivirus/mail filtering platforms (e.g., SentinelOne, Umbrella, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Proofpoint, Mimecast, Barracuda), MFA and identity platforms (e.g., Duo, Okta, Entra ID). * Familiarity with backup, storage, and disaster recovery technologies (e.g., Veeam, Cove, Datto, cloud backup platforms), including experience validating backup jobs and executing restores. * Basic scripting/automation familiarity (PowerShell or equivalent) for repeatable troubleshooting, reporting, or provisioning tasks a plus. * Confidence with AI\-enabled tooling and use jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, WarehouseOS
jobs.description: **About WarehouseOS** --------------------- WarehouseOS is the warehouse management system fulfillment teams run their day on. It’s the software floor staff hold in their hands for an entire shift, and what warehouse managers rely on to plan, monitor, and improve operations. Our customers range from fast\-growing brands to established third\-party logistics providers moving thousands of orders a day. We build software for real\-world warehouse environments where reliability, clarity, and speed matter. WarehouseOS is part of a broader software strategy at Hoj Innovations, a company with more than six decades of experience designing, installing, and optimizing warehouse operations. Across more than 100,000 completed projects, Hoj has developed deep operational expertise in a category increasingly shaped by software. WarehouseOS is the starting point for building software capabilities that can serve the company’s wider portfolio over time. We are looking for people who want to help shape that future. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring our first Staff Software Engineer to lead WarehouseOS workstreams, from clarifying ambiguous problems through rollout and production follow\-through. You will report directly to the Director of Software Engineering, who also leads product direction, and partner with our Principal Technical Program Manager on sequencing, dependencies, and coordination across workstreams. We are deliberately moving more technical decision\-making from the Director into the engineering team. You’ll make technical calls without routine sign\-off. When a decision would shift priorities, commitments, or spend, you’ll bring in the people who own those. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role. You will write production code while leading technical work, reviewing changes, and helping other engineers grow. The balance will shift with the work. The role is based in Salt Lake City, Utah and requires a full\-time in\-office presence. The salary range is **$145,000–$180,000**, depending on experience and qualifications. **The work ahead** ------------------ The work spans an established product, modernization of older systems, and new capabilities. Our .NET services support warehouse order flow, device traffic from the floor, and integrations with customer and partner systems. The challenges include developing a sustainable approach to retaining and accessing growing volumes of historical warehouse data, evolving existing systems without disrupting warehouse operations, and making production easier to understand and support. These problems require investigation and judgment, not a predetermined architecture or a mandate to rewrite everything. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Lead engineering workstreams, taking ownership of technical delivery, rollout readiness, and production follow\-through. * Make and document technical decisions about implementation approaches, component boundaries, data models, APIs, and testing strategies. Revisit tradeoffs when evidence or requirements change. * Break work into pieces other engineers can own, provide context for them to make decisions, and help resolve technical obstacles. * Partner with the Director on customer needs, scope, priorities, and risk, and with the Principal Technical Program Manager on sequencing and cross\-workstream dependencies. * Share code\-review responsibility, mentor engineers through review and pairing, and establish review practices proportionate to the risk of a change. * Build and evolve production services with attention to data integrity, reliability, maintainability, and performance under real warehouse load. * Improve observability, runbooks, release practices, and incident response, and address technical debt where it meaningfully reduces risk or enables delivery. **What success looks like in your first six months** ---------------------------------------------------- Working with the Director and the team, you will establish priorities and aim to: * Lead a workstream from design through production, with clear tradeoffs, meaningful ownership by other engineers, and a supported rollout. * Establish a practical design\-review approach that enables more engineers to make sound decisions independently. * Identify and improve a specific reliability or delivery problem with the team, establishing a baseline and demonstrating the improvement. **We’re looking for someone who:** ---------------------------------- * Has a degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. * Has 8\+ years of professional software development experience, including multiple projects led from design through production. * Has designed, shipped, and operated production systems, and can explain the alternatives considered, the tradeoffs made, and what happened after release. * Has deep experience with C\# and ASP.NET Core, or a comparable modern backend stack with the ability to come up to speed quickly. * Can turn an incompletely defined problem into a practical technical approach, accounting for scope, risk, dependencies, and the realities of an existing system. * Understands relational data deeply and can reason about integrity, consistency, and performance under real load. * Writes clearly and helps other engineers grow through design discussions, documentation, code review, and pairing. * Disagrees constructively, seeks relevant expertise, and changes course when better evidence or reasoning emerges. * Has used modern delivery and observability tooling to improve how a team builds and operates software, not just to complete individual tasks. * Is comfortable in a growing organization where some systems and practices are established and others still need to be built. **Even better if you:** ----------------------- * Have experience in warehouse management, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, industrial automation, or other operations\-heavy software. * Have built or operated integrations with hardware, scanners, mobile devices, or customer and vendor systems. * Have worked with microservice or event\-driven architectures and understand where they help and where they add unnecessary complexity. * Have experience running software on Linux in production, including containers and cloud infrastructure. * Have led incident reviews or improved on\-call practices to reduce recurring operational problems. * Use AI development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity while maintaining quality and accountability. **Benefits and perks** ---------------------- * Flex PTO * Medical, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, medical advice line access, flexible spending accounts, and parental leave * Disability and life insurance options * Employer dollar match to HSA and 401(k) * Team\-building events and monthly catered office lunches **Optional: share a technical decision** ---------------------------------------- If you’d like, include a few paragraphs about a technical decision where there was meaningful disagreement or where you changed your mind. Describe the options, how you reached a decision, how you worked with others, and what you learned from the outcome. An anonymized example is welcome. Please do not include confidential information from a current or former employer.

The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with direct, hands\-on experience building and shipping AI applications, skills, and plug\-ins in a governed, regulated environment, who is productive from the first weeks and ready to grow into agent development. The AI Engineer professionalizes experimental AI prototypes into governed, tested, enterprise\-ready applications, and owns the enterprise standards and governance for HUB’s skills, plug\-ins, and MCP wherever they are used across HUB. The role scales these capabilities to the business through HUB’s native AI ecosystem. The team builds the simple to moderate skills, plug\-ins, and MCP connections directly. Our benefits include: * Competitive base salary plus performance\-based bonus * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and company holidays * Hybrid work arrangement based out of our Chicago office * Professional development and certification reimbursement * Opportunity to shape HUB’s enterprise AI application and asset platform and build across a modern stack spanning Claude, RAG, and agentic tooling **JOIN OUR TEAM** Do you believe in the power of innovation, collaboration, and transformation? Do you thrive in a supportive and client focused work environment? Are you looking for an opportunity to help build and drive change in a rapidly growing and evolving organization? When you join **HUB International**, you will be part of a community of learners and doers focused on our Core Values: entrepreneurship, teamwork, integrity, accountability, and service. *The expected salary range for this position is $ 135,000 to $160,000 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level.* *HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HAS and 401(k) accounts, paid\-time\-off benefits such as vacation, sick, personal, floating holidays and company holidays. In addition, eligible annual bonuses, equity and commissions may be available for some positions.* **What we offer you** We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support, and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career. Benefits and programs vary based on employment status, role, location, and applicable eligibility requirements. * Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, and company\-paid life and disability plans * Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance * A collaborative, high\-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career **The HUB difference** HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** HUB International Limited is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.description: **Open Position – Senior/Staff/Principal Optical Engineer \- Visualization Systems** ***Horizon Surgical Systems Inc.*** Horizon Surgical Systems Inc. is revolutionizing the world of surgical ophthalmology by developing a novel, AI driven, and imaging\-guided surgical robotic system. Horizon Surgical Systems Inc. aims to expand access to care, provide superior capabilities to the human surgeon, and enhance patient outcomes. In this position, you will work closely with a team of optical, mechanical, electrical and software engineers to construct, evaluate and maintain novel imaging devices as part of a robotic surgery platform. **As part of our team, your core responsibilities will be to:** * Participate in the optical and opto\-mechanical design of a multi\-modality surgical imaging platform, comprising a multi\-channel digital microscope, complex incoherent illumination system and a state\-of\-the art swept source optical coherence tomography (SSOCT) system * Construct, align, calibrate and maintain advanced prototype systems and release candidates; work closely with electrical, mechanical, and software teams to ensure optimal system performance * Devise, maintain and execute standard operating procedures for construction, alignment and calibration of prototype systems * Construct and evaluate modular bench prototypes to demonstrate capabilities of the candidate designs * Gather feedback from early users and pilot studies, and work with product management and engineering teams to iterate on design * Operate within a quality management system to allow traceability and team\-wide collaboration * Participate in DfM efforts to ensure system manufacturability and serviceability **Preferred Qualifications** * Preferred: B.S.\+10/M.S.\+5/PhD\+3 YOE in optical or electrical engineering, physics or a related discipline * Minimum: B.S.\+5/M.S.\+3/PhD \+0 YOE * Experience in the construction, alignment and calibration of optical systems, both bench/lab prototypes and commercial systems * Familiarity with optical design tools (e.g. Zemax, Code V or OSLO) * Familiarity with CAD software (e.g. Solidworks) * Strong understanding of practical aspects of optical systems, including opto\-mechanical design and tolerancing (GD\&T), coherence and statistical optics, and design considerations for selecting light sources (lasers, SLDs, LEDs), and detectors (high speed cameras, balanced photoreceivers, etc.) * Prior experience in working with Optical Coherence Tomography systems * Prior experience developing medical devices, and an understanding of quality management systems and design controls as applied to medical devices **Compensation:** Horizon Surgical Systems offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, 401k, remote days, unlimited PTO, paid maternity/paternity leave, and company holidays. Base salary ranges (*not including the equity and end of year bonuses*) * Senior: 110k to 135k * Staff: 135k to 160k * Principal: 160k to 185k This is an exciting opportunity to join a high\-tech startup that is revolutionizing surgical robotics in ophthalmology.

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Ideal Vacuum is an established scientific and industrial vacuum equipment company whose products support universities, laboratories, research facilities, and aerospace customers. Its team manufactures environmental testing systems and contributes to research and technological advancement. **Job Overview** Ideal Vacuum Products is seeking an experienced embedded firmware engineer to develop and support firmware for vacuum, spectroscopy, and other scientific and industrial equipment. You will help build our next generation of products using 32\-bit Arm\-based microcontrollers, work closely with our electrical engineering team, and keep released products reliable through careful debugging, testing, and updates. Our newer PCB designs use STMicroelectronics STM32 microcontrollers. STM32 experience is strongly preferred, and we also welcome candidates with solid production firmware experience on comparable 32\-bit Arm platforms. We value strong embedded C/C\+\+ fundamentals and the ability to learn new devices and development tools. Alongside new development, you will help maintain existing Atmel\-based products and Atmel Studio projects. This includes adapting firmware when PCB components change, resolving production bugs, and verifying that updates work with the supported hardware revisions. **Responsibilities** * **Develop new product firmware.** Write clear, maintainable embedded C/C\+\+ for 32\-bit Arm\-based microcontrollers, including STM32\-based products. Implement device interfaces, measurement and control functions, and communications, and work with electrical engineers during board bring\-up. * **Troubleshoot production problems.** Reproduce failures, trace root causes, and fix existing code. Use in\-circuit debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and diagnostic logs to distinguish firmware, hardware, and interaction problems. * **Support PCB revisions.** Work with electrical engineers when a component is replaced or a board is improved. Compare device behavior and update drivers, initialization, pin assignments, timing, calibration, or communications as needed. Support firmware ports when microcontrollers change. * **Test changes thoroughly.** Verify fixes on actual hardware, test normal and failure conditions, and check for regressions. Confirm compatibility with each supported board revision and document the results. * **Make releases reproducible.** Maintain source control, build instructions, firmware version records, hardware compatibility information, and production programming instructions so the correct tested code reaches each board. * **Work closely with the team.** Collaborate with electrical engineers, software developers, scientists, technicians, and manufacturing staff. Explain findings clearly and balance new development with timely support for production. **Experience** * **STM32 development tools such as STM32CubeIDE or STM32CubeMX**, and familiarity with vendor peripheral libraries or register\-level programming. * **Bare\-metal firmware, an RTOS**, bootloaders, firmware updates, or robust handling of persistent settings. * **Maintaining Atmel/Microchip AVR or SAM** codebases and existing Atmel Studio or Microchip Studio projects. * **Production test fixtures,** automated regression testing, or Python/PC\-side tools that support firmware development and manufacturing. * Scientific instruments, industrial controls, sensor interfaces, precision measurements, or serial communications. **What You Will Bring** * Demonstrated professional experience developing and maintaining firmware for released hardware products, including 32\-bit microcontrollers. * Experience developing firmware for Arm\-based MCUs. STM32 experience is strongly preferred; comparable 32\-bit Arm experience is welcome. * Strong embedded C skills and the ability to work with C\+\+ code as needed, including memory use, interrupts, timers, state machines, and timing\-sensitive behavior. * Practical experience with peripheral interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, ADCs, or PWM, and the ability to learn unfamiliar devices from their datasheets. * Ability to read relevant schematics, follow signals through a circuit, and debug independently at the bench. * Disciplined use of Git or comparable version control, code review, documented testing, and controlled releases. * Clear communication, careful problem\-solving, and a willingness to understand existing designs before changing them. * A degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated professional embedded development experience. **Why Join Ideal Vacuum** Work alongside the people designing, building, and testing the hardware your code runs on. You will contribute to new products and see the practical results of improvements to equipment already in production. **Compensation \& Benefits** Competitive, negotiable salary based on relevant experience. * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) retirement plan. * Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave. How to Apply Email workwithus@idealvac.com with the subject **Embedded Firmware Engineer Application**. Please include your resume and a brief, nonconfidential example of a microcontroller firmware problem you personally solved. Tell us which MCU and tools you used, what you changed, and how you verified the result on hardware. New product bring\-up, a production bug, or a firmware update accompanying a PCB revision are all relevant examples. Ideal Vacuum Products 5910 Midway Park Blvd. NE Albuquerque, NM 87109 Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) 3% Match * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance Experience: * Embedded Firmware: 2 years (Required) Work Location: In person

apply fine\-tuning or other model adaptation when evaluation demonstrates an advantage. * Build evaluation datasets, automated checks, and human review workflows to measure quality, robustness, and regressions. * Diagnose failures through traces and error analysis; improve grounding, tool reliability, context handling, and recovery from unexpected outputs. * Design sandboxed execution with least\-privilege access, network and filesystem restrictions, secrets protection, and resource limits for agent tools and generated code. * Test prompt injection, data leakage, and unintended actions; implement output validation, isolation boundaries, and auditable execution with security partners. * Measure latency, throughput, and inference costs; collaborate with application engineers and learning researchers on testable, observable software. * Test emerging techniques, document findings and limitations, and help the team decide what to pursue, revise, or stop. * Other duties as required. **Share Your Expertise****.** Experience, education, and qualifications essential for success in this role, include:* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field and at least 5 or more years of software or machine learning engineering experience; or an acceptable combination of education and experience. * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications with tool use, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation; ability to explain failures and improvements. * Strong Python or TypeScript skills; experience with APIs, asynchronous code, data models, testing, cloud services, and debugging across system boundaries. * Practical understanding of sandboxing, isolation, access controls, secrets management, and security risks in agentic systems. * Strongly preferred: experience with multimodal or voice AI, agent orchestration, model adaptation, or evaluation infrastructure; active experimentation with emerging AI methods. * Preferred: experience and understanding of agentic toolkits or frameworks such as Deep Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenClaw, Hermes, or comparable tools. We strive to create a welcoming workplace where employees can learn from one another, grow together, and build educational experiences that reflect the world of our learners. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, transgender status (including whether or not you are transitioning or have transitioned), sexual orientation, marital status, religion (including religion dress and grooming practices), age 40 and over, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information (including results of genetic testing and characteristics), veteran and/or military status, or service in the military, and any other basis or status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. ***To all recruitment agencies:*** *Imagine Learning does not accept agency resumes* *without our express written permission**. Imagine Learning is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer/Estimator - MTA
jobs.description: **Job title:** Senior Systems Engineer/Estimator \- MTA **Location:** New York City, NY \| Primarily office; occasional site visits may be required **Compensation Range:** $55\-70/hr. **Who We Are** Infinite Consulting Corp. is a project, program, and construction management firm established in 2009\. We specialize in safety and quality management, project and construction management, cost estimating, CPM scheduling, and project controls. We proudly provide the highest level of service and support at each phase of our clients' projects. Our client's success is our success. Together we fulfill our goal of **“BUILDING BETTER FUTURES”.** We also take pride in our workplace. Infinite is a collaborative environment where people can grow, take on new challenges, and build their careers. Named a 2024, 2025, \& 2026 Top Long Island Workplace, our culture is grounded in integrity, safety, and respect for one another. **About the Role** Infinite Consulting Corp. is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer for an anticipated opportunity supporting public infrastructure projects. This role combines senior construction estimating with hands\-on development of digital systems that improve estimating, scheduling, reporting and project delivery. Prior experience supporting MTA projects is required. The anticipated assignment is approximately 3 years with a potential 12\-month extension. Assignment commencement and duration are subject to client approval and project authorization. **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, either 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m. or 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m., including a half\-hour unpaid lunch. **Role and Responsibilities** * Develop and assess construction cost estimates using AACE Class 1–5 estimating standards and established project methodologies. * Use construction estimating tools, including Bluebeam and RS Means Online, to improve accuracy and efficiency. * Prepare change\-order estimates and bid analyses; compare estimated values with actual post\-bid results. * Support value engineering, constructability reviews and indirect rate analysis. * Design, develop and manage Power Apps, Power Automate workflows and Power BI dashboards; connect data from IMPACT, PeopleSoft and P6\. * Establish, manage and optimize SQL databases for project estimating data, and develop and customize SharePoint sites for collaboration. * Build advanced Excel models using pivot tables, macros and VBA; apply AI prompting to automate workflows and improve estimating, scheduling and data visualization. * Integrate digital tools and platforms to streamline estimating and reporting and enable efficient data exchange. * Migrate estimating data and structure libraries into new HCSS database libraries. * Apply CPM scheduling methods to connect data across Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Planner and other project platforms. * Perform other related estimating and digital\-systems work as needed.**Skills Education and Experience Qualifications:** * Prior experience supporting MTA projects. * Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Construction Management, Construction Engineering, Civil Engineering or a related field. * At least seven years of experience preparing construction estimates. * At least seven years of experience with construction estimating software, such as Bluebeam and RS Means Online. * At least four years of experience using Power Platform and Power BI to develop advanced digital applications for project and program management. * At least five years of demonstrated experience applying AACE Class 1–5 estimating standards. * At least five years of demonstrated experience estimating personal services contracts. * At least five years of experience reviewing estimates for compliance with scopes of work in contract documents. * Advanced Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, macros and VBA scripting, and demonstrated knowledge of AI prompting to design and implement productivity solutions. * Demonstrated experience linking Power Platform applications with server systems, including IMPACT, PeopleSoft and P6\. * Experience using Microsoft Project, Primavera P6 and Planner, with proficiency in CPM scheduling methodology. * Knowledge of Excel, Access, Word and Unifier. * Experience with estimating data structure libraries and transferring data into new database structures. * Demonstrated leadership, coordination, communication and negotiation skills.**Preferred qualifications** * Master’s degree in a relevant field. * Power Platform Fundamentals certification or equivalent. * Your resume should clearly demonstrate relevant project experience, software development work and the required years of experience. **Benefits:** Benefits provided may include the following, subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms: * Medical, dental and vision coverage * 401(k) with 4% match * Short\-term and long\-term disability coverage * Life insurance * Paid time off, sick time and company holidays * A collaborative company culture and autonomy in your role**Why Join Us** Infinite Consulting Corp offers a vibrant and inclusive workplace culture and opportunities for professional growth. We put our people first and we've created a culture that attracts professional, passionate, and caring individuals who are actively working together to solve problems. As a team member with Infinite, you’re visible. You are heard. You can expect to make a difference through your work and you directly influence Infinite’s mission of building better futures. Infinite Consulting Corp is proud to have been named a Top Long Island Workplace by the Long Island Press for the last 3 years running! Our employees described the company culture with values like Integrity, Honesty, Dedication to Safety, and Family\-Oriented, all of which guide everything we do. The company is deeply grateful for this recognition and remains committed to creating an environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to succeed. **Core Values:** At Infinite Consulting Corp, we embody five Core Values: * Accountability: We hold ourselves accountable for our actions and decisions, ensuring the highest level of integrity in all that we do. * Excellence: We pursue excellence in every aspect of our work, delivering results that exceed expectations and setting new standards in our industry. * Innovation: We embrace innovation, constantly seeking new and better ways to solve problems and drive progress in project management and construction. * People: We prioritize our people, fostering a vibrant and inclusive workplace culture where every individual is valued, respected, and empowered to make a difference. * Integrity: We do the right thing, follow through on our commitments, and are honest and transparent in how we work with our clients and each other. **Philanthropy Opportunities** The Infinite Cares mission is to donate our time, money, and energy to causes that make the world a better place. We encourage everybody to find causes they are passionate about and look for ways to make a difference. Take a look and see how we are giving back www.infinitecares.com. The Building Better Futures Foundation is Infinite Consulting Corp.’s nonprofit initiative dedicated to supporting education, community development, and opportunities for the next generation. Through scholarships, mentorship, and partnerships with local organizations, the foundation focuses on creating access and opening doors for students and young professionals. It reflects Infinite’s commitment to giving back and making a lasting impact in the communities where we live and work. Learn more at www.buildingbetterfuturesfoundation.org. **New York City Equal Pay Disclaimer** Infinite Consulting Corp carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s experience, education and training. The anticipated hourly pay range for this position is $55\-70/hr. **Equal Opportunity Disclaimer** We are an equal opportunity employer and referral source. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Attention: Infinite Consulting Corp applicants, please note that all official company correspondence will come from an Infinite Consulting Corp representative that can be verified with an official company email address. Be cautious of any communication requesting sensitive information outside of our secure application process. If you receive suspicious correspondence, contact our Talent department immediately at talent@infiniteconsultingcorp.com Your security is our priority.

jobs.title: Systems Technician
jobs.description: **Are you ready to shape the future of IT? Join Integris, where integrity meets innovation, and people come first.** At Integris, we don’t just offer jobs, we offer purpose. As a nationally recognized **Best Places to Work** and a leader in **future\-ready managed services**, we’re redefining how businesses experience IT. Our mission is bold: to empower clients and employees alike through secure, strategic, and scalable technology solutions. We’re looking for talent that thrives in a culture of **clarity, trust, and relentless execution**, individuals who believe that IT is not just support, but a strategic advantage. If you’re passionate about innovation, driven by impact, and ready to grow with a company that puts **People First**, you’ll find your place here. **Job Summary:** The Systems Technician is responsible for providing frontline technical support for single end\-user level issues, including personal computer, printer, Microsoft 365, Windows application, mobile device, and basic connectivity matters. This role serves as the initial point of contact for client technical assistance and is responsible for managing inquiries received through phone, email, and the client portal. The Systems Technician provides exceptional customer service while troubleshooting and resolving support requests efficiently and effectively. This position may execute responsibilities from the service desk, the field, a client site, an Integris office, or a remote home office depending on business and client needs. This position could participate in an on\-call rotation supporting critical systems and operations outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Participation, availability during assigned periods, and timely response to urgent incidents are essential functions of the role. This role is expected to build technical capability over time, follow documented processes, maintain accurate service ticket documentation, and escalate complex technical issues to Systems Administrators or Systems Engineers when appropriate. The Systems Technician contributes to a positive client experience and plays an important role in maintaining daily service delivery operations. **Job Responsibilities:** *Ticket Management* * Work assigned tickets in order of SLA. * Serve as the first point of contact for client support requests received through phone, email, and client portal. * Answer inbound support calls, create service tickets, and ensure requests are properly documented, categorized, and prioritized. * Troubleshoot and resolve frontline technical issues efficiently and effectively to minimize disruption to customer operations. * Escalate advanced or unresolved technical issues to Systems Administrators or Systems Engineers following established escalation procedures. * Document all technical work comprehensively to facilitate accurate client billing and ongoing support. *Collaboration,**Communication,**and**Customer**Service* * Demonstrate excellent customer service skills with a focus on professionalism, responsiveness, and problem\-solving. * Communicate clearly with clients regarding ticket status, troubleshooting steps, next steps, and resolution details. * Collaborate with Systems Administrators, Systems Engineers, and other technical team members to resolve client issues. * Participate in team meetings, training sessions, documentation efforts, and knowledge\-sharing activities. * Follow up with clients and internal team members as needed to support timely issue resolution and a positive client experience. *Technical Support \& Documentation* * Provide frontline technical support for end\-user devices, Microsoft 365 applications, and common infrastructure issues, escalating complex issues as appropriate. * Support the configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of workstations, peripheral devices, and basic server, networking, and cloud technologies under established procedures. * Assist with Microsoft 365 user administration, including account provisioning, password resets, licensing, and basic support for Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint. * Troubleshoot common connectivity issues involving workstations, printers, wireless networks, VPN access, and basic network services, escalating advanced networking issues when necessary. * Support backup verification, endpoint management, documentation, ticketing, remote management, and monitoring tools as part of daily operational activities. * Collaborate with Systems Administrators, Systems Engineers, and other team members to resolve client issues while continuing to develop technical knowledge and skills. * Follow established IT service management processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to deliver consistent, high\-quality support. * Maintain accurate documentation of work performed and contribute to knowledge base articles and SOP updates as appropriate. *Professional Development \& Technical Growth* * Demonstrate curiosity and commitment to continuous learning across Microsoft technologies, networking fundamentals, service delivery, and client support. * Participate in training, coaching, and certification pathways that support continued growth into advanced technical responsibilities. * Leverage approved AI solutions responsibly to accelerate learning, improve troubleshooting efficiency, enhance documentation quality, and support better customer outcomes. * Develop foundational technical knowledge that prepares the employee for potential progression into Systems Administrator responsibilities. **Job Qualifications** *Education/Certification Requirements:* * Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience). * Valid driver’s license. * Entry\-level certifications are preferred. Examples including but not limited to: + CompTIA Network\+ + Microsoft Fundamentals certifications + Google IT Support Professional Certificate + CompTIA A\+ *Experience**Requirements:* * + 1\-3 years of experience in technical support, help desk, desktop support, call center technical support, field support, or related IT support roles. + Experience supporting Microsoft operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, basic networking issues, and end\-user technology. + Experience delivering customer\-facing support with a strong focus on professionalism, communication, and service quality. + Experience working within a Managed Services Provider (MSP), consulting, or multi\- client IT support environment is preferred. *Technical Knowledge \& Experience (including, but not limited to):* * + Administration and troubleshooting of Windows workstation environments. + Basic Microsoft 365 administration and end\-user support. + Basic Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID user administration. + Basic understanding of Azure cloud concepts and Microsoft cloud services. + Basic networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, wireless connectivity, and general connectivity troubleshooting. + Experience using ticketing systems and remote support tools, including ConnectWise or similar platforms. + Familiarity with endpoint management and remote monitoring tools, including Intune, ConnectWise Automate, or similar technologies. + Familiarity with firewall, wireless, and network support tools, including WatchGuard, Meraki, or similar technologies. + Working knowledge of hardware, printers, mobile devices, peripherals, and workstation deployment. + Working knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, user security awareness, data privacy, and appropriate handling of client information. + Working knowledge of AI\-assisted productivity and support tools, including Microsoft Copilot, Chat GPT Enterprise, and other approved generative AI solutions. + Ability to leverage AI tools responsibly to improve troubleshooting efficiency, documentation quality, and customer support outcomes. At **Integris**, we value our team members and **offer comprehensive benefits**, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401K Retirement Plan * Minimum 4 Weeks of Paid Time Off (PTO) * Birthday PTO * Paid Holidays * Paid Time Off for Volunteering * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Life Insurance * Supplemental Insurance * Employee Assistance Program Join us in transforming IT services for small and midsize businesses across regulated industries. Be part of a team that’s scaling nationally, investing in vertical expertise, and **building for better**. *Integris is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, familial status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected class under applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB221735 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Job Description** * The Human Factors Manager works closely with fellow Human Factors managers and engineers and collaborates with other cross\-functional managers of clinical engineering, system and software engineering, product managers, and program managers among other important functional teams in the development of novel technologies and devices. * The Human Factors Manager's primary role is to support, inform and guide development of Human Factors team members and represent the Human Factors function within and across business units, ensuring the successful execution of Human Factors Usability Engineering Initiatives, process activities and deliverables, while keeping a patient\-first mindset, acting as an advocate for the clinical caregiver end\-users regarding safety and usability, and as representative for medical device regulatory compliance. * As a member of new product\-development project teams, the Human Factors Manager leads as a key stakeholder within a creative and structured process to help their direct HF team plan, communicate and advocate the value of Human factors function, and execute the appropriate scale of usability engineering activities prior to launch, within a regulated design controls environment. * Establish and support project\-based strategy for usability research, consistent with research strategy and initiatives across the Human Factors group. * identity governance. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI agents, Agent 365, or security and governance controls for enterprise AI workloads. * Experience with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft 365 security capabilities, including integration across identity, applications, endpoints, and cloud services. * Understanding of Zero Trust principles and their application across Microsoft 365 identity, data, applications, and collaboration services. * Experience assessing existing environments, identifying security or compliance gaps, and implementing remediation recommendations. * jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description: POSITION OVERVIEW John Boos \& Co. is seeking a highly capable **IT Support Engineer** to serve as hands\-on frontline IT support across both office and manufacturing environments. This position serves as a primary point of initial contact for end\-user technology issues and manufacturing systems troubleshooting while assisting with the administration, maintenance, and improvement of the organization’s broader IT environment. Responsible for troubleshooting workstations, printers, networks, Microsoft 365 services, business applications, and manufacturing technology. Must be adaptable, curious, service\-oriented, and willing to take ownership of unfamiliar problems. Works with employees at all levels while moving between office, manufacturing, and infrastructure environments. DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES **End\-User \& Technical Support** * Serve as a primary point of contact for end\-user technology issues and requests. * Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, application, and peripheral issues. * Troubleshoot and repair desktops, laptops, monitors, docking stations, mobile devices, and other endpoint equipment. * Support users with Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365 applications. * Install, configure, maintain, upgrade, and replace computer hardware and software. * Assist employees with new technology, applications, and changes to existing systems; escalate complex issues when appropriate while maintaining ownership through resolution. **Network \& Infrastructure Support** * Perform basic troubleshooting of wired and wireless connectivity, network connections, switches, TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, cabling, and endpoint connectivity. * Assist with installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of network equipment and connected devices. * Identify and document recurring network or infrastructure problems and assist senior IT personnel with infrastructure upgrades, maintenance, and technology projects. **Microsoft 365 Administration** * Assist with administration and support of Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and related services. * Assist with user access, permissions, application configuration, and general Microsoft 365 troubleshooting. * Support and maintain SharePoint sites, permissions, content, and collaboration solutions. * Provide support for Power BI reports, dashboards, data access, and related business reporting solutions. **Printing \& Manufacturing Technology Support** * Troubleshoot printing issues in office and manufacturing environments, including standard office printers, multifunction devices, and Zebra label printers. * Diagnose issues involving drivers, network connectivity, print queues, labels, applications, and printer hardware. * Provide hands\-on technology support on the manufacturing floor and work directly with operations and manufacturing personnel on technology issues affecting production or business processes. **Systems, Applications \& Documentation** * Install and upgrade software applications and provide ongoing technical support for existing business systems and technology solutions. * Assist in troubleshooting integrations and communication between endpoints, applications, printers, and network resources; work with vendors when necessary. * Participate in testing and deployment of new systems, applications, hardware, and technology solutions. * Create and maintain technical documentation for IT systems, processes, configurations, troubleshooting procedures, recurring problems, equipment, and standards. * Identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, security, and the end\-user experience. EDUCATION \& TRAINING * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical IT experience. * Previous experience in technical support, desktop support, network support, systems administration, or a similar IT role is preferred. * Manufacturing IT experience is beneficial but not required. * Entry\-level candidates with strong technical aptitude, demonstrated troubleshooting skills, and a willingness to learn may also be considered. KNOWLEDGE \& EXPERIENCE * Strong general knowledge of computer hardware, software, peripherals, and operating systems. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365, including experience supporting Microsoft Office applications and Microsoft 365 services. * Experience troubleshooting desktops, laptops, printers, applications, and network connectivity. * Basic understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, wired networks, and wireless networks. * Working knowledge of SharePoint administration and support, with familiarity with Power BI and business reporting environments. * Ability to troubleshoot printers and printing\-related problems in both office and manufacturing environments. * Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server and/or general SQL knowledge, including ability to write or understand basic SQL queries. * Preferred: C\# or other programming/scripting experience, PowerShell, ERP system administration or support, Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory, and Microsoft Intune or endpoint management. * Preferred: Experience with Zebra printers, network switches, wireless access points, VLANs, manufacturing/distribution technology, and Power BI administration, data sources, gateways, or report troubleshooting. SKILLS \& ABILITIES * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills. * Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical employees. * Ability to document technical processes and solutions clearly. * Ability to work independently while functioning effectively as part of an IT team and managing multiple competing priorities. * Comfortable working directly with users in both professional office and manufacturing environments. * Ability to maintain a customer\-service mindset while balancing business and technical requirements. * Willingness to investigate unfamiliar problems, learn new technologies, and take on changing responsibilities. * Willingness to move between desktop support, networking, Microsoft 365, manufacturing systems, applications, and project work as business needs change. * Understanding the urgency of manufacturing technology issues as they relate to shipping and production timelines. BENEFITS * Paid Vacation * Paid PTO * 8 Paid Holidays * Health Insurance * Life Insurance * Vision Insurance * Dental Insurance * Supplemental Insurance * 401(k) Retirement Plan * Variable Pay Bonuses * Company Discount * Gym Membership Discount * Flexible Schedules *John Boos \& Co. maintains a drug\-free workplace.* *John Boos\& Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Kami** Kami is a thriving organisation filled to the brim with talented, creative, and passionate people! It’s hard not to love what you do when our leading digital classroom platform offers meaningful solutions to over 70 million users worldwide, empowering students and supporting teachers! You’ll be joining at a pretty magical time. Kami’s user base is growing by the day. With over 170 team members across the world, we couldn’t be prouder of the accomplishments and milestones we’ve achieved to date. Now, this is your chance to join our team and become an integral member of Kami’s growth, while shaping your own future (and having fun doing it)! **The Opportunity** As a Application Security Engineer at Kami, you won't just be identifying risks and writing reports—you will be the one actively fixing them. We are expanding our in\-house security team and need a hands\-on engineer who thrives on pure engineering remediation. In this role, you will leverage our automated security tools, scanning platforms, and risk/vulnerability processes to pinpoint faults and defects across our systems and applications. Instead of just passing off a ticket, you will jump directly into the codebase to patch those vulnerabilities, refactor out\-of\-life or legacy code, upgrade outdated libraries and dependencies to ensure our environment is secure and modernized. You will act as a core technical resource for the broader engineering team, writing clear security documentation and playbooks, and actively assisting and guiding developers to successfully remediate defects within their own workflows. You will be the ultimate bridge between automated threat detection and active engineering execution, embedding robust security guardrails directly into our software development life cycle. If you are a builder who loves deep, code\-level troubleshooting, enjoys replacing stale legacy infrastructure with secure code, and wants to protect a platform supporting over 50 million global users, this is the perfect place to make a massive impact. **What You’ll Do** Vulnerability \& Legacy Code Remediation Utilize automated scanners and internal risk processes to hunt down defects. Actively dive into code bases to update outdated libraries, rewrite out\-of\-life legacy components, and resolve critical technical debt. * * Ensure continuous modernization of Kami’s codebase by wiping out vulnerabilities stemming from deprecated packages and old dependencies before they can be exploited. Developer Support \& Cross\-Team Guidance* Collaborate actively with engineering pods, reviewing their security posture and directly assisting them in troubleshooting and executing defect remediation. * Accelerate internal security engineering cycles by clearing remediation blockers for engineering teams, turning security into a supportive peer function. Security Documentation \& Playbooks* Draft comprehensive, easy\-to\-follow security playbooks, coding standards guidelines, and remediation documentation for internal distribution. * Create a standardized knowledge base that upskills the entire engineering group on modern secure coding practices and streamlined defect fixing. Secure SDLC Integration* Embed automated security scanning tools, analysis processes, and proactive guardrails cleanly inside the active software development lifecycle. * Ensure systematic and early\-stage identification of technical faults across applications, moving toward a continuous 'shift\-left' security model. Infrastructure Hardening * Implement and maintain robust cloud infrastructure protections, including customized firewalls, intrusion detection mechanisms, and advanced encryption protocols. * Preserve the absolute structural integrity of our global digital infrastructure, securely partitioning and safeguarding core assets. Incident Response Automation* Manage and execute the emergency incident response lifecycle, building automated logic to spot, flag, and contain system anomalies instantly. * Deliver rapid technical resolution timelines during active security incidents, significantly minimizing structural exposure or system downtime. **What You’ll Bring*** Hands\-on Engineering Depth: You have 5\-8\+ years of experience in an Application Security or Security Engineering role. You don't just know how to run security scanners; you know how to read code, identify architectural flaws, and write the necessary fixes or scripts to resolve them. * Dependency \& Legacy Management: Proven experience managing technical debt, identifying out\-of\-life or legacy code paths, and safely updating third\-party libraries/dependencies without breaking production features. * Documentation \& Collaboration Focus: Excellent written skills with a knack for building clean security playbooks. You enjoy working side\-by\-side with developers, pairing to debug technical issues, and assisting teams in pushing code fixes over the finish line. * Modern Tooling \& Environments: Familiarity with cloud\-native architectures, containerized applications, CI/CD integrations, and configuring automated security testing systems (SAST/DAST/SCA). * Proactive Problem Solving: You possess a strong builder mindset. When a security weakness is exposed, you don't just pass off a ticket—you enjoy digging into the architecture to implement lasting infrastructure or code\-level safeguards. * Application Security Fundamentals: Exposure to application security fundamentals, specifically with OWASP, is required or preferred. * Network \& Deployment: Experience with network configuration and application deployment is preferred. **Why Kami?** We’re building a high performance, best in class team to help capitalize on our exciting momentum, and continue scaling Kami's magic and making a difference to schools, students, and teachers. With Kami, you’ll have* A **people\-first** employer that is on an inspiring mission to build the future of education while changing the lives of millions. * **High calibre and diverse team** ranging from successful startup veterans, to Fortune 500 and big tech professionals. * **Continuous learning and development** opportunities, including subsidised course fees, certifications, conferences, and free access to Udemy and more. * A strong **mission**; the satisfaction of knowing you’re not only helping modern\-day superheroes, aka teachers but also helping them shape the minds of future generations all across the globe. * **Happy customers**: Helping thousands of schools worldwide through the digital transformation of education for the 21st century. Just read our reviews. * Huge potential: Already used by **70M users in 175 countries**. One of the most popular and fastest\-growing EdTech platforms worldwide. If you’re looking for a new challenge and the opportunity to impact the lives of millions, apply now!

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Enterprise Scalability (Remote - East Coast Only)
jobs.description: *At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you're a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you'll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit* *klaviyo.com/careers* *to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.* At Klaviyo, we help businesses build stronger relationships with their customers. As our customers grow, our platform needs to support greater data volumes, more demanding workloads, and increasingly complex operations—with the performance and reliability they depend on. Engineering at this scale takes technical depth, sound judgment, and close collaboration. You'll work across teams to solve challenging problems, turn architectural improvements into production results, and help build a platform ready for our largest customers. **Your Impact** --------------- We are seeking a senior technical leader to own Klaviyo's approach to enterprise scalability, performance, reliability, and multi\-region readiness. Reporting to a VP of Engineering, you will be a senior individual contributor with no direct reports. You will lead through technical expertise, hands\-on engineering, and influence, partnering across teams to deliver improvements that matter to our customers. You will identify and remove major bottlenecks, drive platform\-wide architectural changes, and establish clear measures of readiness for our largest tenants and most demanding workloads. Your work will span system design, profiling, implementation, and production rollout. You will also help teams adopt practical tools and repeatable patterns that make performance and reliability part of everyday engineering. This role suits an experienced engineer who can move between deep technical investigation and clear executive communication, make and defend architectural decisions, and build alignment across teams. **Reports to:** VP of Engineering **Direct reports:** None **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Define what scale readiness means.** Establish measurable targets for latency, throughput, error rates, and capacity. Build a shared scorecard and align teams on service\-level objectives, error budgets, and performance expectations for critical enterprise workloads. * **Remove the bottlenecks that matter most.** Use production data, profiling, and reproducible benchmarks to identify constraints. Partner with service owners to implement fixes and verify improvements under representative workloads. * **Drive architectural change.** Design and implement sharding, partitioning, caching, back\-pressure, and workload isolation strategies. Advance multi\-region readiness and build safe paths for high\-volume data migrations. * **Make scale engineering repeatable.** Create lightweight benchmarks, profiling harnesses, and test environments that teams can use independently. Pair with engineers to turn successful fixes into reusable patterns. * **Build readiness into delivery.** Lead scalability reviews and establish clear, proportionate release gates that surface risks early and help teams ship confidently. * **Turn incidents into lasting improvements.** Lead technical deep dives, identify systemic causes, and work with teams to deliver and validate fixes that reduce recurring incidents. * **Apply AI where it improves outcomes.** Use AI\-assisted profiling, workload modeling, synthetic traffic, anomaly detection, and guided runbooks to improve investigation and response. Establish explicit guardrails, evaluate results, and measure operational impact. * **Connect engineering decisions to customer needs.** Communicate priorities, tradeoffs, and results clearly to engineers and executives, tying technical investments to customer experience, enterprise growth, and operating efficiency. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * **Deep experience scaling multi\-tenant SaaS.** You bring 12\+ years of relevant engineering experience, with a track record of removing significant bottlenecks and demonstrating measurable production impact. * **Strong performance and distributed systems expertise.** You have hands\-on experience with performance engineering, capacity planning, sharding and partitioning, caching, back\-pressure, tenant isolation, multi\-region architectures, and large\-scale migrations. * **Engineering depth from diagnosis through delivery.** You can investigate unfamiliar systems, test hypotheses, write production code, and work with service owners to roll out changes safely. * **Sound technical judgment.** You use evidence to weigh architectural tradeoffs and know when to address an immediate constraint versus invest in a broader platform change. * **Leadership across organizational boundaries.** You align teams around shared   AI fluency.** You have applied AI tools or automation to engineering work and can evaluate their usefulness, limitations, and operational risks. You are curious about new approaches and disciplined about validating them. **What Success Looks Like in 6–12 Months** ------------------------------------------ * A company\-wide scale scorecard is adopted and reviewed regularly, with agreed targets and clear ownership for critical enterprise workloads. * Two to three high\-impact bottlenecks are removed, with reproducible benchmarks demonstrating sustained improvements. * Our largest customer workloads show measurable improvements in tail latency, throughput, and error rates. * Multi\-region readiness and high\-volume migration plans have clear priorities, tested assumptions, and actionable next steps. * Teams use shared benchmarks and readiness checks to catch regressions earlier, and repeat P0 incidents decline. * AI\-assisted tools demonstrate measurable value in investigation or incident response, such as faster regression isolation or fewer noisy alerts, with appropriate controls and observability.
