jobs.title: Sr. Marketing Data & GTM Engineer
jobs.description: Job ID: 2026\-14419 Overview: *Si ce poste est situé au Canada, veuillez visiter notre site français à l’adresse suivante :* *https://careerscafr\-kmbskonicaminolta.icims.com/jobs* *et rechercher le numéro d’emploi indiqué ci\-dessus afin de consulter cette offre d’emploi en français.* Konica Minolta is seeking a forward\-looking Senior Marketing Data \& GTM Engineer to transform complex, fragmented data into the audience intelligence and activation capabilities that power modern go\-to\-market execution. This role sits at the intersection of marketing, analytics engineering, revenue operations, and enterprise technology and is designed for a builder who can translate growth priorities into scalable data products and reliable activation workflows. The Senior Marketing Data \& GTM Engineer will develop sophisticated account and contact segments, scoring and prioritization models, marketing\-ready datasets, and governed semantic layers. Serving as a technical bridge between Marketing and Data Engineering, this person will connect behavioral, firmographic, intent, campaign, sales, customer, product, and third\-party data to make it actionable across the customer lifecycle. This role is based in our Ramsey, NJ headquarters and offers a hybrid work environment that balances in\-person collaboration with flexibility, including four days onsite and a remote work option on Fridays. Responsibilities: ***GTM Data Architecture \& Semantic Enablement*** * Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Data Engineering to define the data capabilities needed to support audience strategy, demand generation, lifecycle marketing, personalization, and revenue growth. * Develop efficiencies between data sets existing in legacy systems, a master data lake and Salesforce that help all aspects of the business. * Design and maintain marketing\-ready data models that connect account, contact, lead, engagement, campaign, opportunity, customer, product, digital, and third\-party data. * Build and govern semantic layers, reusable metrics, dimensions, business definitions, and documentation that make enterprise data understandable, traceable, and usable for marketing analysis and activation. * Translate ambiguous business questions into data requirements, logical models, transformation rules, acceptance criteria, and technical delivery plans. * Prototype and productionize reusable datasets, features, and data products that reduce one\-off analysis and accelerate campaign planning and activation. ***Audience Engineering, Segmentation \& Activation*** * Develop scalable segmentation logic for ideal customer profiles, buying groups, whitespace identification, next\-best audiences, personalization, and cross\-sell or retention programs. * Create, validate, and govern reusable audience components, eligibility criteria, exclusions, routing rules, and activation logic across marketing automation, CRM, advertising, web, sales outreach, and other GTM channels and refine based on channel outcomes. * Engineer identity resolution and account\-contact relationship logic with IT and data owners to improve match rates, hierarchy accuracy, deduplication, and activation quality. ***Scoring, Prioritization \& Decision Models*** * Define model inputs, weighting, thresholds, decay, negative signals, exclusions, routing logic, and feedback loops in collaboration with Marketing and Sales. * Back\-test models against business outcomes and monitor lift, calibration, stability, coverage, bias, and adoption. * Create reason codes that help marketers and sellers understand why an account or contact is prioritized and what action to take next. * Embed scores and decision logic into campaign, automation, lead management, and sales workflows. ***Data Engineering, Integration \& Quality*** * Write and optimize advanced SQL to profile, join, transform, test, and analyze large, complex datasets in cloud data environments. * Work with IT and Data Engineering to define and improve pipelines, APIs, batch processes, event streams, and platform integrations required for marketing use cases. * Assess new internal and external data sources for value, quality, coverage, usability, compliance, and integration effort. * Establish data\-quality monitoring, investigate discrepancies across source systems, identify root causes and business impact, and coordinate durable fixes. * Use version control, peer review, testing, release documentation, and change management practices to improve reliability and reproducibility. ***Marketing Analytics, AI \& Measurement Enablement*** * Identify, prototype, and operationalize predictive analytics, machine learning, AI, experimentation, and intelligent automation use cases that improve audience discovery, scoring, personalization, campaign activation, measurement, insight generation, and workflow efficiency. ***Cross\-Functional Technical Leadership*** * Own marketing logic, business rules, data\-product requirements, acceptance criteria, and activation  anguage processing, and agent\-based automation to GTM use cases with appropriate governance, transparency, data quality, and human oversight. * Strong systems thinking and the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into scalable technical solutions. * Demonstrated ability to work hands\-on in data while leading requirements, solution design, stakeholder alignment, testing, and production delivery. * Excellent communication across marketing, sales, analytics, and technology audiences. * Strong ownership, curiosity, judgment, and ability to manage competing priorities. \#LI\-MD1 About Us: *This posting reflects an existing vacancy that we are actively recruiting for.* **About Konica Minolta** Konica Minolta Business Solutions' (Konica Minolta) journey started more than 150 years ago, with a vision to see and do things differently. The company partners with clients to Give Shape to Ideas by supporting their digital transformation through its expansive Intelligent Connected Workplace portfolio. Its business technology offerings include IT Services, intelligent information management, video security solutions and managed print services, as well as office technology and industrial and commercial print solutions. 2025 marks Konica Minolta’s 20th anniversary in production print, for which it celebrates "20 Years of Excellence, Innovation and Impact,” and continues to lead the way in digital commercial printing. This year also commemorates 20 years of Konica Minolta’s bizhub brand. Over the past two decades, the bizhub series has revolutionized office technology and redefined how businesses operate. It has continuously evolved to meet the needs of modern workplaces, fueled by advances in technology and a commitment to innovation. Konica Minolta is proud to be ranked on the Forbes 2025 America's Best Large Employers list, included on CRN’s MSP 500 list numerous times; recognized as the \#1 Brand for Customer Loyalty in the MFP Office Copier Market by Brand Keys for eighteen consecutive years and presented with Keypoint Intelligence’s BLI 2025 and 2021 A3 Line of The Year and BLI 2021\-2023 Most Color Consistent A3 Brand Awards for its bizhub One i\-Series. For more information, please visit Konica Minolta online and follow it on Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and Twitter. Konica Minolta operates on a North American Shared Services model, which aligns cross\-border priorities and enhances delivery to its field organization. This combines service functions in the U.S. and Canada, ultimately providing more resources to support areas such as sales administration, logistics and supply chain, marketing, product planning, finance, IT, HR and legal. **Salary Disclaimer**Konica Minolta is committed to transparent and equitable compensation practices. Our pay structure is designed to support employee growth, allowing individuals to progress through the salary range as they advance in their role. Actual base pay offered will vary based on a candidate’s skills, experience, job‑related knowledge, geographic location, and specific business needs. **AI Disclosure** Konica Minolta Business Solutions (Canada) Ltd., or its authorized third\-party contractors, may employ Artificial Intelligence technologies to support elements of the recruitment process. Notwithstanding this, Applications are reviewed by our recruitment team, who always make the final hiring decision. EOE Statement: Konica Minolta is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Principal AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** **Why Kyndryl** Kyndryl's Security \& Resiliency practice helps clients anticipate, protect against, withstand, and recover from cyber threats and operational disruption. We bring together deep technical expertise, modern platforms, and a culture of continuous learning to build secure and resilient environments. At Kyndryl, curiosity, collaboration, and customer focus are central to how we work. We invest in skills and give people opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow. **The Role** Kyndryl is seeking a Principal AI Security Engineer to secure internal AI solutions, agents, copilots, model platforms, and frontier AI capabilities. This hands\-on senior technical role will write code, build controls, integrate them into enterprise platforms, and translate security requirements into reusable guardrails and measurable risk reduction. **What You Will Do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy controls for AI applications, agents, copilots, and shared AI platforms. * Build reusable services, APIs, libraries, policy checks, automation, and platform integrations. * Implement identity, authorization, secrets, data access, tool\-use, egress, rate\-limiting, logging, and human\-approval controls. * Perform AI threat modeling and technical security reviews and drive remediation. * Build adversarial tests and automated checks for prompt injection, unsafe tool execution, misuse, and control bypass. * Integrate AI security telemetry, detections, alerts, and response workflows. * Lead through engineering depth, reusable patterns, mentoring, and enterprise influence. Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID\-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. **Who You Are** **Required Qualifications** * 10 or more years of experience in security engineering, application security, product security, cloud security, software engineering, platform engineering, or a related field. * Experience implementing authentication, authorization, secrets management, API security, logging, monitoring, and secure development controls. * Experience implementing technical controls that are unique to the evolving AI risk landscape. * Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD. * Ability to conduct threat modeling and convert findings into working engineering solutions. Development experience in Python, Java, C\#, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing or securing generative AI applications, agents, copilots, or machine learning platforms. * Experience with AI gateways, model routing, RAG, vector databases, orchestration, MCP, or model\-serving platforms. * Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, prompt injection defenses, or automated control validation. Relevant security, cloud, application security, or AI engineering certifications. * The base compensation range for the position in the U.S. is \- $179,760 to $341,520 based on a full\-time schedule reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Kyndryl, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. Your actual compensation may vary depending on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction, including, but not limited to, geography, relevant job\-related skills, education and experience, certification and licenses, internal pay equity, and market and business consideration. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area): $215,640 to $409,800 California (All Other): $197,640 to $375,600 Colorado: $179,760 to $341,520 Massachusetts/ Virginia: $179,760 to $375,600 New York City: $215,640 to $409,800 Washington: $197,600 to $375,600 Washington DC: $197,640 to $375,600 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Equal Opportunity Employer** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Engineering - Data Science
jobs.description: LTK's mission is to empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. We have a huge opportunity ahead of us and we're looking for team members who want to create, innovate and disrupt an industry. We empower our team members to drive innovation, create value, and continue to spearhead the creation of this industry — a game changer when it comes to career growth. **Position Title**: Sr Manager, Engineering \- Data Science **Location:** Remote from the U.S. **Reports to**: CPTO #### **About the role** We are hiring a Senior Data Science Manager to lead the team building LTK's foundational AI capabilities. This team develops shared models, services, tools, and evaluation frameworks that enable teams across LTK to build and deploy AI effectively. You will help define the AI platform roadmap, identify capabilities that can serve multiple teams, and turn promising approaches into reliable production services. The work spans areas such as embeddings, semantic understanding, retrieval, model evaluation, and access to large language models, supporting applications across search, recommendations, catalog, and other product and business workflows. We are looking for a technically strong people leader who can connect AI with practical platform development. You will partner closely with engineering and product teams to make shared AI capabilities easy to adopt, operate, and improve. Success means helping those teams deliver better experiences faster, with measurable quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. Building a high\-performing team is central to this role. You will set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, coach team members, and manage performance. ### #### **How you will make an impact** * **Build shared AI capabilities.** Lead a team developing reusable models, services, and tools that address common needs across LTK. * **Shape the platform roadmap.** Partner with engineering, product, and data leaders to prioritize foundational investments based on business value, demand across teams, and technical dependencies. * **Enable other teams.** Work with internal partners to understand their needs, support integration, and provide clear documentation and technical guidance. * **Deliver production\-ready systems.** Partner with engineering on deployment, monitoring, versioning, and ongoing operation of AI services. * **Make evals foundational to AI development.** Own the team's approach to evaluating AI systems, from shared evaluation tooling and representative datasets to release criteria and production quality monitoring. Enable partner teams to measure whether AI capabilities work reliably for their use cases and improve them with evidence. * **Manage quality and cost.** Guide decisions about models, providers, and architecture, balancing accuracy, latency, reliability, and operating cost. * **Own execution and outcomes.** Set clear priorities, manage dependencies, and measure success through platform adoption, service performance, and the outcomes enabled for partner teams. * **Develop the team.** Hire and retain strong talent, support career growth, give regular feedback, and address performance issues directly. #### **What you will bring to LTK** #### **Data Science and AI** * 7\+ years of experience in data science or machine learning * 3\+ years of direct people management experience leading data science or machine learning teams, including hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management. * **Experience shipping AI systems.** You have delivered LLM\-powered capabilities into production and owned their performance after launch, including quality, reliability, latency, and cost. Your experience includes operating AI systems beyond prototypes and traditional ML projects. * **Strong experience building and operating AI evaluations (evals).** You have created representative evaluation datasets, defined task\-specific quality criteria, and built automated evaluations with human review where needed. You have used evals to guide model and prompt selection, catch regressions, establish release criteria, and monitor quality in production. * **Experience building shared AI capabilities.** You have built AI services, tools, or platforms that multiple teams have adopted and used in production. You understand how to make those capabilities reusable, reliable, and easy to integrate. * **Strong technical foundations.** You bring a solid grounding in machine learning, applied statistics, and experimentation. You use that knowledge to choose practical approaches, test assumptions, and measure results. #### **Platform and Technical Leadership** * **Platform strategy and ownership.** You can translate needs across teams into a focused AI platform roadmap. You prioritize investments that solve shared problems, accelerate delivery, and create lasting value. * **Production service leadership.** You have partnered with engineering to deliver reliable AI services, shaping service interfaces, deployment practices, observability, and operational readiness. You establish clear ownership and measurable expectations for quality, latency, availability, and cost. * **Adoption and developer experience.** You treat internal teams as customers. You make shared capabilities easy to discover, integrate, and operate through clear interfaces, documentation, and practical support, and use adoption and feedback to guide improvements. * **Sound architectural judgment.** You make informed decisions about what to build, buy, or adopt. You evaluate models, providers, and tools against demonstrated quality, integration effort, operating cost, and long\-term maintainability. * **Hands\-on technical leadership.** You stay close enough to the work to review code and architecture, challenge assumptions, and resolve difficult technical problems. You set clear standards while developing your team's judgment and ownership. A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent practical experience is equally valued. #### **Nice to have** * Experience with large\-scale or real\-time data and inference systems. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation or AI workflow orchestration. * Experience in marketplaces, social commerce, or recommendation\-driven products. \#LI\-CW1 ### **What we offer for full\-time salaried employees** * The opportunity to be part of the leading global company in creator commerce * A remote\-first, productivity\-first environment * Competitive compensation and benefits package to meet the needs of you and your family * 401(k) with LTK company matching * Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance, Dental Insurance * Paid Maternity Leave and Paid Paternity Leave * Summer Fridays and Flexible PTO * For temporary full\-time employees, benefits eligibility may vary ### **About LTK** Founded in 2011, LTK is the global technology platform purpose\-built to empower lifestyle creators to monetize their content. The full\-service platform connects brands, creators, and shoppers with a world\-class shopping app and trusted tools and technology that make content instantly shoppable. Today, premium lifestyle creators in 160\+ countries drive more than $5 billion\+ in annual retail sales through their LTK Shop profiles. More than 40 million consumers turn to LTK Shops in the LTK shopping platform each month to find inspiration and instantly shop the styles recommended by their favorite creators. More than 8,000 retailers and 1M brands partner with LTK to gain access to its global creator network for content that converts against performance\-driven, cross\-channel KPIs. LTK is headquartered in Dallas, TX, and currently operates on five continents. ### **Our mission** To empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. ### **Our values** * Here to win * Commit to the journey * Work well ### **Commitment to diversity** LTK believes diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental obligations that strengthen our team. We employ a diverse, multi\-disciplinary team to build a meaningful company and culture. *For US\-Based Roles: We are not offering new sponsorships opportunities at this time for persons requiring employment visas, such as an H\-1B; authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.* *Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of LTK are considered the property of LTK and are not subject to payment of agency fees*. *LTK is an Equal Opportunity Employer.* \#LI\-Remote

jobs.description: We are a software company looking for a skilled, organized, and detail\-oriented PHP \& Database Programmer to help develop, maintain, and improve our websites, Web\-based applications, and internal systems. This position involves hands\-on programming, including writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining code; developing new features; and troubleshooting technical issues. Our company develops and sells high\-end professional design software – specifically, add\-on programs for AutoCAD, SketchUp, and Revit – to landscape architects, irrigation designers, architects, and engineers. We started as a father\-son duo working out of a garage and have grown into a company with more than 40 employees, providing best\-in\-class software to thousands of professionals in dozens of countries. Land F/X is a fully remote company, with employees working from home across multiple states. We’ve embraced remote work while continuing to develop excellent software, provide exceptional customer support, and maintain a collaborative team environment. **Applications will be accepted through December 1, 2026\.** To ensure a fair and thorough review process, we ask for your patience as we carefully evaluate applications. jobs.title: Senior DC Power Electronics Verification & Validation Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **About us:** LayerZero Power Systems, Inc. is a leader in power management products for mission and process critical applications. Our customer base is comprised of companies in the computer service provider (on\-line commerce, streaming, hosting, etc.), semiconductor manufacturing and financial sectors. LayerZero provides innovative products to ensure user safety and ultimate reliability of computers, servers, communication gear, and other critical equipment. LayerZero manufactures best\-in\-class products representing high\-end solutions. LayerZero Power Systems is on a trajectory of sustained growth, with a loyal base of existing Fortune 100 customers and an expanding portfolio of new customers. We are seeking a Senior DC Power Electronics Verification \& Validation Engineer to establish and execute the testing, validation, and troubleshooting capabilities for a new 50–150 kW, three\-phase AC\-to\-high\-voltage DC power converters. This role will be responsible for specifying and procuring test equipment, executing design verification and validation testing, and diagnosing and resolving hardware and system\-level issues in prototype and production units. The engineer will work closely with power electronics design, controls, mechanical engineering, and manufacturing teams to identify failures, determine root causes, verify corrective actions, and improve product performance and reliability. The position combines hands\-on electrical engineering, high\-power test development, instrumentation, hardware troubleshooting, and production support. The successful candidate will be comfortable working directly with prototype hardware, electrical schematics, circuit boards, power semiconductor devices, control interfaces, and high\-voltage DC systems. The engineer will help transition the product from initial prototypes through design qualification and production release, establishing repeatable verification methods and production test capabilities suitable for annual volumes exceeding 1,000 units **Key Responsibilities** **Test Laboratory Development and Equipment** * Define laboratory requirements and specify test equipment, instrumentation, fixtures, and supporting infrastructure for high\-power AC/DC converter development. * Identify vendors, evaluate equipment capabilities, prepare technical specifications, and support capital equipment procurement. * Install, commission, and validate test equipment, including programmable AC sources, regenerative or electronic DC loads, power analyzers, oscilloscopes, high\-voltage differential probes, current probes, thermal instrumentation, and data acquisition systems. * Establish safe, repeatable test setups for high\-voltage DC and high\-current AC/DC applications. * Develop laboratory procedures, equipment maintenance practices, calibration requirements, and electrical safety controls. **Design Verification and Product Validation** * Develop and execute verification and validation plans based on product requirements, design specifications, operating limits, and applicable industry standards. * Test sample performance across the specified operating envelope, including input voltage, output voltage, load, efficiency, power quality, transient response, and thermal performance. * Characterize startup, shutdown, steady\-state operation, dynamic load response, and transitions between operating conditions. * Test protection functions and fault responses, including overcurrent, overvoltage, overtemperature, abnormal operating conditions, and controlled fault injection where appropriate. * Evaluate electrical noise, switching behavior, transient events, and other performance characteristics using appropriate instrumentation. * Document test configurations, procedures, measured results, deviations, and pass/fail determinations. Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, and results. * Identify design limitations and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues before product qualification and release. * Perform initial power\-up, commissioning, and functional testing of prototype converter assemblies, circuit boards, power modules, and complete systems. * Diagnose electrical and functional failures using schematics, oscilloscope measurements, waveform analysis, circuit measurements, and other diagnostic techniques. * Troubleshoot power conversion circuits, gate\-drive circuits, power semiconductor devices, DC\-link components, sensing circuits, auxiliary power supplies, protection circuits, and control interfaces. * Isolate root causes and distinguish between hardware defects, control or firmware issues, component limitations, assembly problems, and test setup errors. * Perform or coordinate component replacement, soldering, board rework, wiring modifications, and other prototype repairs within established safety and engineering controls. * Re\-test repaired or modified hardware to verify corrective actions and document findings for design engi ired Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience. * Significant hands\-on experience testing, troubleshooting, or validating power electronics equipment, including inverters, AC/DC converters, DC/DC converters, industrial power supplies, or comparable systems. * Strong understanding of three\-phase AC systems, high\-voltage DC systems, switching power conversion, electrical measurements, and power semiconductor devices. * Demonstrated ability to diagnose electrical hardware failures using schematics, oscilloscopes, differential probes, current probes, power analyzers, and other laboratory instrumentation. * Experience specifying, selecting, integrating, or commissioning electrical test equipment and instrumentation. * Ability to develop and execute structured test procedures, analyze results, document findings, and maintain requirements traceability. * Understanding of electrical protection, thermal behavior, transient response, and safe testing practices for high\-voltage/high\-current equipment. * Strong technical communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with design engineers, controls engineers, and manufacturing personnel. * Ability to work directly with hardware in a laboratory environment and support prototype and production troubleshooting as required. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with power converters rated 50 kW or greater, particularly three\-phase AC\-to\-high\-voltage DC conversion. * Experience with 480 VAC three\-phase systems and DC buses operating in the 800 VDC range or higher. * Experience testing power converters across efficiency, power quality, transient response, thermal performance, protection, and fault operating conditions. * Experience with programmable AC sources, regenerative DC loads, high\-power test benches, and automated measurement systems. * Familiarity with Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, or similar tools for test automation, data acquisition, and analysis. * Experience with prototype PCB debugging, component\-level repair, soldering, and hardware rework. * Experience with EMC testing, electrical safety qualification, reliability testing, FMEA, and root\-cause analysis. * Experience developing manufacturing test systems and supporting NPI through production release. * Familiarity with applicable IEC, UL, and IEEE requirements for power conversion equipment. **Success Criteria** * Establish a functional, safe, and properly equipped high\-power test laboratory. * Execute repeatable verification and validation testing against defined product requirements. * Rapidly identify, diagnose, and document prototype hardware failures and their root causes. * Verify that design modifications resolve identified problems. * Establish reliable production test procedures and support manufacturing readiness. * Improve product quality and engineering productivity through effective test methods, failure analysis, and documented corrective actions. **What We Offer:** * Competitive pay with performance incentives * 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision * 401(k) with company match * 4 weeks PTO, 10 paid holidays, and 2 floating holidays **Why You Will Love Working with Us:** * Impact: Develop your skills and expertise in a rapidly growing industry, with your work directly influencing the success of mission\-critical projects. * Innovation: Immerse yourself in an environment that celebrates forward\-thinking and continuous improvement. * Collaborative spirit: Work closely with engineers, marketers, and other professionals to bring ideas to life. * Grow with us: We are committed to your personal and professional development, offering endless opportunities to improve your skills and advance your career ***At LayerZero, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.***

engineering standards, maintainability, and security, balanced with business pragmatism * Thrives in a lean, fast\-paced environment; self\-driven, adaptable, and comfortable owning features end to end with minimal supervision * Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain AI tradeoffs and limitations to product and business partners and raise risks early Equal Opportunities: **Equal law. You will work closely with the Chief Clinical AI Officer, the Clinical Applications team, and Infrastructure and Information Security. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * VLM Development and Adaptation: Fine\-tune and adapt open VLMs (e.g., Qwen\-VL, LLaVA\-Med, MedGemma, InternVL) and imaging foundation models for report drafting, impression generation, finding detection, and prior comparison. Apply parameter\-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA) and full fine\-tuning under senior guidance. * Vision Encoders and Representation Learning: Work with vision encoders, contrastive image\-text models (CLIP, SigLIP), and self\-supervised approaches (JEPA). Build and maintain embedding pipelines for retrieval, cohort discovery, case similarity search, and drift detection * Data Curation: Curate and version datasets from our internal PACS and reporting systems, including DICOM header, burned\-in pixel, and paired\-report de\-identification * Agentic Engineering: Use Claude Code and OpenAI Codex daily to build, test, and maintain code. Maintain project context (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), and help build and run MCP servers for internal system access * Deployment and MLOps: Deploy models via containerized inference and GPU serving (vLLM, Triton), support CI/CD pipelines, and monitor production models for drift and performance * Evaluation: Build automated evaluation harnesses for clinical accuracy, negation, laterality, and hallucination scoring against radiologist ground truth * Workflow Automation: Build agentic and LLM driven tools for operational workflows, such as converting unstructured requests into RIS scheduling actions and supporting intelligent operations dashboards **Required Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning transformer models in PyTorch (vision, multimodal, or language) using Hugging Face, MONAI, or similar (via internships, research, open\-source work, or projects) * Working knowledge of embeddings and vector search * Experience with open VLMs such as Qwen\-VL or LLaVA * Daily use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) * Familiarity with Docker and GPU\-based model serving * Comfort working with real\-world data and a reproducible approach to experiments **Preferred Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience with vision encoders and contrastive models (CLIP, SigLIP, JEPA) * Exposure to medical VLMs, imaging foundation models, or self\-supervised methods (DINOv2, MAE) * Experience building MCP servers in Python or TypeScript * Familiarity with medical imaging formats (DICOM, HL7, FHIR) and HIPAA/PHI handling * Awareness of MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, model registries) * Awareness of FDA considerations for clinical AI (510(k), PCCP) **Education/Licensing/Certification:** Degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a jobs.title: AI Governance Engineer
jobs.description: As MISO's **AI Governance Engineer**, you will help build and evolve the enterprise AI governance framework as the organization expands its use of generative and agentic AI. In this role, you will develop practical guardrails, controls, processes, and oversight mechanisms that enable responsible and secure use of AI while supporting innovation. You will help create a scalable, risk\-based approach for registering, evaluating, monitoring, and governing AI solutions, including internally developed, purchased, and vendor\-embedded technologies. Working closely with partners across technology, security, compliance, HR, and business teams, you will help establish governance practices that can be adopted across the organization. Because AI technologies and risks continue to evolve rapidly, this position requires ongoing learning, curiosity, and continuous refinement of governance processes and standards. The ideal candidate brings experience in AI engineering, software development, data engineering, or related disciplines, along with a collaborative, hands\-on approach to solving complex challenges and balancing innovation with risk management. Some of the impactful contributions you’ll make as MISO’s **AI Governance Engineer** include: * Owning the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for the enterprise AI governance platform, building and operating it as a scalable internal product. * Defining a repeatable, risk‑tiered governance framework (including measurement, evaluation, monitoring, and incident response) to ensure teams can apply the right controls to any AI solution. * Delivering a central AI registry and intake process that identifies, registers, and tiers high‑risk and high‑visibility AI systems across the enterprise. * Building automated capabilities for registration, observability, and evidence capture, ensuring traceability across data, models, prompts, versions, and evaluations from deployment onward. * Creating reusable evaluation tooling for ML, generative AI, and agentic systems, and validate that governance measures and model‑based evaluations are accurate and continuously improving. * Defining monitoring thresholds, incident‑response protocols, and rollback runbooks for AI failure, degradation, or policy violations, validating them through exercises such as tabletop tests. * Providing transparency to leadership through reporting on AI quality, usage, cost, and value, while collaborating with security, privacy, compliance, risk, and the AI Working Group to drive consistent governance adoption. You’ll need the following skills to be successful as **AI Governance Engineer**: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field; a master’s degree, relevant certifications, or equivalent experience may also be considered. * 8\+ years of experience in software, data, or machine learning engineering, including at least 3 years building or evaluating production ML or AI solutions. * Experience designing, building, and operating shared platforms or internal products used across multiple teams. * Solid understanding of model training, evaluation, and failure modes, with the ability to design sound evaluation approaches. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools. Experience in two or more of the following: * Evaluating or monitoring ML, generative AI, retrieval\-augmented, or agentic systems. * Observability, telemetry, or alerting for production systems. * Test automation or quality engineering for non\-deterministic systems. * MLOps/LLMOps, including experiment tracking, versioning, and model or artifact registries. * Data quality and validation practices for AI‑relevant datasets. * Cloud cost management or usage analytics. Preferred Experience: * Master’s degree or other advanced degree * Familiarity with AI governance or risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001 * Background in statistics or experiment design. * Experience in the energy industry. * Relevant certifications, including: IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP), Microsoft Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI‑103\), Microsoft Azure Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI‑300\), or ISO/IEC 42001 certification. Appropriate level will be determined based upon experience and knowledge. Operating the electricity grid, running a robust energy market, planning for a bright future – it’s what our immensely hardworking and dedicated team does every day. Base salary range for this position is included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **America is strongest when ability can rise** The right person can change the trajectory of a team, a company, or an entire field. Yet most hiring still filters on what is easiest to read: the right degree, the right employer, the right network. Those are poor proxies for what someone can actually do. When they miss real ability, a company loses performance and an idea goes unbuilt. MeritFirst builds objective, efficient ways for people to demonstrate critical thinking, problem\-solving, adaptability, and execution, so companies can hire on demonstrated ability rather than pedigree. For the worker, that means upward mobility. For the company, better performance. At scale, national growth. **The role** Our product has to produce a signal that deserves to influence real decisions about people. Candidates need to trust that they got a fair chance to show what they can do. Employers need to trust that the signal predicts performance better than the credentials they already use. Earning both takes careful product judgment, rigorous measurement, and software that is reliable and explainable. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own major parts of that system end to end, from the candidate experience and assessment engine to employer workflows and evaluation. You will join a small team and work directly with our founder, candidates, and customers. Roadmaps here do not arrive fully specified. You'll decide what should exist, ship the first version, watch how it behaves, and improve it quickly. You will also make the engineers around you better through the systems you architect and the code you review. We use AI heavily. However, if you can't reason about and explain each line of your code, your work isn't ready. Our standard is a system we understand, can explain, test, and trust. **What we're working on** * Hands\-on challenges that show how candidates work with AI * Voice and video interviews * Scoring that employers can audit and candidates can trust * Integrations with the hiring tools employers already use Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Postgres, and Vercel. Engineering team size: 3\. Location: onsite in Austin, Texas. **What you'll do** * **Own an area end to end.** Early on, you'll take on one of our highest\-leverage product areas: its design, code, production health, and roadmap. * **Lead technical design.** Turn ambiguous problems into written designs, make the tradeoffs explicit, and align the team before the big work starts. * **Build evaluation worth trusting.** Make results consistent, auditable, and hard to game. Use AI where it measurably helps, and build the evals that prove it. * **Close the learning loop.** Connect assessment results, employer decisions, and on\-the\-job outcomes so the product gets more predictive over time. * **Treat trust as a technical requirement.** Reliability, security, and privacy are product properties from day one. * **Raise the bar.** Give code reviews that teach, mentor other engineers, and help hire the people who join next. **You'll thrive here if you** * Have led the design and delivery of significant production systems, and operated them long enough to live with your decisions. * Have deep expertise in one part of the stack and can work across the rest. * Debug relentlessly: form hypotheses, follow evidence, and dig beneath frameworks and libraries until you understand the issue. * Know when to build the simplest thing that works vs. when to invest in a foundation. * Have built software before LLMs and treat AI\-written code like code from a stranger. * Have made other engineers better through design review, code review, or mentorship. * Communicate clearly, disagree directly, and can explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-engineer. **This probably isn't the role if you** * Want requirements and architecture fully specified before you start. * Want to lead others without staying hands\-on in the code. * Love building something new but lose interest in maintaining what you ship. * Want a predictable 9\-to\-5\. * Are more excited by the idea of meritocracy, or by AI hype, than by the hard work of building something people can trust. **How we hire** Our process tests demonstrated ability, not pedigree or interview polish. Some steps may be with AI and some without. We want to see your foundations, how you reason, and how you use modern tools without giving up judgment. Along the way, you'll use the MeritFirst product yourself.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life\-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. Data Privacy has never been more top of mind than it is today. Governments around the world are passing new privacy legislation at a fast pace, and companies are investing in many aspects of data compliance to meet these new regulations. There is a significant opportunity here to empower every company to deliver data privacy solutions that meet these regulations and that build customer trust. If you are looking for an opportunity to move the needle on data privacy, then the Microsoft Security Platform, Data Governance and Privacy (SPDGP) team is the right place for you. Within SPDGP, the Data Privacy Platform (DPP) team has been providing internal data privacy products for all Microsoft since 2018, operating these products at high scale and availability. We build reliable, highly scalable, highly performing, and distributed systems for scanning, cataloging, classification, and Data Subject Request (DSR) processing. Our job is to provide privacy infrastructure, to produce meaningful insights about compliance, and to create understandable actions that can be taken to improve. We are leveraging this experience to create new data privacy products to benefit Microsoft and later all our customers.There is a steady stream of new requirements for both our internal and external partners that is creating exciting opportunities to work at high scale, impact, and visibility. As a **Sr. Software Engineer** focused on security you will develop software, tools and code to be used in support of design, infrastructure, and technology platforms as well as commercial or end\-user applications. You will help ensure the software, tools, and code meets the highest standards for security. You will partner with stakeholders to determine user requirements for a feature and consider a variety of feedback channels to incorporate insights into future designs or solution fixes. You will collaborate with others to create a clear and articulated plan for testing, assuring quality of solutions, while applying knowledge of debugging tools, logs, telemetry, and other methods to proactively flag issues. This opportunity will allow you to learn about customer scaling requirements and the application of best practices for meeting scaling needs and performance expectations, while ensuring the correct processes are followed to achieve a high degree of security, privacy, safety, and accessibility. You will look for opportunities to raise the security bar as you apply Microsoft’s security policies and best practices. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** * Leads by example within the team by producing extensible and maintainable code. * Drives identification of dependencies and the development of design documents. * For areas of dependency and overlap with other teams or team members, drives coordination and communicates across teams and resolves conflicts between teams. * Leads discussions for the architecture of products/solutions and creates proposals for architecture. * **Drive system and service integration**: Collaborate across teams to influence architecture and ensure seamless integration between systems and services. * **Lead Innovation through experimentation:** Initiate and guide experiments to evaluate new technologies and determine best\-fit solutions. * **Develop scalable, high\-quality solutions**: Build software that is reliable, maintainable, and scalable to meet evolving business needs. * **Embed operational excellence**: Incorporate live site readiness, monitoring, and incident response into the development lifecycle. * **Promote engineering best practices**: Advocate for clean code, modern development standards, and continuous improvement in engineering processes. * **Enhance developer productivity**: Improve developer tools and automation to streamline workflows and boost team efficiency. **Other:** * Embody our company's Culture and Values. **Qualifications** ### **Required/minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** * **Citizenship \& Citizenship Verification**: This position requires verification of citizenship due to citizenship\-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal, state, and/or local government agency customers and is subject to certain citizenship\-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. * **Microsoft Cloud Background Check**: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. ### **Additional or preferred qualifications** * Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. * Recent working experience with backend engineering and software deployment. * Experience in high\-security, regulated, or cloud environments. Software Engineering IC4 \- The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $119,800 \- $234,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 \- $261,000 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. jobs.description: Millennium Systems International is the leading business management software provider for the beauty and wellness industry and the maker of Meevo. Built over three decades of insight, innovation, and disruption, Meevo is a true all\-in\-one solution for sophisticated salons, spas, and med spas looking to bolster their successes. Meevo grows with you, supporting your goals and vision every step of the way with reliable tools you can count on today and tomorrow. Meevo is HIPAA compliant and user\-friendly, with more than 150,000 users logging in daily to help their salon, spa, and med spa businesses thrive. **We’re just as passionate about our people as we are about our product.** MSI is proud to be recognized as a New Jersey Top Workplace and Remote Top Workplace, along with earning Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Awards for Technology Industry, Work\-Life Flexibility, Purpose \& Values, Employee Well\-Being, Employee Appreciation, and Professional Development. **Our values are at the heart of how we work, collaborate, and succeed:*** Innovation * Disruption * Empowerment * Inspire * Creativity * Integrity **Candidates must reside in the United States. Millennium Systems International participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.** **About the Role:** We are looking for a forward\-thinking **Senior Quality Assurance Analyst** who combines deep QA expertise with a passion for applying AI and intelligent tooling to transform how we test, validate, and ship software. This role goes beyond traditional testing — you will be a force multiplier for the QA organization, leveraging large language models, AI\-powered test generation, intelligent automation, and data\-driven insights to accelerate quality across the full software delivery lifecycle. You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and data teams to embed AI\-assisted practices into everyday QA workflows — from smarter test case design and automated defect triage to predictive risk analysis and self\-healing test frameworks. **This is a remote position.** **What We're Looking For:** **Core Quality Engineering Skills*** Strong foundation in Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering fundamentals, including end\-to\-end testing strategy, risk\-based testing, and release readiness. * Proven experience designing and executing tests across web and API layers — including UI validation, regression, integration, and exploratory testing. * Hands\-on proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress, with the ability to architect scalable, maintainable test suites. * Comfortable working with SQL for test data setup, validation, and troubleshooting data integrity issues across environments. * Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and the ability to integrate automated checks into build and deployment workflows. * Experience working within Agile teams, contributing to sprint planning, test estimation, and release coordination. **AI \& Intelligent Tooling Skills*** Demonstrated ability to leverage AI\-powered tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar LLM\-based assistants) to accelerate test case generation, script authoring, defect analysis, and documentation. * Experience with — or strong aptitude for — prompt engineering techniques to extract high\-quality, context\-aware outputs from AI models for QA workflows. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted test automation approaches such as self\-healing locators, visual AI testing (e.g., Applitools), or intelligent test selection/prioritization. * Ability to evaluate, pilot, and integrate new AI\-powered QA tools into existing processes, measuring impact on speed, coverage, and defect detection. * Understanding of how to use AI for test data generation, synthetic data creation, and edge\-case discovery. * Awareness of the limitations and risks of AI\-generated outputs — able to validate, review, and refine AI suggestions rather than accepting them uncritically. **Leadership \& Growth Mindset*** A track record of mentoring junior QA engineers and elevating team capabilities through knowledge sharing, pairing, and process improvement. * Ability to champion and evangelize AI\-augmented QA practices across the engineering organization. * Experience identifying quality gaps, recommending tooling, and establishing repeatable best practices that scale. * Strong communication and documentation skills — able to articulate technical concepts clearly for both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. * Proactive, self\-directed, and dependable, with a history of independently driving initiatives from concept through execution. **Responsibilities:*** Define and execute AI\-augmented test strategies across functional, integration, and automation testing layers. * Leverage AI tools to accelerate QA workflows — including test case design, automation script generation, def hift\-left testing and AI\-supported code review. * Contribute to CI/CD pipeline quality gates, ensuring automated functional checks are reliable, fast, and actionable. * Establish and share best practices for responsible, effective use of AI in quality engineering across the organization. **Requirements:*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field. * Demonstrated professional experience in software Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering. * Strong programming skills in one or more languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C\#, or equivalent. * Proven experience building and maintaining test automation at scale using modern frameworks (Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar). * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience using AI/LLM\-powered tools to improve QA efficiency, coverage, or speed. * Experience with API testing and CI/CD integration. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. **Bonus Skills:*** Experience with ETL / Data Warehouse testing across tools such as Fivetran, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar. * Familiarity with data modeling concepts (star schema, fact/dimension tables) and data formats (Parquet, CSV, JSON). * Experience validating end\-to\-end data flow from source systems through ETL processes to curated layers jobs.description: Lead with purpose and drive results that matter. (MEPPI) is seeking a highly experienced **Principal System Studies Engineer** to lead and support power systems consulting, advanced engineering studies, and technology initiatives for utilities, grid operators, energy developers, and other industry organizations. We are seeking a power systems professional with extensive experience in **transmission and distribution (T\&D) planning, power systems studies, utility consulting, and engineering analysis** who can provide technical leadership, manage complex projects, support customer engagements, and contribute to the continued growth of MEPPI's Power Systems Engineering Division. This role offers the opportunity to apply advanced engineering expertise, industry knowledge, and project leadership to address complex power system challenges and support the continued development and modernization of the electric grid. **What You'll Do** **Power Systems Consulting \& Industry Engagement** * Lead consulting, studies, and technology integration initiatives with industry organizations such as regional reliability and planning organizations, IEEE, CIGRE, EPRI, and other professional groups. * Engage regularly with Electric Reliability Organizations (EROs), developers, and public and investor\-owned utilities across planning, interconnection, operations, and equipment application functions. * Identify and support T\&D infrastructure development opportunities from early feasibility and planning stages through engineering, implementation, and operations. * Represent MEPPI as a recognized industry leader in power systems consulting, studies, and engineering solutions. * Support sustainable business development and the growth of major customer accounts in alignment with division objectives. * Lead commercial offerings and deliver technical presentations across various markets. **Technical Consulting \& Project Leadership** * Lead and perform advanced power systems studies and consulting engagements. * Organize and manage proposal activities in response to customer specifications, requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for quotations (RFQs), and technical information requests. * Independently manage complex projects from planning through completion, ensuring delivery within established schedules, budgets, and quality expectations. * Develop and manage project plans that establish objectives, strategies, budgets, schedules, and resource assignments. * Consult with customers and project stakeholders to understand technical requirements, address challenges, and deliver effective engineering solutions. * Support project forecasting, resource planning, and workflow management. * Provide feedback and guidance to improve workflow, prevent quality and delivery issues, and support root cause investigations. **Engineering Analysis, Data \& Innovation** * Lead the development, organization, and analysis of data used to support power systems studies and engineering assessments. * Expand the division's capabilities in data mining, visualization, and analytics to improve data quality, analysis, presentation, and integrity. * Lead activities and direct others in the development and application of software and programming tools to enhance engineering models, simulations, automated reporting, data monitoring, and data integrity. * Support generator testing, model development, and model validation in accordance with applicable industry standards. * Lead and contribute to the development of pre\-specifications for T\&D equipment, including key system design parameters. * Identify and implement new technologies, tools, and engineering practices to enhance the division's technical capabilities. **Technical Leadership \& Professional Development** * Train and mentor engineers to expand technical capabilities and develop expertise in emerging areas of power systems engineering. * Lead the continued development of effective engineering practices, technical capabilities, and department tools. * Lead the development of technical papers and articles for professional society journals, trade publications, industry conferences, and technical meetings. * Represent MEPPI at professional society meetings, industry conferences, and trade exhibitions. * Recommend new or revised engineering policies, procedures, and practices. * Collaborate with other MEPPI departments and external vendors to support the goals and professional image of the Power Systems Engineering Division. **What You Bring** **Education** * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering with an emphasis in Electric Power Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent education and experience. **Experience** * Minimum of  ns management, environmental policies, and electric system hardening. * Advanced knowledge of power systems engineering studies, modeling, simulations, and T\&D applications. * Experience with industry\-standard power systems software and modeling tools, including: + EMTP\-RV, PSCAD, MATLAB, ASPEN, and CAPE. + PSLF, PSS®E, TARA, PowerWorld, and related power systems analysis tools. + Economic modeling software such as PROMOD and MAPS. * Programming and automation experience with C, C\+\+, MATLAB, Java, Perl, Python, or similar languages. * Advanced knowledge of industry standards and guidelines, including NESC, NERC, IEEE, IEC, and CIGRE. * Strong organizational, presentation, communication, and technical writing skills. * Advanced analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities. * Ability to work effectively in a team environment while managing multiple projects and priorities. * Advanced computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and related applications. **Preferred Qualifications** * Active participation or leadership within industry organizations such as IEEE, CIGRE, EPRI, or regional reliability and planning organizations. * Experience presenting technical papers and representing an organization at industry conferences and professional society meetings. * Experience mentoring engineers and developing technical teams. * Experience with advanced data analytics, visualization, automation, and engineering software development. **Why MEPPI?** * Comprehensive Health Coverage: Company\-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans with low employee premiums. * Retirement Plans: 401(k) with company match up to 4%. * Generous Paid Time Off: Vacation accrual after 90 days plus 12 paid holidays. * Career Development: Training programs and educational assistance. * Employee Perks: Profit sharing, wellness programs, and 24/7 fitness center access. As a U.S. affiliate of Mitsubishi Electric, we combine global expertise with local execution to deliver innovative engineering solutions and support the continued development of critical electric infrastructure. If you're ready to apply your power systems engineering expertise to challenging technical projects, contribute to industry innovation, and help shape the future of the electric grid, we'd love to hear from you. **Notice to Agencies and Search Firms** MEPPI does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms. The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $130,805 and $161,582 per year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Details of participation in additional compensation and benefit plans, including incentive, medical, financial, and/or other benefits (such as 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits), will be provided if a candidate receives an offer of employment.
