jobs.title: Level 2 Support Technician
jobs.description: **About More Power Technology Group** At More Power Technology Group, we don’t just support IT—we empower organizations to thrive through smart, secure, and scalable technology solutions. As a trusted managed service provider, we specialize in delivering proactive support, cybersecurity, and infrastructure expertise to businesses and government agencies across the Pacific Northwest. Our team is driven by a shared mission to make technology accessible, reliable, and transformative. If you're passionate about solving real\-world problems and want to be part of a company that values innovation, integrity, and community impact, we invite you to join us. **What To Expect** As a Level II Technician, you will be at the heart of our client success, resolving complex technical issues, deploying hardware and software solutions, and collaborating with a team that is committed to excellence. You will work directly with clients to ensure their systems run smoothly and securely while gaining exposure to a wide range of environments and technologies. Expect a fast\-paced, supportive atmosphere where your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your contributions make a visible difference. This is more than a job; it is a chance to build a career with purpose. **POSITION PURPOSE** The Level II Technician is responsible for delivering advanced technical support, troubleshooting client environments, and ensuring reliable performance across hardware, software, and network systems. This role focuses on resolving escalated service issues, maintaining system stability, and serving as a knowledgeable technical resource for both clients and internal teams. The Level II Technician works closely with Level I technicians, project teams, and leadership to diagnose complex problems, implement effective solutions, and document outcomes clearly. This position requires strong technical aptitude, critical thinking, and the ability to communicate solutions in a clear and professional manner. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-oriented, and committed to continuous learning. They can manage multiple service requests across a variety of client environments while maintaining high\-quality standards, strong documentation practices, and effective collaboration. This position may require both remote and on\-site client support, depending on the nature of the issue and project requirements. **POSITION DESCRIPTION** POSITION: **Level II Support Technician** ACCOUNTABILITIES/TASKS * Complete assigned work as specified in the PSA. * Service networks and systems. * Respond to requests from customers for technical assistance and support. * Load and configure network and system software and hardware. * Troubleshoot and repair network and system hardware and software problems. * Complete work order documentation in a timely and accurate manner. \* Maintain tools and equipment. * Maintain assigned tools, test equipment, and spare parts in good working order. * Provide input for the selection of tools and test equipment. \* Provide technical input during bid preparation. * Participate in pre\-job bid meetings as requested. * Interface with customers to identify needs, concerns, and to recommend solutions. * Estimate man\-hour requirements. \* Research technical issues as necessary. * Provide technical solutions using all available resources. * Research knowledge base as necessary to provide solutions. \* Contribute to efficient and effective business operations. * Participate in staff meetings. * Provide input to business operations and planning. * Assist in the selection and development of service staff. * Support business operations as requested and as needed. * Participate in safety and quality control meetings. * Assist in keeping assigned areas clean and neat. * Add/Update Client documentation in PSA. * Maintain technical competency. * Maintain model/brand service certifications. * Must have a valid driver's license and reliable vehicle to perform onsite work that can be over 1 hr. away drive time. KNOWLEDGE/SKILL/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS * Preferred three (3\) years of experience as a computer technician in a multi\-client environment. HUMAN RELATIONS REQUIRMENTS * Ability to interact with customers on a professional and friendly level. * Ability to interact with other employees and management personnel on a professional and friendly level. * Exhibit supervisory and team leader skills. * Exhibit traits of personal reliability and consistency on a day\-to\-day basis. * Exhibit a willingness to take personal responsibility for ensuring customer satisfaction. * Exhibit a willingness to ask for and provide assistance to other personnel. * Exhibit a high degree of professional and personal integrity regarding customer and store equipment and assets. * Exhibit a high degree of personal grooming and appearance. REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS * Report directly to Support Desk Manager * Supervise the activities of Level 1 technicians as needed. FREEDOM TO ACT * Implement technical solutions COMPENSATION * $26\.00 – $32\.00/hour plus benefits * Great opportunity and a clear path to vertical progression to Level III Engineer. NOTE: This position description is representative of major requirements and is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $26\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Employee discount * Health insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI\-generated answers. Our AI\-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst\-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action. Founder\-controlled and growing profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward\-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives. Our Agents team at Muck Rack is building AI for PR and communications professionals. Our first agent helps customers understand their media coverage. Next, we're building agents that can plan and carry out multi\-step workflows. You'll take features from idea to production, working across our Python agent runtime, MCP server, and Django/Vue application. You'll help decide how the technology works, ship it to real customers, and learn from how they use it. You'll help shape what we build next and how we build it. You'll work with new models, solve real customer problems, and take your ideas from experiment to production. If you want to build agents people actually rely on, we'd like to meet you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build agents that take action.** Build tools, prompts, guardrails, and multi\-turn workflows with memory. Help agents know when to act, ask a question, or hand off to a human * **Ship the full experience.** Build in\-product chat, streaming responses, permission\-aware APIs, and our external MCP server * **Make quality measurable.** Build evals, catch regressions, and use production feedback to improve quality, latency, and cost * **Help shape the platform.** Make decisions about how we build, deploy, and run agents as the product grows **To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You'll Need to Have** -------------------------------------------------------------- * 7\+ years building production software * Fluent Python skills, including async programming and experience with FastAPI, FastMCP, or Django * Experience shipping LLM\-powered features or agents to real customers including exposing tools via MCP * A practical understanding of prompting, tool use, context management, and where models go wrong * Experience measuring AI quality and using what you learn to improve it * Strong API and tool design skills, including authentication and authorization * Proactively incorporates AI tools into day\-to\-day work to improve productivity and accelerate delivery * Working\-hour overlap with US time zones (Eastern preferred) **If Any of the Below Also Describe You, This Could Be an Exciting Opportunity** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Agent frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, or the OpenAI Agents SDK * MCP servers and LLM tooling * AI evaluation tools and methods, including DeepEval and LLM\-as\-judge * Streaming UIs, server\-sent events, and Vue.js * Experience with LLM observability * AI security, including prompt injection defenses and tenant isolation ### **Interview Overview** Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision. * 30\-minute interview with a member of our Talent Team * A 1 hour zoom interview with the hiring manager * Peer interviews with several team members * 30\-minute Executive Interview * 30\-minute Bar Raiser ### **Travel \& Team Engagement Expectations** This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected. ### **Salary** * The anticipated salary range for this role in Ireland is €95,000–€110,000 annually, depending on experience. * The anticipated salary range for this role in United Kingdom is £105,000–£115,000 annually, depending on experience. * The anticipated salary for this role in Bulgaria is €6,500\+ gross per month, depending on experience. ###### **Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.** **Why Muck Rack?** ------------------ **Remote Work, Forever** * Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup * Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership * Virtual and in\-person team bonding (lunches, events, competitions) **Transparent \& Fair Compensation** * Competitive geo\-neutral pay in the U.S. * Annual reviews to ensure equity and market alignment * Standardized bonus or commission structure * 401(k) with employer contributions * Equity opportunities **Health \& Wellness** * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance for employees and dependents * 100% premium coverage for individuals on high\-deductible plans * 24/7 Virtual Care and Employee Assistance Program * Employer\-funded HSA contributions and other pre\-tax benefits * Quarterly wellness stipend and free Headspace subscription **Time Off \& Family Benefits** * 4\+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days * 13 paid holidays with the option to swap for personal days * Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave **Learning and Development** * Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion * Bi\-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training * Unlimited access to Coursera and O'Reilly * 2 additional PTO days annually for learning and development **Inclusive, Customer\-First Culture** * Commitment to equity and valuing diverse perspectives * Agile, founder\-led company focused on collaboration and innovation * Trusted by 3,000\+ companies worldwide *Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.\-based employees. Support is provided for employees in other locations, in compliance with local laws and regulations.* While we are a fully distributed team, we do have limitations on where we can hire and maintain a list of acceptable working locations based on job function. If we are unable to hire in your current location for the role for which you applied, you will be notified via email. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: We are building a practical AI capabilities for airline employees and customers. Projects include crew assistance, document and image understanding, multilingual information retrieval, and customer\-facing connections to flight information and booking services. The focus is applying existing models and tools to real problems. You will work with a small team, contribute directly to technical decisions, and follow projects from early prototypes through testing, deployment and ongoing improvement. **What you will do** * Build and maintain our AI knowledge corpus: collect, clean, organize and update documents and structured information while preserving sources, versions and access permissions. * Improve retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), including document processing, embeddings, search and the quality of information supplied to models. * Integrate and maintain models such as Qwen for vision and Gemma for answer generation, including local deployment on Apple silicon. * Work with our application developers on Apple Intelligence and the Foundation Models framework. * Develop Model Context Protocol (MCP) and API integrations for customer\-facing services such as flight schedules, fare search and booking workflows, using authoritative business systems for current information. * Create repeatable evaluations, investigate incorrect answers and integration failures, and improve accuracy, response time and reliability. * Document your work and build maintainable systems with appropriate security, privacy and monitoring. **What we are looking for** * Demonstrated ability to build working software, including an LLM application, retrieval system, AI integration or substantial related project. * Strong programming and debugging skills, particularly in Python, with experience using APIs, processing data and working with Git. * Practical understanding of how language models use retrieved information and tools, including their limitations. * Ability to turn an unclear business request into a manageable implementation and explain technical choices clearly. * Care with source accuracy, confidential information and testing. * Independence, curiosity and willingness to maintain and improve what you build. **Helpful experience** * Qwen, Gemma or comparable open\-weight models. * RAG pipelines, vector search, reranking and automated evaluations. * MCP servers, tool calling, authentication and business\-system integrations. * Swift, iOS/macOS development, Apple Intelligence, Foundation Models or MLX. * Local or offline AI deployment, multilingual applications, document processing or computer vision. * Airline, travel, commerce or other operational systems. You do not need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of useful work matter more than a particular degree or an extensive list of AI tools. **How we work** We encourage using AI tools for development, research, documentation and content preparation. You should be comfortable using them to move faster while understanding, testing and taking responsibility for the resulting work. This role offers direct ownership, access to real airline problems and the opportunity to help shape a growing internal AI capability. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D. **The Role** We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build how developers and AI agents access our agentic web infrastructure. This role is based in our New York office, hybrid with the NYC team. Our APIs are used by millions of developers and the AI agents acting on their behalf. The team owns the main API gateway, the customer platform (keys, usage, teams), identity and enterprise SSO, and the public interfaces to our product: the SDKs, CLI, MCP servers and other tools developers and agents use. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Online Serving and Inference, AI Platform
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. **The Team** ============ Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) power the innovation in all areas of the business, including helping members choose the right title for them through personalization, better understanding our audience and our content slate, creating high\-quality subtitles, dubbings, images, trailers, and other assets, optimize our payment processing, and much more. The Artificial Intelligence (AIP) organization builds highly scalable and differentiated AI/ML infrastructure to maximize the business impact of all AI practitioners at Netflix, which is the key to accelerating this innovation. **The Opportunity** =================== The Online Serving and Inference team builds and maintains the infrastructure that enables ML practitioners to run their large\-scale online serving and inference workflows to deploy AI models for Netflix member scale ecosystems. The team is responsible for the common framework to develop and deploy AI/ML models in Netflix infrastructure to power the AI applications and features. We are looking for an experienced AI/ML infrastructure engineering leader to lead the development of our next\-generation serving and inference platform! You will lead this team to architect, design, develop, test, and launch a brand\-new platform to enable ML practitioners across the content, studio, consumer, ads, and games domains to effortlessly package, deploy, and execute inference workflows for thousands of large\-scale models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), computer vision and foundation models. The models will come from various lifecycle stages, including early research and experimentation, development, productization, and ongoing innovation and optimization of productized models. We are a highly collaborative team. You will be highly cross\-functional in partnering with other engineering, product management, machine learning, and data teams to take Netflix’s AI initiatives to the next level. To succeed in this role, you will need a strong AI/ ML infrastructure background and a passion for building scalable, robust systems that enable and accelerate our ability to apply large and complex ML models across various domains. **In this role, you will:** =========================== * Partner with Applied Research and backend application teams to understand their needs and gather and iterate on the platform's requirements. * Drive the architecture, design, build vs. buy evaluation, and execution of the online serving and inference platform. Strive for extensibility and ensure the platform can scale to meet the needs of the evolving AI landscape. * Build a roadmap focused on incremental delivery. Define success metrics, align on migration goals, and drive the platform's adoption. * Communicate progress to stakeholders, customers, and senior leadership. * Maintain existing platform offerings, balancing immediate needs in current systems while prioritizing the development of the next\-gen platform. * Hire and grow diverse, highly talented engineers while maintaining and fostering an inclusive team culture. **To succeed in this role, you will need:** =========================================== * 10\+ years of software engineering experience and 3\+ years of management experience. * Experience leading teams responsible for building high\-traffic distributed systems and ML infrastructure * Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies to support data preparation, processing, and inference for large\-scale AI/ML models, such as Kubernetes. * Industry experience working with GPU based mode inference, and serving optimization (batching, latency, cost per request) in large scale computing environments * Modern Foundation Model, such as LLM, serving and inference stacks such as vLLM, Nvidia Triton, TensorRT LLM, or SGLang. * Strong technical acumen and can act as a credible technical advisor to the team, set and enforce a high\-quality bar for code and system design, and be a mentor for the team. * A passion for translating the needs of ML practitioners into infrastructure offerings with an eye toward automated and self\-serve capabilities. * Strong communication and collaboration skills and ability to build strong relationships with internal customers and external partners. * A demonstrated ability to develop, drive, and execute a technical vision and roadmap. * A track record of attracting top talent and leading and growing high\-performance, diverse, and highly talented senior and staff level engineers to maximize their impact and deliver results in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment. * Experience managing a hybrid team with partners and team members distributed across (US) geographies \& time zones. To learn more about our AI Platform, you can review the relevant talks/blog posts on the Netflix ML Platform Research website . Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $523,000\.00 \- $920,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, Records Platform (T3\)** **About Neumo** Neumo builds the cloud software that powers government. More than 4,500 state, local and federal agencies across North America run on our platforms, processing over 900 million transactions and collecting $44 billion in revenue for the communities they serve. When a county records a deed, a family orders a birth certificate, or a business files a local tax return, that transaction often runs through our systems. That comes with a particular kind of engineering responsibility. Our platforms are systems of record for legally binding documents and public funds. Correctness is not negotiable, downtime has civic consequences, and the data we hold is expected to remain accurate and retrievable for decades. **Summary** The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds and maintains features for Neumo’s Records platform (Land Records, Vital Records and Search). County recorders and clerks use it to record deeds, index documents, issue certified birth, death and marriage certificates, and give the public secure access to records that go back generations. Every recorded document has legal weight, so correctness, security and reliability are essential. Records is a key area of investment for Neumo. We are evolving it from a tightly coupled, manually configured platform that depends on specific peripherals into a best\-in\-class product that meets customers where they are. Positioned between the Software Engineer and Staff Engineer roles, the Senior Software Engineer owns features from design through production and makes sound technical decisions within their area. They raise code quality on the team and help newer engineers grow. This role requires strong skills in .NET, SQL Server and cloud technologies, plus the judgment to work effectively in Neumo’s AI\-assisted, agentic delivery model. The Senior Software Engineer reports to a Software Engineering Manager on the Records platform. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, build, test and maintain features within the Records platform, such as eRecording and eSubmission, automated indexing, search, certified copy requests, property fraud alerts, and ID verification and payment integrations. * Contribute to platform modernization by decoupling tightly coupled components, replacing manual configuration with configurable, self\-service setup, and reducing dependencies on specific peripherals. * Take on meaningful parts of our modernization work, resolving compatibility issues and validating changes. * Build self\-service configurable features that support each jurisdiction’s statutes, workflows and level of digital maturity without custom code. * Develop and tune search features, including indexing, relevance and query performance, for large volumes of recorded documents. * Support customer migrations by building and testing data migration tooling, with a focus on data accuracy and record integrity. * Work from approved specifications in Neumo’s agentic delivery model. Use AI agents to draft code and tests, then review, correct and own what ships. * Conduct thorough code reviews, including reviews of AI\-generated code, and hold a high bar for correctness, maintainability and test coverage. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues related to performance, reliability and data quality, and take part in on\-call rotations and post\-incident reviews. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and monitoring to support reliable, repeatable releases. * Participate in sprint planning and backlog refinement. Give realistic estimates and raise risks early. * Document key design decisions and platform knowledge, and share expertise through pairing and walkthroughs so critical knowledge doesn’t live with one person. * Mentor Software Engineers and newer team members on coding practices, debugging, testing and how the Records platform works. * Partner with product managers, QA, architects, Staff and Principal Engineers, and implementation teams to clarify requirements and keep designs consistent with Neumo’s platform direction. * Build on Neumo’s shared enterprise services, such as identity and access, payments, notifications, reporting and search, instead of rebuilding them within Records. * Follow secure development practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management and access control, in line with the frameworks our government customers require. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in full\-stack development and cloud software, with a focus on Microsoft technologies. * Advanced coding skills in .NET, including both .NET Framework and modern .NET. Experience with Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Java and React is a plus. * Strong experience with SQL Server, plus working knowledge of NoSQL databases, cloud storage and data management best practices. * Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud\-native design patterns, such as microservices, serverless architecture, distributed caching and containerization. * Hands\-on experience with search platforms such as Elasticsearch, Solr or Lucene, including indexing and performance tuning. * Experience upgrading or modernizing legacy applications while keeping them stable in production. * Experience with high\-volume data processing and data migrations. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools, and the judgment to review generated code critically. * Experience working in Agile environments, with a collaborative approach to problem\-solving and mentoring. * Understanding of security and compliance standards, such as SOC 2 and PCI, and how they apply to engineering design. * Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues and trade\-offs to engineers, product partners and leadership. **Nice to Have** * Experience with land records, vital records, recording or county clerk systems. * Experience with document management, OCR, imaging or scanning technologies. * Experience integrating with hardware peripherals, or moving away from hardware\-dependent designs. * Experience with eRecording standards or submitter integrations. * Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS platforms. * Experience with spec\-driven development or agentic coding tools, such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot agents. * Experience with public\-sector security frameworks, such as StateRAMP/GovRAMP or FedRAMP. **Neumo Summary** With the backing of four decades of public sector expertise and corporate capability, Neumo has successfully supported government services. Neumo was honored and recognized for four (4\) consecutive years as a GovTech 100 Company representing the top 100 companies focused on making a difference in and selling to state and local government agencies across the United States. Neumo is committed to helping communities thrive and brings a wealth of experience combined with innovation. Today, Neumo offers more administrative and financial support to government officials than any other organization. And with a responsive, client\-focused approach, we foster partnerships that give our customers the certainty they need to accomplish more. Neumo offers a competitive benefits and compensation package and are looking for team members who will thrive in our dynamic environment. Neumo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Selection for a position will be made without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, marital status, non\-disqualifying physical handicap, and age.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Nanofabrication and Characterization Engineer
jobs.description: **About Neurophos** =================== The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach. Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large\-scale AI inference. We’ve assembled a world\-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others. Join us and shape the future of computing! **Location:** Austin, TX. Full\-time onsite position. **Reports To**: Chief Scientist **FLSA Status**: Exempt **Position Overview** --------------------- We are seeking a hands\-on Nanofabrication and Characterization Engineer to build and characterize prototype metasurface chips for our optical vector\-matrix multiplication (OVMM) engine. Prototypes made in university cleanrooms let us try new metasurface designs, materials, and process changes in weeks rather than waiting on a full foundry cycle. This role owns that fast path: you will turn electromagnetic designs into masks and process flows, fabricate multilevel metal–dielectric nanostructures, integrate the active tunable layer and package the device, and measure what you built so every run teaches us something. You will spend most of your time in shared\-user university nanofabrication facilities and in our own lab: running lithography, deposition, etch, and planarization steps, inspecting and cross\-sectioning devices, and measuring their optical and electro\-optic response. The rest of your time goes to process documentation, run tracking, and data analysis. If you combine strong cleanroom process skills with the drive to test your own devices, this role will let you own the metasurface prototyping line, from design to measured device. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Process Flow Development:** Turn metasurface designs into complete, multi\-step process flows and travelers. Select lithography, deposition, etch, and planarization steps that meet target dimensions and tolerances with the tools at hand. * **Nanoscale Lithography:** Pattern sub\-200 nm features and align multiple layers using electron\-beam lithography and optical or deep\-UV steppers. Develop and maintain dose, proximity\-correction, and resist recipes. * **Thin\-Film Deposition and Etch:** Deposit and etch metals, dielectrics, and thin conformal liners (sputtering, evaporation, PECVD, ALD, RIE/ICP). Control thickness, sidewall profile, and aspect ratio to nanometer\-level tolerances. * **Multilevel Integration:** Build stacked metal–dielectric structures with vias and planarization (CMP, damascene, or lift\-off). Diagnose and fix yield problems that arise between layers: misalignment, dishing, voids, and adhesion. * **Active Layer and Device Assembly:** Integrate the electro\-optically tunable material layer, including surface preparation, alignment and encapsulation layers, cell assembly, and sealing. Dice, mount, and wire\-bond devices for testing. * **Process Metrology:** Inspect every run with SEM, FIB cross\-sections, AFM, profilometry, and ellipsometry. Feed measured dimensions back into the design so it models the as\-built device. * **Optical and Electro\-Optic Characterization:** Measure the reflectance, spectra, polarization response, and voltage\-dependent tuning of finished devices on microscope\-based optical benches. Compare results against simulation and trace gaps to specific design or process causes. * **Facility and Run Management:** Hold access and training at university cleanroom facilities, schedule tool time, manage materials and consumables, and maintain a steady run cadence with clear records of what was built and why. **Secondary Responsibilities** * Design metasurface unit cells and arrays using full\-wave electromagnetic simulation in partnership with the modeling team, set geometries and tolerances based on what the process can produce, and generate mask layouts. * Maintain process recipes, travelers, run logs, and characterization reports so that any run can be repeated and audited. * Supply the modeling and design teams with as\-fabricated dimensions, material properties, and process tolerance sses and lessons learned to foundry partners, and compare foundry\-built and prototype devices. * Mentor engineers and technicians in cleanroom practice, process safety, and metrology. **Qualifications** ------------------ * **Degree:** MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Applied Physics, Optics, or a closely related field, with a thesis or work centered on nanofabrication. * **Experience:** 3\+ years of hands\-on cleanroom experience fabricating nanophotonic, metasurface, plasmonic, MEMS, or semiconductor devices, including independent ownership of multi\-step process flows. * **Nanolithography:** Direct experience with electron\-beam lithography and multilayer alignment at sub\-200 nm feature sizes, including resist processing and dose and proximity correction. * **Deposition and Etch:** Practical command of metal and dielectric deposition and dry etch, including recipe development for profile, selectivity, and uniformity. * **Metrology:** Proficiency with SEM, AFM, ellipsometry, and profilometry; FIB cross\-sectioning experience strongly desired. * **Optical Characterization:** Experience measuring the optical response of nanostructured devices with microscope\-based reflection or transmission spectroscopy and polarization optics. * **Software for Analysis:** Proficiency in Python (and/or MATLAB) for process data analysis, image analysis, and automated measurement, plus layout tools such as KLayout or L\-Edit for mask design. * **Safety:** Strong cleanroom safety practices with hazardous chemicals and gases, and laser safety training for optical bench work. * **Communication:** Clear technical documentation and strong collaboration with device designers, modeling engineers, packaging engineers, and facility staff. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Experience in a university or shared\-user nanofabrication facility, including quickly qualifying new tools and working within shared tool schedules. * Damascene metallization, CMP, or other planarization processes for multilevel interconnect\-like stacks. * Atomic layer deposition of conformal dielectric or metal\-nitride liners in high\-aspect\-ratio features. * Experience with liquid crystals, electro\-optic polymers, phase\-change materials, or other tunable optical materials, including alignment layers and cell assembly. * Post\-CMOS processing or heterogeneous integration on foundry wafers or dies. * Dicing, die attach, wire bonding, and electrical probing of fabricated devices. * Nanophotonic or metasurface design experience with full\-wave electromagnetic simulation (FDTD, FEM, RCWA) and simulation\-to\-layout workflows. This is the path to owning the full design\-to\-characterization cycle. * Statistical process control, design of experiments, and yield analysis across wafers and runs. * Experience transferring a process to a commercial foundry or working with foundry design rules. **What We Offer** ================= This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in an innovative startup redefining the future of AI hardware. Work on game\-changing technology at the intersection of photonics and AI as part of a collaborative, brilliant team. You’ll contribute to a platform that redefines computational performance and accelerates the future of artificial intelligence. Come help us bring this transformative technology to the world. **Benefits** ------------ Join a team that invests in your future and your well\-being. At Neurophos, we offer: * 100% coverage of base health plan premiums for you and your dependents, plus HSA contributions. * Unlimited PTO. No rigid vacation banks, just a focus on delivery. * 401(k) matching and stock option opportunities to ensure our success is your success. * Full suite of voluntary benefits, including Dental, Vision, Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident insurance. * Personalized Benefits. Choose the plans that fit your life and take the cash back for those that don’t. Compensation Range: $160K \- $190K

jobs.title: Performance Engineer I
jobs.description: **About NovaSource** NovaSource Power Services is the world’s \#1\-ranked solar operations and maintenance (O\&M) provider and insight\-driven total asset optimization partner for renewables asset owners ready to fuel smart growth. With over 20 years of operating experience and a presence on 5 continents, NovaSource has the global reach and strategic capabilities to achieve our clients’ renewables goals around the world. NovaSource’s comprehensive approach to total asset optimization in addition to O\&M services includes value engineering, performance analysis, strategic supply chain management, and advanced monitoring systems. The company operates in key global markets managing over 30GW of solar power plants. NovaSource’s expertise extends beyond solar and includes battery energy storage systems (BESS), offering a complete suite of services for the evolving renewable energy landscape. **About the role** ------------------ As a Senior Performance Engineer , you will turn operating data into clear explanations, prioritized recommendations, and measurable improvements for solar photovoltaic (PV) and battery energy storage system (BESS) assets. You will take analytical responsibility for an assigned portfolio, with guidance from senior engineers, proactively investigate underperformance, and help customers understand opportunities to improve energy production, reliability, and asset value. You will work closely with Operations, Asset Management, Monitoring, Engineering, Commercial, Contracts, and Technology. PE owns analytical quality, recommendations, and benefit verification; Operations retains execution accountability, with Asset Management coordinating customer priorities and approvals. Technology owns digital platforms, configuration, and production automation. You will apply established methods to routine assignments and seek senior technical review for complex diagnoses, material customer recommendations, contractual interpretations, and performance\-test conclusions. Indicative future\-state focus: Performance Intelligence \& Diagnostics, 30%; Asset Value Enhancement, 20%; Customer Support, 20%; Reporting Assurance \& Performance Governance, 15%; and Organizational Support \& Capability Building, 15%. These proposed allocations are subject to baseline validation and may vary with portfolio needs and the transition of routine reporting and technology responsibilities. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Performance Intelligence \& Diagnostics:** Maintain a proactive review cadence for an assigned portfolio. Analyze expected versus actual performance, equipment trends, availability, and energy losses; distinguish physical asset issues from data or modeling limitations. Apply appropriate environmental normalization and assess sensor quality and measurement uncertainty. For PV, investigate production losses and equipment performance; for BESS, assess availability, charge/discharge efficiency, usable energy capacity, degradation, auxiliary consumption, and operating constraints using approved methods. Distinguish equipment limitations from dispatch instructions and contractual requirements. Prioritize findings by energy impact, reliability risk, and contractual significance, and escalate material issues with practical next steps. * **Asset Value Enhancement:** Support performance modeling, degradation studies, and loss analysis to identify improvement opportunities. Maintain a prioritized opportunity register documenting baselines, estimated recoverable energy, indicative financial benefits, assumptions, and agreed implementation owners. Help prepare technical recommendations and business cases, track actions through cross\-functional reviews, and verify outcomes using appropriate baselines and operating\-condition adjustments. Clearly distinguish estimated opportunities from verified energy recovery and realized financial benefits. * **Customer Support:** Prepare clear, evidence\-based performance narratives for customer meetings and business reviews. Proactively raise material trends, risks, and improvement opportunities rather than responding only to requests. Explain technical findings, uncertainties, and recommended actions in terms of production, reliability, asset value, and potential performance\-guarantee exposure. Coordinate responses with customer\-facing teams and obtain appropriate technical review before communicating material conclusions. * **Reporting Assurance \& Performance Governance:** Review performance reports and key performance indicators (KPIs) for accuracy, consistency, and alignment with approved methods and contractual requirements. Validate calculations, assumptions, exclusions, and data quality; investigate material exceptions and document limitations or measurement uncertainty. Maintain traceable analytical records and escalate recurring data or calculation defects to the responsible teams. PE provides analytical assurance and exception investigation, rather than ro  rather than independently negotiating commitments. Use analytical coding tools for repeatable investigations; define requirements and validate outputs for Technology\-delivered tools without owning production software or automation deployment. **What you will bring** ----------------------- * A masters degree in engineering, physics, mathematics, data science, or a related technical field; a bachelor’s degree with relevant experience may also be considered. * Relevant coursework, academic projects, internships, or professional experience in energy systems, engineering analysis, or asset performance. * Foundational knowledge of solar PV and/or BESS systems and a willingness to develop capability across both technologies. Understanding of expected\-versus\-actual performance, equipment behavior, environmental effects, sensor and meter quality, and basic measurement uncertainty. * Demonstrated ability, through coursework, projects, internships, or work, to analyze operational datasets using Python, MATLAB, SQL, or equivalent tools. Python is preferred; familiarity with performance\-modeling and data\-visualization tools is an advantage. * Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication. Ability to connect measured trends to physical operating conditions, document assumptions, and explain technical findings and business implications to different audiences. * A collaborative, customer\-focused approach; ability to prioritize concurrent assignments, follow through on recommendations, ask questions, and seek appropriate review. A commitment to learning, sound engineering practice, and continuous improvement. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation package \+ Paid Time Off (PTO). * **Health Coverage:** Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, and vision plans effective on your first day. * **Flexible Spending \& Health Savings Accounts (FSA/HSA):** Options to help you save on healthcare costs. * **Career Growth:** On\-the\-job training with a clear path for advancement. * **Income Protection:** Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance. * **Legal Support:** Access to legal assistance services. * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Confidential counseling and support resources. * **Retirement Savings:** 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions. * **Additional Perks:** Pet insurance and more employee benefits. **Office Physical Requirements:** All positions in our office require interaction with people and technology while either standing or sitting. In order to best service our customers, internal and external, all associates must be able to communicate face\-to\-face and on the phone with or without reasonable accommodation. NovaSource is committed to compliance with its obligations under all applicable state and federal laws prohibiting employment discrimination. In keeping with this commitment, it attempts to reasonably accommodate applicants and employees in accordance with the requirements of the disability discrimination laws. It also invites individuals with disabilities to participate in a good faith, interactive process to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made without imposing an undue hardship. *Potential candidates will meet the education and experience requirements provided on the above job description and excel in completing the listed responsibilities for this role.* **US: Diversity Statement – Equal Employment Opportunity** It is NovaSource’s policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. NovaSource disapproves of, and will not tolerate, unlawful discrimination against any applicant or employee because of race, color, national origin or ancestry, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, age, religion, disability, family care status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal laws.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Entitlements & Spend Platform
jobs.description: **About Orb:** We're a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We're building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence. Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you'll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar. For San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Amsterdam residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. Our values, *customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together* are at the core of everything we do. **About the role:** Every usage\-based business eventually asks the same three questions in real time: what has this customer consumed, what are they entitled to, and what should happen next? This team owns the runtime layer where billing state becomes something customers can act on — alerting, spend controls, entitlement checks, and usage analytics. This is a foundational role. Enterprise and AI customers increasingly treat entitlements, spend controls, and real\-time analytics as a single problem rather than three separate features, which makes this one of the highest\-leverage areas of Orb's roadmap. You'll help set the direction, the primitives, and the interfaces other teams build against. The work sits squarely at the intersection of infrastructure and product. On one side, it's real systems engineering: alerts, balances, and entitlement checks computed against actual tiers, credits, and commits, fast and reliably enough to stand behind latency guarantees. On the other, it's a customer\-facing product surface where API design, clarity, and getting the primitives right matter as much as the systems underneath. You'll spend as much time understanding what customers are trying to do as you will building the thing that does it. You'll build the system customers rely on to know, in real time, what's been consumed, what's allowed, and what should happen next — the reactive side that alerts the moment a limit is crossed, and the proactive side that serves live balance and entitlement state on demand. Because it runs against Orb's real pricing, credits, and commits, customers can put it directly in the critical path of their own spend and access decisions — the layer they reach for as they scale. **In this role, you will:** * Own a product surface end to end — from customer conversations and product design through API design, implementation, and rollout * Design and ship alerting and analytics that are granular, flexible, and fast enough to carry contractual latency SLAs * Build the entitlement and spend\-control primitives (credit balances, allocations, usage\-percentage alerts, rate limits) that enforce against Orb's real billing state in real time * Shape the roadmap, primitives, and interfaces other teams build against — foundational decisions that are still open * Collaborate across PM, design, sales, and customer success, and work directly with enterprise and AI customers to turn their pain points into what we build **About you:** * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning products or systems end to end * Energized by ambiguity and ownership — you want a say in what gets built, not just how * Strong product instincts and genuine customer empathy; you like being close to customers and to the business impact of your work (this is revenue\-adjacent, and people trust these numbers) * Comfortable designing APIs and data models that other teams and customers depend on * Enough systems depth to reason clearly about real\-time and low\-latency tradeoffs — this team leans product, but the engineering is real * Attention to detail across API design, product UX, and everything in between **Orb's Tech Stack:** At Orb, we believe great engineers can learn any stack, so you do not need experience with these specific tools and we encourage you to apply regardless. * **Frontend:** Typescript \+ React \+ Tailwind CSS * **Backend:** Python * **Datastores:** PostgreSQL \+ Clickhouse * **Streaming Platforms:** Kafka \+ Spark Streaming * **Cloud Platform:** AWS **Why Adyen x Orb?** This is an exceptional opportunity to join a solid, established company with a startup mindset, characterized by small teams, direct communication, and work on important challenges. You'll have direct access to massive global datasets (e.g., payments, identity data) and the ability to see your team's work have an immediate impact at scale. While this is a San Francisco\-based role, we recognize that global mobility matters—especially for candidates navigating complex situations. Adyen has deep roots in Europe and a strong global presence, and we're open to future relocation conversations to our offices if better supports your personal or professional goals in the future. Our aim is to build a lasting foundation for you at Adyen x Orb—starting in San Francisco, but with the flexibility to adapt as life evolves. *The annual base salary range for this role is $212,800 \- $293,000 plus RSUs; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click* *here**. This position is based out of the San Francisco office.*

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, AI Platform
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. OpenLoop is building the future of healthcare infrastructure. We're hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to build and lead our Applied AI team, the engineers who ship the LLM\-based agents and assistants our operations, clinical and patient\-facing teams use every day. This is a leadership role with real technical depth. You'll hire and grow a team of Senior, Staff and Senior Staff Applied AI Engineers, own delivery of production AI systems, and set the standards for how we build, evaluate and safely run AI on patient data. You don't need to write production code daily, but you need to be credible in architecture and eval reviews and know what good looks like. **What You'll Do** * **Build \& Lead the Team:** Hire, onboard and develop a team of Applied AI Engineers across Senior, Staff and Senior Staff levels, and grow it from a single pod into multiple teams as the work expands. * **Own Delivery of Production Agents:** Drive the roadmap and execution of LLM\-based agents and assistants that real users rely on, from scoping to launch to ongoing operation. * **Set the Technical Bar:** Partner with Staff\+ engineers on architecture for agent runtime and orchestration, retrieval, model access and observability. Make the call on trade\-offs when the team needs one. * **Evaluation as a Standard:** Make evaluation sets, regression tests and AI\-graded evals a required part of how the team ships, so we can show improvement with numbers and catch regressions before users do. * **Reliability, Cost \& Operations:** Own the operational health of AI systems in production, including on\-call, incident response, provider fallbacks, model version upgrades and AI spend by agent and use case. * **Security, Privacy \& Safety:** Make sure every AI system protects patient data (PHI), follows least\-privilege access, and defends against misuse such as prompt injection. Partner with Security and Compliance on HIPAA requirements. * **Workflow \& Use Case Prioritization:** Work with Product and Operations leaders to find where agents can reliably take over human workflows, where they should hand off to a person, and which bets to make first. * **Cross\-functional Leadership:** Explain AI capabilities, risks and timelines in plain language to product, operations, clinical and executive stakeholders, including when the honest answer is "the AI isn't ready for this yet." * **Team Health \& Process:** Run planning, prioritization and delivery rituals that keep a senior team shipping fast without burning out. Give clear, direct feedback and build career paths. * Other duties as assigned. **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field * **Proven Engineering Experience:** 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years managing engineers directly (hiring, performance management, career development). * **Production LLM Experience:** Led or built LLM\-based systems in production that real users relied on, not only demos, prototypes or personal projects. * **Senior Team Leadership:** Experience managing senior and Staff\-level engineers and earning their technical trust. * **Technical Depth:** Enough hands\-on understanding of agent runtime, evaluation, retrieval and observability to review designs, challenge assumptions and make sound architecture calls. * **Evaluation Rigor:** You hold teams to measuring whether AI systems work with evaluation data, rather than "it seemed to work." * **Engineering Fundamentals:** Strong grounding in production engineering across testing, services, APIs, deployment, incident management and on\-call. * **Data \& Security Fluency:** Experience leading teams that handle sensitive data with a security\-first mindset. * Comfort building in a greenfield space, and clear communication with technical and non\-technical partners ### **Preferred Qualifications** * **Regulated\-Industry Experience:** Healthcare (PHI, HIPAA), finance or insurance. * **GCP Experience:** Leading teams that run production services on Google Cloud. * **Scaling Teams:** Grew an engineering team from zero, or from one team to several. * **Model Operations:** Led migrations between model versions or providers. * **Classic ML Background:** Machine learning experience beyond LLMs. * **Internal Platforms:** Led a platform used by other engineering teams. **Our Benefits** In addition to a competitive base pay, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for: * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts * Flexible PTO * 401(k) \+ Company Match * Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more **Our Company** --------------- We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work. Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

This role is responsible for resolving escalated technical issues, maintaining client IT environments, implementing solutions, and ensuring reliable, secure IT operations. Security \& Best Practices * Support MFA, conditional access, endpoint protection, and other standard security controls. * Assist with security incident triage, suspicious email investigations, and endpoint remediation. * Identify outdated systems, configuration weaknesses, and potential security risks. * Follow established security policies, change management procedures, and documentation standards. Client Service \& Teamwork * Provide professional, responsive, and friendly support to end users and client contacts. * Communicate technical issues, timelines, and resolutions clearly and proactively. * Take ownership of assigned tickets and follow through until resolution or appropriate escalation. * Maintain accurate documentation of client environments, configurations, and procedures. * Work collaboratively with other engineers and service desk staff. * Participate in scheduled client\-site visits and occasional after\-hours maintenance when required. Required Qualifications \& Technical Skills * 3\+ years of professional IT support experience, ideally within an MSP or multi\-client IT environment. * Strong working knowledge of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 administration. * Practical experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP. * Experience troubleshooting networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VPNs, Wi\-Fi, and switching. * Familiarity with Windows Server administration and common small\-to\-mid\-sized business infrastructure. * Experience with remote monitoring and management (RMM), professional services automation (PSA), ticketing, and remote support tools. * Working knowledge of endpoint security, MFA, patching, and backup solutions. * Strong analytical troubleshooting skills and the ability to work independently on escalated issues. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * A customer\-first mindset, strong organizational skills, and attention to detail. * Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for client\-site visits. Preferred Qualifications * Previous experience working for a small or mid\-sized MSP. * Experience with Microsoft 365 administration and cloud identity management. * Familiarity with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper\-V. * Exposure to Microsoft Intune and endpoint management. * Experience with business\-class firewalls, managed switches, and wireless infrastructure. * Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery platforms. * Microsoft, CompTIA, or networking certifications such as MS\-900, AZ\-900, Network\+, Security\+, or equivalent practical experience. What Success Looks Like * Independently resolves the majority of assigned Level 2 technical issues. * Reduces unnecessary escalations by using sound troubleshooting and research skills. * Maintains clear, accurate, and useful ticket documentation. * Provides a consistently positive experience for clients. * Follows established processes while identifying opportunities to improve them. * Helps maintain stable, secure, and well\-documented client environments. * Demonstrates initiative, accountability, and a willingness to learn. What We Offer * A collaborative, close\-knit team with direct access to experienced engineers and leadership. * Exposure to a broad range of technologies and client environments. * Opportunities to develop technical skills and take ownership of projects. * A client\-focused environment where quality of service matters more than ticket volume alone. * Competitive compensation based on experience and technical ability. * Benefits and professional development opportunities, as applicable. Who Will Thrive in This Role? We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, takes pride in doing things the right way, and understands that excellent IT support requires both technical ability and strong client relationships. You should be comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities, and supporting a variety of business environments. You do not need to know everything, but you should have a strong technical foundation, a methodical troubleshooting approach, and the judgment to recognize when an issue requires additional expertise. If you are a dependable, technically capable IT professional looking to grow, we would like to hear from you. Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Tampa, FL 33611

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
jobs.description: **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** *(Remote, US\-Based Only)* **Build quality into software that matters.** At Pulsara, great testing requires more than finding defects or building automated tests. Our Senior Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) combine hands\-on testing with software engineering expertise to build and sustain reliable automation, solve complex technical challenges, and mentor others while helping shape the team's approach to software quality. **And reliability matters here.** Pulsara is used by healthcare professionals coordinating care for time\-critical patients. The defects you uncover, the automation you build, and the expertise you share help deliver software our customers can depend on when it matters most. If you enjoy tackling complex testing challenges, improving how software is built and tested, and helping others succeed, **keep reading.** **What is Pulsara?** **Pulsara connects people when seconds matter.** Pulsara is a secure, user\-friendly software software solution that unites the entire care team, even across different departments or organizations. By replacing multiple phone calls, radio reports, faxes, and pagers with one unified patient channel, Pulsara streamlines workflows, leading to reduced treatment times, lower costs, and enhanced experiences for both patients and caregivers. **Who we are:** Pulsara is a 100% remote team made up of people with backgrounds in technology, healthcare, emergency services, business, and beyond, united by a common purpose: **to improve the lives of people in need and those who serve them.** Working remotely gives us flexibility, but great remote work takes more than being able to work from home. We communicate intentionally, collaborate across teams, take ownership of our work, and depend on one another to follow through. We are a company that continues to evolve. We value people who are curious, comfortable learning, willing to challenge how things have always been done, and interested in helping us make both our product and the way we work better. **Want to learn more?** Explore our technology at Pulsara.com and discover our team, culture, and benefits on our Careers page. **What You’ll Be Testing** Pulsara isn’t a single web application. Our technology environment includes: Native iOS and Android applications Web\-based patient care, administration, and reporting tools * ️ A highly scalable AWS cloud environment Internal and public APIs ️ Relational databases and complex data workflows Secure, HIPAA\-compliant systems supporting communication across organizations That means testing often requires looking beyond a single screen or expected workflow. A change in one area may affect workflows elsewhere, and understanding those relationships is an important part of becoming effective in this role. **Your Primary Job Focus and Day\-to\-Day Activities Will Include:** * **️ Build and sustain reliable automation** Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and test suites that perform reliably over time. Improve test coverage, execution performance, and maintainability while minimizing flaky tests. **Strengthen testing tools and environments** Create, maintain, and troubleshoot test environments and supporting tools. Integrate automated testing into CI/CD workflows to help identify issues earlier and support dependable releases. **Plan and execute effective testing across the Pulsara platform** Develop practical test strategies, plans, and reusable test cases based on requirements, technical complexity, risk, and customer workflows. Perform manual and automated testing across mobile and web applications, internal and public APIs, database migrations, and tools running in AWS to identify defects, risks, and unexpected behavior. **Lead through technical expertise and mentorship** Share your experience designing and maintaining reliable automation to mentor other Test Engineering team members, strengthen their technical capabilities, and help shape the team's approach to testing and automation. **Think beyond the happy path** Explore edge cases, complex system interactions, and real\-world conditions. Apply technical expertise and sound judgment to determine where automation adds value and where hands\-on testing is essential. **Investigate and communicate problems clearly** Troubleshoot complex defects and test failures, document reproducible findings, collaborate on solutions, and verify fixes. **Keep the customer in focus** Understand how healthcare professionals use Pulsara and recognize where technical issues, unexpected behavior, or workflow friction could affect their ability to coordinate care. **Help us continuously improve** Identify opportunities to improve testing practices, automation, and tools. Apply new technologies, including AI\-assisted tools, where they meaningfully improve quality and efficiency. **What We Are Looking For** ✅ Demonstrated expertise in software testing and qua se for Android, and Playwright for web ✅ Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, CI/CD workflows, Linux environments, and troubleshooting automated tests and test environments ✅ Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, CloudWatch, ECS, ECR, or CloudFormation, and familiarity with supporting tools such as Docker or Fastlane ✅ Experience with test management and issue\-tracking tools such as Jira, Qase, or comparable platforms ✅ Strong technical judgment, debugging, and problem\-solving skills, including identifying root causes and determining when manual or automated testing is most effective ✅ Effective communication and collaboration with Software Engineers, Product Managers, DevOps, and other testing professionals ✅ Hands\-on experience exploring AI\-assisted development and testing tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or ChatGPT, including using LLMs to generate test cases, test data, or support troubleshooting. Familiarity with testing nondeterministic AI outputs is a plus. ✅ Experience testing healthcare technology, mission\-critical software, or applications in regulated environments is a plus, but not required. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is welcome but not required. We place greater value on demonstrated capabilities, the testing challenges you've solved, the automation you've built, and how you've helped others succeed. **What Makes Someone Great at This Job** **You’re curious.** You dig into complex systems, ask thoughtful questions, and investigate until you understand not just what happened, but why. **You think like the customer.** You understand that technically correct software isn't always a good customer experience. You consider how Pulsara works in real\-world situations and advocate for quality that matters to the people using it. **You see both the details and the big picture.** You can uncover subtle defects, recognize patterns across systems, and understand how changes in one area may affect another. **You make others better.** You enjoy sharing what you know, mentoring less\-experienced team members, and helping others strengthen their technical and testing capabilities. **You collaborate and take ownership.** You communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, work through problems with others, and take pride in the quality of what the team delivers. **Travel:** This position requires 0% travel **What We Offer** Competitive Pay: $70K \- $80K (based on experience) All\-Team Profitability Incentive Plan Medical, Dental, Vision, Life/AD\&D, and LTD benefits Employer 401(k) Match Competitive PTO Cell \& Internet Reimbursement 100% Remote – Work From Anywhere in the USA **Cover Letter Instructions:** **Cover Letter Required** Please briefly introduce yourself and tell us why you're interested in joining Pulsara. We'd especially like to hear about your experience with hands\-on testing and automation, an accomplishment that demonstrates your ability to build or sustain reliable testing solutions, and how you've helped others develop their technical skills. We're more interested in what you've accomplished, the challenges you've solved, and the impact you've made than how many years you've held a particular title. **Interested?** Whether your experience comes from professional development, coursework, or personal projects, we'd love to hear from you. **Ready to grow your skills while building software that makes a difference? Show us what you can bring to Pulsara.** **Candidate \& Recruiter Notes** * **Application Review:** Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. * **E\-Verify\+:** Used to verify identity and employment eligibility. * **U.S.\-Based Only:** Applicants must reside in the U.S. * **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer without sponsorship, now or in the future. * **Background Checks:** Conducted after acceptance of a conditional offer. * **Recruiters \& Staffing Firms:** Please do not respond.
