jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - DTC
jobs.description: Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest\-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list. Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60\+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com. Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best\-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®. As a Senior Product Manager for DTC at Pattern, you will own the strategy and roadmap for the software that powers our direct\-to\-consumer fulfillment operation. You will lead a dedicated engineering team through two\-week sprints to build and scale order management, guided pick, pack, and ship workflows, carrier and rate optimization, and DTC inventory replenishment tools. This role sits at the intersection of high\-volume fulfillment operations and rapid technology expansion, driving measurable gains in order accuracy, ship speed, and cost per order across our growing warehouse network. ### **What is a day in the life of a Sr Product Manager \- DTC?** * Connect daily with the offshore engineering team (8:00 to 9:00 AM MT) to facilitate standups, unblock technical decisions, and keep execution aligned with the roadmap. * Run sprint planning, write user stories and acceptance criteria, assign sprint points, and lead retrospectives every two weeks. * Partner with UX designers to design and refine guided tools for warehouse associates across picking, packing, labeling, and replenishment. * Work with Warehouse Operations, Client Services, and Finance to identify DTC pain points, prioritize requirements, and run User Acceptance Testing (UAT). * Analyze order, carrier, and labor data to find opportunities in carrier selection, packaging, same\-day ship cutoffs, and cost per order. * Turn operational problems into business cases with clear success metrics, and present tradeoffs and roadmap decisions to leadership. ### **What will I need to thrive in this role?** * 5\+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years owning a product area in DTC or ecommerce fulfillment, warehousing, WMS/OMS, or supply chain. * Track record of owning a multi\-quarter roadmap end to end, from discovery through launch and adoption, with measurable business outcomes. * Proven experience leading engineering teams through the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and two\-week sprint cycles, including distributed teams across time zones. * Working knowledge of DTC fulfillment: order orchestration, pick/pack/ship, carrier rate shopping, cartonization, inventory slotting and replenishment, and ecommerce platform integrations (e.g., Shopify). * Strong data skills: comfortable writing SQL in Snowflake, building analyses in Excel or Google Sheets, and using AI development assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor). * Ability to influence without authority and align engineering, design, operations, and executive stakeholders around a shared direction. ### **What does high performance look like?** * Ship DTC releases that move core metrics: order accuracy, on\-time ship rate, cost per order, and units per labor hour. * Replace manual processes, spreadsheets, and workarounds with automated, in\-house software that scales with order volume. * Deliver sprint commitments on time while keeping team velocity and quality high. * Set a clear DTC product vision and multi\-quarter roadmap that leadership and operations trust. * Anticipate operational constraints ahead of peak season and have solutions in place before volume hits. * Raise the bar for product practice on the team through strong documentation, prioritization, and mentorship of peers. ### **What is my potential for career growth?** * Own a core product line within a fast\-growing tech business expanding 30 to 40% annually. * Direct exposure to enterprise\-level DTC fulfillment scaling, double\-digit facility network expansion, and warehouse automation. * Path to Principal or Group Product Manager roles with ownership across multiple fulfillment product areas. * Professional network development through close collaboration with  akes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern's processes and outcomes. * **Data Fanatics** \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data. * **Partner Obsessed** \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner's expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern. * **Team of Doers** \- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners. ### **What is the hiring process?** * Phone Interview * Video Interview * Top\-Grading Interview / Panel Interview * On\-Site Visit / Final Interview * Reference Checks * Executive Review * Offer ### **How can I stand out as an applicant?** **Strong Nice\-to\-Haves:** * Experience building or implementing WMS/OMS, carrier rate\-shopping, or cartonization software. * Prior background at high\-volume DTC brands, ecommerce platforms (e.g., Amazon, Shopify, Walmart), or 3PLs. * Experience preparing fulfillment systems and teams for peak season volume. * Background in high\-volume outbound fulfillment at Amazon, Shopify, Walmart or similar scale, particularly within robotics\-enabled facilities (e.g., Amazon Robotics/AR) or automated material\-handling environments. * Hands\-on experience using modern AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate product workflow and problem\-solving. **Interview Standout Tips:** * Walk through a product area you owned: the problem, the metrics, the decisions you made, and the results. * Demonstrate how you turned an ambiguous operational problem into structured software requirements and a shipped solution. * Show a clear track record of leading distributed offshore engineering and design teams across multiple time zones. * Be ready to discuss tradeoffs between speed, cost, and accuracy in a high\-volume fulfillment operation. **Why should I work at Pattern?** Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include: * Unlimited PTO * Paid Holidays * Onsite Fitness Center * Company Paid Life Insurance * Casual Dress Code * Competitive Pay * Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance * 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred. Pattern provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. **Our Benefits:** At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. **Belonging at PayPal:** Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **DevOps Engineer** **Location:** Burlingame, CA **Department:** ESS Engineering **Reports to:** Senior Manager, Software Engineering **Position Type:** Full\-time **About the Company** Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven sodium\-ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid. Sodium\-ion is cheap, readily available, and safe — making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market. Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt\-level innovation at world\-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, SunPower, and Fluence. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners including TDK Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and GM Ventures. We recently announced America's first sodium\-ion grid storage factory in Sacramento with production starting Q1 2027, and over $1B in signed customer commitments including Jupiter Power and Energy Vault. **About the Role** Peak Energy is looking for a DevOps Engineer to build and scale the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and automation systems supporting our grid\-scale battery storage technology. As Peak grows from pilot deployments to gigawatt\-scale production, our software infrastructure must scale alongside our products. You'll help establish the foundation that enables our engineering teams to develop, test, and deploy software efficiently and reliably. This is a hands\-on infrastructure engineering role focused on cloud services, Infrastructure as Code, database provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation. You'll build and maintain the systems that connect our development environments, manufacturing operations, and deployed battery systems to the cloud. You'll work closely with software, test, and manufacturing engineering teams to improve automation, reliability, and scalability across our software infrastructure. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure supporting Peak's battery storage software, data pipelines, and engineering applications. * Develop and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for software builds, testing, and deployment across development and production environments. * Define, provision, and manage cloud resources using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, establishing scalable and repeatable infrastructure practices as Peak expands its manufacturing operations and deployed battery fleet. * Partner with software and test engineering teams to integrate automated testing and validation into development and deployment workflows. * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to improve infrastructure reliability, performance, and observability. **What You'll Bring (Minimum Qualifications)** * 4\+ years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical role. * Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform or equivalent tooling. * Experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar tools. * Experience provisioning, configuring, and managing cloud infrastructure on Azure, AWS, or GCP. * Experience deploying and managing cloud databases, including PostgreSQL or similar relational database systems. * Proficiency in Python, Bash, or other scripting languages for infrastructure automation. * Experience with cloud networking, access management, monitoring, and infrastructure security. * Experience supporting software deployments and troubleshooting production infrastructure. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized application deployments. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure Functions, Service Bus, Azure Monitor, or Azure Database for PostgreSQL. * Experience with IoT device infrastructure and management. * Experience supporting automated testing infrastructure, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, or engineering validation environments. * Familiarity with data ingestion pipelines, streaming infrastructure, or cloud\-connected devices. * Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Datadog, or Application Insights. * Experience supporting manufacturing systems, industrial automation, IoT, or hardware\-integrated software. * Familiarity with database administration, backup and recovery, and infrastructure performance optimization. * Prior experience building infrastructure and deployment processes in an early\-stage or rapidly scaling engineering organization. **Our Core Values** * **Speed Through Focus** — Move fast but understand why. Focus on the goal, don't sacrifice quality. * **Mission Over Self** — Put the company's mission and team success ahead of individual interests. * **Face the Brutal Truth** — Transparency, honesty, big\-picture curiosity. Fearless decision making. * **Be a Good Person** — Kindness, collaboration, and teamwork. **Compensation \& Benefits** The salary range for this role is **$180,000 \- $240,000**, with actual pay varying based on work location, experience, and skills. Our competitive benefits package includes: * Flexible time off * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Strong 401(k) plan * Equity opportunities * Many great work perks Join us to thrive in a supportive environment while making a meaningful impact in the energy sector! jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description: #### **ABOUT THE ROLE** We at Peloton are looking for a scrappy, creative and fast\-moving AI Engineer. You'll take raw ideas and rapidly transform them into production\-grade applications that empower our global organization. You will architect the Intelligence \& Integration Layers that connect autonomous agents directly into Peloton's enterprise infrastructure. We don't care about your specific stack or what programming language you grew up with. We care about systems thinking, engineering fundamentals, product sense, and your ability to ship fast. Work at the bleeding edge of the AI ecosystem with top\-tier tools and compute resources. What you build goes directly into the hands of real users in days, not months. #### **YOUR DAILY IMPACT AT PELOTON** * Take ambiguous problems and turn them into functional, high\-performing AI features and standalone tools * Solve the "State Problem" for AI by building memory architectures and vector stores (Pinecone, Pgvector) that maintain context while strictly adhering to data retention and deletion policies * Build pipelines and entity\-resolution logic that connect data across CRM, ERP, CPQ, and marketing systems (e.g. Salesforce, SAP, BigQuery) into a single, reliable source of truth agents can act on * Embed with Peloton business units to understand their workflows, identify high\-value opportunities, and select the right initial use cases to prove value * Embed closely with stakeholder teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build * Share field feedback that helps other teams understand where the models succeed and where they can improve * Deploy continuous evaluation pipelines to test models for hallucinations, prompt injections, data leakage, and performance regressions before code hits production * Implement Semantic Caching and smart routing logic (directing routine queries to smaller, cheaper models) to maintain low latency and efficient inference costs #### **YOU BRING TO PELOTON** * 5–7\+ Years of General Software Engineering. Strong foundational software engineering skills (distributed systems, async patterns, API design, microservices, and databases) * Comfortable pivoting to whatever language or framework gets the job done fastest * Hands\-on experience deploying RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) and Agentic Workflows into production using LLM APIs, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks * Proven track record building and maintaining pipelines across fragmented enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, CPQ, marketing platforms) with attention to entity resolution, schema design, and data quality — not just consuming clean data once it exists * Cutting\-Edge Stack: Work at the bleeding edge of the AI ecosystem with top\-tier tools and compute resources. * Direct Impact: What you build goes directly into the hands of real users in days, not months. \#LI\-DD1 \#LI\-HYBRID **ABOUT PELOTON:** Peloton (NASDAQ: PTON) provides Members with expert instruction, and world class content to create impactful and entertaining workout experiences for anyone, anywhere and at any stage in their fitness journey. At home, outdoors, traveling, or at the gym, Peloton brings together innovative hardware, distinctive software, and exclusive content. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, Peloton has millions of Members across the US, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia, and Austria. For more information, visit www.onepeloton.com. Peloton is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. Equal employment opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at Peloton, where all team members, applicants, and other covered persons are considered on the basis of their personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic predisposition or carrier status, unemployment status, familial status, domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking victim status, caregiver status, or any other protected characteristic as established by applicable law. This policy of equal employment opportunity applies to all practices and procedures relating to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment. If you would like to request any accommodations from application through to interview, please email: applicantaccommodations@onepeloton.com. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: **The Team \+ The Role** ------------------------ The Core team builds features and platform capabilities that power critical areas of the Pendo product experience. Our work supports high\-stakes customer use cases, drives how our systems evolve, and creates a consistent experience across the platform. We operate in complex product areas where delivery speed, system reliability, and long\-term maintainability are equally important. As a Sr. Software Engineer, you own complex technical challenges and drive solutions independently. You apply sound engineering judgment, partner with product and design, and take accountability for outcomes, not just output. You break ambiguous work into small, continuously shippable increments, bring others along, and improve the codebase as you deliver. This role is based in our Raleigh office. **What this looks like day\-to\-day** ------------------------------------- * **End\-to\-end feature ownership:** Own complex, ambiguous features from problem definition through delivery. Break work into small, independently shippable increments to maintain consistent progress and deliver customer value. * **Production\-quality engineering:** Write reliable, maintainable production code and select testing approaches based on risk and system impact. Apply safe rollout patterns, including feature flags and incremental deployments, to reduce delivery risk. * **Production reliability:** Respond quickly to production issues within your area of ownership and drive them to resolution. Identify root causes and implement improvements that prevent recurring problems. * **AI\-enabled development:** Integrate AI tools into daily engineering workflows for code generation, debugging, test writing, and task decomposition. Share effective practices that improve how the team uses AI to build and deliver software. * **Technical collaboration:** Provide actionable code reviews and contribute constructively to engineering discussions and planning. Partner with product, design, and fellow engineers to align technical decisions with product outcomes. * **Continuous improvement:** Identify recurring friction in code, tests, tooling, and development processes. Proactively implement improvements that strengthen engineering quality and team efficiency. * **Clear technical communication:** Create documentation, commit messages, and technical notes that make decisions and implementation details easy to understand. Maintain enough written context for teammates to continue work without requiring verbal handoffs. **Who You Are** --------------- Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work. You're a builder, not a maintainer. You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Sr. Software Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work. You're AI\-curious \- genuinely. You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut. **Must\-haves** --------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering experience delivering customer\-facing SaaS product features in production environments. * Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language: Go, Java, Python, or C\+\+. * Deep understanding of scalable web architecture, API design, and performance optimization. * Experience with AWS or GCP cloud platforms and both SQL and NoSQL databases. * Demonstrated ability to independently structure ambiguous technical work into small, deliverable increments and drive execution through completion. * Experience designing and implementing unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests, with sound judgment about when to apply each approach. * Familiarity with safe deployment and rollout practices, including feature flags, canary releases, or comparable approaches. * Active use of AI tools in software development workflows. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and design teams. * Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice\-to\-haves** ------------------- * Experience improving team\-level engineering tooling, development processes, or developer workflows beyond individual feature delivery. * Experience mentoring engineers and strengthening team capabilities through technical documentation, constructive code reviews, or knowledge sharing. * Experience contributing to shared platform capabilities that support multiple product areas. **About Pendo** --------------- Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest\-growing startups, supported by best\-in\-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech. **Pendo Core Values:** Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus. **Location:** Pendo is a hybrid culture. In\-office 3 days per week unless designated remote. **Compensation:** The expected salary range for this role to be performed in Raleigh, NC is $135,000 \- $150,000\. **Benefits:** Highly competitive, employer\-heavy coverage (including $0 premium options), strong 401(k) match, equity, and flexible time off. **EEOC:** We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. **Accessibility:** Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: accommodation@pendo.io. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Position Summary Penn Foster Group is seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to help shape the future of our enterprise data platform and AI strategy. This is a highly visible technical Leadership role responsible for architecting, building, and evolving our modern cloud data platform while establishing engineering standards, mentoring a growing team, and driving innovation across the organization. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will serve as a Senior Technical expert for our Databricks Lakehouse platform, providing hands\-on Leadership across data ingestion, transformation, governance, analytics enablement, and AI\-ready data products. You will partner closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Platform Engineering, Security, Data Governance, and MLOps teams to build trusted, scalable, and governed data solutions that power enterprise analytics, machine learning, and generative AI. This role combines deep technical expertise with Leadership, mentoring, and strategic influence. You'll help establish the long\-term technical direction of Penn Foster Group's data ecosystem while coaching and developing engineers, driving engineering excellence, and implementing modern data engineering best practices. Why Join Penn Foster Group? Penn Foster Group is in the midst of an exciting enterprise\-wide data platform modernization journey. We are investing in a modern cloud\-native architecture built on Databricks, Azure, and AI\-enabled technologies that will become the foundation for analytics, operational reporting, machine learning, and generative AI across the company. This is a unique opportunity to join at a transformational point in our technology journey. Rather than simply maintaining existing systems, you'll help define the future of our data platform—shaping architecture, engineering standards, governance, and the adoption of emerging AI technologies that will influence how data is used across the organization for years to come. You will also be a key player in our drive for Self Service Analytics at PFG. **As our Senior Data Engineer, you will have the opportunity to:** * Help define the long\-term strategy for Penn Foster Group's modern Data \& AI platform. * Influence enterprise architecture decisions around Databricks, Azure, Unity Catalog, semantic data products, and AI\-powered analytics. * Build modern, scalable data products that enable self\-service analytics and generative AI. * Lead adoption of emerging Databricks capabilities, including Genie, AI/BI, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and other evolving platform innovations. * Mentor and develop a growing Data Engineering team while establishing engineering standards that scale across the organization. * Partner directly with technology and business Leaders to solve meaningful business problems using modern cloud and AI technologies. If you're passionate about building modern data platforms, mentoring engineers, and helping shape the future of AI\-enabled analytics, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership * Provide technical Leadership for the Data Engineering team through architecture guidance, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering best practices. * Mentor and develop junior and mid\-level Data Engineers, fostering technical growth, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. * Establish engineering standards for software development, testing, CI/CD, documentation, observability, and operational excellence. * Senior technical design discussions, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and drive adoption of modern engineering practices. * Champion a culture of quality, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Data Platform \& Databricks Leadership * Serve as the technical Senior Engineer for Penn Foster Group's Databricks Lakehouse platform. * Design, build, and support scalable enterprise data pipelines using SQL, Python, Apache Spark, and Databricks. * Define best practices for Databricks development, including Workflows, Repos, Jobs, notebooks, reusable Python libraries, Git integration, cluster policies, SQL Warehouses, and deployment automation. * Design and optimize Delta Lake architectures using Medallion patterns, Delta optimization, Liquid Clustering, and Photon. * Build reusable ingestion frameworks supporting batch, streaming, CDC, and API\-based integration patterns. * Optimize Spark workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud cost efficiency. AI \& Databricks Genie Enablement * Partner with Analytics and business stakeholders to develop trusted semantic data products that power Databricks Genie. * Design and maintain Genie Spaces and Genie Ontologies that accurately represent business entities, relationships, metrics, and terminology. * Establish best practices for semantic modeling, governed metrics, business metadata, and AI\-ready datasets. * Evaluate and implement emerging Databricks AI capabilities to improve self\-service analytics and business produc optimization techniques, including Adaptive Query Execution, partitioning, caching, Photon, Liquid Clustering, and Delta optimization. * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based development workflows, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing. * Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, data quality, observability, security, and compliance. Preferred * Experience implementing Databricks Genie, Genie Spaces, and Genie Ontologies. * Experience designing semantic models and AI\-ready data products. * Experience supporting Power BI, Tableau, or other enterprise BI platforms. * Experience with machine learning platforms, MLOps, or Generative AI applications. * Experience with dbt, Great Expectations, or similar modern data engineering tools. * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional and/or Microsoft Azure certifications. Working Conditions \& Hiring Process * U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside and perform work within the United States. jobs.title: Software Development Process – Engineer
jobs.description: **Title**: Software Development Process – Engineer **Location**: **Wabtec** (formerly GE Transportation), Erie, PA **Job Description**: Our company is seeking a high\-caliber Software Development Process Engineer to assist driving software process engineering and quality governance support across our global Controls Software teams. In this role, you will work to standardize, deploy, and continuously improve engineering frameworks across the organization to ensure world\-class product quality. Your mission is to act as a catalyst for organizational change by institutionalizing development best practices, leveraging deep root\-cause analysis, and managing data\-driven quality systems at scale. You will support defined software quality assurance parameters that are executed, with success measured by the visible first\-time yield analysis of the released products. **Key Responsibilities** * **Process Governance \& QMS:** Oversee the tailored documentation and maintenance of the Documents Inventory List within a large, matrixed Quality Management System (QMS). * **Metrics \& Analytics:** Define, deploy, and track software metrics, converting complex performance data into actionable Software Quality Governance Reports. * **Continuous Improvement:** Support cross\-functional optimization projects of varying size and complexity, keeping a systematic track of progress in the continuous process improvement project report. * **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** work on risk assessments and process gap analyses utilizing professional quality control tools (e.g., 5\-Why, Fishbone diagrams). * **Training \& Coaching:** Instruct diverse software teams to ensure comprehensive process adherence, while standardizing official training records. * **Operational Leadership:** Assist cultural and technical alignment across multiple development methodologies (including Waterfall, Iterative, and Agile) to balance delivery priorities and protect project timelines. **Required Qualifications** * **Education:** Educational background in Engineering, Software Development, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. * **Experience Baseline:** 2–3 years of overall experience working within Software Development or Software Quality Assurance environments. * **Governance Specialization:** At least 1\+ year of dedicated experience focused strictly on Software Quality Assurance, software process auditing, or quality governance. * **Methodology Expertise:** Hands\-on experience navigating and implementing diverse development frameworks (Waterfall, Iterative, Agile/Scrum, etc.). * **Organizational Change:** A proven track record of deploying industry\-leading development techniques and driving process adoption across varying team cultures and complex environments. * **Quality \& Planning Tools:** Practical experience using traditional QC problem\-solving toolsets along with strong day\-to\-day proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Visio for mapping and data organization. * **Leadership \& Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills combined with a natural aptitude for leading, educating, and coaching technical teams. * **Execution Mindset:** Strong ability to balance multiple high\-velocity priorities with a clear passion for delivering zero\-defect products on schedule. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Matrix Environment:** Experience managing engineering process workflows in large\-scale, matrixed enterprise settings. * **In\-House Tooling:** Desirable background or familiarity with building in\-house automation, monitoring tools, or automated metrics dashboards using PowerApps, Power BI, or Python. **Core Deliverables Expected in Role** * **Documents Inventory Lists:** Complete, compliant, and up\-to\-date process standard inventories. * **Quality Governance Reports:** Regular, data\-driven insights mapping software parameters to performance. * **Process Gap Analysis Reports:** Formally documented process deployment gaps matched with systemic root\-cause corrections. * **Training Log Records:** Verifiable proof of execution and adherence regarding organizational software process updates. * **Process Improvement Project Reports:** Active, audited logs showcasing ongoing engineering efficiency and yield enhancements. **Benefits**: Phoenix Technical Solutions offers an attractive compensation and benefits package; including health, dental, vision, STD, LTD, Life, IRA with generous company match, paid holidays, vacation and more. Our global commitment to technological advancement offers opportunities for personal growth and development in a stable, supportive work environment.

technology. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED**: Reports to the IT Operations Manager **SUPERVISION EXERCISED**: None **RESPONSIBILITIES**: * General/Operations Desk * Documents all incidents and notes within incidents reported. * Guide by example in an upbeat manner to all team members. * Build up the team and support each member while developing an environment of unity. * Ensure that Help Desk service Will rotate between IT North – Statesville and IT South – Mooresville offices on a rotating basis. jobs.title: Senior Robotics & Autonomous Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Nov 04 2026 **Job Description: Senior Robotics \& Autonomous Systems Engineer** Recommended Job Title Alternative title: Robotics, AI \& Cloud Integration Engineer Department: Robot Operations \& Engineering Reports to: Senior Manager, Robot Operations Employment Type: Full\-Time Work Location: Robotics Development \& Operations Level: Mid\-Senior / Senior Technical Specialist **1\. Position Overview** The Senior Robotics \& Autonomous Systems Engineer will be responsible for developing, programming, integrating, testing, and maintaining intelligent robotic systems using AI\-assisted engineering tools. The ideal candidate must have practical experience working with robotic hardware, including Electronic Speed Controllers (ESCs), microcontrollers, ultrasonic distance sensors, LiDAR scanners, and multi\-axis camera gimbals. The candidate will leverage AI\-powered development tools to accelerate embedded programming, robotic navigation, obstacle detection, autonomous movement, and system integration. In addition to robotics engineering, the candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining web\-based content and applications, implementing CI/CD pipelines using Git or Bitbucket, and integrating robotic systems with cloud infrastructure using AWS IoT Greengrass Core, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR). This position requires someone who can work across the entire robotics technology stack, from physical hardware and embedded software to cloud infrastructure and web\-based management platforms. **2\. Key Responsibilities** **A. Robotics Hardware Programming \& Integration** * Program, configure, and maintain Electronic Speed Controllers (ESCs) for robotic motor control. * Develop firmware and control logic for microcontrollers used in robotic systems. * Integrate ESCs, motors, microcontrollers, and other electronic components into functional robotic platforms. * Configure and integrate ultrasonic distance\-measuring transducers for proximity detection and obstacle avoidance. * Integrate and program Digital Servo 2DOF Multi\-Angle Steering Gimbal systems for camera positioning and directional control. * Integrate LiDAR sensors with approximately 12\-meter scanning range for environmental mapping, obstacle detection, and autonomous navigation. * Develop sensor\-fusion capabilities combining ultrasonic sensors, LiDAR, cameras, and other sensor inputs. * Troubleshoot hardware communication, power management, motor synchronization, and sensor integration issues. * Use AI\-assisted programming tools to develop, debug, optimize, and document embedded software. **B. Autonomous Navigation \& Obstacle Avoidance** * Develop robotic navigation algorithms that enable robots to move autonomously within designated operational environments. * Implement LiDAR\-based obstacle detection and avoidance mechanisms. * Develop distance\-measuring and collision\-prevention logic using ultrasonic sensors. * Implement motor speed control, steering, directional movement, and navigation routines. * Develop algorithms for real\-time environmental awareness and object detection. * Integrate camera systems with robotic platforms to support visual inspection and object recognition. * Test and optimize autonomous navigation under different terrain and environmental conditions. * Develop fail\-safe mechanisms for emergency stops, obstacle detection, and abnormal operating conditions. **C. AI\-Assisted Software Development** * Use AI development tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding assistants to accelerate software development. * Generate, modify, debug, and optimize Python, C/C\+\+, embedded firmware, and other programming languages used in robotics. * Use AI tools to develop robotic control algorithms and sensor integration scripts. * Apply AI\-assisted workflows to troubleshoot hardware and software integration challenges. * Develop reusable software modules and libraries for robotic operations. * Maintain technical documentation, system configurations, and software development records. **D. Web Development \& Content Management** * Use AI tools to build, deploy, update, and maintain web content and web\-based applications. * Develop and modify website interfaces, dashboards, and operational management pages. * Integrate web\-based applications with robotic systems and cloud services through APIs. * Maintain website functionality, responsiveness, and user experience. * Deploy web updates and manage application content through Git\-based version control. * Use AI tools to accelerate frontend development, content creation, troubleshooting, and application modifications. * Support the development of web dashboards for monitoring robotic operations, sensor readings, and system performance. **E. CI/CD \& Software Deployment** * Establish and maintain Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using Git and Bitbucket. * Manage source code repositories, branches, pull ills would distinguish an exceptional candidate: * ROS 2 (Robot Operating System). * SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping). * OpenCV and computer vision. * GPS and IMU integration. * Raspberry Pi 4/5 and NVIDIA Jetson platforms. * CAN bus communication and motor synchronization. * Docker and Linux system administration. * AWS IoT Core and AWS IoT Device Management. * Python\-based robotics automation. * Machine learning and AI\-based object recognition. * Remote fleet management and robotic telemetry. **7\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** The candidate will be evaluated against measurable technical and operational outcomes. **Performance Area** **KPI / Expected Outcome** ESC \& Motor Integration Reliable motor control and synchronization Sensor Integration Successful integration of LiDAR and ultrasonic sensors Obstacle Avoidance Reliable detection and avoidance of obstacles within the designed operating range Autonomous Navigation Successful execution of predefined navigation tasks AI Development Effective use of AI tools to reduce development and debugging time Web Development Timely development and deployment of requested web updates CI/CD Reliable automated build and deployment processes AWS Integration Successful deployment and monitoring of Greengrass components System Reliability Reduced hardware and software failures Documentation Complete technical documentation and deployment procedures **8\. Expected Deliverables Within the First 90 Days** **First 30 Days – Assessment \& Integration** * Assess existing robotic hardware and software architecture. * Review ESC, microcontroller, LiDAR, ultrasonic sensor, and gimbal configurations. * Evaluate existing Git/Bitbucket repositories and AWS infrastructure. * Produce a technical integration and development plan. **Days 31–60 – Development \& Deployment** * Implement or improve ESC and microcontroller programming. * Integrate LiDAR and ultrasonic obstacle detection. * Develop camera gimbal control functionality. * Establish or improve CI/CD pipelines. * Deploy an initial AWS Greengrass component. **Days 61–90 – Testing \& Operational Readiness** * Demonstrate autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance. * Demonstrate remote software deployment through AWS Greengrass. * Deploy a functional web\-based robot monitoring interface or update an existing one. * Deliver technical documentation and operational procedures. * Present a robotics system performance and improvement report. **9\. Candidate Assessment – Practical Technical Test** I recommend including a practical assessment during recruitment rather than relying exclusively on interviews. **Assessment** **What the candidate must demonstrate** Test 1: ESC Program an ESC to control motor speed and direction Test 2: Microcontroller Develop firmware to communicate with sensors Test 3: Ultrasonic Measure distance and trigger obstacle alerts Test 4: LiDAR Detect an obstacle and initiate an avoidance response Test 5: Camera Gimbal Control a 2DOF servo camera positioning system Test 6: AI Programming Use an AI coding assistant to develop and debug a robotics function Test 7: Web Development Use AI tools to modify and deploy a web page Test 8: CI/CD Push code to Bitbucket and demonstrate an automated deployment pipeline Test 9: AWS Deploy a containerized application or Greengrass component using AWS services **10\. Recommended Candidate Profile** The ideal candidate is not simply a software developer or an electronics technician. The organization needs a multidisciplinary engineer who can independently work across: **The Robotics Technology Stack** Level 1: Physical Robotics ESCs • Motors • Microcontrollers • Sensors • Gimbals Level 2: Robotics Intelligence AI Programming • LiDAR • Navigation • Obstacle Avoidance • Computer Vision Level 3: Software Engineering Golang • Python • C/C\+\+ • Web Development • Git • Bitbucket • CI/CD Level 4: Cloud \& Edge Computing AWS Greengrass Core • Lambda • ECR • Docker • Remote Deployment

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Homefeed
jobs.description: **About Pinterest:** Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here. Our Retrieval team builds shared machine learning capabilities that help Pinterest connect people with relevant ideas. We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to advance how we develop those capabilities through agentic AI. Your primary focus will be Reflex, our effort to automate and accelerate recommendation research and development. You will own a major technical area, building agents that investigate opportunities, implement changes, run experiments and learn from their results. You will work closely with other technical leaders while remaining hands\-on with the hardest engineering and modeling problems. You will also contribute to generative retrieval, with a particular focus on Semantic IDs: learning structured representations of content that recommendation models can generate and use to retrieve relevant items. This role combines applied AI research, production engineering and technical leadership, with opportunities to improve both our recommendation models and the way engineers build them. What you'll do: * Own and advance a major technical area in automated recommendation research within Reflex, collaborating with other technical leads and partner teams. * Build LLM agents that connect hypothesis generation, implementation, experiment execution, evaluation and learning from previous results. * Develop rigorous evaluations for agent behavior and research outputs, and use them to improve quality, reliability and efficiency. * Contribute to generative retrieval models, particularly Semantic ID learning, evaluation and integration into production recommendation systems. * Take promising ideas from research and prototypes through offline evaluation, online experimentation and production launches. * Build reliable integrations with ML development infrastructure and make informed tradeoffs across model quality, iteration speed, compute cost and operational complexity. * Raise technical quality through hands\-on implementation, design and code reviews, documentation and mentorship. * Work with research, recommendation and ML infrastructure teams to shape technical approaches, resolve dependencies and support adoption. * Identify and apply relevant advances from research, and contribute new methods where existing approaches fall short. What we're looking for: * Bachelor's in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum 8 years of experience building and shipping ML or AI systems, including substantial hands\-on engineering and technical leadership. * Demonstrated experience building LLM agents or other agentic AI systems for complex tasks, with a clear approach to evaluating and improving their performance. * Strong ML fundamentals and depth in one or more relevant areas, such as applied LLMs, representation learning, recommendation systems, retrieval or ML systems. * Experience taking research ideas into reliable production systems and evaluating their impact through meaningful experiments. * Strong software engineering skills, including the ability to design maintainable systems, implement difficult components and conduct thorough technical reviews. * Experience leading a substantial technical area, making decisions under ambiguity and collaborating effectively across teams. * A track record of mentoring engineers and raising the quality of a team's technical work. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to different audiences. * A disciplined approach to using AI in your own work, including verification of generated code, analysis and conclusions. We'll teach you our stack and our products, and we're committed to your continued growth as a technical leader. This is an individual contributor role; prior people management isn't required. **Relocation Statement:** * This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. **In\-Office Requirement Statement:** * We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection. * This role will need to be in the office for in\-person collaboration 1\-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-DM57 **Our Commitment to Inclusion:** Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support. *By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ProSomnus Sleep Technologies is seeking a versatile Software Engineer to develop and maintain software for connected medical devices and supporting applications. This hands\-on role spans mobile applications, embedded sensor technology, and cloud\-based services. The engineer will contribute to product features, software enhancements, and reliability improvements while helping advance automated testing, build infrastructure, and release processes. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, working across technologies, and improving how software is developed, tested, and delivered within a small, collaborative engineering team. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Software \& Product Development** * Design, develop, test, and maintain software features for connected medical devices and associated applications. * Contribute to iOS and Android mobile applications, including BLE connectivity, data synchronization, and user\-facing functionality. * Support embedded sensor firmware, device integration, backend services, and web applications as project needs require. * Investigate and resolve software defects, performance issues, and field\-reported problems. * Improve existing software through refactoring, dependency updates, and reliability enhancements. * Participate in the development of new product capabilities and future device technologies. **Test Automation \& Software Quality** * Develop automated testing tools and frameworks for mobile applications, embedded devices, APIs, and backend services. * Contribute to sensor and firmware test automation, including BLE protocol verification, data acquisition, and regression testing. * Develop and maintain unit, integration, and automated regression tests using tools such as Flutter Test, pytest, Appium, or similar frameworks. * Collaborate with engineers to improve test coverage, testing practices, and software quality. * Support software verification and validation activities in accordance with established medical device development procedures. **Build Infrastructure \& Release Engineering** * Develop and improve automated build, continuous integration, and release workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions, or similar platforms. * Help establish centralized, reproducible build environments, scheduled builds, and automated verification processes. * Improve software packaging, dependency management, and release reliability. * Develop engineering tools and scripts to reduce manual processes, including device testing and manufacturing automation. **Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement** * Collaborate with software, firmware, hardware, quality, and regulatory teams throughout the product development lifecycle. * Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and release activities. * Identify opportunities to improve software architecture, engineering tools, and development practices. * Prepare and maintain technical documentation, software specifications, and test records as required. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of professional software development experience preferred. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Dart, Python, C/C\+\+, Go, JavaScript, or TypeScript. * Experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications or embedded systems. * Familiarity with software development practices, including version control, code reviews, and automated testing. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across technical disciplines. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android application development. * Experience with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), embedded systems, or firmware development. * Experience developing automated test frameworks or device test tools using Python, pytest, Flutter Test, Appium, or similar technologies. * Experience with CI/CD, automated mobile builds, and release infrastructure using GitHub Actions, Codemagic, Jenkins, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with backend and cloud technologies such as Go, Vue.js, REST APIs, SQL databases, or AWS. * Experience with manufacturing automation or software development for medical devices and other regulated products.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ **At Provectus**, you don’t prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude \+ AWS system into their real, regulated production — then you watch the business number move. We’re an Anthropic and AWS Partner with 150\+ certified architects. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter — without the layers, politics, and years\-to\-impact of a hundred\-thousand\-person firm. 350\+ builders, 100\+ customers in production, founder\-led since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA. **Why Provectus** ----------------- * **Frontier access — Anthropic Preferred Partner:** newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems. * **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. * **Embedded, not engaged.** You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff\-augmented. * **Autonomous.** You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. * **Your experience stays portable.** Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy\-maintenance grind, not a single stack. * **Craft \& growth** — build beside senior FDEs on a Claude\-certified team; a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name. * **We give you a stage:** Claude certification, conference talks, open\-source contributions, published work under your own name. ### **What you’ll do:** * Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive — and you are the one who builds it. * Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously. * You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. * Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare. * Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice. ### **What we look for:** * Typically 7\+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands\-on today and intend to stay that way. * Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly. * Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works. * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non\-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why. * Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. * Cloud\-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits. * Pre\-sales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room. * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job. * Hands\-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses). ### **Nice to have:** * Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production. * IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform. * Open\-source contributions or public writing on applied AI. ### **What we offer:** * Full\-time. * On\-site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC 1/week * Unlimited Vacation policy. * Generous health, vision, and dental insurance. * 401(K) matching plan. * Base salary $180k–$200k \+ bonuses; OTE up to $250k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data. * No Visa sponsorship ### **We’re real** * **A person reads your application.** We filter out AI\-generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team. * **We may ask for a quick ID verification.** Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates. * **You’ll meet the people you’d work with.** We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We'd be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Co\-Founder \& CEO. ### **How we hire:** * Recruitment interview. * Tech interview with our FDE (30 min). * A live engineering building session (1\.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. ***Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI\-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows.*** * Soft skills interview. * Offer discussion. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
