jobs.title: AI Agent Engineer, AI Transformation
jobs.description: **About Psomagen** **Psomagen, Inc.** is a U.S. genomics services company headquartered in Maryland, operating CLIA/CAP\-certified laboratories. We provide sequencing, single\-cell, spatial, proteomics and bioinformatics services to academic, foundation, pharma and clinical customers. We are building AI into how the company operates, so that our teams spend less time on routine work and more time on science and customers. **About the role** We are looking for a hands\-on developer with real AI agent experience to lead Psomagen's company\-wide AI transformation. You will design, build and operate AI agents on top of the tools our teams use every day: Google Workspace, HubSpot, our in\-house LIMS and SAP. You will work directly with the CEO and with every function, identify where agents can remove manual work, ship them quickly, and keep them reliable in production. This is a builder role, not an advisory one. **What you'll do** * Design, develop and operate AI agents using Hermes and comparable agent frameworks, and keep the underlying models swappable as better ones appear * Connect agents to our business systems (Google Workspace, HubSpot, LIMS, SAP) and choose the right way to integrate each one, so that agents can read, draft and act within defined permissions * Work with sales, project management, lab operations, finance, regulatory/quality and IT to find high\-value workflows (for example quoting, customer communication, document management, reporting and internal Q\&A) and turn them into working agents * Build the supporting infrastructure: knowledge retrieval over company documents, evaluation and testing of agent outputs, logging, monitoring and cost control * Put guardrails in place: role\-based access, audit trails and human approval steps for actions that touch customers, finance or regulated records * Collaborate with our LIMS development and bioinformatics teams so that agents fit our existing systems and pipelines * Train employees to use agents effectively, gather feedback and keep improving what is deployed * Track new AI models, tools and practices, and bring in the ones that make a practical difference to the business **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, software engineering or a related field * 4\+ years of professional software development experience, with strong Python skills * Demonstrated experience building and operating LLM\-based agents in production or in substantial real\-world use (tool calling, multi\-step workflows, retrieval, prompt and context design, evaluation) * Current knowledge of frontier AI models and agent tooling, with the ability to explain trade\-offs among models, frameworks and cost * Experience connecting software or agents to business systems (for example Google Workspace, HubSpot, an ERP such as SAP, or similar), including authentication and permission design * Strong communication skills, and comfort working with non\-technical colleagues to understand their workflows * Awareness of data security and privacy requirements when AI handles customer, financial or health\-related data * Legally authorized to work in the U.S. **Preferred** * Experience with Hermes or similar open agent frameworks, and with Google Cloud * Hands\-on experience with Google Workspace administration and APIs, Apps Script, and HubSpot * Experience with LIMS, SAP or other laboratory and enterprise operations systems * Domain knowledge of sequencing services or genomics, especially bioinformatics (pipelines, workflow tools such as Airflow, QC and reporting) * Experience in a regulated environment (CLIA/CAP, ISO 9001 or ISO 27001\) * Experience with SQL and data pipelines **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base salary range: $70,000 to $140,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus a performance\-based bonus * Benefits: \[medical/dental/vision, 401(k), PTO, etc.] Psomagen is an equal opportunity employer. **The pay range for this role is:** 70,000 \- 140,000 USD per year(Psomagen HQ)

jobs.title: Software Engineer - WMS Integration and Reporting (Hybrid)
jobs.description: Publix Super Markets, Inc., the largest employee\-owned company in the U.S., is driven by a dynamic technology team of 2,300\+ professionals delivering innovative solutions to 1,400\+ stores and 260,000\+ associates across 8 states. From IT security and platform engineering to architecture, software development, and infrastructure, we offer career opportunities at every level \- internships through technical leadership. Join a company consistently ranked among Fortune’s “100 Best **The Warehousing Modernization team is currently seeking a Software Engineer for modernizing Publix legacy warehousing systems. This key role involves participating in initiatives to modernize warehousing processes like receiving, integrating with other Warehousing Systems, and Reporting that currently supports our expanding distribution network, encompassing 9 Distribution Centers and 33 warehouses dedicated to servicing over 1200 retail stores.** **Location: Hybrid (Lakeland, FL):** To support our hybrid work model, candidates must reside, or be willing to relocate, within a commutable distance of Lakeland, FL. **Work Model:** Enjoy the best of both worlds \- collaborate in person and innovate remotely. **Interview Process:** Candidates selected to advance in the interview process will be required to participate in at least one onsite interview at our Lakeland, FL campus. **Why Join Us?*** **Hybrid Flexibility:** Work remotely when you need focus time and join us onsite for high\-impact collaboration and brainstorming sessions. * **Operational Efficiency:** Ensure technology solutions support efficient workflows and enable automation to improve operational effectiveness. * **Cutting\-Edge AI Projects:** Drive innovation in AI platforms, integrating advanced tools and frameworks to solve complex business challenges. * **Empowered Culture:** We value autonomy, creativity, and continuous learning—your ideas shape the future of technology in our organization. **Your impact:*** Design and develop enterprise\-grade technology solutions using modern methodologies (Agile and traditional) ensuring performance, scalability, stability, usability, and cross\-system integration while leveraging CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub, etc.). * Analyze business and system requirements, user stories, and technical design artifacts to develop internal designs, program specifications, and product backlog items under guidance. * Collaborate with Architecture and Technical Leads to ensure alignment with enterprise standards, best practices, and solution designs. * Partner with Business Systems Analysts and Product Owners to validate business requirements and support solution delivery. * Develop, maintain, and automate unit test plans, test scripts, and test cases to ensure application quality and reliability. * Utilize development tools, including AI, and environments to efficiently code, unit test, debug, and manage application components throughout the development lifecycle. * Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including solution designs, program specifications, and testing results. * Plan, coordinate, and support the deployment of technical solutions from testing environments to production under established guidance. * Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve moderately complex application and production issues, escalating when appropriate. * Participate in on\-call rotation to support production systems and ensure operational continuity. \#LI\-JB1

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: *We're building an autonomous infrastructure engineering agent: think Claude Code, but for your cloud. If you're excited about agentic AI systems that solve impactful problems for engineers, developers, and security experts at innovative startups and iconic enterprises alike, this role is for you.* Neo is Pulumi's answer to what infrastructure engineering looks like in an AI\-first era. It's a virtual infrastructure teammate that understands your cloud environment, plans and executes multi\-step operations, and brings domain expertise to problems ranging from spinning up complex ML infrastructures to cloud migrations to continuous compliance enforcement. What makes Neo possible is infrastructure\-as\-code: by modeling cloud infrastructure in code space, we can leverage the fact that LLMs are already excellent at coding to affect cloud infrastructure changes. Combined with Pulumi's registry and petabytes of deployment history, we have a unique foundation for building infrastructure intelligence. We're looking for engineers to build all aspects of Neo: from agent orchestration and tool interfaces to the web experience where users watch Neo work, approve operations, and understand its reasoning, to the interface with the models and how we orchestrate and fine\-tune them to maximize impact. We seek bold thinkers to reimagine the entirety of cloud engineering. While Pulumi is headquartered in Seattle, WA., we are dedicated to being a remote first company. This role will be located remotely within the U.S., with a preference for candidates based in Pacific Time Zone locations. #### **Responsibilities** * Build the planning and execution systems that let Neo safely perform multi\-step infrastructure operations across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and more * Design tool interfaces that give the agent semantic understanding of cloud resources and access to engineering workflows * Develop the context systems that help Neo understand each customer's infrastructure patterns and usage * Create the feedback loops and self\-correction mechanisms that make autonomous operation reliable * Build evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance across Neo's capability areas: migrations, compliance, cost optimization, diagnostics, and more * Work on the web interface where Neo operates as a "virtual teammate"—task assignment, progress visibility, approval workflows * Integrate Neo's capabilities into Pulumi's MCP Server for agent\-to\-agent workflows * Collaborate with platform teams to deeply integrate agent capabilities into the CLI, SDKs, and Pulumi Cloud #### **You may be a good fit if you:** * Are genuinely excited about agentic AI—systems that plan, act, and adapt in the real world, not just generate text * Have built production systems using LLMs, including experience with skill design, tool use, function calling, and multi\-step orchestration * Care deeply about reliability and safety when AI systems take real actions with real consequences * Are comfortable across the stack—agent orchestration, backend services, and frontend interfaces * Write production\-grade Go (our primary language), with working proficiency in Python and TypeScript, and can pick up new environments quickly * Bring a product mindset: you think about what users need, not just what's technically interesting * Communicate clearly and work well with a distributed team #### **Strong candidates may also have:** * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) or infrastructure\-as\-code tools * Background in building developer tools, CLIs, or platform engineering systems * Familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) * Experience building evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for AI systems * Knowledge of prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, MCP, or retrieval\-augmented generation #### **Compensation** * Base Salary Hiring Range: $185,000 to 215,000 * All full\-time employee offers at Pulumi include base salary, bonus or variable, equity and benefits (details below). **Benefits \& Perks at Pulumi:** **Healthcare Coverage:** We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and supplemental insurance at no cost to U.S. employees. Internationally, we comply with local healthcare requirements and provide regionally appropriate coverage. **Time Off:** Our unlimited PTO policy encourages balance and rest — and we require employees to take at least three weeks off annually, plus 13 U.S. holidays. **401(k):** U.S. employees are eligible for a 401(k) plan with an employer match to support long\-term financial wellness. **Parental Leave:** We provide 20 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents or primary caregivers, and 16 weeks for non\-birthing parents or secondary caregivers. **Remote\-First Culture:** Pulumi has been fully remote since 2020, with teammates across 20\+ U.S. states and 12\+ countries. We support flexible work with asynchronous collaboration and an annual "work from anywhere" stipend. **Professional Development:** Every employee receives an annual learning and development budget to support growth, learning, and career goals. **Equity Ownership:** We believe in acting like owners. All employees receive equity and are empowered to think big, move fast, and build the future of cloud together. **Additional Support:** We offer a monthly wellness fund to support mental and physical well\-being, and a quarterly happiness fund for team connection. **About Pulumi:** Pulumi is reimagining how teams build cloud software, enabling developers and infrastructure experts to work better together through a unique combination of programming languages, tools, and systems innovation. Our flagship infrastructure as code technology is open source and our SaaS product, Pulumi Cloud, provides platform teams, secrets management, and cloud management capabilities, and more. We have pioneered leveraging AI across all of these areas with our LLM\-powered Pulumi Copilot to push the boundaries of what's possible. At Pulumi, we dream big, in the pursuit of helping our customers out\-innovate and win. Founded in 2017 by industry veterans with over five decades of combined experience building developer platforms, Pulumi now has a global community of more than 350,000 members and serves over 3,250 customers. Despite our rapid growth, we're still only getting started, and are early in our mission to democratize the cloud. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-performance, we want to work with you to accelerate Pulumi's impact. *At Pulumi, we don't just accept difference, we celebrate, support, and thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our customers. Pulumi is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Engineer – Microsoft Fabric
jobs.description: Data \& Analytics Engineer – Microsoft Fabric **Location:** Irving, TX **Job Type:** Full\-time **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM **Salary:** $100,000–$120,000 per year **Work Setting:** Primarily in person About the Role Quantum Pain \& Spine is looking for a **Data \& Analytics Engineer** to help build and own the data foundation supporting a growing multi\-entity healthcare organization. We are building a centralized analytics environment in **Microsoft Fabric** that will bring together data from eClinicalWorks, HubSpot, financial and operational systems, and other business applications. This role sits between traditional data engineering and analytics engineering. We are not looking for someone focused primarily on massive distributed systems, streaming infrastructure, or highly complex data platforms. We need someone who can take source data, make it reliable and understandable, model it around real business questions, and deliver trusted datasets and reporting that leadership can actually use. The ideal candidate combines strong SQL and data\-modeling skills with practical Microsoft Fabric and Power BI experience and is comfortable working directly with business stakeholders. ResponsibilitiesMicrosoft Fabric \& Data Platform * Help design, build, and maintain our Microsoft Fabric environment. * Work with Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse, pipelines, and related services. * Build and maintain reliable data pipelines from business systems. * Integrate data from sources including eClinicalWorks, HubSpot, spreadsheets, APIs, and other operational platforms. * Develop repeatable ingestion and transformation processes. * Monitor data refreshes, pipeline performance, and failures. * Help establish deployment, documentation, and data\-development standards. Analytics Engineering \& Data Modeling * Transform raw and standardized data into business\-ready analytical models. * Build dimensional and star\-schema models. * Develop curated Gold\-layer datasets for reporting and analysis. * Create reusable definitions for key business metrics. * Build and maintain semantic models for Power BI. * Work with DAX where needed to support reporting and analytical use cases. * Create data\-quality checks and reconciliation processes. * Investigate conflicting data and help determine reliable sources of truth. Reporting \& Business Analytics * Partner with Strategic Operations, Finance, Operations, and leadership to understand business questions. * Translate business requirements into datasets, models, and reporting solutions. * Build or support Power BI dashboards and reporting products. * Improve the reliability and consistency of existing reporting. * Reduce manual spreadsheet\-based reporting where appropriate. * Help develop analytics around financial/AR performance, referral performance, patient journeys, operational efficiency, and other business priorities. Data Governance \& Documentation * Document data sources, transformations, business definitions, and dependencies. * Help establish consistent data standards across the organization. * Identify data\-quality issues and work with operational teams to understand their root causes. * Help create scalable structures that make future analytics work easier and more reliable. * Support appropriate access controls for business and healthcare data. What We’re Looking For * Approximately 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a similar role. * Strong SQL skills. * Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and star\-schema design. * Experience building business\-ready datasets from multiple source systems. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric or closely related Microsoft data technologies. * Experience with Power BI. * Understanding of semantic models and DAX. * Ability to investigate messy or conflicting data and determine how it should be reconciled. * Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate questions into technical solutions. * Strong problem\-solving and documentation skills. * Ability to own projects from source data through final analytical product. Preferred Qualifications * Hands\-on Microsoft Fabric experience. * Experience with Fabric Lakehouse and/or Warehouse. * Experience with Power BI semantic models. * Experience integrating REST APIs or SaaS platforms. * Python experience. * Familiarity with Azure data services. * Experience with HubSpot data. * Healthcare analytics experience. * Experience with EHR data, particularly eClinicalWorks. * Experience with financial, revenue\-cycle, referral, or operational healthcare data. * Familiarity with data governance and healthcare privacy considerations. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcome. Experience with PySpark, Databricks, or large\-scale distributed data technologies is useful but is **not the primary focus of this role**. What Success Looks Like Within the first several months, this person should: * Understand the organization’s major data sources and data\-quality challenges. * Establish a stable Microsoft Fabric development foundation. * Validate and organize eClinicalWorks data being shared into Fabric. * Begin integrating additional high\-value data sources. * Establish standards for business\-ready data models. * Deliver the first trusted end\-to\-end analytical products. * Reduce dependence on manually reconciled spreadsheets. * Give leadership faster access to consistent and explainable business information. Initial analytical priorities are expected to include: * Financial and accounts\-receivable visibility * Referral performance and conversion * Operational and patient\-journey analytics Work Environment This is primarily an **in\-person position in Irving, Texas**. Occasional remote work may be approved at manager discretion based on current projects, deadlines, and operational needs. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: **Company Overview** **ReadyOn.AI** is an AI\-native Labor Operating System that is redefining how the world’s largest enterprises manage frontline labor. Born out of a Stanford AI Lab, the company applies advanced AI and market\-design principles to one of the hardest optimization problems on earth: matching the world’s 2\.7 billion frontline workers to the right shifts, in real time. Frontline workers now expect the same flexibility and autonomy that gig platforms provide, while large employers face relentless pressure to meet aggressive labor\-cost targets. ReadyOn bridges that divide with a system of action that predicts workforce demand, dynamically matches it to an employer’s supply of employees, and automates the thousands of staffing decisions made daily across complex, multi\-site operations. The platform is already proven at global scale, powering labor operations for several of the world’s largest enterprises. Landmark customers include a F250 food\-service enterprise (300K employees across 16 countries; $7B\+ annual labor spend, a F500 hotel group (250K\+ employees; $5B\+ annual labor spend), a F250 entertainment operator (75K employees; $4B\+ labor spend). Across these deployments, ReadyOn has proven that scheduling was never the real problem—it was a symptom. The true challenge is how to match people and work dynamically at scale. ReadyOn solves this problem with an AI system of action that transforms labor from a fixed cost into a strategic advantage, reshaping how enterprises think about workforce design altogether. Headquartered in San Francisco with 80 employees, ReadyOn grew 8x year\-over\-year revenue growth in 2025, driven by multiple seven\-figure Fortune 250 enterprise deployments and a rapidly expanding pipeline. **Transform How Frontline Work Runs** Enterprises struggle to manage hundreds of millions of dollars in frontline labor spend due to decades\-old software and manual processes, creating massive, avoidable costs. Frontline labor often represents 40% of the P\&L, yet the systems managing this $3 trillion market were built for static schedules and limited flexibility. ReadyOn was founded to reject that paradigm. Staffing is not a scheduling problem; it is a real\-time supply–demand orchestration problem. ReadyOn is an AI\-native labor operating system, built from the ground up for AI agents to perform real\-time labor optimization \- much like ridesharing platforms that match drivers and riders in real time, but applied to frontline labor instead of fixed, one\-size\-fits\-all schedules. **Who’s Building It** AI is not a bolt\-on feature in our platform. Every decision, from demand forecasting to shift assignment, flows through an adaptive, autonomous decision layer that learns from operational data and continuously optimizes for cost, compliance, and worker satisfaction. Behind that system is a founding team of experts in labor markets, enterprise software, and AI\-enabled platforms: **Reza** **– Engineering leader who scaled enterprise systems at Google, Yahoo, and AT\&T** **Dominic** **– Operator who optimized labor\-intensive operations in 21 countries** **Mohammad** **– Stanford professor and leading expert in algorithmic market design** ReadyOn has already proven product–market fit with multiple multi\-million\-dollar customers, consistent expansion within existing accounts, and measurable ROI that moves stock prices. **Deployment Strategist Role** Joining the Enterprise Partnerships team, the Deployment Strategist works across multiple customer deployments and alongside our Engagement Managers to turn complex labor environments into working ReadyOn deployments. You will contribute directly to live Fortune 500 implementations: building configurations, running data analyses, supporting training delivery, and joining customer engagements. You will also build the structured product intelligence that helps Engineering and Product understand what is happening in the field. The best people in this role become the team’s institutional memory, and the role grows from deployment execution into product synthesis, analytical infrastructure, and solutions work. Strong performers move into Engagement Management, Solutions Engineering, or Product roles. **Ideal Candidates:** * **Learn by Doing:** You get up to speed quickly in unfamiliar tools, data, and operating environments, and you are comfortable contributing to live Fortune 500 deployments from day one. * **Turn Data into Decisions:** You break down ambiguous operational questions, work directly with messy data, and move quickly from analysis to a clear recommendation. * **Own Your Workstreams:** You take ownership of multiple workstreams at once, work out what needs to happen next, and follow through without close supervision. * **Build for Reuse:** You look for the template, script, or playbook that makes the next deployment faster than the last, and you build it. * **Be the Bridge:** You explain technical and analytical findings clearly to engineers, product managers, and non\-technical operators, and you turn what you see in the field into structured product feedback. **Responsibilities \& Impact** * *Execute Client Deployments:* Own defined deployment workstreams, including go\-live preparation, configuration troubleshooting, and manager training. Lead relevant client calls and bring technical and analytical depth to customer conversations. * *Design Configurations and Solutions:* Translate employer data and rules into system\-ready configurations. Own solution design details in pilots and early\-stage deployments, and contribute to validation and UAT testing. * *Turn Field Insight into Product Direction:* Surface field\-level product gaps to Product and Engineering, grounded in deployment data. Write feature requests informed by cross\-customer pattern analysis. * *Deliver Data Analysis and Reporting:* Build deployment health dashboards, cross\-customer operational analyses, and adoption and usage metrics. Run ad hoc data pulls for customer\-facing deliverables such as board decks and QBR materials. * *Automate and Reuse:* Build reusable templates, scripts, playbooks, and analytical frameworks that make each subsequent deployment faster, and support the data warehouse and internal analytics infrastructure as it develops. **Your Background** * **0\-3 years of professional experience**, with a degree in Computer Science, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a similar analytical field. * **Analytical Problem\-Solving and Data Fluency:** You structure ambiguous operational questions into analyses, work comfortably with raw data (exports, API responses, unfamiliar schemas), and spot patterns across data sets and engagements. * **Technical Orientation:** You pick up new tools and schemas quickly, think in systems, and have basic comfort with code: you can read scripts, automate repetitive tasks, and debug configurations. You know enough about APIs, data sync, and webhooks to diagnose problems and talk with engineers. * **Execution and Operational Rigor:** You manage several concurrent workstreams, follow through without close supervision, and build repeatable processes that make the team more consistent. * **Internal and External Communication:** You distill complex information clearly on client calls and write summaries, feature requests, and status updates that stand on their own. You work well across engineering, product, and customer teams. * **AI\-assisted development tools:** Claude Code, Cursor, nice to have: Python or BI tool experience * **Nice to Have:** Exposure to enterprise SaaS, workforce management, or labor operations. Compensation Range: $95K \- $150K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Customer Data Platform (CDP) & Personalization
jobs.description: **Description** At Realtor.com®, we help people discover and create their perfect home. We bring together real estate data, consumer experiences and technology to support people throughout their home journey. Realtor.com is building a Customer Data Platform on Twilio Segment so we can recognize consumers across web, apps, email and push and give each person an experience that fits where they are in their home search. It’s heading to production now, and we need engineers to help build and run it. We’re hiring a Software Engineer for the CDP’s serving path: the profile store and the Personalization Activation Subgraph, a federated GraphQL service between the CDP and our site and apps. Personalization has to be fast and safe. If anything is slow or down, users and search engines just get the standard page. The work is backend\-first but goes all the way to the screen. You’ll write resolvers and profile store code, wire the subgraph into our server\-rendered pages and CMS, and build the components that render each treatment, its fallback and its exposure events. Over time you’ll own treatments end to end, from the CDP trait to the pixel on the page. You’ll start alongside a senior engineer and our vendor, then help bring the platform in\-house with data engineering, Identity \& Authentication, Web Platform, Mobile, Notifications and MarTech. Top Reasons to Apply: * Help build a new platform with real executive sponsorship. * Work on a system that sits at the meeting point of identity, data and the consumer experience on one of the largest real estate sites in the U.S. * Grow quickly with senior engineers on work that spans backend, front end and data What You’ll Do: * Build and maintain an Apollo Federation v2 subgraph that serves profile traits, audiences and personalization decisions to web, CMS and native clients, using our schema conventions, resilience patterns (timeouts, circuit breakers, kill switches, flags) and router\-provided identity so a CDP failure never breaks a page. * Help build the RDC\-owned profile store and its refresh pipeline (event consumers, backfills, rate\-limited batching) to serve traits in single\-digit milliseconds, partnering with Web Platform on caching. * Bring personalization into server\-rendered React pages, islands and CMS experiments with Apollo Client components that load without flicker, never block the page and protect Core Web Vitals, with clean exposure and engagement tracking through Segment. * Help build the Kafka integration that sends identity events to the CDP without PII leakage, and enforce consent and opt\-out so suppressed users are never personalized or tracked. * Ship through EKS, Argo CD, Helm and CircleCI, join on\-call once ramped up, build the dashboards, alerts and runbooks for your services, and turn product requirements into flagged, A/B\-tested features with short design docs. What You’ll Bring: * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, including building and supporting services in production. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. * Experience shipping user\-facing features across both a backend service and the UI. * Solid TypeScript/Node.js for backend work (our subgraphs are Node/TypeScript). * React and TypeScript on the front end, with some experience in server\-side rendering (Next.js or similar) and a GraphQL client such as Apollo Client. * Working knowledge of GraphQL APIs: schema design, resolvers and error handling. * Familiarity with caching and key\-value stores (Redis, DynamoDB or similar) and why latency matters for page rendering. * Understanding of basic resilience patterns: timeouts, retries and fallbacks. * Experience with AWS, Docker and CI/CD pipelines. * Habit of writing tests and adding logging and metrics to the code you ship. * Clear written communication and comfort asking questions and raising risks early. Preferred * Apollo Federation v2 experience: subgraphs, entities and @key, composition checks with Rover/GraphOS. * Hands\-on work with a Customer Data Platform, ideally Twilio Segment (Engage audiences, computed traits, Profile API, Destinations). mParticle, Tealium, Braze or Amperity also count. * Kafka or another event streaming system, including idempotency and ordering. * Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and front\-end performance tuning. * Feature flag and experimentation tools (LaunchDarkly, Amplitude Experiment, Optimizely) and exposure logging. * OAuth 2\.0/OIDC and JWT basics, or identity platforms like Auth0 or Okta. * Client\-side analytics (Segment analytics.js, Amplitude or similar). * Kubernetes, Argo CD, Helm and Terraform. * Observability tools such as New Relic or Datadog. * Awareness of privacy requirements around PII, consent and opt\-out (CCPA/CPRA). * Micro\-frontend, design system or headless CMS experience. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Associate Engineer
jobs.description: Robert Thomas Iron Design (RTID) is a high\-end custom metal fabrication studio specializing in architectural and ornamental metalwork. We strive to create an environment where people can learn and pursue their craft in an artisanal production environment; a creative place to learn, grow, develop and build a fulfilling career. Our goal is to inspire craftsmanship in all we do. Located in the historic Charleston Naval Yard, we are committed to a high standard in everything we do and have fun doing it. Check us out at: www.robertthomasiron.com We are seeking an Associate Engineer to join our engineering team. This role is CAD\-forward: most of your time will be spent building SolidWorks models and producing the drawings our blacksmiths, fabricators, and machinists build from. Every gate, railing, light fixture, piece of furniture, and production tool that leaves our shop starts as a model, so it has to be right. The ideal candidate pairs advanced SolidWorks skill with a solid foundation in engineering principles and machining, and understands how steel is actually forged, cut, machined, and joined. **Key Responsibilities** **CAD Modeling \& Drawing Creation** * Create detailed 3D part, assembly, and weldment models in SolidWorks for architectural ironwork, furniture, lighting, hardware, and production tooling. * Produce complete, accurate fabrication and machining drawings, including dimensions and tolerances (GD\&T where appropriate), weld symbols, finishes, and notes. * Develop drawing packages for internal use, client approval, and shop fabrication, including bills of materials (BOMs), cut lists, and flat patterns/templates * Prepare shop drawings and submittals for clients, architects, and contractors; incorporate redlines and manage revisions. * Model forged components and hand\-forged features with an understanding of how forging tolerances differ from machined tolerances. * Translate sketches, renderings, and field measurements into buildable designs. * Import, clean up, and work with files from other CAD platforms (AutoCAD, Rhino, Inventor, Fusion 360, STEP, DXF) supplied by architects, designers, and 3rd party design services. * Build and maintain RTID’s part, template, and drawing libraries; uphold drawing standards, part numbering, file naming, and revision control. * Tabulate quantity takeoffs and material estimates from drawings. **Engineering \& Manufacturing Support** * Apply sound engineering principles (statics, strength of materials, load paths, connection and weld design) to ensure designs are structurally sound and meet applicable building codes for guards, railings, and gates. * Perform engineering calculations and basic simulation (FEA) where needed, and identify items that require review by a licensed Professional Engineer. * Design for manufacturability: select materials, stock/standard sizes, joinery, and processes that fit RTID’s forging, fabrication, and machining capabilities. * Create machining drawings and support CNC and CAM programming for parts, fixtures, dies, and production tooling, including tooling for our cookware manufacturing division. * Design jigs, fixtures, and forging tooling that improve repeatability, quality, and throughput. * Work closely with the Shop Foreman and craftspeople to answer technical questions, resolve design challenges during production, and feed lessons learned back into the models. * Support development of new forged product lines designed for repeatable standard and semi\-custom production. **Systems \& Coordination** * Structure BOMs and item data for use in our MRP system so engineering information flows cleanly to purchasing and production. * Manage engineering change orders and drawing revisions throughout the project lifecycle. * Coordinate with project management and production on drawing release schedules and priorities. * Coordinate and collaborate with RTID’s supporting 3rd party design services (CAD, rendering, 3D modeling, detailing). * Collaborate with clients, architects, and contractors to clarify design intent and resolve technical questions. * Work with purchasing and outside vendors (laser, waterjet, machining, finishing) on specifications, materials, and lead times. **Wage Range: $28\.00\-$33\.00/hour** **Qualifications \& Skills** **Required** * Minimum 5 years of hands\-on SolidWorks experience, with advanced proficiency in parts, assemblies, weldments, sheet metal, configurations, and drawing creation. * Associate’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field preferred; * Solid foundation in engineering principles, including statics, strength of materials, and the properties of carbon and stainless steels. * Working knowledge of machining processes (milling, turning, CNC) and the ability to produce drawings a machinist can build from without questions. * Thorough understanding of drafting standards (ASME Y14\.5\), GD\&T, and AWS weld symbols. * Understanding of metal fabrication processes, including cutting, forming, welding, forging, and finishing. * Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and shop drawings. * Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. * Strong communication and collaboration skills; equally comfortable on the shop floor and in a client meeting. * MS365 Applications and MS Teams ecosystem proficient. * Process and systems mentality – familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma and 5S principles. * Dependable, flexible, and can be counted on to deliver. **Desirable** * Experience in ornamental ironwork, architectural metals, or custom metal fabrication (desirable but not required). * Proficiency in additional CAD software such as AutoCAD, Rhino, Inventor, or Fusion 360\. * Understanding of MRP/ERP systems, including item masters, BOMs, routings, and work orders. * CAM software experience (SolidWorks CAM, Mastercam, Fusion 360 CAM, or similar). * SolidWorks Simulation / FEA experience; CSWA or CSWP certification. * Hands\-on shop experience in machining, welding, or blacksmithing. * Familiarity with PDM and revision control systems. * Experience designing tooling, jigs, and fixtures.

jobs.description: **Job Title:** **Software Engineer III \- Supply Chain and Reverse Logistics** **Company:** SRC Logistics, Inc. **Location:** Springfield, MO **Job Type:** Full\-time, Salaried Exempt \*\*This position is not eligible for relocation at this time.\*\* **About the Company:** SRC Logistics, Inc. is a leading provider of reverse logistics core management and warehousing services, catering to customers across various industries. Our integrated IT system empowers dealers, suppliers, and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) with real\-time sales and return data. We are a company driven by a culture of ownership, financial literacy, and continuous improvement. Join us and become an Employee\-Owner, contributing to our entrepreneurial and accountable environment. **Position Summary:** We are seeking a talented Software Engineer III with Full Stack development experience to collaborate with our internal and external account management team. In this role, you will play a vital part in enhancing, designing, developing, and testing programs that facilitate the management of reverse logistics and operational processes. Your work will contribute to the satisfaction of our customers and the overall success of our supply chain operations. **Essential Responsibilities:** * Creatively develop new code for web\-based software solutions supporting the supply chain and reverse logistics industry. * Develop new features, investigate bugs, and maintain existing web applications written in PHP, MySQL, and NodeJS. * Ensure exceptional code quality and conduct thorough testing at both the unit and system integration levels for every newly developed feature. * Translate business requirements into technical specifications and implement them accordingly. * Contribute to improving the quality and design of the existing codebase. * Provide technical problem resolution for less complex issues. * Perform data integrity tests and validation, analyze output, and identify production issues and process flow requirements. * Collaborate with users to enhance output and data integrity. * Translate user needs and requests into technical processes and system design. * Define reporting needs and execute required data resources for desired output. * Collaborate with Quality to establish workflow standards and assist in implementing guidelines and training. * Work in an Agile or Waterfall environment, participating in short sprints and development cycles. * Manage data requisites from customers, including input/output flow and SQL interfaces. * Develop and maintain utility programs and scripts for automation. * Generate, maintain, and manage flowcharts of systems and processes. **Working Conditions:** This position involves primarily working in a controlled atmosphere, with occasional exposure to dust, fumes, noise, and varying temperatures for short periods. The role requires regular use of hands, fingers, and the ability to talk and hear. Adherence to safety standards, Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and wearing personal protective equipment (PPE) in designated areas is mandatory. This position offers partial remote work, allowing up to 60% of the workweek to be performed remotely. **Job Specifications** **Education \& Experience:** * Associate’s Degree in Computer Information Systems or related field with an emphasis on programming. * PREFERRED: Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Information Systems or related field with an emphasis on programming. * 5 years of programming experience as a full stack developer. * PREFERRED: 10 years of programming experience, with a proven track record in PHP, MySQL, or NodeJS programming and database structures. **Skills:** * Complex problem\-solving skills, including identifying, investigating, and evaluating options to implement solutions. * Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy in completing tasks and reporting information. * Strong judgment and decision\-making abilities, considering costs and benefits to determine the most appropriate actions. * Excellent organizational skills, including time management, multitasking, and prioritization. * Relationship building skills, with the ability to build strong connections with supervisors, employees, and stakeholders. * Active listening skills, attentively understanding and seeking solutions to points made by others. * Effective communication, both oral and written, tailored to various audiences. **Behaviors:** * Must be extremely reliable, responsible, dependable, in order to fulfill obligations * Embrace opportunities to expand personal competencies and capabilities through training \& education * Engage and support Logistics’ safety culture and efficient operation of the business and maintain positive working relationships with employees across the organization. * Participate in and support the principles of Great Game of Business and Open Book Management **What’s In It for Me?** At SRC, we want you to think, act, and feel like an Owner. One way we assist with that is by sharing the financials. You will get the opportunity to know exactly how the company is performing at any time. Sharing the wealth with those who help create it is important to us. As a full\-time Employee\-Owner, you will start your journey to full Employee Ownership on Day 1\. **If you choose to become an Employee Owner, you will be eligible for the following:*** Full benefits package on your 61st day of employment including affordable medical, dental, and vision, company paid life insurance and short\-term disability, and other elective benefits * 401(k) with 5% match after 90 days of employment * Employee Stock Ownership Program at no cost to the employee * Immediately eligible for prorated Vacation and paid Holidays * Opportunity for Quarterly Bonus Program * 100% Tuition reimbursement program * Opportunities for growth across the SRC family of companies * Internal \& External Volunteer Opportunities * We like to WIN; you can expect fun team celebrations that typically involve food or giveaways, but most usually food! **Location:** 2607 N. Mulroy Rd Springfield, MO 65802

jobs.title: Staff Product Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ------------------------ At ServiceTitan, we are transforming product security into a core part of how engineering delivers software. We are looking for a Staff Product Security Engineer to embed with one of our engineering portfolios and own its security outcomes end to end, across application security and cloud security, so that our 80 plus R\&D teams build securely by default without slowing down innovation. In this role, you will sit alongside engineering leaders in planning and design, threat model systems before they are built, own the portfolio's risk picture, and bring secure\-by\-default patterns to each team's architecture and workflow. You will be the security expert engineers know by name and the voice that carries their real\-world context back into the program's strategy. This is an opportunity to shape how security is practiced where software actually gets built, turning security into an enabler of engineering velocity rather than a constraint. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Design Partnership** * **Standing Seat in Planning and Design:** Join the portfolio's planning and design cadences as a permanent participant. Review roadmaps, architecture proposals, and technical designs early enough to shape them rather than gate them. * **Threat Modeling:** Lead and scale threat modeling across the portfolio using the program's standard and tooling. Prioritize top\-tier systems, coach squads to run their own models, and make sure identified threats become tracked requirements in the findings flow. * **Architecture Review:** Provide secure architecture guidance for cloud\-native services, microservices, multi\-tenant data access, identity and secrets handling, and AI\-enabled features. Translate the program's security requirements into concrete design decisions the squads can implement. **Portfolio Risk Ownership** * **Own the Risk Picture:** Maintain a current, evidence\-backed view of the portfolio's security risk across application findings, cloud posture, identity, and data exposure. Know what each squad builds, the data it touches, and where it is heading. * **Drive Priorities with Engineering Leaders:** Partner directly with the portfolio VP and their leaders to set remediation priorities, negotiate tradeoffs, and drive adherence to vulnerability remediation SLAs. Bring the data, own the follow through, and escalate with judgment. * **Risk Acceptance and Exceptions:** Guide squads through the program's risk acceptance process. Make sure exceptions are documented, time\-bound, and visible to the right decision makers. **Paved\-Road Adoption** * **Fit Central Patterns to Local Architecture:** Take the paved roads built by the Platform and Programs team, including secure service templates, secrets management patterns, secure cloud configuration templates, CI/CD guardrails, and IaC policy sets, and adapt them to each squad's stack and workflow. * **Drive Adoption in the Field:** Get squads onto SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC scanning, container scanning, and CSPM coverage, and keep them there. Tune signal quality with squads so findings are actionable, and close the loop on what is noise versus real risk. * **Hands\-On Remediation Support:** Read the code, review the Terraform, and pair with engineers on fixes for the hard findings. Write reference implementations and fixes when that is the fastest way to unblock a squad. **Champion Coaching** * **Develop the Portfolio's Champions:** Recruit, coach, and support the security champions across your squads. Be the technical expert they bring the hard questions to, and build them into the portfolio's first line of security response. * **Contextual Enablement:** Deliver just\-in\-time training, design reviews, and office hours tuned to what the portfolio is actually building. Help squads learn to fix their own code and configuration. **Strategy Feedback** * **Feed the Program Roadmap:** Bring real engineering context back to the Director and the Platform and Programs team. Identify where central tooling, patterns, or standards fall short of what squads need, and shape what gets built next. * **Metrics and Reporting:** Contribute portfolio\-level data to the program's metrics rhythm. Report on coverage, remediation velocity, and risk trends for your portfolio to security and engineering leadership. * **Incident Support:** Support triage and investigation of security incidents touching your portfolio, and turn lessons learned into design changes and paved\-road improvements. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * **Experience:** 7\-10\+ years in product security, application security, cloud security, or a closely related security engineering role, with a strong software engineering foundation. Prior experience embedded with or partnering directly with engineering teams is strongly preferred. * **Breadth Across AppSec and CloudSec:** Demonstrated ability to work across the full stack of a modern SaaS product: secure  sts on the central team when you need depth. **Shape How Security Is Practiced:** You will help define what embedded security partnership looks like at ServiceTitan, from how you engage with engineering leaders to how field learnings become platform patterns that scale across every team. **High Ownership, High Leverage:** You will have the autonomy to identify problems, design solutions, and drive them to completion with your portfolio, and the backing of a central team that turns what you learn into patterns for everyone. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $179,900 USD \- $269,900 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $168,200 USD \- $252,200 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

jobs.description: **Senior Plastics Engineer – Automotive** **About Sigma International** Sigma International is a global Tier\-1 automotive supplier specializing in decorative trim, illuminated components, plastic injection\-molded products, and integrated electronic systems. We partner with leading automotive OEMs to develop innovative interior and exterior components that combine design, functionality, and advanced manufacturing technologies. **Position Overview** Sigma International is seeking an experienced **Senior Plastics Engineer** with deep technical expertise in plastic injection molding, product design, tooling, and automotive manufacturing. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering position for someone who understands plastics inside and out. The ideal candidate has extensive experience working with injection\-molded components, plastic materials, mold design, manufacturing processes, and complex technical challenges. The Senior Plastics Engineer will take ownership of product engineering activities, provide technical direction, resolve complex design and manufacturing issues, and support projects from initial concept through production. We are looking for someone who can work independently, make sound engineering decisions, and serve as a technical resource across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and suppliers. **Key Responsibilities** **Senior Product Engineering \& Technical Leadership** * Lead the design, development, and optimization of automotive plastic components and assemblies. * Serve as the primary technical expert for plastic product design, materials, injection molding, and tooling. * Evaluate product designs for functionality, manufacturability, dimensional accuracy, quality, and cost. * Apply advanced Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles to improve product performance and manufacturing efficiency. * Review and approve engineering designs, GD\&T, material specifications, tolerances, and technical documentation. * Develop and modify complex 3D CAD models, assemblies, and engineering drawings. * Provide technical guidance to engineering, quality, manufacturing, and program teams. * Independently manage engineering priorities and make technical recommendations. **Plastic Injection Molding, Materials \& Tooling** * Lead technical evaluations of injection\-molded plastic components and tooling designs. * Work directly with mold makers and tooling suppliers to review mold concepts, identify risks, and resolve technical challenges. * Provide expert\-level troubleshooting of injection molding defects, including warpage, sink marks, shrinkage, flow lines, dimensional variation, and cosmetic defects. * Evaluate and recommend plastic resins based on mechanical, thermal, optical, dimensional, and manufacturing requirements. * Lead mold trials, tooling modifications, engineering validation, and production readiness activities. * Identify opportunities to improve mold performance, cycle times, part quality, and manufacturing costs. * Resolve complex tooling and molding issues with practical, cost\-effective solutions. **Engineering \& Manufacturing Support** * Act as a senior technical resource for daily engineering and production challenges. * Lead root cause investigations involving product design, tooling, materials, dimensional issues, and assembly failures. * Develop and implement permanent corrective actions to prevent recurring manufacturing problems. * Support prototype development, product testing, engineering validation, and design improvements. * Design or modify checking fixtures, prototype tooling, and assembly stations when required. * Collaborate closely with manufacturing and quality teams to improve existing products and processes. * Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on product quality, manufacturability, and cost reduction. **Automotive Program \& Customer Support** * Lead technical feasibility reviews and engineering evaluations for new RFQs and customer programs. * Provide engineering input for tooling costs, product development, manufacturing feasibility, and technical risks. * Take ownership of engineering deliverables throughout product development and launch. * Support APQP, PPAP, design validation, tooling approval, and production launch activities. * Work directly with customers, suppliers, and internal teams to resolve complex engineering issues. * Ensure engineering documentation and technical requirements are maintained throughout the product lifecycle. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Plastics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Polymer Engineering, or a related technical field. * **8–10\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience with plastic injection\-molded components, preferably in the automotive industry.** * **Extensive, demonstrated expertise in plastics engineering, injection molding processes, mold tooling, and plastic material selection is essential.** * Proven ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex plastic molding, tooling, and product design problems. * Strong understanding of plastic resin properties, shrinkage, warpage, mold flow behavior, dimensional stability, and manufacturing limitations. * Advanced proficiency in at least one professional 3D CAD platform: Siemens NX, CATIA, or SolidWorks. * Experience creating and modifying complex 3D models, assemblies, and 2D engineering drawings. * Strong knowledge of DFM, GD\&T, dimensional tolerances, and automotive engineering specifications. * Significant experience working directly with mold makers, tooling suppliers, and injection molding operations. * Experience leading engineering activities from product development through tooling validation and production launch. * Working knowledge of automotive APQP and PPAP requirements. * Demonstrated ability to take technical ownership, make independent engineering decisions, and manage multiple priorities. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Important:** Candidates must have substantial, practical experience in plastics engineering. General mechanical design experience without significant injection molding, tooling, and plastic materials expertise will not meet the requirements of this position. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience designing or developing automotive plastic optical lenses, light guides, and illuminated components. * Knowledge of optical\-grade plastics, particularly polycarbonate (PC) and PMMA. * Experience integrating plastic lenses and light guides with LEDs, PCBAs, and electronic assemblies. * Experience with automotive interior and exterior decorative components. * Knowledge of Class\-A surfaces, painting, plating, coatings, and decorative finishes. * Experience with Moldflow analysis and injection molding simulation. * Experience designing checking fixtures, prototype tooling, and assembly stations. * Knowledge of IATF 16949 automotive quality requirements. * Previous experience serving as a senior technical expert or mentoring other engineers. **What Success Looks Like** * Complex plastic design, tooling, and manufacturing problems are resolved independently and effectively. * Plastic components consistently meet customer specifications, dimensional requirements, and manufacturing expectations. * Tooling and injection molding issues are identified early, minimizing delays, scrap, and production disruptions. * Engineering projects move efficiently from concept through tooling development, validation, and production. jobs.description: The Senior Wafer Fab Yield Engineer is responsible for driving systematic yield improvement across semiconductor wafer fabrication. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** SmartRent (NYSE: SMRT) is revolutionizing how people live and work with the industry's only end\-to\-end platform designed for the rental housing industry. By uniting purpose\-built software, integrated hardware and full implementation and support in one ecosystem, we help owners and operators simplify operations, cut costs and deliver exceptional resident experiences. Recognized by Deloitte, HousingWire and the PropTech Breakthrough Awards, SmartRent is shaping the future of property technology and redefining what it means to make rental housing smarter. **Job Description** You own the mobile platform layer: the native module boundary, the build and release pipeline, and the performance and stability budgets. Feature engineers ship on top of what you build, and your work is measured by how fast they can do that without writing one\-off bridge code. This is a hands\-on IC role. You will work in Swift and Kotlin for native code and in JavaScript most days. You decide when a device integration becomes a shared native module instead of a one\-off, and you say no when it should stay in JS. *Candidate based in Phoenix, AZ is preferred to come to our headquarters in North Phoenix on a hybrid schedule.* **Responsibilities** * Design and maintain the shared native modules that power device control and other hardware\-specific features across our apps * Plan, sequence, and schedule React Native and native platform upgrades, including related dependency work, without stalling feature delivery * Own the iOS and Android build, signing, and store submission process, and keep it documented so any engineer on the squad can cut a release and new engineers can build on day one * Define targets for crash\-free session rate, cold start time, and binary size; instrument and alert on them; and advocate for them in planning when a feature puts one at risk * Partner with backend teams early on payload shape, pagination, real\-time device state, and error semantics before APIs are built * Set code review standards, mentor other mobile engineers, and document technical decisions so they outlast the conversation * Collaborate with other squads on shared mobile patterns, and with Product, QA, Customer Success, and Marketing on release scope and timing **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5\+ years shipping mobile apps on both the App Store and Google Play * 3\+ years of production React Native experience, including building and maintaining native modules * Deep expertise in Swift or Kotlin with working fluency in the other, and comfort reading platform SDK source when documentation falls short * Experience leading at least one significant platform migration or major React Native upgrade from planning through delivery * Backend experience (Node, Elixir, or similar) sufficient to collaborate on API design as a peer * Hands\-on experience integrating hardware, BLE, or other connected\-device protocols from the mobile app side * Experience working in a fast\-paced and high\-growth environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with offline\-first state management and conflict resolution on unreliable networks * Experience delivering accessibility and localization at scale in React Native \#LI\-Hybrid ### **We Put Our Employees First** We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well\-being and future. For our US employees, this includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance with low deductibles and 75–100% employer contributions. jobs.title: Junior Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description: Description: **Build Confidence. Ship Quality. Make an Impact.** **Join Stampin' Up! as a Junior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** At Stampin' Up!, we're known for helping people create meaningful connections through creativity. Behind every order, every subscription, every reward, and every crafting experience is technology built by passionate people who care deeply about delivering exceptional experiences. We're looking for a **Junior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** who is curious, collaborative, and excited to grow. This isn't a traditional QA role. Here, you'll be a **software engineer who happens to focus on testing**, helping us build quality directly into the products our demonstrators and customers rely on every day. If you love solving puzzles, asking questions, digging into data, and figuring out how things really work, we'd love to meet you. **A Little About Us** At Stampin' Up!, our mission goes beyond creating products. We create opportunities for people to connect, share, and build communities around creativity. Our culture is rooted in four core values: * We Care About People First * We Act With Courage * We Better Our Best * We Own It We're a company that believes great work happens when talented people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. We celebrate creativity in all forms, whether that's designing a beautiful handmade card or building a better automated testing framework. **What You'll Do** You'll be part of a small, highly collaborative team where quality isn't something inspected at the end. It's built in from the beginning. As an SDET, you'll be **embedded with the development team, not a separate QA department**. You'll work side\-by\-side with developers, business analysts, and product owners to ensure quality is part of every conversation. You'll also help us continue our evolution from manual testing to automation\-first quality practices. In this role, you'll help **build the automated tests that decide whether a release ships**, while still applying critical thinking and exploratory testing where automation isn't the best solution. You'll gain exposure to the full business, including opportunities to **learn a real e\-commerce business end to end: ordering, payments, subscriptions and commissions**. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys learning, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't afraid to tackle a large system one piece at a time. **What Success Looks Like** The people who thrive here tend to be: * Curious enough to investigate beyond the first answer * Comfortable asking questions and learning from others * Excited by both technical challenges and business problems * Strong communicators who can build trust with technical and non\-technical partners * Accountable and proactive rather than waiting for direction * Adaptable and eager to learn new tools, technologies, and ways of working * Positive team players who contribute to a healthy, collaborative culture **Key Responsibilities** * Demonstrate Stampin' Up!'s core values in your daily work and interactions * Partner closely with developers, business analysts, and product owners to understand requirements and identify quality risks early * Design, develop, and maintain automated tests for web applications, APIs, and backend services * Write SQL queries to validate business processes, investigate defects, and verify data integrity * Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and improve test reliability and coverage * **Use AI tools daily to write tests, investigate failures and speed up your work** * Evaluate and validate AI\-generated code and recommendations with sound engineering judgment * Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation isn't practical or sufficient * Investigate production issues, analyze logs, and help identify root causes * Document test results, defects, and quality risks using Azure DevOps and related tools * Take ownership of testing efforts and continuously improve team processes and automation capabilities * Contribute to software development projects as needed through the same engineering and code review process as the rest of the team Requirements: **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience * 3\+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, or software development involving automated testing * Experience building and maintaining automated tests with frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress * Proficiency in at least one programming language such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or C\# * Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, troubleshooting, and data validation * Experience testing REST APIs and understanding modern integration patterns * Familiarity with Git, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows * Ability to distinguish application issues from test failures or environment issues * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Clear verbal and written communication skills **Bonus Points If You Have** * Experience with Playwright and TypeScript * Experience with Azure DevOps * Experience testing .NET applications and Microsoft SQL Server * Experience with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar tools * Experience validating financial calculations, commissions, or high\-volume data processes * Experience supporting e\-commerce, payment processing, or order management systems * Experience with Application Insights, logging tools, and troubleshooting distributed systems * Experience with accessibility, performance testing, or test data management * Experience contributing production code, not just test code * Experience helping improve engineering tooling or automation frameworks **A Few Honest Challenges** We're committed to helping team members grow, and we believe transparency helps everyone succeed. In this role, you'll be learning and contributing within a large, interconnected system. The products support both our e\-commerce experience and the internal systems that drive ordering, commissions, subscriptions, and business operations. Much of the evidence for whether something is working correctly lives in the data, so SQL won't be an occasional tool. You'll use it regularly. You'll also balance automation and hands\-on testing. Not everything should be automated, and part of your success will be learning when each approach makes the most sense. Most importantly, you'll need the confidence to ask questions, seek feedback, and learn continuously. Nobody masters everything on day one. **Why You'll Love Working Here** Besides working with incredible people? **We've got perks.** * A wicked\-awesome benefits package (seriously, compare it) * A Friday dress code every day of the week. Dust off those jeans. * Extreme crafting experiences (totally optional, but surprisingly fun) * Generous paid time off because work\-life balance matters * Tuition assistance to support your career growth * 401(k) program with company match * A collaborative culture where your ideas matter * Opportunities to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact **Ready to Join Us?** If you're excited about automation, quality engineering, AI\-assisted development, and solving real business problems alongside great people, we'd love to hear from you. Bring your curiosity. Bring your problem\-solving skills. Bring your willingness to learn. We'll help you build the rest. **Apply today and help us create experiences that inspire creativity and connection around the world.**

strategy and multi‑year roadmap aligned with statewide technology standards and security frameworks. · Design and implement short\- and long\-term strategic plans to make certain network capacity meet existing and future requirements. * Ensure that network capacity, resiliency, scalability, and cybersecurity requirements meet current and future agency needs. · Establish best practices and policies for installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting end user workstation hardware, software, and peripheral devices. * Create and maintain technical standards, configuration baselines, documentation, and change control processes consistent with state HR classification expectations for IT Infrastructure Managers. * Lead analysis and planning for segmentation and modernization initiatives including HQ‑to‑roadside network separation and experience with network firewall migration. **Technical Responsibilities** · Plan, acquire, and coordinate installation of in\-house and remote hardware and software across the organization’s network. * Manage and optimize enterprise Cisco switching infrastructure across data centers, HQ, and roadside field locations. · Conduct research and make recommendations on network products, services, protocols, and standards in support of network procurement and development efforts. * Administer Meraki wireless systems including access point configuration, RF optimization, and cloud management. · Assess, approve, and administer all equipment, hardware, and software upgrades. * Configure, deploy, and maintain Cisco ASA/Firepower and FortiGate firewalls, including hybrid deployments in Azure. * Lead the agency’s firewall modernization project. * Design and deploy network segmentation to isolate critical remote operational networks from HQ systems. * Maintain BGP routes and troubleshoot connectivity with remote operational environments and partner networks. * Utilize NetBrain for automated topology mapping, diagnostics, and network workflow automation. * Utilize Rapid7 for vulnerability detection, prioritization, and remediation tracking across network components. * Ensure high availability, resiliency, and continuity for mission‑critical transportation and revenue‑generating systems. **Operational \& Security Responsibilities** * Ensure network operations comply with statewide cybersecurity frameworks and internal agency security policies. * Maintain firewall rulesets, segmentation strategies, and network access controls to enforce least‑privilege and zero‑trust principles. * Participate in incident response activities by providing packet analysis, log data, and network forensic insight. * Review and approve network change requests following governance and Change Advisory Board (CAB) processes. * Maintain disaster recovery readiness and test network failover and redundancy plans. **Team Leadership \& Vendor Management** * Supervise, mentor, and evaluate a team of three network
