groups, transportation partners, external vendors, and service providers. · Establish and maintain regular written and in\-person communications with the organization’s executives, decision\-makers, stakeholders, department heads, and end users regarding pertinent network activities. * Manage licensing, hardware refresh cycles, procurement requests, and vendor contract evaluations related to network infrastructure. * Independent self\-starter with excellent management, oral and written communication skills. * Flexibility to respond to the needs of the organization, including working as needed. * Ability to lead and motivate staff. **Tools \& Platforms** * Meraki wireless systems * Cisco ASA/Firepower and FortiGate firewalls * Azure Firewall, VNets, VPN Gateways * NetBrain automation and mapping * Rapid7 vulnerability management * Standard network monitoring and ITSM tools **Core Competencies** * **Technical Expertise:** Advanced knowledge of networking, cloud security, routing, and firewall technologies. * **Leadership \& Coaching:** Ability to lead, coach, mentor, and evaluate assigned staff in alignment with state expectations. * **Problem‑Solving:** Applies professional‑level analytical skills to identify root causes and deliver sustainable solutions. * **Communication:** Ability to prepare technical documentation and convey complex concepts clearly to non‑technical stakeholders. * **Collaboration:** Works effectively with diverse teams, external partners, statewide IT, and cross‑department leadership. * **Customer Focus:** Demonstrates responsiveness, ownership, and service excellence supporting mission‑critical environments. * **Adaptability:** Responds effectively to shifting workloads, emerging threats, and evolving technology standards. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field **or** equivalent professional experience. * Eight (8\) years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise networking, routing, switching, and firewall administration. * Four (4\) years of supervisory or team‑lead experience managing technical IT personnel. * Demonstrated expertise with Cisco switches, Meraki wireless systems, enterprise firewalls, BGP routing, and hybrid cloud networking. **Preferred This is a hands\-on development role with structured mentorship, focused on writing quality code, learning modern engineering practices, and delivering features to production. **Key Responsibilities** **Front\-End Development** Develop and maintain web application features using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue). jobs.title: Principal Full-Stack Data Scientist - Foundational Models
jobs.description: ### **About Stitch Fix, Inc.** Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we're equally committed to building yours. We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what's possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential. ### **About the Role** Stitch Fix is redefining retail by blending the art of fashion with the science of machine learning. The Foundational Models team builds and evolves the machine learning systems that power personalization and recommendations across Stitch Fix. The team owns foundational capabilities—including client and item representations, recommendation and retrieval systems, and core models such as the Client Time Series Model (CTSM)—that are leveraged across multiple client experiences and downstream applications. We foster a culture of ownership where Data Scientists manage the full lifecycle of their work. As a Senior Full\-Stack Data Scientist, you will work across the full machine learning lifecycle: identifying opportunities, developing and evaluating new modeling approaches, running large\-scale experiments, and deploying and operating models in production. You will tackle technically challenging problems in personalization and recommendation systems, working with large\-scale behavioral, transactional, textual, and visual data. This is a highly collaborative and hands\-on role. You will partner with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Product, and other technical teams to translate research and emerging ML techniques into reliable systems that create measurable client and business impact. ### **Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, evaluate, and productionize machine learning models that improve Stitch Fix's personalization and recommendation systems. * Advance foundational modeling capabilities, including client and item representations, embeddings, retrieval, ranking, recommendation models, and assortment generation. * Explore and apply LLMs and machine learning techniques—including deep learning, representation learning, multimodal modeling, and generative approaches—where they can meaningfully improve our systems. * Own work across the full ML lifecycle, from problem formulation and data exploration through modeling, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. * Design rigorous offline evaluations and online experiments to understand model performance, measure client and business impact, and communicate results to stakeholders and leadership. * Work with large\-scale behavioral and product datasets using Python, SQL, and distributed data\-processing tools. * Build production\-quality ML solutions with attention to scalability, reliability, latency, observability, and cost. * Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and other Data Science teams to understand downstream needs and translate them into reusable foundational ML capabilities. * Contribute to the technical direction of the Foundational Models team through design discussions, code reviews, research, prototyping, and development of engineering and modeling best practices. * Communicate complex technical concepts, modeling approaches, and tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical partners. * Mentor and collaborate with other Data Scientists and engineers, helping raise the technical bar across the team. ### **About You** This is what you'll need to succeed in this role from day 1\. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field required. Master's Degree or PhD preferred. * 8\+ years of experience in design and deployment of machine learning solutions, ideally in personalization, such as recommendation systems, representation learning, or search. * Strong ability to architect technical solutions and write production\-grade code in Python. * Ability to independently drive ambiguous machine learning problems from initial exploration and prototyping through production deployment, monitoring, iteration, and measurable impact. * Experience working with large\-scale datasets using SQL and distributed data\-processing technologies such as Spark. * Experience with modern deep\-learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Strong understanding of model evaluation and experimentation, including offline evaluation, A/B testing, and translating model improvements into measurable product or business outcomes. * Ability to reason about the tradeoffs involved in production ML systems, including model quality, latency, scalability, reliability, and computational cost. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions and communicate complex concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn and apply new machine learning techniques to practical problems. ### **Why You'll Love Working at Stitch Fix** * We are a group of bright, kind people who are motivated by challenge. We value integrity, innovation and trust. You'll bring these characteristics to life in everything you do at Stitch Fix. * We cultivate a community of diverse perspectives—all voices are heard and valued. * We are an innovative company and leverage our strengths in fashion and tech to disrupt the future of retail. * We win as a team, commit to our work, and celebrate grit together because we value strong relationships. * We boldly create the future while keeping equity and sustainability at the center of all that we do. * We are the owners of our work and are energized by solving problems through a growth mindset lens. We think broadly and creatively through every situation to create meaningful impact. * We offer comprehensive compensation packages and inclusive health and wellness benefits. *This link* *leads to the machine readable files that are made available in response to the federal Transparency in Coverage Rule and includes negotiated service rates and out\-of\-network allowed amounts between health plans and healthcare providers. The machine\-readable files are formatted to allow researchers, regulators, and application developers to more easily access and analyze data.* Please review Stitch Fix's US Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice at Collection here: https://stitchfix.com/careers/workforce\-applicant\-privacy\-policy **Recruiting Fraud Alert:** To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are top of mind for us. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Vulnerability Management Analyst II
jobs.description: **Summa Health****Full\-Time / Benefit Eligible****Remote Opportunity \- Hybrid Preferred** Summa Health is strengthening how we protect the systems our patients and caregivers depend on, and we’re looking for someone who will find the weaknesses before anyone else does. If you’ve worked in vulnerability management, you know the scan results never end and that not every finding deserves the same urgency. We want the person who can tell the difference. You’ll need the judgment to prioritize risk in a clinical environment, where some systems can’t simply be patched and rebooted, and the communication skills to work with engineers, system owners, and clinical teams to get fixes done without disrupting care. We act with urgency, follow through, and own what we find. **Summary** : Under direction of the Manager, Cybersecurity Operations, the Cybersecurity Vulnerability Management Analyst is responsible for performing the tasks that support enterprise vulnerability identification, assessment, prioritization, and remediation tracking across the organization's technology environment, including on\-premises infrastructure, cloud workloads, medical/IoT devices, and third\-party connected systems. Operates and maintains the organization's vulnerability scanning and assessment platform(s) (e.g., Rapid7 InsightVM), executes scheduled and ad hoc scanning activity, validates and triages findings, and applies risk\-based prioritization using industry\-standard scoring methodologies (e.g., CVSS, EPSS) in conjunction with asset criticality and business/clinical impact. Coordinates with Infrastructure, Application Owners, Clinical Engineering, and third\-party vendors to drive timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities and missing patches within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and documents risk exceptions, compensating controls, and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms) for vulnerabilities that cannot be remediated on standard timelines. Monitors emerging Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), vendor security advisories, and threat intelligence to identify organizational exposure ahead of active exploitation, and produces recurring vulnerability management metrics, dashboards, and reporting to support Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) oversight and leadership decision\-making. **1\. Formal Education Required** : a. Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, IT, or Engineering or equivalent combination of education and/or experience. **2\. Experience \& Training Required** : a. Five (5\) years information security experience; Five (5\) years of IT related experience; Experience working in a complex healthcare environment. b. Certifications required: i. CompTIA Security\+ (or equivalent) ii. CompTIA CySA\+ (or equivalent) c. Certifications preferred: i. GIAC Vulnerability Assessor (GVFA) (or equivalent) ii. CompTIA CASP (or equivalent) 3\. Other Skills, Competencies and Qualifications: a) Advanced knowledge of vulnerability scanning and assessment platforms (e.g., Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys) and scan configuration, credentialed/uncredentialed scanning, and agent\-based assessment methods. b) Advanced knowledge of vulnerability scoring frameworks (CVSS v3/v4\) and exploit\-probability models (e.g., EPSS), and their application to remediation prioritization. c) Advanced knowledge of common vulnerability classes (e.g., buffer overflow, injection, misconfiguration, unpatched/end\-of\-life software, insecure default configurations) and their exploitation paths. d) Intermediate knowledge of enterprise patch management processes and tooling (e.g., WSUS, Microsoft Intune/SCCM, Ivanti) and coordination with Infrastructure/Endpoint teams on patch cycles. e) Intermediate knowledge of computer networking concepts and protocols, and network security methodologies (e.g., segmentation, firewalls, IDS/IPS). f) Intermediate knowledge of cloud infrastructure security posture management concepts as applied to vulnerability identification in IaaS/PaaS/SaaS environments. g) Basic knowledge of medical device and operational technology (OT/IoMT) security considerations, including compensating controls where patching is not feasible. h) Basic knowledge of server and client operating systems, and common hardening baselines (e.g., CIS Benchmarks). i) Advanced knowledge of cyber threats, threat actor TTPs, and how emerging CVEs and advisories translate into organizational risk. j) Basic knowledge of laws, regulations, policies, and ethics as they relate to cybersecurity and privacy, including HIPAA Security Rule implications of unremediated vulnerabilities. k) Intermediate skill in triaging scan output, eliminating false positives, and validating exploitability of findings. l) Intermediate skill in developing and tracking remediation plans, risk exceptions, and compensating controls in a GRC risk register. m) Intermediate skill in producing vulnerability management reporting, dashboards, and KPI/metrics packages for technical and executive audiences. n) Basic skill in utilizing virtual collaborative workspaces and/or tools (e.g., SharePoint, Teams, ticketing/ITSM platforms). o) Ability to communicate complex technical findings, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well\-organized manner through verbal, written, and/or visual means. p) Ability to evaluate information for reliability, validity, and relevance, and to synthesize scan data, asset context, and threat intelligence into prioritized remediation guidance. q) Ability to function effectively in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment with competing remediation priorities across clinical and business systems. r) Ability to develop productive working relationships with a broad range of business, clinical, and operational professionals to drive remediation without unilateral authority over their systems. s) Ability to negotiate resolutions for conflicting security and business/clinical operational objectives, including patch\-window and downtime constraints. t) Ability to exemplify Summa Health's core values. u) Ability to take direction and operate independently in moderately ambiguous situations. v) Ability to effectively interact with populations of patients/customers with an understanding of their needs for self\-respect and dignity. 4\. Level of Physical Demands: a. Sedentary: Exerts up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently. b. Minimal, may occasionally move computer equipment (desktop, laptop, monitor, printer, and peripherals) when necessary. *Summa Health System is recognized as one of the region’s top employers by a number of third party organizations, including NorthCoast 99\. Exceptional candidates gravitate to Summa because of its culture, passion for delivering excellent service to our patients and families commitment to our philosophy of servant leadership, collegial working relationships at every level of the organization and competitive pay and benefits.* Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled $41\.15/hr \- $61\.72/hr The salary range on this job posting/advertising is base salary exclusive of any bonuses or differentials. Many factors, such as years of relevant experience and geographical location are considered when determining the starting rate of pay. We believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members when determining offers. Please keep in mind that the range that is listed is the full base salary range. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical. Summa Health offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program to include medical, dental, vision, life, paid time off as well as many other benefits. * Basic Life and Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) * Supplemental Life and AD\&D * Dependent Life Insurance * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability * Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, and Critical Illness * Retirement Savings Plan * Flexible Spending Accounts – Healthcare and Dependent Care * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Identity Theft Protection * Pet Insurance * Education Assistance * Daily Pay

For those based in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle, a hybrid setup is also available.* **About Superhuman** -------------------- Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. Tell us your superpower! **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: * Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) and RRSP matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities Superhuman takes a market\-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary depending on your location. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Core AI
jobs.description: **About Sycamore** ================== Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need. We are a small, engineering\-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders. **Where you could focus** ========================= Core AI owns the horizontal runtime, intelligence, and improvement capabilities that Product and Infrastructure both depend on, along with the Sycamore Forge experiences that make them usable. Engineers here own end\-to\-end slices, from cloud service and API design through the React interface. The team covers four related areas, and you do not have to pick one to apply. Tell us what you have built and we will work out the fit together. **The agent runtime.** Multi\-turn sessions, model routing, tool execution, memory, durable workflows, and the APIs that expose them. The hard part is correctness across long horizons: surviving retries, provider interruptions, partial failure, and context growth without losing the thread. **Harnesses and environments.** An agent that writes and runs code needs somewhere to do it. That environment has to start fast, isolate genuinely untrusted execution, reach only the services it legitimately needs, and carry credentials it can use but never read. The same area owns the verification layer that decides whether what an agent produced actually works rather than only appears to. **Evaluation.** Agent quality is genuinely hard to measure. A change that looks better on a handful of examples often is not, and a judge model can be confidently wrong in the same direction as the system it grades. This is where the offline suites, replay corpora, and statistical discipline that gate a release come from. **Self\-improving systems.** Every agent run produces evidence, and almost all of it is currently thrown away. This area turns it into improvement: structured trajectories at fleet scale, failure clusters surfaced from production rather than guessed at, and proposed changes that are versioned, measured, staged, and reversible. **What you will do** ==================== * Develop the learning data plane around agents: structured trajectories, feedback and outcome signals, offline datasets, lineage, privacy controls, and reliable links between an agent version and its behavior. * Create evaluation systems for task completion, tool use, long\-horizon behavior, safety, latency, and cost, and own the credibility of the numbers they produce. * Design experiment and versioning systems for comparing changes through replay, shadow traffic, canaries, or controlled rollouts, with clear promotion and rollback criteria. * Build durable orchestration for long\-running tasks, checkpoints, approvals, handoffs, and human\-in\-the\-loop interactions, with typed tool interfaces, protocol\-based execution, and memory retrieval that enforces tenant, user, and project visibility boundaries. * Own the execution environments agents run in, including isolation, startup performance, resource limits, and cost, and the policy layer that gates self\-modification so a proposed change is staged and tested rather than applied silently. * Publish reliable APIs, event\-driven interfaces, and reusable libraries that work across agent categories and enterprise deployments. **The environment you will work in** ==================================== Our current Core AI environment includes Python cloud services; React and TypeScript product surfaces in Sycamore Forge; asynchronous and streaming systems; typed APIs and data models; relational and vector data; durable workflows; protocol\-based tool execution; multiple model providers; and cloud\-native deployment. We use coding agents, automated tests, traces, evaluations, browser automation, offline replay, cost and latency signals, and production feedback as part of everyday engineering. We are building toward a governed collect, learn, evaluate, and apply loop rather than a single monolithic training system. This is context, not a checklist. We do not require previous experience with every language, framework, model provider, cloud platform, database, or infrastructure tool in our stack. Comparable experience building distributed runtimes, experimentation platforms, retrieval or recommendation systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or production AI systems is highly relevant. **What we are looking for** =========================== * 5\-12 years of software engineering experience. We will make exceptions for exceptional people in either direction. * Strong backend and distributed\-systems fundamentals, including typed API design, asynchronous workflows, persistence, reliability, and production debugging. * Real depth in at least one of the areas above, and genuine interest in working across the others. * An empirical approach to AI quality: you can form a hypothesis, design a useful evaluation, interpret noisy evidence, and distinguish a real improvement from movement in a proxy metric. * The ability to reason about retries, idempotency, partial failure, long\-running state, concurrency, latency, cost, experiment design, and safe rollout. * A security\-minded approach to multi\-tenant systems, identity, authorization, credentials, tool execution, privacy, and auditability. * Product judgment. You can find a durable abstraction behind a real requirement without generalizing too early or freezing customer\-specific behavior into the platform. * AI\-native. You use coding agents and modern models as a force multiplier while still owning architecture, correctness, evidence, and operational outcomes. * Comfort building product\-facing software. You can work in React and TypeScript when a capability needs a great interface, and reason about streaming state and accessibility. * Comfort with startup ambiguity, fast feedback loops, and broad ownership. None of the following is required, and any of them is a strong signal for a particular area: production Kubernetes work deep enough to have written controllers rather than only configured them; a real understanding of isolation boundaries and what each one does and does not contain; comfort with statistics, including the ways an experiment can mislead you; trajectory or event data at scale, including the joins, lineage, and privacy handling that make it usable; or reinforcement learning, post\-training, or large\-scale experimentation. We care more about the systems you personally built, measured, and operated than a particular company, school, language, or model vendor. **Interview process** ===================== * A 30\-minute introductory conversation. * Two 60\-minute technical interviews, one focused on systems design and one on coding. * A take\-home assignment where you build and present a real solution using the tools you would use on the job. **Why join** ============ * Build the cloud services that help enterprise agents learn from production experience. * Ship Core AI capabilities end to end in Sycamore Forge, from cloud service and API design through the React experience customers use. * Turn production outcomes into governed improvements used across customers. * Shape how feedback\-driven learning, agent evaluation, and safe self\-improvement work in a high\-trust enterprise setting. * Join early enough to shape the Core AI architecture and engineering team. * Receive competitive cash compensation and meaningful equity in the company you are helping build.

jobs.title: Metrology Engineer
jobs.description: Metrology Engineer Position Summary We are looking a hands\-on Metrology Engineer to support dimensional measurement, inspection method development, and metrology equipment capabilities within a manufacturing environment. This individual will be responsible for developing measurement methods, programming and troubleshooting advanced inspection equipment, and ensuring manufactured components and assemblies meet engineering drawings and design specifications. The ideal candidate will have experience with CMM programming, optical/vision measurement systems, CT scanning, GD\&T, and measurement system analysis. This role will work closely with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering teams to improve inspection processes, support production, and maintain measurement accuracy and reliability. Key Responsibilities * Interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and technical specifications using GD\&T principles and ASME standards. * Develop and implement dimensional inspection methods, measurement procedures, and test methods for components, subassemblies, and finished products. * Program, operate, and troubleshoot Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM), optical/vision measurement systems, CT scanners, and form measurement equipment. * Develop and optimize measurement programs for use by quality inspectors and production personnel. * Perform dimensional inspections of molded components and assemblies using advanced metrology equipment and conventional measurement tools. * Troubleshoot equipment, measurement programs, and system malfunctions to minimize inspection downtime and maintain production support. * Conduct measurement system analysis, including Gage Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R\&R) studies, to evaluate measurement accuracy and repeatability. * Analyze measurement data, SPC results, and process capability to identify trends, measurement issues, and opportunities for improvement. * Perform visual and workmanship evaluations of plastic components for defects such as flash, damage, discoloration, and contamination using microscopes and other inspection equipment. * Qualify measurement methods, fixtures, and inspection equipment in collaboration with Quality Engineering and Program Management. * Support the selection and evaluation of measurement equipment, fixtures, programs, and external suppliers. * Train and provide technical guidance to metrology technicians, quality inspectors, and production personnel on CMM, vision systems, and CT scanner operation. * Develop troubleshooting procedures, standard work instructions, and technical training documentation. * Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, and Engineering teams to investigate equipment issues, identify root causes, and implement long\-term corrective actions. * Support equipment downtime investigations, shift escalations, and manufacturing process improvement initiatives. * Maintain accurate measurement records, equipment documentation, jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: ### **About Takt** Takt is a warehouse intelligence platform that unifies labor, automation, and robotics data so 3PLs, retailers, and e\-commerce companies can run more efficient operations. Warehouses generate enormous amounts of data and most of it never reaches the people doing the work. We build the software that closes that gap, giving supervisors and frontline employees the information they need, when they need it, on the floor where decisions actually get made. Our software runs every shift, every day, in real facilities for leading brands including Macy’s, Target, Stitch Fix, Flexport, ODW Logistics, and CarParts.com. ### **About the Role** We’re hiring a senior backend engineer to design and build the distributed systems at the core of the Takt platform. Warehouses produce large, fast\-moving datasets from labor systems, automation, and robotics, and our backend turns that stream into the real\-time operational views our customers run their shifts on. Our services are written in Go, Python, and Node.js and run on Google Kubernetes Engine across multiple regions. You’ll work across all three, picking the one that fits the problem. This is a senior role with real architectural ownership. Our engineering team is small and works together to solve problems; you’ll work directly with our CTO and Director of Engineering, shape how the platform scales, and mentor other engineers as the team grows. Security is top of mind in everything we build: our customers trust us with operational data from their facilities, and we design for that trust from the first line of code. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and operate scalable backend services in Go, Python, and Node.js that power the Takt platform. * Build integrations that bring in data from warehouse management, labor, automation, and robotics systems, and keep them reliable when upstream systems change or fail. * Deploy and run services on Google Kubernetes Engine across multi\-region environments, designing for availability, failover, and data locality. * Model, store, and query data at scale with Google Cloud Spanner and Google BigQuery, working with large operational datasets from real warehouse systems. * Design APIs and data pipelines that serve real\-time views to web, TV, kiosk, and mobile experiences on the floor. * Build with security top of mind: least\-privilege access, safe data handling, and designs that hold up in SOC 2 and GDPR audits. * Own services end to end, from design and documentation through deployment, monitoring, and incident follow\-through. * Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code review, and pairing as the team grows. ### **How We Build** We’re an AI\-forward engineering team. Every engineer gets a monthly AI tools budget for Claude, Cursor, and whatever else makes you better, and we expect you to use it. AI\-assisted development isn’t a shortcut here; it’s how we work. As a senior engineer, you’ll help set the standard for using these tools well: reviewing generated code critically, understanding what ships under your name, and building guardrails so the whole team can move fast safely. ### **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience. * Deep, hands\-on experience building production services in at least one of Go, Python, or Node.js (TypeScript), and the willingness to work across all three. * A track record of designing and operating scalable distributed systems, and reasoning clearly about consistency, latency, and failure modes. * Experience running services on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, ideally GKE on Google Cloud. * Strong SQL skills: writing, optimizing, and debugging queries against large production datasets is a must. * Experience with large datasets and the databases that serve them; Spanner and BigQuery experience is a strong plus, as is depth in comparable systems. * A security mindset applied by default: least privilege, safe handling of customer data, and pragmatic risk trade\-offs. * Ownership and drive: you take ambiguity and run with it, communicate clearly, and leave systems better documented than you found them. ### **Nice to Have** * Production experience in more than one of Go, Python, and Node.js. * Experience with multi\-region architectures and the trade\-offs of replication, failover, and data residency. * Experience with streaming or batch data pipelines, such as Dataflow. * Familiarity with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and infrastructure as code. * Prior startup experience, or comfort owning a domain rather than a slice of one. * Curiosity about logistics, warehousing, or how physical operations actually run. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this role is $150,000 – $180,000, depending on experience. Benefits include: * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) with employer match. * Unlimited PTO. * A monthly AI tools budget for every engineer. * A top\-of\-the\-line MacBook Pro, dual 4K monitors, and your choice of keyboard and mouse at your desk in the office. ### **Interview Process** Two phone screens, followed by an onsite in our Reston office with four to five interviews. We’ll keep you informed at every step; no black holes. ### **Location** Takt is based in Reston, VA, with our office located next to the Wiehle\-Reston East Metro station on the Silver Line. We’re looking for local candidates who can be in the office at least four days a week; we build together. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. ### **Our Commitment** Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is core to Takt’s values. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a supportive place to work. Takt will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits of employment. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Our technical teams rack, power, cool, cable, configure, and troubleshoot the GPU clusters that customers train and serve models on. We are hiring an AI Infrastructure Engineer to be the technical depth of that team. This role spans the full stack of a GPU deployment: you will install and commission the hardware, configure the Linux hosts and the InfiniBand or RoCE fabric that connects them, and own the Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets that no one else can close. When a node fails repeatedly, you are the person who finds out why. This is a hands\-on role. You will still be in the aisle with a torque wrench during deployment windows. You will also write the runbook that prevents the next escalation, tune the fabric that shaved 8% off a customer’s job time, and sit in the vendor call explaining why their firmware is the root cause. The work is hybrid. Deployment windows, hardware break\-fix, and physical layer work happen on site. Configuration, diagnostics, ticket ownership, automation, and documentation can happen from wherever you work best. What you’ll do Escalation and root cause ownership * Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets end to end — accept escalations from Tier 1 and support teams, drive them to resolution, and close them with a documented cause rather than a reboot. * Perform root cause analysis on server hardware failures: correlate IPMI/BMC event logs, MCE and EDAC records, kernel messages, thermal and power telemetry, and vendor diagnostics to distinguish a genuine component failure from firmware, configuration, environmental, or workload causes. * Identify recurring failure patterns across the fleet — a DIMM slot that fails repeatedly, a firmware revision correlated with GPU falloff, a rack with marginal airflow — and drive the systemic fix. * Lead or contribute to post\-incident reviews; translate findings into monitoring, runbook, and standards changes. * Serve as the technical escalation point for vendors: build the evidence package, defend the diagnosis, and manage RMA and field\-service engagements through to closure. * Communicate directly with customers during open incidents and maintenance windows, not only after the fact: status while the issue is live, the notice before a window, and the confirmation after it closes. Concise and factual, with no speculation about cause before it is established. * Direct colocation remote hands in writing, to the level of cabinet, rack unit, port, and cable label, and verify the result remotely before accepting the work as done. * Participate in a shared on\-call rotation for infrastructure incidents. **GPU systems and troubleshooting** * Administer and troubleshoot GPU compute nodes — NVIDIA H100/H200/B200/B300 SXM and PCIe platforms, AMD Instinct, or comparable accelerators. * Diagnose GPU\-level faults using vendor tooling: nvidia\-smi, DCGM and DCGM diagnostics, XID error interpretation, NVLink and NVSwitch health, ECC and row\-remapping events, thermal and power throttling analysis. * Install, update, and validate GPU drivers, CUDA toolkits, fabric manager, and container runtimes; manage version compatibility across the fleet. * Run and interpret node validation and burn\-in — NCCL tests, bandwidth and all\-reduce benchmarks, GPU stress tests — before handing capacity to customers. * Investigate performance degradation that is not an outright failure: straggler nodes, reduced collective bandwidth, PCIe link width or speed downgrades, NUMA and topology misconfiguration. **Network administration: AI fabric and tenant connectivity** * Configure and administer high\-performance AI fabrics — InfiniBand (NDR/HDR) and RoCEv2 Ethernet — including switch configuration, firmware management, and topology validation. * Operate InfiniBand subnet management: subnet manager configuration and failover, partitioning (P\_Keys), routing engine selection, and topology verification against the intended fat\-tree or rail\-optimized design. * Troubleshoot fabric health with UFM and the OFED toolchain — ibdiagnet, ibnetdiscover, perfquery, port counters — to isolate symbol errors, link flaps, degraded optics, and bad cables to a specific port. * Tune and validate RoCE deployments: PFC and ECN configuration, lossless queue setup, and congestion control behavior under collective traffic. * Configure and maintain host\-side networking: RDMA and OFED stacks, NIC and HCA firmware, adapter tuning, bonding, VLANs, and out\-of\-band management networks. * Validate fabric performance after deployment and after change and maintain accurate port maps and topology documentation. * Operate the tenant\-facing side of the network alongside the AI fabric: VLANs and trunking, LACP port\-channels across an MLAG or VLT switch pair, enterprise switch CLI, and the firewall, NAT, VPN, DHCP, and DNS configuration that customer connectivity depends on. Verify tenant segmentation and isolation against the design before capacity is handed over. **Linux systems administration** * Administer the Linux fleet ( uns, serials, port maps, firmware inventory, and lifecycle state. * Write and refine runbooks, install standards, and validation checklists so deployments are repeatable rather than improvised. **What you bring** * 4–7 years combining data center or infrastructure operations with Linux systems administration; time spent in both the aisle and the terminal. * Strong Linux administration skills in a production environment — RHEL, Rocky, or Ubuntu — including kernel and driver management, storage, networking, and shell\-level diagnostics. * Hands\-on experience with a bare\-metal provisioning system as an operator, not just an installer, including diagnosing nodes that fail to enlist, PXE, or commission. Comfort using Redfish and IPMI as automation interfaces for power, boot order, and firmware, not only as sources of event logs. * Demonstrated Tier 2/3 escalation experience: you have been the person a ticket lands on when the first two people could not solve it. * Server hardware root cause analysis experience — reading BMC, IPMI, and system event logs and correlating them with kernel and application symptoms to reach a defensible cause. * Hands\-on experience with high\-performance or data center networking: InfiniBand, RoCE, or high\-speed Ethernet fabrics, including switch configuration and link\-level troubleshooting. * Working knowledge of production L2 and L3 networking beyond the AI fabric, enough to isolate whether a customer problem is host, switch, firewall, or upstream. * Experience administering or supporting GPU or accelerated compute systems, including driver stacks and vendor diagnostic tooling. * Solid data center fundamentals: power distribution and redundancy, cooling and airflow, structured cabling, and rack layout. * Scripting ability in Python or Bash, and comfort with configuration management such as Ansible. * Clear technical writing — incident summaries, runbooks, and RCA document a customer or an executive can read. * Experience as the customer\-facing technical contact during a live incident, and experience directing remote hands or field technicians in writing at a site you are not standing in. * Availability for on\-call rotation and occasional after\-hours maintenance windows. **Nice to have** * Production experience with large\-scale GPU clusters — multi\-rack SXM deployments, NVLink/NVSwitch topologies, or rail\-optimized fabric designs. * Deep InfiniBand experience: UFM, subnet manager tuning, ibdiagnet\-driven fault isolation, adaptive routing, or SHARP. * Familiarity with HPC and AI workload schedulers — Slurm, Kubernetes with GPU operators, or Run:ai — and how scheduling interacts with node health. * Experience with parallel or high\-performance storage (Lustre, GPFS, WEKA, VAST, or NFS over RDMA). • Exposure to liquid\-cooled and high\-density deployments — rear\-door heat exchangers, direct\-to\-chip, CDUs. • Observability stack experience: Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM exporter, Elasticsearch, or equivalent. * Certifications such as RHCE or RHCSA, NVIDIA networking or InfiniBand credentials, CompTIA Server\+/Network\+, or Uptime Institute DCCA/DCCS. * Experience in a growth\-stage environment where standards are being written rather than inherited. **Working conditions and physical requirements** Part of this role is performed in an operating data center. Candidates should be able to, with or without reasonable accommodation: * Lift and maneuver equipment up to 50 lbs unassisted, and heavier items with team or lift assist. • Work at heights on ladders and in confined spaces, including under raised floors and in overhead cable trays. * Stand, walk, kneel, and reach for extended periods in an environment with sustained noise, cold aisles, and limited natural light. * Wear required PPE and follow all electrical and site safety procedures. **Compensation and benefits** ● Negotiable – Depending on Experience Pay: From $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Internal Tool Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Terranova** ------------------- Terranova is a hard\-tech company developing innovative systems to reshape the physical world. We combine mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, and real\-world field operations to tackle complex engineering challenges. We're looking for an **AI Tool Engineer** to help us build smarter, more efficient ways of working across our engineering, manufacturing, and field operations. **About the Role** ------------------ As an AI Tool Engineer at Terranova, you'll develop practical AI\-powered tools, software, and analytical models that improve how our team designs, builds, tests, and operates complex machinery. This is a highly hands\-on role focused on solving real engineering and operational problems. You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software, and field engineers to identify inefficiencies, automate repetitive workflows, and turn operational data into actionable insights. We're looking for someone who can independently identify opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and deploy tools that make a measurable difference in how the company operates. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **AI Tools \& Workflow Automation** * Design and build internal AI\-powered tools that streamline engineering, manufacturing, and operational workflows. * Identify repetitive, manual, or cumbersome processes and develop software solutions to automate them. * Integrate AI tools with existing engineering software, databases, documentation, and operational systems. * Build internal applications that help engineers and operators access information, make decisions, and complete tasks more efficiently. **Data Analysis \& Process Optimization** * Develop systems to collect, track, and analyze metrics across shop operations, equipment performance, and field activities. * Analyze field injection data, including flow rates, pressures, material consumption, ground uplift, and operational efficiency. * Build dashboards, reporting tools, and data pipelines to visualize performance and identify opportunities for improvement. * Help quantify engineering and manufacturing processes to establish benchmarks, monitor performance, and reduce inefficiencies. * Develop models to predict operational outcomes, improve process parameters, and support engineering decisions. **Modeling \& Applied AI** * Build and deploy machine learning, statistical, and predictive models for engineering applications. * Use LLMs, AI agents, and other emerging technologies to automate complex workflows and improve internal productivity. * Develop tools for analyzing experimental results, identifying trends, and optimizing system performance. * Explore new applications of AI across robotics, manufacturing, equipment monitoring, and field operations. **Cross\-Functional Engineering** * Work directly with engineers, technicians, and operators to understand challenges and develop practical solutions. * Take projects from problem identification through prototyping, implementation, and iteration. * Build lightweight, maintainable tools that can be deployed quickly and improved based on real\-world feedback. * Proactively identify opportunities where software, data, or AI can improve the company's efficiency and capabilities. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Strong proficiency in Python and experience building software tools, automation scripts, and data\-processing pipelines. * Experience working with LLM APIs, AI agents, machine learning frameworks, or applied AI systems. * Ability to build end\-to\-end applications, from data ingestion and backend logic to simple user interfaces. * Strong data analysis skills, including SQL, Pandas, and statistical modeling. * Experience integrating APIs, databases, and third\-party software platforms. * Comfortable working with messy, incomplete, or unstructured real\-world data. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to independently take loosely defined problems and turn them into working solutions. * Interest in physical engineering systems, manufacturing, robotics, or industrial operations. * Ability to work closely with multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical concepts clearly. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with industrial automation, PLCs, sensors, or equipment telemetry. * Familiarity with mechanical engineering, fluid systems, hydraulics, or manufacturing processes. * Experience with time\-series data, predictive modeling, or optimization algorithms. * Experience developing computer vision applications for industrial monitoring or quality control. * Familiarity with CAD software, engineering simulations, or engineering data pipelines. * Experience deploying internal tools using modern web frameworks and cloud services. **Why Terranova?** ------------------ At Terranova, you'll have the opportunity to apply AI to real\-world engineering problems rather than building software in isolation. Your work will directly influence how physical systems are designed, manufactured, tested, and operated. You'll have significant ownership over projects, the freedom to experiment with new technologies, and the ability to see your solutions implemented in the shop and in the field. We're looking for a builder who enjoys moving quickly, solving ambiguous problems, and using AI and software to make complex engineering operations more efficient.

jobs.title: SAP Principal Pre-Sales & Delivery Architect
jobs.description: **About Tessera Labs** Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera combines the reliability of an integrator with the speed of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. **Role Summary** We are looking for an SAP Principal Pre\-Sales \& Delivery Architect to hold the solution direction across several customer engagements at the same time, from the first customer conversation through delivery. This is not a project role, and it is not a consulting role: we are a software platform company. Two outcomes define the job. The first is that the customer sees value, stated in their terms, agreed in writing, and tracked. The second is that the customer's own teams adopt the Tessera platform as their normal way of working, rather than working around it. The second is what makes the first durable, and it is the measure you will be held to. The role also sits partly ahead of delivery in pre\-sales. You will join early customer and partner conversations together with the Tessera client partner, because an architect who only sees signed work designs for the problem we solved last year. What you learn there is expected to change how you run the engagements you already hold, and what we ask Product to build next. SAP is where most of our engagements start, and deep SAP judgment is what the role needs on day one. It is not where they stop. Our platform spans ERP, CRM, HCM and SCM, and integrations of orbital systems with SAP and your design view is expected to widen with it. This role owns the proposal definition, solution build and solution delivery with AI across several SAP engagements/ accounts — how it is shaped in the sales cycle, how it is designed, and how it lands. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Solution Direction Across Engagements (35%)** * Own the functional and architectural direction on several concurrent engagements, including the trade\-offs between what the customer asked for and what will actually create value. * Orchestrate the engagement team across functional, technical, data and other AI enabled workstreams — you are the person who holds the whole picture when nobody else does. * Translate customer business outcomes into a solution shape the Tessera AI platform can deliver — and say clearly, early, when it cannot. Provide feedback to the Tessera product platform team for new R\&D initiatives. * Agree what "better" means with each customer before execution starts: measurable, written, and owned by a named person on their side. * Hold the line between business intent and technical design, working directly with Forward Deployed Engineers, Tessera AI agents and customer architects. * Act as the counterpart our Technical Program Managers come to first, and get a straight answer from. **2\. Pre\-Sales, Go\-to\-Market and Product Input (30%)** * Lead the solution definition and approach in early customer and partner conversations. Shape opportunities before they are scoped — approach, effort and risk — and tell our go\-to\-market teams what is real and what is not. * Own the SAP solution story in proposals and statements of work, alongside the sales team/client partner and the Forward Deployed Engineers who run platform demonstrations. * Bring the forward view back into live engagements and adjust how we run them. * Close the loop with Product: turn field findings into Tessera platform product input, so one fix and new features \& functions serves many customers instead of one. * Contribute your SAP domain know\-how back into the Tessera platform, so the agents get better at this work with every engagement. **3\. Customer Platform Adoption (25%)** * Own customer platform adoption as a deliverable, not a hope. Make Tessera capabilities the default path for the customer's teams and retire the workarounds. * Define what adoption means on each engagement, measure it, and report it alongside delivery status. * Find where adoption stalls — process, skills, trust, or product gap — and fix the cause rather than the symptom. * Build the customer\-side advocates who carry the platform after we step back. **4\. Engagement Shaping and Workforce Rationalization (10%)** * Decide what an eng nt\-facing presence: able to hold a room of customer architects, business owners and finance stakeholders, and to say no to a customer in a way that keeps the relationship. * A record of driving adoption, not just go\-live: evidence that the customer's teams kept using what you delivered. * 15\+ years in enterprise transformation with an SAP foundation (ECC and S/4HANA), spanning several process such as Finance and Logistics areas rather than depth in only one — enough judgment to design across finance, supply chain and order management, and to know when to bring in a specialist. Experience in several end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA implementations across Greenfield/ Brownfield/ Selective Data Transition approach and very familiar with the key challenges and major activities for each transition path. * Solid technical architecture knowledge: integration patterns, data architecture, and how an SAP landscape actually fits together, including SAP BTP and integration with non\-SAP systems. Have a good understanding of SAP Business AI roadmap. You can hold your own in a room full of engineers. * The confidence to tell a program it is over\-staffed, and the evidence to back it. * Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months. * Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences. * Demonstrated experience leading distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline. * Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Who This Role Is Not For** If your experience is deep configuration inside one or two process areas, this is not the role — we hire specialists for that work and you would be underused here. If your pre\-sales experience is running the demo rather than owning the solution, the same applies. And if you prefer one engagement at a time with a clear scope agreed by someone else, you will find this uncomfortable. We are asking for a senior architect who is at ease holding several unfinished things at once in various stages of the sales cycle and delivery. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience across more than one enterprise suite — ERP, CRM, HCM or SCM. SAP is the entry point, not the whole picture. * Experience across more than one SAP S/4HANA transition path (Greenfield, Brownfield, Selective Data Transition). * Prior experience partnering with AI, automation or RPA tooling inside an enterprise delivery context. * Experience working within the SAP partner and co\-sell ecosystem, including RISE with SAP. * SAP Activate methodology experience across multiple full\-lifecycle S/4HANA programs. * SAP certifications, for example in S/4HANA Finance, Sourcing and Procurement, or SAP Activate. * Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus. **First\-Year Measures of Success** * **Month 3:** Fluent in the Tessera platform. Holding at least two engagements. Trusted by the Technical Program Management and sales client partners on those accounts. * **Month 6:** Value targets agreed and tracked on every engagement you hold. Adoption measured and improving. A steady flow of field input reaching Tessera product platform R\&D. Owning the solution on at least two new SAP opportunities. * **Month 12:** Tessera AI Platform client user adoption on your accounts is the norm rather than the exception. Your engagement teams are sized on evidence. Your read of where customers are heading has changed at least one thing in how we deliver or what we build. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs' name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $147K \- $212K

jobs.description: **Job Title** Associate/Full Professor of Electrical Engineering**Agency** Texas A\&M University \- Texarkana**Department** College of Engineering and Computing \- Engineering**Proposed Minimum Salary** Commensurate**Job Location** Texarkana, Texas**Job Type** Faculty**Job Description** The College of Engineering and Computing invites applications for a full\-time, nine\-month, tenure\-track faculty position at the rank of Associate/Full Professor of Electrical Engineering who will contribute to both the Electrical Engineering and Computer Engineering programs, with an anticipated start date of Fall 2027\. support the development, safe operation, and improvement of electrical engineering teaching and research laboratories. * Serve on division, college, and university committees. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES:** **Minimum Qualifications** * An earned Ph.D. in electrical/computer engineering or a closely related field. * A record of, or demonstrated potential for, effective teaching in electrical and computer engineering courses and laboratories. * A record of active and impactful research, scholarly publication, and external funding appropriate to the rank sought. * Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a growing college. * For appointment at the Associate Professor rank, a record of teaching, scholarship, and service that meets Texas A\&M University Texarkana standards for appointment at that rank; normally, this includes at least five (5\) years of successful service at the Assistant Professor rank or equivalent experience. * For appointment at the Professor rank, a record of teaching, scholarship, and service that meets Texas A\&M University Texarkana standards for appointment at that rank; normally, this includes at least five (5\) years of successful service at the Associate Professor rank or equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Ability to teach and develop courses relevant to electrical and computer engineering, with demonstrated expertise in one or more areas, including robotics, control systems, artificial intelligence, or intelligent systems. * Experience with curriculum development, innovative and experiential teaching practices, and the development, commissioning, or operation of electrical engineering laboratories. * Familiarity with ABET accreditation, outcomes\-based assessment, and continuous program improvement. * Evidence of the ability to engage undergraduate students in research, design, and industry\-sponsored projects. * Professional Engineering (PE) licensure or eligibility to obtain the PE license. * Experience with program development. **Other Requirements** * Eligibility to work in the United States at the time of hire. No pre\-employment sponsorship is authorized for this position. * Ability to travel or work beyond normal office hours when required for program activities. * Ability to maintain confidentiality in academic and student matters. **SUPERVISION OF PERSONNEL:** This position generally does not supervise employees. **ABOUT TEXAS A\&M UNIVERSITY TEXARKANA** Texas A\&M University Texarkana is a regional comprehensive university committed to academic excellence, student success, applied research, and service to the communities of Northeast Texas and the surrounding region. jobs.description: **Position Overview** The Senior Data Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing enterprise data solutions that enable data\-driven decision\-making and operations across TMRS. This role partners with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable data pipelines, reporting solutions, and advanced analytics capabilities powered by artificial intelligence and machine learning.**Key Responsibilities*** Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions aligned with organizational objectives. * Build and optimize scalable data pipelines and cloud\-based data solutions using modern SaaS and PaaS platforms. * Develop and tune complex queries using T\-SQL, PL/SQL, and Python to support ETL/ELT processes. * Create and maintain reliable data repositories, ensuring accurate data lineage and integrity across cloud environments. * Lead enterprise AI and machine learning initiatives, including integration and operationalization of models. * Enforce data governance standards, including data quality, data classification, retention, and access controls in alignment with organizational policies. * Ensure proper data usage controls for AI, including approved data sources, data privacy, and secure handling of sensitive information. * Establish and maintain end\-to\-end model lifecycle management processes, including version control, validation and approval processes, deployment standards, continuous performance monitoring (e.g., drift and accuracy), and scheduled periodic reviews with documented outcomes. * Collaborate using Agile methodologies and tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and Git to support iterative development and delivery. * Ability to use and integrate approved AI solutions * After hours support as needed * Other duties as assigned **Physical Requirements** Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force. Ability to perform the essential job functions safely and successfully consistent with federal, state, and local standards.**Qualities We Are Looking For*** Demonstrates strong initiative and ownership by proactively identifying and addressing gaps. * Exhibits a servant leadership mindset, focused on enabling others and removing obstacles to success. * Drives meaningful impact with a strong focus on outcomes and results. * Actively listens to customers and stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into effective solutions. * Consistently produces high\-quality work with strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Demonstrates curiosity and a commitment to lifelong learning and continuous improvement * Invests in the growth of others by sharing knowledge, coaching, and mentoring. * Interacts with excellence, modeling self\-control, integrity, and kindness to foster a collaborative and respectful environment **Education and Experience****Required*** 7\+ years of experience delivering data solutions, analytics, and reporting within cloud\-based environments * Proven experience leading technical projects from intake through design, development, and implementation * Demonstrated ability to translate business needs and stakeholder requests into complex technical requirements * Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for data engineering, transformation, and analysis * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Self\-driven with a strong attention to detail; able to perform structured problem\-solving in a collaborative team environment * Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, information systems, engineering, actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, or related field. **Preferred** * Previous implementation of data and analytics solutions using Microsoft Synapse Analytics * Experience implementing large language models (LLMs) and managing model versioning, including prompt/version control, evaluation tracking, continuous monitoring, and deployment lifecycle management. **CERTIFICATES AND LICENSES** **Preferred*** Microsoft Azure Data certifications * Microsoft Azure AI certifications **TMRS Overview** Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) is a trusted partner to more than 900 cities across Texas, providing retirement, disability, and survivor benefits to over 260,000 public servants and their families. We are proud to be recognized as an example of fiduciary excellence through our management of more than $44 billion in Trust Fund assets. At TMRS, every role supports our mission: providing secure lifetime income to our members. Our work gives back to communities across Texas, and we take pride in doing it with integrity, accountability, and a commitment to excellence.**Compensation and Benefits** * Starting base salary (based on experience and qualifications) * Participation in TMRS pension plan, with a 2:1 organization match * Optional participation in a 457(b) deferred compensation plan * Medical, dental, and vision insurance at no cost to employees * Hybrid work opportunities; 12 paid holidays; generous leave * Modern, centrally located Austin office * Thoughts and ideas clearly and concisely. * You are a neighbor. You live within a commutable distance to TMRS’ office and will work in the office at least three days/week. There are remote work opportunities, but this is not a remote position. TMRS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Junior Technical Designer
jobs.description: **Location:** Albany, NY **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Target Salary Range\*:** $85,000 \- $105,000\. * This represents the potential salary range for this position depending on education level, years of experience and/or certifications in addition to other position specific requirements which may impact salary **Position Overview:** ====================== The work you’ll do will be impactful to the mission of our NYS customer. You will play a crucial role as you join our team in partnership with New York State of Health (NYSoH) to provide comprehensive health coverage to more than 7\.0 million New Yorkers through its Health Benefit Exchange (HBE) The Junior Technical Designer supports the design, development, and enhancement of application components within the NYSOH platform. Working under the guidance of Senior Technical Designers and the Technical Design Manager, this role assists with creating technical documents, developing application features, analyzing issues, and ensuring technical solutions follow established standards. The Junior Technical Designer contributes to building high\-quality code and technical designs while growing skills in enterprise\-level software development. **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- **Technical Design Support** * Assist Senior Technical Designers in preparing technical design documents, including class diagrams, sequence diagrams, API specifications, and database models. * Help translate functional and non\-functional requirements into preliminary technical designs. * Support design sessions by taking notes, preparing documentation, and completing assigned design activities. * Contribute to development of application components using Java, Spring, Hibernate, REST/SOAP services, and DB2 under supervision. **Application Development \& Coding** * Implement assigned application features, enhancements, and fixes following established coding standards and best practices. * Develop and maintain basic application workflows, integration components, and rule logic using Drools DRL and industry\-standard patterns. * Support creation of authentication and authorization modules for various user roles. * Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to strengthen technical quality and maintainability. **Issue Analysis \& Troubleshooting** * Assist with defect triage by gathering logs, reproducing issues, and documenting findings. * Support root cause analysis efforts led by Senior Technical Designers, helping identify logic errors, design gaps, or requirement inconsistencies. * Contribute to preparing solution options, documentation, and basic impact assessments. * Implement approved fixes and workarounds under guidance from senior team members. **Collaboration \& Team Support** * Participate in daily status meetings with Project Managers, Architects, and development teams to report progress and discuss challenges. * Work closely with mid\-level and senior developers to clarify tasks, understand requirements, and ensure aligned technical delivery. * Assist in maintaining technical documentation and updating design artifacts as changes occur. * Provide support for POCs by researching tools, preparing prototypes, and documenting results. **Continuous Learning \& Improvement** * Stay current with relevant technologies, design practices, and development methodologies used in the NYSOH application stack. * Seek mentorship from Senior Technical Designers and Technical Design Managers to enhance technical competencies. * Apply Java design patterns and engineering principles to improve code reliability and quality. * Learn emerging engineering techniques, design patterns, and best practices relevant to NYSOH systems. * Use approved AI tools to support code review, impact analysis, test case generation, and exploration of design options, validating results with senior oversight. **Qualifications:** ------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field. * 3–6 years of software development or technical design experience (internships and academic projects accepted). * Familiarity with Java, Spring, Hibernate, REST/SOAP Web Services, and relational databases. * Exposure to rule engines (Drools), API design, or enterprise application frameworks is a plus. * Strong desire to learn and develop technical design skills in a large\-scale system. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication abilities. * Experience using AI tools for technical analysis or development support is a plus. * Ability to follow instructions, ask clarifying questions, and collaborate effectively with senior technical staff.
