jobs.title: Digital Product Manager - Obie Insurance
jobs.description: **At Obie, we don’t just insure properties — we ensure progress.** With advanced technology, real\-time data, and a vast network of agents and partners, we help real estate investors and landlords get insurance coverage whenever and wherever they need it. Thousands of owners nationwide trust us to be the insurance experts, so they don’t have to be. Joining our team means embracing a fast\-moving environment driven by innovation, collaboration, and constant progress. We learn quickly, iterate often, and celebrate wins together. If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you. Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays. **Brief Summary of Role** We’re looking for an experienced, hands\-on Product Manager who loves figuring out how things work and can’t wait to make them better. You’ll join our growing team as an individual contributor, turning messy, technically complex problems into solutions and products that people actually use \- and checking that they made a difference! You don’t need prior insurance experience; curiosity, ownership, and strong product judgement matter most. You’ll own a meaningful product area end\-to\-end: bring your own point of view, get clear on why it matters to customers and the business, and build it with Design and Engineering. You enjoy turning “could we…?” into a working first version. You’ll think across customers, agents, internal teams, and interconnected systems. Initial ownership is open, with room to contribute access domains as priorities evolve. You’re the person who asks, “What does the data say?” and then goes looking, talking to customers and teammates along the way. You can explain tradeoffs, make timely decisions with incomplete information, and follow through on results after launch. You’re curious beyond the current tools and playbook. If you find a smarter way to do something, you’re eager to try it with the team and share what worked (and what didn’t). **What you'll Do** * **You’ll be a product owner:** Take a problem from “we should…” to shipped, used, and improved. The backlog is a part of the job, not the finish line. Shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area, define KPIs and success upfront, and use business and customer evidence to prioritize. You can point to work you’ve owned through multiple iterations and explain what changed as you learned. * **You’re the best listener in the room:** Seek out customer insight, relevant data, and cross\-functional input without treating every request as a requirement. Weigh options, make tradeoffs visible, and explain both what you recommend and what you choose not to do. You know which decisions need a deeper dive and which need a sensible call so the team can keep building. * **You get that product building is a team sport:** Build trust across Engineering, Design, Technical Project Management, QA, operations, and business partners. Bring people into decisions early, navigate disagreement, and create clarity that helps others execute with confidence. You’re happy to own the hard call, share the credit, and jump in when a fellow PM needs a hand. Making the team better is part of the fun. * **You’re mission first:** You get stuff done. Help the team turn business priorities into clear work that’s ready to build, without getting stuck in planning limbo. Balance larger bets with smaller, high\-leverage improvements, remove avoidable process drag, and keep attention on outcomes. You’ve improved the flow, clarity, or quality or work reaching engineering and can show how you evaluated results after launch. * **You can get your hands dirty:** Turn complex problems into clear, buildable work with Design and Engineering. Bring experience with technically deep products, such as APIs, integrations, data pipelines, or Salesforce’y systems. You’ll happily dig into an API spec or sketch a workflow in Figma to understand what’s going on under the hood. Learn enough to ask good questions, spot constraints, and sequence the work \- and notice when the UX still feels clunky. * **You can work async:** You don’t need someone hovering over your shoulder to move things forward. Own decisions as context shifts, and leave a trail your teammates can actually follow: research, decisions, metrics, and open questions that are easy to find and use. You can show who a written artifact or stakeholder conversation clarified a complex decision, resolved disagreement, or enabled others to act. * **Nice to have:** Experience in insurance, insurtech, fintech, or another regulated environment; Salesforce, data products, carrier/partner integrations, or workflow\-heavy B2B software; or balancing platform work with customer facing improvements. Have you built a scrappy AI prototype, tinkered with an agent, or found a better way to show an engineer what you mean? We’d love to hear about it! These are help additions,  t. * **Interview Process** At Obie, transparency is core to our interview process. We focus on open communication and a positive experience; no trick questions—just honest conversations about your skills and aspirations. To help you prepare, please familiarize yourself with these resources before moving forward: * Our company’s blog to learn more about the market we serve and the information our customers value. * Check out our LinkedIn to see how people interact with our brand and product. * Press and podcast features like Inc. 5000 , TechCrunch , Innovate State , Uncontested Investing Podcast , Insurtech Amplified Podcast * Meet us and get to know Obie You'll first talk to Kara on a 30\-minute call to determine whether we’re a good fit for one another. You’ll learn more about Obie and have the chance to ask about our company, team, culture, and product. * Meet the hiring manager Next, you'll have a 45 minute video interview with the hiring manager, Adam Tsouras , to assess your technical skills. * Complete a Project Exercise This role requires strong planning, collaboration, and communication skills, so we'll also present you with a short exercise to complete to provide you a chance to flex those muscles. You will be able to complete this exercise on your own time, so please be thorough and use the resources available to you. We'll be looking to see your problem solving abilities, writing and communication skills, empathy, general demeanor, and ability to leverage key product management strategies. More on this when you get there! * Meet the Team Since you'll be joining a close\-knit team, we'll ask you to meet other people in the company so we get to know each other a bit better **Moving Forward with Obie** Obie is a leading insurance platform for real estate investors, combining proprietary technology with a modern insurance experience to simplify Home and Landlord insurance. Today, we serve customers nationwide through direct digital experiences, a growing network of insurance agents, and strategic partnerships with lenders, property management platforms, and real estate technology companies. As part of The Baldwin Group, one of the nation's leading insurance distribution platforms and a USA TODAY Top Workplace, we're combining the agility of a fast\-growing technology company with the scale, resources, and career opportunities of a larger organization as we shape the future of investment property insurance. **Obie has you Covered** Being in the insurance industry, we understand the importance of comprehensive benefits for you and your family. These are just some of the benefits and perks we provide: * Comprehensive health, dental, vision and life insurance * Flexible paid time off Retirement savings plan with company match * Obie values transparency and data driven decision making, enabling us to have a consistent and equitable approach to compensation. We are informed by a benchmarking tool which provides real time compensation data allowing us to regularly check our salary ranges against other venture backed companies and startups within our industry. We've provided the full base salary range for this role below, but please note that we typically target the mid point of the salary range to allow room for growth within the role. Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of relevant experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations. The pay range for this role is: 90,000 \- 130,000 USD per year (Remote (United States)) The Baldwin Group will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate who applies on our career site. Any unsolicited resumes sent to The Baldwin Group, including unsolicited resumes sent via any source from an Agency, will not be considered and are not subject to any fees for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.

jobs.title: Engineer, IT Disaster Recovery - IT Infrastructure - Full Time (Hybrid)
jobs.description: ***Summary:*** *The Engineer, IT Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity (DR\-BCP) is responsible for the design, implementation, support and maintenance of disaster recovery and business continuity critical to healthcare operations including patient care, clinical applications, and administrative functions for The Guthrie Clinic (TGC). This role focuses on developing and testing DR\-BCP plans and playbooks to minimize downtime and ensure rapid recovery in the event of disruptions.* *The* *Engineer collaborates with IT teams, vendors, and hospital stakeholders to ensure the operational resilience for TGC. This position will be a technology advocate throughout the organization for the effective application of technology to meet business needs and to support business changes and growth*. ***Experience:*** * *Preferred three to five (3 to 5\) years of experience in implementing and managing DR and BCP processes in an enterprise environment; healthcare experience preferred.* * *Highly experienced information systems professional with a strong technical background and proven track record of accomplishments in a large, complex multi\-level organization* * *Strong understanding of disaster recovery tools, business continuity planning, standards and leading practices.* * *Experience developing DR and BCP test plans and scripts.* * *Understanding of value propositions of DR and BCP planning.* * *Proficiency in backup and replication technologies, high\-availability architectures, and cloud\-based DR solutions (e.g., Azure Site Recovery).* * *Solid understanding of IT infrastructure components such as servers, network, storage systems and virtualization technologies.* * *Experience with ITSM functionalities such as change control, CMDB and ticketing systems.* * *Strong knowledge of healthcare information systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner), cybersecurity and clinical operations.* * *Prior experience delivering high availability systems in a 24/7 environment across geographically dispersed business units.* * *Demonstrated ability to facilitate evaluation of technologies and achieve consensus on technical standards and solutions among a diverse group of information technology professionals.* * *Demonstrated commitment to customer service who has provided responsive and effective support, developed solid working relationships with customers, and delivered high quality, value\-added services that met/exceeded customer expectations.* * *Polished professional with demonstrated information technology experience and strong communication skills that can rapidly gain and maintain credibility with customers and IT colleagues.* ***Education:*** * *Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration or related field strongly desired or an equivalent combination of education and experience.* ***Licenses/Certifications:*** * *Preferred certifications include Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), Disaster Recovery Certified Specialist (DRCS), ITIL 4 Foundation.* Essential Functions: * Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plans for IT systems, including servers, networks, databases, and applications critical to TGC operations. * Conduct risk assessments and business impact analyses to identify critical systems, prioritize recovery objectives, and mitigate potential vulnerabilities. * Plan and execute regular DR\-BCP tests, including tabletop exercises, simulations, and full recovery drills, to validate recovery procedures and ensure readiness. * Support incident response efforts during disruptions, coordinating recovery activities to restore IT services swiftly and effectively. * Work with IT teams, clinical staff, and vendors to align DR\-BCP plans with operational needs, ensuring seamless integration with existing infrastructure. * Create and maintain detailed DR\-BCP documentation, including recovery procedures and runbooks, and provide training to IT staff and stakeholders. * Collaborate with DR\-BCP vendors and service providers to ensure solutions meet SLAs and support TGC requirements. * Monitor and update DR\-BCP plans to reflect changes in IT infrastructure, TGC growth, and incorporating technologies like cloud DR and automation. * Stay current on DR\-BCP trends (e.g., cloud\-native DR, AI\-driven recovery, zero\-downtime architectures) and evaluate their applicability to enhance TGC application resilience. * Anticipates and provides solutions for complex problems and issues, recommends upgrades and enhancements. Rapidly absorbs complex technical and conceptual information to identify issues and implications. Able to present understandable alternatives to both technical and non\-technical individuals at all levels of the organization. * Promotes the use of TGC’s PMO methodology and standards to manage IT initiatives. * Demonstrates commitment to customer service by providing responsive and effective support, developing solid working relationships with customers and IT colleagues, and delivering high quality, value\-added services that exceed customer expectations. * Demonstrates a commitment to excellence in Customer Service with all internal and external customers of TGC. * Performs related duties as assigned and unrelated duties as requested. ***Other Duties:*** ***Other duties as assigned*** ***\#LI\-NW1*** Joining the Guthrie team allows you to become a part of a tradition of excellence in health care. In all areas and at all levels of Guthrie, you’ll find staff members who have committed themselves to serving the community. The Guthrie Clinic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The Guthrie Clinic is a non\-profit, integrated, practicing physician\-led organization in the Twin Tiers of New York and Pennsylvania. Our multi\-specialty group practice of more than 500 physicians and 302 advanced practice providers offers 47 specialties through a regional office network providing primary and specialty care in 22 communities. Guthrie Medical Education Programs include General Surgery, Internal Medicine, Emergency Medicine, Family Medicine, Anesthesiology and Orthopedic Surgery Residency, as well as Cardiovascular, Gastroenterology and Pulmonary Critical Care Fellowship programs. Guthrie is also a clinical campus for the Geisinger Commonwealth School of Medicine.

jobs.title: Data Engineer IV - Enterprise Analytics
jobs.description: **The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.** A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer\-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high\-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer\-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference? **Job Summary** Are you a meticulous and detail\-oriented data professional? We're seeking a skilled and efficient **Data Engineer IV** to join our Enterprise Data and Analytics team! You'll play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency, and reliability of our enterprise data processes and systems built on Azure Databricks. **Key Responsibilities:** * Monitor and maintain data pipelines and workflows built on Azure Databricks. * Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline issues to ensure accurate and consistent data flows. * Collaborate with data engineers and our business partners to understand data requirements and system behavior. * Document and update data processes and procedures for clarity and consistency. * Perform regular system backups and disaster recovery drills to ensure data security and availability. Provide technical support to stakeholders regarding data access and usage. * **Skills and Background You’ll Need** EDUCATION: A High School Diploma or GED is required. A Bachelor’s degree is preferred. EXPERIENCE: Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience. * Hands\-on, technical experience with Azure Databricks. * Strong understanding of Azure data ecosystem and incident management techniques. * Experience working with financial services data and systems is highly preferred. * Excellent attention to detail and problem\-solving skills. A proactive and adaptable attitude with a willingness to learn new technologies. * **Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate** * **Engaging Hearts \& Minds:** Contributes to creating a team identity and building momentum toward a shared purpose. * **Strategic Visioning:** Assists in considering different future scenarios, opportunities, and risks to generate operational plans that align with the business unit/function’s strategic vision. * **Developing People:** Supports the delivery of both individual and group feedback to aid ongoing development and overall department performance. **Why Join The Standard?** ========================== We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service\-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect: * A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions * An annual incentive bonus plan * Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure * A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement * Paid parental leave and adoption/surrogacy assistance * An employee giving program that double matches your donations to eligible nonprofits and schools In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee\-focused benefits support work\-life balance. Learn more about *working at The Standard.* * *Eligibility to participate in an incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program and plan. Any award depends on a variety of factors including individual and organizational performance.* The actual compensation for this role will be based on a combination of education and experience, knowledge and skills, position budget, internal equity, and market data. Salary Range: $131,750\.00 \- $223,500\.00 Positions will be posted for at least 5 days from original posting date. Standard Insurance Company, The Standard Life Insurance Company of New York, Standard Retirement Services, Inc., StanCorp Mortgage Investors, LLC, StanCorp Investment Advisers, Inc., and American Heritage Life Insurance Company and American Heritage Service Company, marketed as The Standard, are Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability or veteran status or any other condition protected by federal, state or local law. Except where precluded by state or federal law, The Standard will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. The Standard offers a drug\- and alcohol\-free work environment where possession, manufacture, transfer, offer, use of or being impaired by an illegal substance while on The Standard's property, or in other cases which the company believes might affect operations, safety or reputation of the company is prohibited. jobs.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Throne** Throne is a fast growing Series C startup transforming local communities by delivering clean, safe, accessible restrooms to cities, transit agencies, and public spaces. With flagship customers in Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Ann Arbor, and Washington DC, and recent launches in New York City, Atlanta, and Seattle, we're rapidly scaling into new markets in 2027 and beyond. We recognize an unspoken problem: that better bathroom accommodations are sorely needed in most cities. Public and retail bathrooms are neither positioned to meet demand, nor incentivized to provide the quality experience people deserve. Our mission is to provide peace of mind to the millions of people who set out on an adventure on any given day. That adventure may be big or small. It may involve taking your toddler to the park, driving a stranger to the airport, running a half marathon, or exploring a new city for the first time. **About the Role** Throne is looking for a full\-time Software Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer to be a crucial member of the Software and R\&D Engineering Teams. Thrones are proprietary technology which include mechanical components, smart plumbing, smart HVAC, various sensors, actuators, and on\-board processing systems, cellular connectivity and a solar/battery driven power system. Software QA Engineer will be contributing into establishing QA/QC processes, improving time\-to\-market and maintaining high quality of our custom firmware and software solutions for internal Staff, and external Users and Partners. You will work closely with Throne's extended team, consisting of start\-up veterans, creative innovators, and portable sanitation experts. We are passionate about defining Throne as the reliably clean option at some of life's most stressful moments. We are ruthless about results, relentless about improvement, and we value diversity, inclusion, and having fun. The person hired in this role will work a hybrid schedule, and will be expected to work onsite about 3 days a week from either Brentwood, MD (right outside of Washington, D.C.) or Seattle, WA (Industrial District). The base salary range for this position is $100,000 \- $135,000\. Actual compensation will depend on a candidate's applicable experience, skills, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including equity. **At Throne You Will:** * Work closely with the product and engineering teams to understand business requirements. * Participate in test efforts estimation. * Design test cases, checklists and scenarios for different test levels and types using test design techniques. * Conduct manual testing of firmware and software to ensure products and features perform according to the requirements and contribute to a lovable user experience. * Perform integration testing of hardware/firmware/software components and communicate issues to the relevant teams, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments. * Investigate logs, identify and localize issues on production and QA environments. * Provide traceability/test coverage information, contribute to the Test Plan. * Setup/maintain QA test environment. * Optimize testing, considering different contexts and different constraints, by applying various testing practices, utilizing AI and other tools for test and process automation. * Contribute to technical and testing documentation creation and maintenance. **We Are Looking For:** * Solid knowledge in software quality assurance with a minimum 4 years of relevant commercial experience. * Experience with back\-end (API, database testing), web and mobile testing. * Understanding of cloud\-based architecture and hands\-on experience with AWS tools and services (e.g. Lambda, CloudWatch). * Understanding of specifics of micro\-services and serverless architecture. * Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, OpenSearch, or similar). * Experience with test automation (JavaScript, TypeScript or Python). * Willingness to work in a startup lab environment in an active R\&D phase. * Tolerance to changing requirements and priorities, and context switching between different products. * Ability to communicate effectively with on\-site and remote teams, and explain technical concepts and issues to less tech savvy colleagues. * Proactiveness in giving feedback and improving existing processes. * Hands\-on experience using jobs.description: Technology Sr. Software Engineer \- Data Subject Rights \- TikTok Privacy and Security **Location :** San Jose **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A81056 Responsibilities The TikTok Privacy and Security (PnS) R\&D team creates privacy solutions that are intuitive for users, auditable for regulators, and sustainable for the company, making TikTok a platform where people can safely discover, create, and connect. We build user\-facing privacy features, including privacy settings, consent management, data access and export, and age\-appropriate experiences. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy\-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy\-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. The systems you build will protect hundreds of millions of people, and the privacy decisions you make will reach every one of them. The TikTok Privacy and Security Product DSR team builds the platform behind data subject requests: the rights users exercise to access, delete, correct, or export their data. The team turns those rights into systems that run accurately, on time, and at global scale, across the products and data stores where that data actually lives. In this role, you will design and build core DSR systems, apply judgment where business goals and compliance meet, and take that work end to end with partner teams. Responsibilities As a Sr. Software Engineer on the TikTok Privacy and Security Product DSR team, you will: \- Design, build, and evolve backend systems that improve privacy across TikTok, and help turn repeated requirements into shared platform capabilities. \- Make sound business and compliance judgments in the systems you own, and carry the work end to end: problem framing, technical design, delivery, launch, and adoption. \- Partner across product, legal, policy, data, and engineering teams. Align on requirements and tradeoffs, and land privacy capabilities in the products and data systems that depend on them. \- Work with data and its lifecycle. Implement how data is collected, stored, used, shared, retained, and deleted, and connect those controls to how products operate. \- Use data analysis and data processing to measure privacy coverage, risk, and business impact, and extend privacy capabilities into new scenarios and product lines. \- Build and operate high\-scale backend services, and take part in privacy incident response, including scope, root cause, and remediation. jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description: **About Tolmo** --------------- Tolmo is cybersecurity for the age of AI. Coding agents now ship software faster than any human team can review or secure it; 100\+ pull requests per engineer per week is no longer an outlier, and attackers are using the same agents to find and exploit weaknesses in days, not months. The old playbook of quarterly pentests and endless alert queues breaks at this speed. We're building a new security playbook. Tolmo runs a fleet of AI security agents that reason over a live graph of your entire production system (code, CI, cloud, and telemetry) and continuously attack a faithful copy of it like a real adversary. Every finding arrives validated, with its blast radius and a remediation plan that lands in your workflow, ready for a coding agent to fix. Hours to integrate, days to your first validated finding. We've done this before: Tolmo's founders built Sqreen (acquired by Datadog) and led security products that thousands of organizations trusted. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator and just getting started. **The role** ------------ Our product is only as good as our agents' judgment. As a Research Engineer on AI Security, you make that judgment better and measurably so: how our agents plan, reason over a graph of a customer's production system, decide what is worth testing, and know when a finding is real. This sits between research and engineering. In one week you might design an eval that catches a new class of false positive, change how an agent plans a multi\-step investigation, compare models on a hard benchmark, and harden the agents themselves against prompt injection from the systems they inspect. You'll work directly with the founders, our engineers, and the security leads who run pentests with our agents, and your work ships to production. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Agent reasoning:** improve how our agents plan, use tools, and reason over a live graph of code, cloud, and telemetry, so they reach real findings faster and with fewer dead ends. * **Evaluation:** build the evals, benchmarks, and graders that tell us whether an agent actually got better, and make them part of how every change ships. * **Model selection and tuning:** compare models, prompts, and agent designs on cost, latency, and quality, and turn the results into production decisions. * **Model and agent security:** defend our agents against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and manipulation by the very systems they test, and research the security of LLM\-based applications our customers build. * **Reliability at scale:** make long\-running agents dependable across thousands of runs: verification, self\-checks, and sensible stopping. * **Learning from the field:** study agent runs from customer engagements, find where reasoning broke, and turn each failure into an eval and a fix. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Hands\-on experience building, evaluating, or improving LLM\-based agents or systems in production. * A rigorous, empirical approach: you design experiments, distrust single anecdotes, and let the evals decide. * Strong engineering skills: you write production\-quality code (Python, TypeScript, or Go) and build tools other people rely on. * A working understanding of security, or a strong drive to learn it fast: how real systems are attacked and how findings are validated. * Familiarity with LLM security risks such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, and tool misuse. * You build with AI coding agents daily (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) and have opinions about what makes them reliable. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Research background in machine learning, AI safety, or security: publications, open\-source work, or talks. * Offensive security experience: penetration testing, red teaming, bug bounty, or CTFs. * Experience with reinforcement learning, fine\-tuning, or synthetic data generation for agents. * Experience with graph data models or reasoning over structured data. * Prior early\-stage startup experience. **Compensation \& benefits** ---------------------------- * **Competitive salary**, depending on level and experience. * **Early\-stage equity:** you're joining early; you'll own a real piece of what we build. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and the equipment you need to do your best work. * Based in San Francisco; we work in person. *Tolmo is building a team with wide\-ranging backgrounds, perspectives, and paths into security; we think it makes our product and judgment better. If you're excited about this role but don't match every point above, we'd still like to hear from you. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants of every background.*

We believe in compensating our dedicated team members fairly for their hard work and commitment. Please note that actual salaries may vary within, above, or below this range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievement, business needs, and location.* *Toppan Merrill strives to provide our employees and loved ones with competitive benefits including:* * *Enhanced Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance for employees and dependents* * *Employer Contribution to* 401(k) * *Paid time off including vacation, sick, community involvement, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays* * *Paid parental leave* * *Paid community* *involvement/volunteer* *days* * *Wellness Resources and Employee Assistance Programming* Toppan Merrill is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Systems and Network Engineer
jobs.description: Description: POSITION SUMMARY Systems and Network Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for maintaining and improving Trean’s technology environment to support day\-to\-day operations. The position combines infrastructure engineering with advanced technical support to help ensure systems and services remain secure, reliable, and available to the business. The role works closely with end users, internal IT teams, business stakeholders, technology vendors, and service providers to resolve complex technical issues, deliver infrastructure projects, and drive ongoing technology improvements. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS * Administer, maintain, patch, and upgrade Trean’s server, network, cloud, and related infrastructure technologies. * Administer and support Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and related cloud, identity, collaboration, and endpoint technologies. * Monitor infrastructure performance and availability, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and perform root cause analysis. * Maintain secure infrastructure configurations, remediate vulnerabilities, and support security, access management, audit, and compliance activities. * Support backup, data recovery, and disaster recovery activities, including scheduled recovery testing. * Plan and implement infrastructure projects, upgrades, migrations, and technology improvements. * Use PowerShell and automation to improve infrastructure administration and operational efficiency and apply AI technologies such as Microsoft Copilot where they can improve IT operations and service delivery. * Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, including configurations, diagrams, inventories, procedures, and system changes. * Work directly with end users and collaborate with IT staff, business stakeholders, vendors, and service providers to resolve technical issues and support business needs. * Participate in scheduled maintenance and after\-hours or on\-call support as required. Requirements: MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS * Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. * Five or more years of hands\-on experience supporting enterprise systems, networks, cloud services, or related infrastructure. * Experience administering Windows Server, Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 services, enterprise networking, virtualization, and backup and recovery technologies. * Experience configuring and troubleshooting switching, VLANs, firewalls, wireless networking, VPNs, and related network technologies. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, identity and access management, endpoint management, and data protection technologies. * Working knowledge of infrastructure security, vulnerability remediation, patch management, backup, and disaster recovery practices. * Experience implementing infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and system changes in production environments. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, problem\-solving, and technical documentation skills. * Ability to manage day\-to\-day operational responsibilities and technical projects with limited supervision. * Demonstrated commitment to continual learning and professional growth, with a Driver mentality focused on initiative, adaptability, and continuous improvement. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, end users, business stakeholders, vendors, and service providers. CORE TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES * Microsoft Cloud and Productivity: Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, and Purview. * Systems and Infrastructure: Windows Server, virtualization, systems administration, infrastructure monitoring, and performance management. * Networking: Switching, VLANs, network segmentation, enterprise firewalls, wireless networking, VPNs, remote connectivity, monitoring, and troubleshooting. * Infrastructure Security: Secure system and network configuration, vulnerability remediation, authentication, access controls, logging, and monitoring. * Backup and Recovery: Backup, restoration, disaster recovery, and business continuity technologies. * Automation and AI: PowerShell, scripting, automation, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, and practical application of AI technologies. * IT Operations: Change management, inventory and asset management, technical documentation, and infrastructure support processes. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience supporting hybrid infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments, including geographically distributed locations and remote users. * Experience working in a regulated or security\-focused environment with established security, change management, and compliance requirements. * Experience evaluating and applying AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, to improve IT operations and service delivery. * Experience leading or serving in a key technical role on infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives.

jobs.title: BI & DATA ENGINEER
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- The BI \& Data Engineer builds and operates the systems that move data from vendor and internal source systems into Azure, and turns that data into reporting the business relies on. This is a hands\-on build\-and\-run role on a two\-person data team: you will write the extraction, build the pipeline, model the data, publish the Power BI, answer the business questions that come back, and own it when it breaks. Enterprise architecture and platform design are set by the Enterprise Data lead. You are the person who implements it — with real input into how, and real ownership of what you build. This role includes recurring reporting work that is manual today, including Excel\-based reports and ad\-hoc requests from finance and operations. Taking that over is part of the job, and so is systematically automating it. We are not looking for someone to maintain manual processes indefinitely; we are looking for someone who will replace them. Several of our source systems are vendor\-managed platforms with limited, undocumented, or unreliable APIs. A meaningful share of this work is engineering dependable extraction from systems that were not built to be integrated with. Comfort in that environment matters more here than credentials. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ***Reporting \& Business Support*** * Own recurring weekly and monthly reporting cycles, including reports that are manual today * Build and maintain Power BI datasets, reports, and DAX measures * Serve as first point of contact for reporting and analytics requests from finance, operations, and leadership * Translate business questions directly into reporting without an intermediary * Systematically replace manual and Excel\-based reporting with automated equivalents, and document what you replace ***Data Extraction \& Integration*** * Build and maintain extraction from vendor and internal systems into Azure — REST APIs, database sources, SFTP, and file\-based feeds * Engineer around real\-world API constraints: missing pagination, row caps, rate limits, intermittent failures, and undocumented behavior * Implement partitioned, resumable, idempotent extraction so a failed run resumes where it stopped rather than starting over * Detect and handle silent failure modes, including truncated result sets and partial loads * Reverse\-engineer undocumented vendor endpoints and maintain that documentation internally ***Pipelines \& Data Modeling*** * Build, schedule, and maintain pipelines in Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, or equivalent * Land raw source data durably before transformation so loads can be replayed without re\-extraction * Build and maintain layered SQL models from raw landing through curated reporting tables, to defined architectural standards * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting; act as first response when pipelines fail * Keep pipeline and extraction code in source control with repeatable deployment ***Data Quality \& Reconciliation*** * Run reconciliation between source systems and reporting, including control totals that surface incomplete extraction * Investigate discrepancies to root cause and remediate rather than annotate * Treat unexplained variance as a defect, not a reporting caveat ***Security \& Vendor Engagement*** * Follow least\-privilege access practice; keep credentials and secrets in Key Vault rather than in code or configuration files * Meet compliance and audit expectations for regulated data * Reproduce and document vendor\-side issues with evidence to support escalation **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 3–7 years in a data engineering, BI engineering, or hybrid analytics role * Hands\-on Azure data services experience: Data Factory, Blob Storage / Data Lake, Azure SQL * Strong SQL, including performance work on large tables * Power BI: datasets, DAX measures, refresh configuration * Python or C\# at a level sufficient to write and maintain API extraction code independently * Practical experience consuming REST APIs: authentication, pagination, rate limits, retry and error handling * Advanced Excel, including automation * Source control (Git) and repeatable deployment practice * Comfort working directly with business stakeholders and owning the conversation end to end * Demonstrated ownership of production systems, including responsibility when they fail **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience as the sole or primary data person at a small or mid\-sized company * Integration experience with Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, ADP, or Entra ID / Azure AD * Microsoft Fabric or Synapse * Regulated or compliance\-driven environment — healthcare, medical waste, or finance * Waste, logistics, or field\-service operations domain knowledge CI/CD or infrastructure\-as\-code for data pipelines * * Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. EOE

jobs.description: **Staff Software Engineer – Streaming Data Platform** **About the role and team** Leading at Uber means setting technical direction and building foundational systems that operate at global scale. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Streaming Data Platform team, you will shape the architecture and evolution of the critical infrastructure that powers real\-time data movement and processing across Uber's global marketplace. Our streaming data platform serves as the backbone for real\-time applications, analytics, and machine learning, enabling engineering teams to reliably produce, process, and consume massive volumes of data. The platform supports a diverse range of mission\-critical workloads, where scalability, low latency, high availability, and operational efficiency are essential. You will tackle some of the most challenging problems in large\-scale distributed systems, from designing next\-generation streaming architectures and improving fault tolerance to optimizing resource utilization and simplifying platform operations. Your work will directly influence the reliability, efficiency, and developer experience of foundational infrastructure used across Uber. This role is for an accomplished technical leader who can navigate complex architectural tradeoffs, anticipate future scaling challenges, and drive transformative engineering initiatives across organizational boundaries. You will combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking, influence long\-term technology investments, and empower other engineers to deliver impactful solutions. If you are passionate about solving hard distributed systems problems, pushing the boundaries of infrastructure performance, and building platforms that enable innovation at unprecedented scale, this is where you will make your mark. **What you'll do** * Define and drive the technical vision and architecture for Uber's streaming data platform, ensuring its long\-term scalability, reliability, performance, and extensibility as business and infrastructure requirements evolve. * Lead the design and evolution of large\-scale distributed streaming systems, solving fundamental challenges in data delivery, distributed coordination, consistency, fault tolerance, resource management, and high availability. * Drive architectural innovation and modernization across streaming infrastructure, identifying opportunities to simplify complex systems, eliminate scalability bottlenecks, and improve overall platform efficiency. * Establish technical strategies for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency, leveraging deep systems expertise, benchmarking, and workload analysis to optimize compute, storage, memory, and network utilization. * Architect highly resilient, multi\-tenant infrastructure that supports diverse workloads with demanding throughput, latency, durability, and availability requirements. * Build and champion foundational platform capabilities, including automation, observability, capacity management, and self\-service tooling, that improve developer productivity and reduce operational complexity across engineering organizations. * Anticipate emerging technical challenges and opportunities, evaluating new technologies and architectural approaches to inform strategic investments and long\-term platform roadmaps. * Provide technical leadership for complex, cross\-organizational initiatives, driving alignment among stakeholders and ensuring successful execution from initial strategy through production adoption. * Establish engineering excellence and operational best practices for mission\-critical infrastructure, including architecture reviews, reliability standards, incident prevention, and systematic root\-cause analysis. * Mentor and elevate senior engineers, fostering technical depth, sound architectural judgment, and a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and engineering excellence. * Collaborate with infrastructure, storage, data engineering, and product engineering organizations to align platform capabilities with Uber's evolving real\-time data needs and broader technical strategy. **Basic Qualifications** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant expertise in designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems, infrastructure platforms, or data\-intensive services. * Deep understanding of distributed systems principles, including consistency, replication, consensus, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed coordination, and failure recovery. * Proven experience architecting high\-performance, highly available systems that operate at significant scale with stringent throughput, latency, reliability, and durability requirements. * Strong proficiency in one or more systems or backend programming languages, such as Java, Go, C\+\+, Scala, Python, or Rust, with demonstrated ability to design and implement complex production systems. * Experience with large\-scale data infrastructure, distributed messagi nicate complex technical concepts clearly, and raise the technical bar across an engineering organization. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep experience architecting or developing large\-scale streaming, messaging, or real\-time data processing infrastructure using technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, Apache Flink, Apache Spark, or equivalent distributed systems. * Expertise in the internals of distributed data systems, including partitioning, replication, log\-based storage, metadata management, state management, backpressure, and end\-to\-end delivery guarantees. * Experience leading architectural evolution or significant modernization of foundational distributed infrastructure serving large numbers of applications and engineering teams. * Strong understanding of systems\-level performance optimization, including Linux internals, multithreading, memory management, network protocols, storage I/O, and resource scheduling. * Experience designing multi\-region or geographically distributed infrastructure, including cross\-region data replication, disaster recovery, and availability strategies. * Expertise in building scalable multi\-tenant platforms, including workload isolation, capacity management, resource allocation, and infrastructure cost optimization. * Experience with cloud\-native infrastructure, container orchestration, and large\-scale automation frameworks. * Familiarity with modern data architectures, including change data capture (CDC), event\-driven systems, stream processing, real\-time analytics, and data lake integration. * Experience designing or contributing to open\-source distributed systems, infrastructure frameworks, or technologies adopted by the broader engineering community. * Demonstrated success in driving major architectural transformations, influencing organization\-wide technology strategy, and balancing short\-term delivery with long\-term infrastructure investments. * Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science or a related field, with a focus on distributed computing, storage systems, or system performance. jobs.title: AI Engineer – Agentic Systems & Automation
jobs.description: **The Role** We're hiring an engineer to build production AI agents that do real work across our business. You'll take processes like document intake, data extraction, keeping systems in sync, internal copilots, decision support, and workflow orchestration, and turn them into agents that run reliably every day. This is a hands\-on engineering position. We need someone who writes the code, deploys the agent, and stays accountable for how it performs. If your strength is AI strategy decks rather than shipped systems, this isn't the right fit. You'll report directly to the Director of Technology, with nothing standing between a problem you identify and a solution you put into production. **Location and Schedule** This is a full\-time, in\-office role at our headquarters in Kennesaw, GA. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available, and we are not offering relocation for this position. You should be able to commute to Kennesaw reliably starting on your first day. **What You'll Build and Own** **Agent Design and Development** * Architect and ship production agentic systems using tool calling, multi\-step reasoning, sub\-agent orchestration, memory, retrieval, and human\-in\-the\-loop review points * Work with leadership and operators in each business unit to find the automation opportunities worth pursuing, then deliver agents that capture them **Integration and Security** * Connect agents to our existing environment, including Microsoft Graph, Entra, SharePoint, Teams, Procore, Azure Functions, Make.com, and outside APIs * Build secure identity and access patterns for agents: managed identities, service principals, OAuth2 flows, least\-privilege Graph permissions, and audit logging **Evaluation and Reliability** * Stand up evaluation pipelines and observability for every production agent, covering cost, output quality, failure modes, and regression testing * Track down problems early and keep agents performing as the business and the models change **Governance and Direction** * Set and maintain AI governance standards across our companies for data handling, model selection, prompt management, versioning, and rollback * Write clear documentation of architecture and decisions so your systems can be maintained long after they're built * Follow the agentic AI space closely (Claude, OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, LangGraph, MCP, and others) and give practical recommendations on which platforms to use **The Environment You'll Build In** Our technology runs on a modern, well\-maintained foundation: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Azure (Functions, Table Storage, Entra Domain Services), Procore, and custom integrations built with Make.com and Microsoft Graph. We see well\-applied technology as a real competitive edge across our portfolio of operating companies, and agentic AI is now a core investment for all of them. **Must\-Haves** * 3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 1 year delivering AI/LLM systems in production (prototypes and demos don't count) * Strong Python and/or TypeScript skills * Hands\-on work with at least one major agent framework or SDK, such as the Anthropic Claude SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, Semantic Kernel, or Azure AI Foundry * Real experience building eval harnesses and interpreting the results. You should be able to show how you know an agent is working * Working knowledge of Azure Functions, Microsoft Graph API, Entra ID app registrations, OAuth2, and managed identities * Solid backend and integration skills: REST APIs, webhooks, queues, state management, and authentication patterns * Clear writing and the ability to lay out trade\-offs for a technical leader making investment calls * ***Able to work on\-site daily in Kennesaw, GA*** **We'd Especially Like to See** * Production work with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or Azure AI Foundry * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar tool\-server designs * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) built over enterprise document stores like SharePoint, OneDrive, or Confluence * Background in multi\-entity or multi\-tenant environments where identity and data concerns cut across organizations * Infrastructure\-as\-code or DevOps experience with Bicep, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps * Exposure to construction technology (Procore, Bluebeam, etc.) or vertical SaaS integrations **Also a Plus** * A cybersecurity or compliance background, especially in AI governance, data classification, or zero\-trust * Open\-source contributions to agent frameworks or developer tools * Experience as one of the first AI hires at a company **How We'll Measure Success** * How quickly new agents and automations go from idea to production * Business results you can point to, such as hours saved, faster cycle times, fewer errors, or revenue gained * Reliability, including uptime, eval pass rates, cost efficiency, and how incidents are handled * The strength of what you leave behind: maintainable code, documentation, security posture, and knowledge shared with the team **What Sets This Role Apart** * You report straight to the Director of Technology, with no extra layers in the way * You'll have a real budget for tools and platforms, not a free\-tier mandate * You'll be building on a clean, modern stack instead of untangling legacy systems * Your work will span multiple operating companies and touch many parts of the business * You'll be able to point to live production systems and say you built them **Benefits and Growth** We offer a competitive base salary based on experience, along with health, dental, and vision coverage, a retirement plan, and paid time off. We also support continued growth through learning budgets, conference attendance, and dedicated time for building new skills. **Applying** Along with your resume, send a brief write\-up of one agentic AI system you've put into production. Tell us what it did, what was hardest about building it, how you evaluated it, and what you'd change if you built it again. That write\-up matters more to us than your resume. Public repos, write\-ups, or recorded demos are very welcome. A cover letter isn't required, but the project description is. **About United Contractor Services** United Contractor Services (UCS) is a national specialty subcontractor ranked among the Top 50 Walls and Ceilings contractors in North America. We deliver commercial interior scopes, including metal framing, drywall, acoustical ceilings, EIFS, stucco, painting, and Division 8 and 10 Specialties, across multiple markets, with UCS superintendents leading the work on every project. ***United Contractor Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The opportunity** =================== Three billion people a month play something built in Unity. We're the team changing how those things get made — building AI that generates assets, writes and repairs code, and turns an idea into something playable faster than has ever been possible. Our group owns the backend and operations behind all of it: the cloud infrastructure our AI products run on, the data and experimentation platforms that tell us what works, the evaluation systems that tell us whether the AI is actually any good, and the operations that keep everything running across regions and customers. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who is genuinely **AI\-native** — for whom agents and AI tooling are how the work gets done rather than a productivity add\-on — and who sets direction rather than waiting for it. We've built the foundations over the past few months — CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, deployment standards — and they work. The platform is stable, and we intend to keep it that way. What we have not solved is how much of *understanding* it still depends on people: when a metric moves, someone works out what it means; when something degrades, a human reads dashboards and makes the call; when a model changes, we find out more slowly than we should. None of that scales with the speed we're now shipping at, and none of it needs to stay manual. **What makes this a Staff role rather than a senior one is that several of these problems do not yet have a defined shape, and we are asking you to give them one.** We have more open directions than we can pursue. Deciding which ones are worth the team's time, convincing people you are right, and then building the thing — that is the job. **What you'll be doing** ======================== * **Own how this team builds software with AI.** We use AI across our workflow today and we're not satisfied with how far it goes. You'll set the standard — agentic code review and repair, generated tests that stay honest as requirements change, the tooling and patterns the team adopts because they make the work faster. Not just working this way yourself, but moving the floor for everyone, and having the judgment to tell a tool that earns its place from one that doesn't. * **Define what we measure, and rebuild observability so it explains itself.** Our telemetry has gaps, and much of what we collect is ambiguous, unlabelled, or only meaningful to whoever built it. You'll own the model of system health and business outcomes across our platform, make each metric self\-explanatory, and replace manual review and manual reaction with automated interpretation. * **Make diagnosis agentic, and decide how far that should go.** Build the troubleshooting layer that correlates signals, proposes root causes, and takes safe automated action — so that understanding a production issue doesn't start with a person reading graphs. Where the automation stops and a human stays in the loop is a judgment call with real blast radius, and it's yours to make. * **Own the infrastructure side of evaluation, as the technical counterpart to our Quality Engineering Lead.** Our products generate code, find and fix bugs, and produce art and design — output with no single correct answer. We have the beginnings of an evaluation system and it isn't mature yet. You'll make evaluation fast, repeatable and cheap enough to run continuously, working as the engineering peer of the lead who owns the methodology. * **Decide what AI does for gaming LiveOps.** Live games are managed continuously after launch: events and content, player behaviour and retention analysis, monetization, live health. We think Unity's data puts us in an unusual position to make that faster, smarter and far less manual. **We are early here and genuinely do not know yet what it becomes.** We're not asking you to execute a plan — we're asking you to form one, defend it, and know when to abandon it. * **Make agentic systems affordable.** As more of our product and our own workflow runs on inference, the economics become an engineering problem — token efficiency, routing work to the cheapest model that can do it, managing what an agent has to keep in context, and recovering agent state so a failed run resumes instead of starting over. You'll own how we measure and optimize all of it, and set the budgets the rest of us build within. * **Set technical direction for Unity AI's backend platforms.** Make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse, run technical spikes with developers on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, and partner with product, design and other engineering teams to shape the roadmap rather than receive it. * **Raise the engineers around you.** Design review, code review, mentoring, and the kind of technical argument that leaves the other person better at their job. jobs.description: **Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track)** ==================================================================== ### **Position Overview** **School / Campus / College:** College of Engineering **Organization:** Civil \& Environmental Engineering **Title:** Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track) ### **Position Details** #### **Position Description** The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) at the University of Washington invites applications for a faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor (Tenure Track), with an anticipated start date of September, 2027\. The location of this position is on the University of Washington campus in Seattle, Washington. We seek applicants who demonstrate commitment to excellence in research, teaching, and service in a diverse and inclusive academic community. The successful candidate will join our faculty on a full\-time basis for a nine\-month academic appointment, 3\-year term, renewable, beginning September 16, 2027\. The base salary range for this position will be \[$11,500 \- $13,500] per month, commensurate with experience and qualifications, or as mandated by a U.S. Department of Labor prevailing wage determination. Positive factors for consideration include, but are not limited to, candidates with a promising record of research excellence in transportation; candidates working with emerging methods, tools, or technologies, such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, robotics and automation, new sensing and data sources, quantum applications, or directions we have not anticipated; and/or candidates who bring new areas of strength for the department. Applicants are encouraged to connect their work to one or more of the Grand Challenges identified in the Department's strategic plan. All University of Washington faculty are expected to engage in teaching, research, and service. Our department offers a highly collegial and collaborative culture, with broad interdisciplinary research ties and opportunities. The UW has an active community of transportation researchers within CEE, the College of Engineering (CoE), and across the university. The candidate is expected to collaborate with colleagues within CEE, CoE, throughout the university, and externally; and to develop an externally funded research program. In teaching, the candidate will support and expand transportation course offerings at the undergraduate and graduate levels. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Posting End Date: November 16 When you join the team at Unum, you become part of an organization committed to helping you thrive. Whether you’re directly supporting a growing family, or developing online tools to help navigate a difficult loss, customers are counting on the combined talents of our entire team. Help us help others, and join Team Unum today! **General Summary:** -------------------- This position is for an experienced Senior Data Engineer who will serve as a hands\-on technical lead for data engineering across assigned Value Streams, providing technical leadership across at least two Value Streams, translating enterprise architecture standards, patterns, and governance guardrails into detailed, production\-ready designs that engineering teams can successfully implement. This is a 100% hands\-on technical role. The role will lead by doing, not simply coordinate the work. The Senior Data Engineer will lead the design and delivery of complex data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data marts, data models, and integration solutions using technologies including Snowflake, SQL, Python, and modern ETL/ELT tooling. This individual will partner closely with architects, product owners, engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable data solutions. They will also play an important role in Value Stream transformation by establishing engineering best practices, leading design and code reviews, mentoring engineers, and driving consistency and technical excellence across teams. **Job Specifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field preferred. * 6\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Integration, or related technical disciplines. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience designing and building complex data pipelines, ETL/ELT solutions, data warehouses, data marts, and data models in large\-scale enterprise environments. * Strong hands\-on expertise with Snowflake, SQL, Python, and modern ETL/ELT technologies. * Experience working with cloud data platforms and integrating data through APIs, batch, near\-real\-time, and real\-time integration patterns. * Deep knowledge of data modeling, data integration patterns, solution design, and modern data engineering practices. * Demonstrated ability to translate enterprise architecture patterns, standards, and guardrails into detailed, scalable, production\-ready technical designs. * Proven experience serving as a hands\-on technical lead, including making design decisions, conducting design and code reviews, solving complex engineering problems, and guiding engineers through implementation. * Strong understanding of DevOps and CI/CD practices, Git, automated testing, automation, deployment, and operational excellence. * Experience delivering solutions within complex enterprise data environments involving multiple systems, platforms, and data sources. * Familiarity with legacy data platforms such as Teradata and DB2 is beneficial, particularly within modernization or transformation environments. * Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering delivery. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. * Strong business acumen with the ability to balance technical quality, delivery objectives, and business outcomes. **Principal Duties and Responsibilities:** * Serve as the hands\-on technical lead for data engineering across assigned Value Streams, providing technical direction across at least two Value Streams. * Lead the design and implementation of complex data engineering solutions, including data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data marts, data models, and enterprise data assets. * Translate enterprise architecture standards, patterns, and governance guardrails into detailed, scalable, and implementable technical designs. * Actively contribute to solution design and engineering, troubleshooting complex technical challenges and guiding solutions through implementation and production. * Make key technical design decisions and lead design and code reviews to ensure solutions meet scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability standards. * Lead complex integrations across cloud, on\-premises, internal, and external data sources, including batch, near\-real\-time, real\-time, and API\-based integrations. * Partner with architects, product owners, analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and determine appropriate technical solutions. * Establish and promote engineering best practices for data modeling, integration, automation, testing, performance optimization, deployment, and operational support. * Guide engineers through implementation and provide hands\-on technical coaching and mentoring to strengthen engineering capabilities across teams. * Support Value Stream transformation through the adoption of modern data engineering patterns, technologies, and development practices. * Apply approved AI\-enabled tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity, quality, and delivery. \#LI\-TS1 \~IN1 Unum and Colonial Life are part of Unum Group, a Fortune 500 company and leading provider of employee benefits to companies worldwide. Headquartered in Chattanooga, TN, with international offices in Ireland, Poland and the UK, Unum also has significant operations in Portland, ME \- plus over 35 US field offices. Colonial Life is headquartered in Columbia, SC, with over 40 field offices nationwide. Unum is an equal opportunity employer, considering all qualified applicants and employees for hiring, placement, and advancement, without regard to a person's race, color, religion, national origin, age, genetic information, military status, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or protected veteran status. The base salary range for applicants for this position is listed below. Unless actual salary is indicated above in the job description, actual pay will be based on skill, geographical location and experience. $98,340\.00\-$201,900\.00 Additionally, Unum offers a portfolio of benefits and rewards that are competitive and comprehensive including healthcare benefits (health, vision, dental), insurance benefits (short \& long\-term disability), performance\-based incentive plans, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match up to 5% and an additional 4\.5% contribution whether you contribute to the plan or not. All benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of individual Plans. Company: Unum

The Database Administrator I collaborates with software development teams, infrastructure engineers, security stakeholders, and county customers to maintain highly available, resilient, and cost\-effective data solutions. **Key Responsibilities** * **Database Administration and Optimization:** Administer, monitor, and maintain Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Aure VMs. Proactively analyze and optimize queries, indexes, and database configurations to sustain peak performance and system health. * **High Availability \& Business Continuity:** Architect, test, and manage backup, restore, geo\-replication, and disaster recovery strategies to satisfy recovery point (RPO) and recovery time (RTO) objectives. (Bicep) and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to automate database deployments, patching, and routine maintenance. **Core Technical Skills** **Database \& Data Analytics** * Azure SQL Database \& Managed Instance * Microsoft SQL Server \& T\-SQL * Query Performance Tuning \& Indexing * High Availability \& Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) * Azure Data Factory (ETL Pipelines) * Power BI Datasets, Modeling \& Instance. * Proven experience designing and managing complex backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions. * Strong proficiency in T\-SQL development, indexing, and query performance tuning. * Demonstrated experience managing access controls with Microsoft Entra ID and RBAC. * Experience developing or supporting Azure Data Factory ETL pipelines and Power BI reports/dashboards. * Working knowledge of Azure monitoring practices, operations troubleshooting, and technical documentation. **Preferred** * Experience administering broader Azure cloud services, including Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Virtual Machines, and Key Vaults. * Experience utilizing Infrastructure as Code (Bicep) and Ci/CD pipelines within Azure DevOps. * Experience in supporting multi\-tenant SaaS environments or public\-sector/local government entities. * Familiarity with security audits, compliance initiative, and cloud governance frameworks. **Success Measures** Performance and impact in this role will be evaluated on: * **Platform Availability \& Resilience:** Maintaining high system uptime across county environments while validating disaster recovery readiness through regular testing. * **Performance \& Data Reliability:** Delivering measurable query performance improvements, resolving technical issues promptly, and ensuring dependable data integration and reporting pipelines. * **Security, Compliance \& Cost Governance:** Sustaining least\-privileged access, ensuring continuous audit compliance, and optimizing cloud resource spend. * **Automation \& Operational Standards:** Driving operational efficiency through CI/CD and scripting automation while maintaining clear technical documentation and standard runbooks. **How to Apply** To be considered for this
