Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Linux Infrastructure Engineer (Bare Metal, Storage & AI Factory Infrastructure)
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Linux Infrastructure Engineer** with deep expertise in Linux administration, bare metal infrastructure, enterprise storage, and next\-generation **AI Factory / GPU infrastructure platforms**. This role is focused on designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting large\-scale Linux\-based infrastructure that powers both traditional enterprise workloads and modern AI/ML environments. This is **not a DevOps\-focused role**. We already have a dedicated DevOps team and are looking for an engineer with extensive hands\-on experience in **Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS), GPU infrastructure, high\-performance storage, data center operations, and enterprise Linux platforms**. The ideal candidate will have experience building and managing infrastructure from the hardware layer up, including servers, networking, storage, GPU clusters, and AI\-ready platforms. They should be comfortable working with high\-performance computing (HPC), AI Factory environments, and large\-scale Linux deployments where performance, reliability, and operational excellence are critical. **Key Responsibilities \& Required Skills** **Linux \& Bare Metal Infrastructure** * Expert\-level Linux administration (Ubuntu required; Red Hat and SUSE preferred) * Deep expertise in **bare metal server deployment, architecture, provisioning, and lifecycle management** * Experience operating **Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS)** platforms and large\-scale infrastructure environments * Strong understanding of server hardware, including: + BIOS/UEFI + RAID controllers + Firmware management + iLO/iDRAC/IPMI + NICs and SmartNICs + HBA cards + Hardware diagnostics and troubleshooting * Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise Linux infrastructure at scale **AI Factory \& GPU Infrastructure** * Experience deploying and managing **GPU\-accelerated infrastructure** for AI/ML workloads * Understanding of NVIDIA GPU technologies including: + A100, H100, H200, B200, or equivalent GPU platforms + NVIDIA DGX and OEM GPU servers + GPU provisioning and lifecycle management + GPU monitoring and performance optimization * Knowledge of AI Factory architecture and infrastructure requirements * Experience supporting GPU clusters, AI training environments, and high\-performance computing (HPC) workloads * Understanding of: + GPU resource allocation and scheduling + Multi\-GPU systems + GPU networking requirements + High\-bandwidth, low\-latency infrastructure design * Familiarity with NVIDIA ecosystem technologies such as: + CUDA + NCCL + GPUDirect Storage + NVIDIA Fabric Manager + NVIDIA Base Command (preferred) **Enterprise Storage \& Data Platforms** * Advanced Linux storage administration: + LVM + XFS, EXT4 + NFS + iSCSI + Fibre Channel SAN + Multipath I/O * Strong hands\-on experience with **Ceph**, including: + Cluster architecture + MON, OSD, MDS + RBD, CephFS, RGW + Capacity planning + Performance tuning + Failure recovery * Experience with high\-performance AI storage platforms such as: + WEKA + VAST Data + Dell PowerScale + Pure Storage FlashBlade + NetApp * Understanding of: + NVMe\-over\-Fabrics (NVMe\-oF) + RDMA + GPUDirect Storage + Parallel file systems + AI data pipelines **Networking \& Infrastructure** * Strong networking knowledge: + Bonding + VLANs + Routing + MTU optimization + DNS + DHCP * Experience with high\-performance data center networking: + 100G/200G/400G Ethernet + RoCE + RDMA + Spine\-Leaf architectures * Familiarity with NVIDIA Spectrum\-X, Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX adapters, or equivalent technologies * Strong understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 infrastructure design and troubleshooting **Operations \& Reliability** * Experience with high availability, clustering, and disaster recovery * Strong troubleshooting skills across: + Linux operating systems + Hardware platforms + GPU infrastructure + Networking + Enterprise storage * Experience supporting mission\-critical production environments * Bash and Python scripting for automation and operational efficiency * Experience creating operational documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure standards * Understanding of AI infrastructure design and reference architectures * AI cloud integration for workloads * SOP and runbook development and maintenance * Incident, problem, and capacity management * Business continuity and disaster recovery planning for AI workloads * Proactive risk identification and mitigation to avoid business impact **Nice to Have** * Kubernetes infrastructure (especially AI/ML and GPU integration) * KVM, VMware, OpenShift Virtualization, or similar virtualization platforms * Ansible automation * NVIDIA Base Command Manager * Slurm or HPC workload schedulers * Observability and monitoring platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) * Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools * IPAM solutions * AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud exposure **We Are Not Looking For** * Candidates whose experience is primarily CI/CD pipeline engineering * Engineers focused mainly on Terraform, GitOps, or application delivery pipelines * Cloud\-only administrators with limited bare metal, storage, or hardware experience * Professionals whose primary expertise is software development rather than infrastructure engineering **Ideal Candidate** Someone who has spent years designing, building, and operating enterprise Linux environments, large\-scale bare metal infrastructure, storage platforms, and modern AI Factory environments. The ideal candidate understands how to deploy and manage GPU\-enabled infrastructure, BMaaS platforms, enterprise storage, and high\-performance networking while solving complex operating system, hardware, storage, and AI infrastructure challenges. DevOps experience is a plus, but deep Linux, infrastructure, storage, BMaaS, and AI Factory expertise is the primary requirement.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Connect
jobs.description: * Engineering * San Francisco * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About the Role** ------------------ Vercel Connect helps developers give agents and AI\-built apps secure access to the data, tools, and events they need—without wrestling with OAuth, credentials, and integration complexity. We’re currently building two things: 1\) a platform for managing agent identity, access and permissions and 2\) a set of rich connectors for the 1000s of systems (like Linear, Slack, GitHub, Google, etc.) that agents will need to talk to. We’re solving core problems like agent identity and delegated access, tool approval and standards around making agents aware of changes on 3rd party platforms. As a senior engineer on this team you'll not only own our APIs, token infrastructure, authorization, SDKs, and more, but work with external companies to make it easier for developers to build agents that integrate with their products. You’ll need to balance both high uptime and fast performance with flexibility to allow for seamless connection to many systems that weren’t designed with agents in mind. If you’re looking for a role that will put you at the center of how agent identity and credentials work, this is it! **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Ship provider integrations end to end — auth flows, token exchange, app registration, and the configuration UI — from generic API\-key and OAuth presets through bespoke cases like Snowflake Partner Connect, Slack manager apps, and Microsoft Entra. * Own and improve our infrastructure (uptime, performance, secure storage of credentials and keys) and developer experience for Connect * Work with industry leaders within and outside of Vercel to propose and implement new authentication and authorization protocols for AI era * Build and harden event forwarding — signature verification inbound, project\-scoped identity outbound, delivered to the right deployment and environment. * Make Connect the obvious way to give an agent a credential, extending the SDKs , consent\-redirect flow, and framework adapters. * Reduce the cost of the next hundred integrations, so most new providers become configuration rather than code. * Work directly with the teams building on Connect, and turn what you learn into platform improvements. **About You** ------------- * **6\+ years** building and operating production backend or full\-stack systems, with a track record of owning a service or platform surface rather than a feature. * You deeply understand your users problems and work in a focused manner to address them, leveling up the product you’re working on over time. * Deep, practical understanding of **OAuth 2\.0/2\.1, OIDC, and JWTs** — not just wiring up a client library, but reasoning about authorization codes, PKCE, refresh semantics, audience and scope restriction, token exchange, and what each of those actually protects against. * A **security instinct for integration code specifically** — SSRF and DNS rebinding, confused\-deputy and mix\-up attacks, redirect\-URI validation, webhook signature verification, tenant isolation. You've either found these bugs or fixed them. * Strong **TypeScript**, and comfort developing backend and frontend components. * Experience integrating with **many third\-party APIs**, an appetite for the reality of it — undocumented behavior, non\-compliant OAuth, inconsistent errors — and the judgment to absorb that mess behind a clean abstraction. * You're comfortable with ambiguity, ship incrementally against a large surface, and communicate clearly with the teams building on top of you. * You push the envelope of leveraging agents and AI in ur dev workflow, giving you the insight to help build the agent platform of the future **Bonus Points** ---------------- * You've built or operated an **OAuth authorization server**, an identity provider, or a multi\-tenant integrations platform. * Experience with **MCP**, agent tool\-calling, or delegated\-access and consent patterns. * Prior work on integration marketplaces, partner engineering, or webhook infrastructure at scale. * Open source contributions, particularly in the auth, Next.js, or agent tooling ecosystems. **Compensation \& Benefits:** ----------------------------- * Competitive compensation package, including equity. * Inclusive Healthcare Package. * Learn and Grow \- we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. * Flexible Time Off. * We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $196,000\-$294,000\. Actual salary will be based on job\-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity\-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. **Disclosures:** ---------------- * **Privacy:** Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. * **Equal Opportunity:** Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. This is a hands\-on builder role. You'll write the API, design the schema, build the Vue.js view, wire up the agent, and own the outcome end\-to\-end. ### **What You'll Do** * Designing and build REST APIs (Node.js) against Postgres, with versioning, input schemas, caching, and hybrid NP/prod auth models. * Building widgets and Vue.js views that surface network inventory and operational metrics (counts dashboards, site status, work\-item boards). * Configuring and extending AI agents (MCP servers, tool bindings, prompt design) that assist network engineers with day\-to\-day ops. * Modelling relational data for work\-item tracking, project management, and CMDB\-adjacent inventory. * Owning the full lifecycle: schema migration API widget agent tool PR prod deploy. * Debugging across the stack: platform security policies, credential vaults, DB pool exhaustion, agent tool\-call failures. * Collaborating with network engineers to translate ops asks ("we need a counts page showing X Nexus, Y Pica8") into shipped features. ### **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or one or more years of relevant work experience. * One or more years of relevant work experience, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Experience in JavaScript/Node.js — async patterns, REST handler design, error handling. * Experience with AI agents / LLM tool\-use patterns (MCP, function calling, agent orchestration). * Frontend fundamentals — Vue.js (or React), HTML/CSS, browser networking, state management for dashboards. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Network engineering domain knowledge (Cisco Nexus, Pica8, Arista, NAC, VXLAN, data center refresh workflows) * Strong SQL and relational modeling — Postgres preferred; comfortable writing migrations, joins, and parameterized queries. * API design discipline — input validation, versioning, idempotency, auth, rate limiting. * Git workflow proficiency — branching, PR hygiene, disciplined commits, comfortable with staged/unstaged distinctions. * Debugging across boundaries — reading platform errors, tracing failures from UI API DB external system. * Security\-aware coding — credential vaults, secrets handling, least privilege, understanding prod vs non\-prod boundaries. * Clear written communication — turning fuzzy asks into scoped work items; documentation others can act on. * Project management systems (PMO, epics/stories/tasks) and integrations with them. * Prior work on internal developer platforms or low\-code/API\-gateway tooling. * Experience with ServiceNow, CMDB, or IT asset management systems. ### **What Success Looks Like in Year One** * You've shipped multiple end\-to\-end features (schema API UI agent tool) that network engineers use weekly. * You've reduced manual toil for at least one recurring ops workflow. * You've extended the platform's agent capabilities so engineers can get answers conversationally instead of navigating dashboards. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. jobs.title: Experience Designer (UX/UI)
jobs.description: We're hiring an Experience Designer I (XD I) to join our digital team. You'll design apps, web products, and interfaces for connected devices, from the first research interview to the launch video. This is an early\-career role. You've got 2 to 3 years of experience and you're ready to work on real products with real constraints. You won't own every skill below on day one, and we don't expect you to. You'll get hands\-on time across the whole process and learn from senior designers who've shipped a lot of it. The best fit is someone who loves the messy middle of a project. You ask good questions, sketch fast, test early, and care about how the last pixel moves. Our digital work rarely lives on just one screen. In a given year you might touch: * **Consumer apps** for iOS and Android, often as the companion to a physical product * **Web apps** and dashboards that turn sensor data into something people can act on * **IoT products** where the app, the device, and the setup flow all need to feel like one thing * **Medtech touchscreens** built for clinicians and patients, where clarity and safety come first * **Non\-traditional interfaces** like voice, light, haptics, embedded displays, and AI\-driven experiences One week you're designing an onboarding flow for a smart home device. The next, you're figuring out how a nurse reads a screen from six feet away with gloves on. ‍ Whipsaw is a product design and brand consultancy in San Francisco. We take products from first insight to first customer, with one team covering strategy, industrial design, digital experience, brand, packaging, and launch. We've partnered with 350\+ clients, designed 1,000\+ products, and picked up 325\+ design awards along the way. Our clients range from funded startups shipping their first product to established companies building something new. Here's what makes us a little different. The product leads, and the brand follows. Our digital designers sit next to industrial designers and engineers, so the screen on a device and the device itself grow up together. ‍ **Base Salary Range:** $80,000 to $100,000 per year, based on experience and skills **Location:** Hybrid (3\-days in person) at 55 Mississippi Street, San Francisco, CA 94107 ### **What you'll do** You'll work across every phase of a project, usually as part of a small team with a senior or lead designer. **Discover** * Run needs finding and user research: interviews, observation, competitive reviews * Synthesize what you learn into insights, journey maps, and clear problem statements **Define and ideate** * Map flows, information architecture, and wireframes * Use AI tools to generate and stress\-test ideas quickly, then apply your own judgment to pick what's worth pursuing * Explore app concepts and visual directions, from rough sketches to polished comps **Prototype and test** * Build AI\-enabled prototypes that feel real enough to test with users and clients * Plan and run usability and validation testing, then turn findings into design changes * Write front\-end code when it's the fastest way to prove an idea **Refine and ship** * Refine visual design until every state, edge case, and screen size holds up * Design UI microinteractions and motion that make interfaces feel alive and easy to read * Build and maintain design systems that engineering teams can actually use * Create launch assets and motion graphics for product reveals, websites, and campaigns **Work with clients** * Present work in client reviews and workshops, and explain the thinking behind it * Partner with industrial designers, engineers, and brand designers so hardware and software line up ### **What you'll bring** **You'll need** * 2 to 3 years of professional UX/UI experience, at a studio, agency, or in\-house team * A degree in interaction design, HCI, graphic design, industrial design, or a related field * Strong visual craft: type, layout, color, hierarchy, and an eye for detail * A solid grasp of UX process, from research through testing * Fluency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and interactive prototyping * Hands\-on experience using AI tools in your design process, and opinions about where they help and where they don't * Clear communication, both in writing and when presenting to a room * A portfolio that shows your thinking and your polish (more on that below) **Nice to have** * Front\-end coding skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) or experience building in Framer or Webflow * Motion design in After Effects, Rive, Protopie, or similar * Experience designing for hardware, embedded screens, or regulated products like medical devices * Work on a design system used by a real engineering team * Comfort running usability sessions and synthesizing results on your own Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about how you think and how fast you learn than a perfect match.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer

Support Installation Qualification during commissioning and validate updates to equipment strategies and specifications in the CMMS database as needed. * Lead cross\-site reliability initiatives to standardize processes and drive improvements across multiple locations. Assist and support local teams (e.g., plant and project engineering) in identifying, collecting, analyzing, and managing data to reduce failures and improve performance. Provide mentorship and training to junior engineers and field personnel on advanced reliability methodologies and tools. * Create and implement reliability strategies at sites, including Asset Criticality Assessments, Proactive Maintenance (PM) strategies, and Spare Parts analyses. Develop and monitor corporate\-level KPIs, dashboards, and reporting systems to monitor and improve asset performance. Align proactive maintenance strategies (e.g., preventive, and predictive tasks) with asset criticality to ensure efficient and effective processes. Conduct and facilitate Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) for significant or recurring failures, and implement strategy improvements to prevent recurrence * Ensure best practices in CMMS utilization, including maintaining accurate preventive and predictive maintenance procedures as well as asset master data, hierarchy, and configuration. Analyze CMMS data to enhance reliability and reduce maintenance costs while ensuring visibility of performance metrics to site managers. Drive the implementation and sustainability of effective workflow processes, including work request management, work request authorization, work order planning, kitting, scheduling, execution, and documentation/closure * Benchmark asset reliability performance and determine best practices, collaborating closely with local teams. Oversee asset lifecycle management for critical corporate physical assets, focusing on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and long\-term performance optimization. * Develop tools to identify recurring mechanical issues and collaborate with field operations to resolve them effectively. * Manage maintenance program to ensure that the Company remains in compliance with the Long\-Term Service Agreement (LTSA) * Provide preliminary work scopes, estimates and budgeting details of assigned projects or work items * Effectively plan, schedule, and manage multiple capital and operational projects concurrently * Comply with safety and environmental practices in accordance with regulatory and company requirements * Attend safety trainings, maintain required certifications to perform job duties, set example of high safety standards and assist in regulatory inspections * Occasional travel, including overnight visits, to other compressor stations will be required **Requirements \& Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering is required * Minimum of 5 years' experience in engineering is required; at least 3 years' experience in asset reliability engineering is preferred * Certified Maintenance and Reliability Professional accreditation preferred * Must be willing to travel approximately 10\-25% of time * Practical knowledge of relevant industry codes, such as API and ASME, and the application of Non\-Destructive Testing methodologies * Solid understanding of predictive and preventative maintenance programs * Knowledge of maintenance best practices in the chemical industry preferred * Ability to mentor, train, facilitate, and influence others in the use of reliability tools and systems * Experience with Mechanical Integrity and Process Safety Management Programs * Practical understanding Inventory Management * Ability to effectively solve problems and manage multiple priorities and programs * CMMS experience required * Experience with rotating equipment (e.g., pumps and compressors) preferred * Reliability program implementation and oversight experience preferred * Must possess valid driver's license and meet company insurability requirements * Ability to work overtime, weekends, holidays and respond to call outs and emergencies * Knowledge of reading and interpreting charts, assembly and instruction manuals * Ability to work in changing climate conditions * Excellent verbal and written communication skills and fluency in English is required * Must be able to lift, push and pull a minimum of 75 lbs. and be able to work in tight spaces, climb to and work from elevated platforms, ladders, walkways, etc. **Benefits**: This position is located in Austin, Houston, Alice or Midland, Texas and is an in\-office position. Selected candidate is eligible for employer matched 401(k), medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD\&D insurances and other benefit offerings.

jobs.description: Wizard is the AI\-native platform for creative work, starting with professional video: a native C\+\+ editor and headless media runtime that humans, agents, and developers all operate. *Full\-stack engineer with database depth, owning the web platform end\-to\-end: API design, schema, query performance, deploy.* **Why this role matters** ========================= The .wiz semantic project file is our architectural moat — Adobe and DaVinci can't adopt it without starting from zero. Making that moat real outside the desktop app — for collaborative review, on\-set metadata capture, and AI\-native workflows — is what this role does. The clearest example: Wiz\-Live, our concept for collapsing the gap between production and post. Traditional film sets "slate" every take — a clapboard synced to timecode — so editorial, sound, and VFX can recover critical metadata after the fact (scene, take, camera, lens, who's who). It's valuable but slow, so many productions, including our own sister company Story, skip it. Wiz\-Live's bet: link the shotlist directly to camera and computer at the moment of the take, so metadata is captured and attached automatically — with local inference (object detection, character tagging, ASR, proxying) layered on top. Done right, footage could be edited essentially as it's shot, with a rough assembly — director's favorite takes flagged — ready before the crew wraps for the day. None of that works without a schema and pipeline that can take heterogeneous, high\-frequency, on\-set metadata and reliably link it to the right clip, in real time, in a way both editors and Wizard's AI can query later. That's this role. **About the role** ================== Full\-stack web engineer with database depth. Owns the web platform end\-to\-end: API design, schema, query performance, deploy. You'll build the collaborative layer on top of Wizard's primitives — a Frame.io\-and\-Figma hybrid: lightweight, collaborative editing and review tools built on the Wiz CLI the core team is already shipping. **What you'll do** ================== **Future roadmap this role feeds** * Plugins marketplace * Editor client marketplace * Far future: a chat\-based app **What you bring** ================== **Required** * TypeScript * Postgres (or comparable RDBMS) * API design (REST or GraphQL) * Modern web framework (Next.js, Remix, etc.) * CI/CD comfort **Show us what you can do** =========================== **Nice to have** * Realtime infra (websockets, pub/sub) * Vector DB * ML data pipelines * n8n or workflow tooling **About Wizard** ================ Every so often, a new technology redefines how stories get told: the printing press, the telephone, radio, the film camera, the cutting room, television, the digital camera, non\-linear editing. jobs.title: Software Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. Our work helps law firms operate more efficiently and helps the injured people they serve access settlement funds more quickly and accurately. We are looking for a quality engineer who is passionate about building the testing and evaluation that keeps complex, data\-heavy products working correctly at scale. Zipliens is looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team and own quality for a product area within the applications we build for the legal industry. After several years of high growth, Zipliens has become a leader in lien resolution, a process required in most personal injury settlements. The software we build supports that work, so the quality of what we ship has a clear, real\-world impact on law firms and the people they represent. We're scaling engineering significantly this year, and quality engineering is growing along with it. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams and combines exploratory testing with automation. You'd own quality for a feature or product area, including the test strategy, the automation behind it, and the release sign\-off for that area. You'll have established patterns and existing test suites to work from, and you'll help improve them as the team grows. We also build with AI as a first\-class part of the workflow, and that applies to testing as much as to development. Our product uses LLMs to extract structure from medical records and lien correspondence, so evaluating non\-deterministic output is a regular part of the job. We also use agentic coding tools and internal skills and harnesses we've written ourselves to build and maintain automation, and you'd be expected to use those tools well, review what they produce, and help improve them. **Requirements**### **Responsibilities:** * Own quality for a feature or product area, including the risk\-based test strategy, the regression scope, and the release sign\-off for that area. * Build and maintain the automated test suites for your area and keep them integrated with CI. When tests fail or become flaky, you'll troubleshoot them and fix the underlying cause. * Run exploratory testing against the lien workflow and develop a detailed understanding of the applications your team owns, including their risk areas and failure modes. * Test our LLM\-based features. This includes building the evaluation suite for a feature, setting acceptance thresholds with product (for example, precision and recall targets for extraction), checking LLM\-judge agreement against human labels, and adding adversarial and prompt\-injection cases. * Use agentic coding tools to build and maintain automation, and review AI\-generated tests before they merge. * Join refinement early enough to shape Acceptance Criteria with the Product Owner, flag testability gaps before development starts, and recommend coverage and risk priorities for your area. * Shepherd defects for your area from triage through resolution, writing clear, reproducible reports that engineers can act on. * Work directly with the engineers on your team day to day. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams rather than run as a separate function. ### **Qualifications:** * 3\+ years on a QA or software development team, including experience owning test coverage for a feature or product area. * Strong skills in at least one of exploratory testing and test design, test automation and infrastructure, or AI/LLM evaluation, with working proficiency in a second. We don't expect the same depth in all three. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining automated test suites in a modern framework (Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar), including diagnosing flaky tests and fixing their root causes. * Comfortable reading and writing code. Our backend is Python/Django and our frontend is React, and you should be able to read a change in either and understand what it affects and what it puts at risk. * Experience integrating tests into CI pipelines and deciding which checks should gate a merge or a deploy. * Strong SQL. Much of what we test lives in PostgreSQL, and verifying a workflow often means verifying the data it produced as well as what the UI shows. * Hands\-on experience testing LLM or ML features, whether in production or through prototypes and experimentation: building golden datasets, measuring output quality, and understanding how these systems fail. * Experience using or experimenting with agentic coding tools, and good judgment about when their output needs a closer look. * Clear written communication. You'll be writing defect reports, test plans, and release sign\-offs for engineers and product, and explaining risk to non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience testing document processing or extraction from unstructured data. * Experience testing third\-party integrations, especially where the counterparty's documentation isn't solid and you need contract tests, sandboxes, or recorded fixtures to work around it. * Familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes. We have an SRE who owns the cluster \- you won't be running it, but you'll be reading logs and working out where a failure happened in it. * Experience handling sensitive data such as PHI, or working under HIPAA\-style requirements. **Benefits** * Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants * Flexible Spending Accounts (Health \& Dependent Care) * Company\-Paid Short\-Term Disability Coverage * Voluntary Long\-Term Disability, Life, AD\&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options * 401(k) Plan with Company Match * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time \& 10 paid Holidays) * Parental Leave Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $77,000 \- $104,000 annually with an opportunity to earn a discretionary quarterly bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience. Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer\-sponsored visa support now or in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ You will be Doctronic's first dedicated data engineer, and you will own the plumbing end to end: how data moves from our production systems into our lakehouse and warehouse, how it gets transformed into trusted, documented tables, and who can access what. This role serves every team in the company: AI engineering, product, finance, partnerships, and data to name a few. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build reliable, monitored CDC pipelines from our production databases (MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) into our S3 \+ Iceberg lake and Snowflake * Stand up a transformation layer (e.g. dbt) on Snowflake so core business metrics (visits, bookings, revenue, retention) come from tested, version\-controlled models * Select and implement an orchestration tool so pipelines and dashboard refreshes run automatically, with alerting when they break * Design and enforce the access control model for patient data: row/column\-level PHI restrictions, HIPAA Safe Harbor compliance, anonymization pipelines, and account deletion workflows * Establish a single governed copy of production data that analytics, finance, and the AI team all read from * Support the AI team's data needs for model training * Design and build a best\-practice warehouse architecture with clean raw, transformed, and business\-ready layers powering our executive dashboards **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of data engineering experience, including ownership of production data platforms end to end * Strong SQL and Python, with experience building and operating ELT/CDC pipelines (Fivetran, Airbyte, or similar) * Hands\-on experience with a modern lakehouse/warehouse stack: S3, Apache Iceberg, a catalog layer, and Snowflake or an equivalent warehouse * Experience with transformation frameworks (dbt or similar) and orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Glue workflows, or similar) * Solid AWS fundamentals: IAM, Lambda, Kinesis, Glue * A pragmatic, reliability\-first mindset * Comfort operating with high autonomy and minimal specs in a flat, engineering\-first organization * Strong communication skills; you'll work directly with product, marketing, finance, and AI stakeholders **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with HIPAA/PHI data governance, anonymization, or healthcare data * Experience with event/behavioral data pipelines (ClickHouse, GTM/server\-side tracking, CDPs) * Familiarity with ML data workflows: feature pipelines, training datasets, notebook environments (SageMaker, Databricks, Jupyter) * Experience with BI tooling (Metabase or similar) and semantic/metrics layers * Prior experience as the first or only data engineer at a startup **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Base salary range: $200,000 to $275,000 annually, depending on experience, plus meaningful equity * Parental Leave: 12 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender or path to parenthood — no distinction between birthing and non\-birthing parent Compensation Range: $200K \- $275K

jobs.title: Data Engineer Client Data Operations
jobs.description: **An important note before applying:** ***We're a small, growing team, and openings like this can attract 1,000 or more applications. We want to give as many qualified candidates as possible a fair shot, but there's only so much a small team can do when reviewing that volume while also doing the work that's the reason this opportunity exists.******To help, we're using an AI\-powered verbal screening tool where you can talk through your experience and how you approach problems. We know... we know... another AI tool in the hiring process. We're not exactly fans of that either, but we believe it gives more people an opportunity to show us what they know beyond what's on their résumé.*** ***We're not looking for perfect or rehearsed answers. In fact, we'd much rather hear a genuine, imperfect answer than something polished that doesn't really tell us anything. We want to hear about your actual experience, and our team will make the hiring decisions, not the AI.*** ***Please complete the screening questions as part of your application. Quick Apply or Easy Apply submissions without completed responses may not be considered.*** **Data Engineer Client Data Operations** Location: Remote (United States; Dallas, TX area preferred, not required)**About Limetree** ================== Limetree is a performance\-focused marketing agency that blends behavioral science, data, and practical marketing know\-how to help organizations say the right thing, to the right people, in ways that actually work. We specialize in industries where customer interaction is high\-value and high\-stakes, including healthcare, financial services, and other regulated or complex environments. Our work connects insight to action, using behavioral science and data to inform strategy, creative, and delivery in ways that drive measurable outcomes for our clients. Limetree has been recognized multiple times on the Inc. 5000 as well as a national Inc. Best Workplace, and holds multiple patents that inform our approach to marketing performance, decision\-making, and execution.**Role Summary** ================ We are hiring a hands\-on Data Engineer to own how new client data gets into our systems and keep the pipelines behind our direct mail, digital marketing, and reporting work reliable. You will take unfamiliar feeds, make sense of them, build repeatable ingestion processes, and catch problems before they become bad data or missed campaign deliveries. This is a production ownership role. You will be the first person working through data and pipeline failures and, as you learn our processes, take over the technical execution of routine mail drops. You will work closely with our Senior Analytics Engineer, who depends on clean, consistent data for downstream analytics and reporting. This is an individual contributor role, not a people\-management position.**What You Will Do** ==================== **Onboard Client Data** ----------------------- * Set up new feeds from client and vendor systems, including SFTP and scheduled file deliveries; identify source fields, changes, missing data, and inconsistent formats. * Map incoming data into established schemas and tables, identify sensitive fields, and apply approved privacy and access rules. Raise ambiguous data or policy questions before moving forward. * Build the validation and matching steps that make data usable, including record counts, identity matching or LTID assignment, and CASS/NCOA processing where relevant. * Document each feed so someone else can understand the inputs, transformations, checks, outputs, and what to do when it fails. **Build New Pipelines** ----------------------- * Build and extend SQL, Python, and Spark pipelines as we bring on new direct mail and digital clients, using consistent data structures rather than one\-off solutions. * Set up scheduled jobs, file watchers, transformations, testing, and monitoring so new data streams run with minimal manual intervention. * Improve existing pipelines as source files, schemas, tools, and business requirements change. **Keep Production and Campaign Delivery Running** ------------------------------------------------- * Own the day\-to\-day checks and troubleshooting for current Databricks workflows, AWS jobs, and related tools; investigate failures and fix root causes. * Handle schema drift, bad source files, expired credentials, broken dependencies, stale data, and vendor\-tool issues; improve alerts, recovery steps, and runbooks. * Take ownership of routine audience and mail\-drop production, including suppressions, address hygiene, count reconciliation, QC, and vendor file preparation, within established approvals. * Flag risks to scheduled client drops early, explain what is affected, and recommend a safe path to resolution. **Work With the Team** ---------------------- * Hand off reliable, documented data to our Senior Analytics Engineer for downstream modeling, analysis, and reporting; work together when definitions or matching rules need decisions. * Partner with campaign, account, and technical colleagues to clarify requirements and resolve issues without making them chase the status of a feed or delivery. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * First 90 days: Understand the main feeds and drops, take over daily checks, fix production issues with support, and independently set up or improve a client data flow with review. * By six months: Own routine new\-client ingestion and pipeline maintenance, be the first responder for issues, and run standard mail drops with documented quality and release checks. * The result: New client data is repeatable and trustworthy; pipeline failures have a clear owner; routine troubleshooting and drop execution no longer depend on a single senior colleague. **What We Are Looking For** =========================== **Experience and Judgment** --------------------------- * Several years of hands\-on data engineering experience, ideally four or more, including pipelines you have operated in production and failures you personally diagnosed. * Comfort taking a messy or poorly documented source file from first inspection through a reliable production data feed. * Strong attention to detail: you reconcile counts, question suspicious data, and make fixes that prevent a problem from coming back. * Able to work independently, explain technical issues plainly, and know when a business rule or privacy question needs an owner to decide. **Technical Skills** -------------------- * Strong SQL and Python; practical experience with Spark or similar large\-scale data processing. * Production cloud data engineering experience. We currently use Databricks and AWS, but value strong AWS\-native or comparable experience as our platform evolves. * Experience with orchestration, monitoring, schema mapping, file\-based integrations, access controls, Git, testing, and operational documentation. * Careful handling of personally identifiable or protected health information in regulated data environments. **Helpful Background** ====================== * Direct mail and/or digital marketing audience data, including deduplication, suppressions, CASS/NCOA, AccuZIP, AccuTrace, USPS tracking, or digital marketing sources and APIs. * Healthcare, Medicare, or health plan marketing data; SFTP, S3, Parquet, and client\-facing reporting feeds. **Why Join Limetree** ===================== You will own real production work, see the effect of getting data right, and improve the processes as you learn them. We need someone who likes building reliable systems and taking ownership of how they run.**Compensation** ================ Base salary: $115,000\-$145,000, depending on experience and qualifications. eFP00eeEvE

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Traffic Studies
jobs.description: **About Obvio AI** ------------------ Each year, more than 40,000 people in the U.S. leave home and never make it back due to traffic crashes. At Obvio, we believe these deaths are preventable. We deploy solar\-powered, AI\-assisted cameras to enforce traffic laws where pedestrians are most vulnerable, automating enforcement in ways that traditional systems cannot. Our approach has already led to a 50% reduction in reckless driving in early partner cities. Founded by the team behind Motive's AI dashcam and backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Khosla Ventures, we are building the intelligence layer for safer streets globally. **About The Role** ------------------ Obvio's traffic studies team runs short, camera\- and radar\-based data studies that measure speeding, red\-light, stop\-sign and crosswalk behavior at specific locations in a city before any enforcement program starts. Cities rely on these results, so accuracy and timely delivery matter. Today the pipeline works, but it scales with people rather than software. We are hiring a **Full\-Stack Engineer** to change that. You will own the software that takes a study from field deployment to a published report, make the routine path repeatable and largely automated, and make ad\-hoc requests (a new city, a new sensor, a new metric, a tighter timeline) something the system takes on through configuration and small extensions rather than one\-off engineering effort. You will work alongside computer\-vision engineers who hand you detectors and trackers, an annotation team that reviews and audits the results, field operations who deploy the hardware, and a go\-to\-market team that sets delivery dates with cities. Your job is the connective tissue between them. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own the traffic\-study backend end to end:** ingestion from multiple sensor types, vision\-pipeline orchestration on our ML servers and cloud compute, event extraction, annotation hand\-off, statistics, and publishing to the city\-facing portal (e.g., Python services on AWS ECS/EC2, S3 event data, Postgres). * **Scale the routine path:** turn manual steps (stats entry, reprocessing, report assembly) into automated, auditable ones so a study runs the same way every time with minimal engineer involvement. * **Handle ad\-hoc requests:** new sensors (each with its own data layout and quirks), new metrics, new report formats and shorter timelines. Design the system so these become configuration and small extensions rather than rewrites. * **Design and evolve the data model:** schema design, indexing, and query performance on growing Postgres datasets that back both the pipeline and the internal tools built on top of it. * **Own pipeline health:** maintain monitoring and alerting for the vision and event\-extraction services, catch stuck or failed studies early, and drive fixes to root cause. * **Make the numbers defensible:** implement counting and violation logic from written specifications, version it, and make every reported figure traceable to the raw data and the logic that produced it. * **Coordinate across teams:** work with the annotation team on intake, view\-quality gates and delivery dates, and with field operations on deployment timing and data hand\-off; give the go\-to\-market team realistic capacity and lead\-time answers. * **Support internal tooling as a backend:** expose the APIs and data endpoints that the annotation and operations teams' tools (e.g., built in Retool) consume — presentation and review managers, calibration tools, audit dashboards, capacity and status views. **Who You Are** --------------- * **An end\-to\-end owner:** you prefer to be accountable for a whole system and its output rather than a single layer of it. * **Pragmatic:** you balance shipping fixes quickly with leaving the codebase in better shape than you found it. * **Automation\-minded:** when you see a recurring manual step, your instinct is to design it out of the process. * **Rigorous with data:** you understand that an inaccurate count delivered to a city is a credibility problem, and you build for traceability and auditability from the start. * **A clear communicator:** you write things down, make requirements explicit before implementing them, and work well across engineering, annotation, operations and go\-to\-market teams. * **Comfortable with ambiguity:** priorities shift with customer needs, and you can re\-plan without losing momentum. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience with meaningful full\-stack ownership: backend services and data pipelines, plus the internal tools and front ends people use to operate them. * Experience building and operating services on a major cloud (AWS preferred: ECS/EC2, S3, IAM). * Solid database skills: schema design, indexing and query performance on growing datasets (Postgres or similar). * Experience building internal tools or dashboards, whether on a low\-code platform such as Retool or with a modern web framework. * Experience running production systems: monitoring, alerting, incident response and post\-incident fixes. * Experience orchestrating batch or compute\-heavy workloads (job queues, workers, GPU/ML servers, or similar). * Based in Islamabad or Lahore and able to work from the office. **Bonus Points** * Experience with pipelines that consume computer\-vision or sensor outputs (detections, tracks, radar), or with video and imagery at volume. * Experience with data\-quality, annotation or audit workflows. * Familiarity with IoT or edge devices and their operational quirks (timestamps, connectivity, uploads). * Startup or small\-team experience where you owned a system end to end. **Why Obvio** ------------- * Your work will help save lives and improve road safety * Series A of $54M * Fast\-moving startup environment with meaningful ownership * Competitive compensation and early\-stage equity Obvio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Obvio considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. Obvio is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

The provided salary depends on many factors, such as work experience and transferable skills, business needs and impact, location, and market demands.* At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI\-native, full\-stack, multi\-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer\-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer\-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built\-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real\-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM\-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. **Applying to Render** ---------------------- We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. **About the Role** ------------------ Most infrastructure engineers never get to build a cloud from the metal up. At Render, you will. Developers and businesses around the world run their apps on Render, and we are building our own bare metal footprint to give them better performance and economics. You'll help take our first colocation site from an empty cage to production workloads, then scale that foundation as we expand our physical presence to thousands of hosts over the coming years. You'll join a small, experienced team with real ownership. You'll partner closely with network engineering and our Kubernetes platform team, and the decisions you make now will become the template for every site that follows. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Take our first colocation site from empty cage to production workloads, then scale what you build as we grow to more sites and thousands of hosts * Design how servers go from the loading dock to production with minimal human touch: netboot, imaging, BMC\-driven discovery, and host identity * Partner with network engineering on what the fleet needs from the network, from out\-of\-band management to production connectivity * Build the interface our Kubernetes platform team uses to request capacity, see host health, and coordinate maintenance, so consuming bare metal feels as easy as consuming cloud * Own the fleet's source of truth for hardware, software, and the physical environment * Automate the full server lifecycle, from burn\-in and acceptance testing through remediation, staged firmware rollout, and RMA * Build automation like a production system, with guardrails on destructive actions and designs that survive site\-level failure * Shape the technical and operational direction of our bare metal platform, from build\-vs\-buy decisions to how we operate thousands of hosts, and help hire the team that runs it **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Hands\-on experience building and operating automation for bare metal fleets in datacenters or colocation * Both sides of the work: time with physical hardware and colo providers, and modern, software\-driven fleet management * Strong Go or Python, and experience designing systems with reconciliation loops and idempotent, failure\-tolerant actions * Depth below the abstraction: you know what your tools are doing under the hood and can debug them when they fail * Experience operating through real failures, such as bad hardware batches, flapping BMCs, or a rollout you had to halt * Deep Linux knowledge and solid networking fundamentals (DHCP, PXE, DNS, BGP) * Working knowledge of Kubernetes, enough to design the interface between the fleet and the clusters that run on it * Clear communication, comfort with ambiguity, and the willingness to push back on a plan when something doesn't add up **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Operating bare metal fleets at a scale of thousands of hosts * Experience on a bare metal or datacenter build\-out from its early days * Running a hybrid environment, or moving workloads between public cloud and owned hardware * DCIM/IPAM tools such as NetBox or Nautobot, or provisioning stacks such as Ironic/Metal3, Tinkerbell, or MAAS * Building reconcilers or state machines for physical infrastructure * Hardware depth: component diagnostics, burn\-in tooling, firmware, or Redfish and IPMI at fleet scale * Building internal platforms or APIs used by other infrastructure teams * Based near our colocation sites, or able to visit them regularly If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need. **Benefits** ------------ * 4 weeks of paid vacation. * 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return. * Long\-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans. * 100% employer\-paid medical coverage and 99% employer\-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well. * Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc. * Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy. * Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders. * Continuous learning benefits \& related support. *This position is generally not eligible for new visa**sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.* *Render is an equal\-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy\-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.* *We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.* *We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!* Render — CCPA Applicant Privacy Notice Render — GDPR Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $230K \- $290K

jobs.title: Cyber Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** As a Cyber Security Engineer, you’ll strengthen the security of IT infrastructure, networks, and cloud environments. You’ll assess risks, monitor security events, investigate vulnerabilities, and help teams prevent and recover from incidents. Your impact: By detecting threats and improving security controls, you help protect users, systems, and data. This role calls for practical security engineering skills and the ability to work across technical teams. **Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and maintain network, system, endpoint, and cloud security controls, including firewalls, VPNs, identity and access management, and encryption. * Monitor and analyze security information and event management (SIEM) alerts, threat intelligence, and logs; investigate incidents and coordinate response and recovery. * Conduct vulnerability assessments, security assessments, and risk investigations; recommend remediation and support information security compliance. * Maintain security documentation, system security plans, and controls aligned with applicable NIST standards, ISO 27000\-series standards, PCI requirements, and risk management frameworks. * Support secure architecture, system hardening, disaster recovery, and security tool deployment across on\-premises and cloud environments. **Skills** * Essential: Experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, network security, vulnerability management, incident response, security analysis, and IT security monitoring. * Essential: Knowledge of computer networking, LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, network protocols, routing, firewalls, authentication, PKI, and operating systems. * Preferred: Familiarity with Cisco ASA, Cisco ISE, IDS, EDR, Splunk or other SIEM platforms, Nmap, Burp Suite, and vulnerability research. * Preferred: Exposure to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, VMware, Terraform, Linux distributions, Windows, Active Directory, scripting, and CI/CD. * Understanding of information security compliance, security risk assessment, system administration, and standards such as ISO 27001 and ISO 27002\. Pay: $60\.00 \- $65\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

technical depth:** You've worked alongside — or as — a Forward Deployed Engineer, and you're comfortable enough in the technical weeds (APIs, integrations, data structures) to translate between a customer's technical team and Within's product/engineering org without a translator. * **Consulting\-grade problem structuring:** you know how much process rigor a given account actually needs, and you don't over\- or under\-engineer it. * **Executive presence:** You run QBRs and exec readouts as comfortably as a working session with an admin\-level user. * **Sharp analytical thinking:** You reason from usage data and adoption metrics, not vibes, and move between root\-cause detail and the board\-level narrative in one breath. * **Outcome\-oriented and scrappy:** You hypothesize, hustle, in and expand the buying committee. * **Spot and scope expansion:** Surface unaddressed problems mid\-engagement and turn them into a crisply scoped next solution for Sales to sell. * **Improve the conversation without needing to be the one writing the code. * You're commercially minded — you think in NRR, expansion pipeline, and renewal risk, not just satisfaction scores. * You communicate cleanly across altitude: a crisp Slack to a technical admin, a clean board\-ready summary to a sponsor. * You're comfortable in ambiguity — you can scope a problem, build a plan, and move without waiting for perfect information. **What Success Looks Like — Primary KPIs** ------------------------------------------ * **NRR \& GRR** across your $7M–$15M portfolio * **Time\-to\-value / onboarding SLA attainment** across your engagements * **Expansion pipeline sourced and handed to Sales**, and win rate on those opportunities * **Account health / adoption metrics** (usage depth, breadth across
